_doc: The authored world's history (design/gdd/world-generation.md), exported by tools/design/world/export_world.py from design/world/*.json and design/map/continent-11; do not edit by hand. start_year: every game starts here (Core Rule 11). sects: the 30 living sects with their authored start (alignment chinh | ma | trung, the four development levels, treasury, a minor sect's lord and loyalty), seat (place id), founded year, specialty (the sect archetype NPC Builds reads) and leader (a cast key). fallen_sects: sects that fell before the start. people: the fixed cast (alive: realm, home place id, traits; dead: records with peak_realm, died, cause), with master, vassal_of, served_under and abode_slot where authored. events: the landmark chronicle and the annals, ordered by year then id; place is a place id, famous a famous site's name, feature a named feature with its tile; secret events are hidden until discovered. legendary_items: the 34 unique items, held by a living cast member or lost at a place or slot. territory: eras, land changes, wars, vassal changes, grudges. hidden_slots: the 28 hidden places with their 2-3 candidate tiles and origin event; tile_secrets: the 80 with their candidates; famous_sites and features: named sites and features. data_version: a hash of the inputs, recorded in each save (Core Rule 13).

people.name: Doãn Ngọc Hành
people.gloss: Ngọc Hành is the fifth star of the Northern Dipper, the one that weighs
people.role: Head of Thiên Xu Tông and keeper of the Bắc Thần Ấn
people.appearance: A narrow, grey-robed man who looks fifty and always slightly tired, with an accountant's ink-stained middle finger and the stone seal on a cord at his chest.
people.wants: To hand on a Compact that holds without him, and to keep Thính Vũ from the war it is building toward without fighting it.
people.secret: He knows that in 803 the whole guard of Tinh Tủy Mạch was called down to Chiết Kích Nguyên as reinforcements and none came back, so the post stood empty until 806, though no order ever withdrew it (N-thien_xu-04). Under the Compact's own wording an unwatched wild vein might have let Băng Tâm's claim stand. He refused the petition so the Pivot would never lose land by a ruling, and sealed the archive's guard roll for 803 with his own hand. He does not know a second copy was filed among the dead lists of that year, or that it has left the archive. Since a night at the ridge palace in 1154, when Hoa Triêu Dương (hoa_trieu_duong) played him eight airs on what he took for a ridge flute, he cannot hear the seat's single dusk bell without counting eight strokes. He decided for the war the next morning. He lets Bách Vong Ngôn's forbidden zither go, and could not say why. He refuses Ngũ Trấn Bắc's writ each spring because Thính Vũ's spymaster Nhiếp Vô Thanh writes to him through the clerk Tào Mặc Toán, and her numbers are half of Phòng Bách Kế's.

people.name: Đàm Tùng Lại
people.gloss: Tùng lại is the sound of wind in pines
people.role: Head of Tùng Đào Cung since 900; the head who lost the Cold Ford and goes to war only for his vassals
people.appearance: A tall, stooped man with a ferryman's hands, who tilts his head before he speaks as if to catch a sound behind him.
people.wants: To leave a sect that shelters what grows under it rather than one that spreads, and to see Vi Thanh Âm, whom he named heir in 1199, come through the Root Hall's searches whole.
people.secret: He answers none of Ngu's letters because he wrote one in 906, a long one, and the Coiled Root Hall's men took it before it left the palace. It has passed from master to master of that hall, and Nhiếp Cô Tân has held it since 1090. In it Đàm wrote that the Cold Ford was never Tùng Đào's to keep.

people.name: Tô Vãn Chiếu
people.gloss: Vãn chiếu is the glow of the evening sun
people.role: Head of Lạc Hà Tông; the merchant who moved the sect up the mountain
people.appearance: A tall woman in a robe the colour of dusk, a counting ring on each thumb, with Tử Điện worn at her hip like a ledger she never opens.
people.wants: To pay Phan Vật Hoa back before the term ends in 1209 and get the founder's ring out of Thiên Bảo Trai's vault before anyone learns it was there. Her way is thirty outer disciples' contracts, sold to the studio in one lot over and above the spring's placements; she has told Hách Ánh Hà that the list is the list, and has not struck her own kin off it. After that, to see Tử Điện wake, which means bringing its twin home from the poisoned plain.
people.secret: She pledged the Lone Duck Ring, the key to the sect's treasury, as surety for the loan. And she knew of the carved gallery under Vân Kiều before she proposed the move, because Quách Tiếp Vân told her in 1176. The Deep Vein Scripture she reads there alone was as much the reason for the move as the maples.

people.name: Mạnh Dạ Vũ
people.role: Head of Thính Vũ Lâu; proclaimed the Night Rain Edict and moved the halls onto the thunder ridge
people.appearance: A narrow man in a black oiled-silk rain cloak who keeps the spotted-bamboo umbrella furled at his side indoors, and turns his head toward a sound before he turns his eyes.
people.wants: To see the North Star Compact broken without fighting a war he can lose, and to choose his heir before she chooses herself.
people.secret: At Đan Sơn Mạch he ordered Kỷ Vãn Tình's rear guard to hold the pass so the rest could withdraw, knowing the Pivot's arrays would close on it. Mạnh Lưu Ly is her daughter and his. He has told her neither thing.

people.name: Sở Ngọc Hồ
people.gloss: Ngọc hồ is the jade vessel that holds the ice heart (Vương Xương Linh)
people.role: Head of Băng Tâm Các, Keeper of the Vessel
people.appearance: Tall, white-haired since her Kết Đan, with eyes the pale grey of lake ice; she wears the jade vessel at her belt and nothing else of colour.
people.wants: To leave the Pavilion stronger than she found it, and to name an heir who will not need her.
people.secret: She knows the Jade Vessel Array is weakening and has not told the sect, because she does not know how to mend it without Tiết Hàn Mai, who is dying.

people.name: Ngu Lam Sơn
people.gloss: Lam is the blue mist on a mountain
people.role: Head of Thúy Vi Tông; the man who brought the sect down off the ridge
people.appearance: A small, round-shouldered man in a grey robe that is always damp at the hem, with a tea-stained thumb and the White Cloud Whisk pushed through his belt like a fly-swat.
people.wants: To hand the sect to someone who will keep it gentle, then walk into the haze and not come back for a long time.
people.secret: He read the founder's pulse in her last year and felt in it what a Wood root feels on Metal ground; he believes the ridge wore her life down. He moved the sect for that reason, and he has let Cù Thúy Bách believe he moved it for the vein. She knows the same thing, and neither has said it to the other.

people.name: Hoa Triêu Dương
people.gloss: The phoenix sings to the morning sun (Thi Kinh)
people.role: Head of Phượng Minh Cung; keeper of the Tiêu Thiều Quản
people.appearance: Small and quick, with the red-gold colouring of the vent birds and a laugh that carries across a hall; she keeps the panpipes in a plain cloth bag in her sleeve and has never been seen to open it.
people.wants: To make Phượng Minh what its name promises: the sect whose coming means the age is well governed, standing beside the Pivot as the south's judge rather than beneath it.
people.secret: In 1154, the night before Doãn Ngọc Hành decided to bring Thiên Xu into the war, she played him the first eight movements of the Shao on the Tiêu Thiều Quản in the ridge palace. She has never known whether he came for the Compact or for the music, and Thiên Xu destroyed a sect for less. He took the pipes for a ridge flute and has never asked.

people.name: Chung Hoài Cực
people.role: Founder of Thiên Xu Tông (year 120, at 80) and author of the North Star Compact
people.cause: died at 720 in seclusion under Thái Nhất Phong, attempting Hóa Thần

people.name: Kỳ Tùng Ẩn
people.role: Founder of Tùng Đào Cung (year 200, at 130); lies under the oldest pine in the palace yard
people.cause: old age at 620, as the sect records it

people.name: Nhan Cô Vụ
people.gloss: The lone wild duck (Vương Bột: lạc hà dữ cô vụ tề phi)
people.role: Founder of Lạc Hà Tông (year 290, at 140)
people.cause: his lifespan worn down after the field of 803 (C017) took his only child; died on Tịch Chiếu Đảo at 790
people.appearance: Remembered as a thin old man in grass-stained hemp who sat facing west every evening of his life.
people.wants: Dead. In life: to sit where the sun goes down and teach whoever came to sit with him.
people.secret: He wrote in the canon's margin that its upper layers crawl without living Wood, and planted the maples so the sect would never have to read the note; it was found in 1131. And in 802 he had his elders bury an array of rot under Chiết Kích Nguyên, to be sprung if his daughter's field broke. She sprang it. That, more than the silence of the boats, is why he cut the ninth verse. The array drew on its maker: it took two centuries of his life, which is why he died at 790.

people.name: Phó Tiêu Tương
people.gloss: The rain on the Tiêu and Tương rivers
people.role: Founder of Thính Vũ Lâu (year 380, at 140); hung the first rain-chain and kept the withered lotus
people.cause: died at 640 in her third attempt on Hóa Thần, by the lotus on Tàn Hà Hồ
people.appearance: Remembered as a slight woman under a spotted-bamboo umbrella, who would stop speaking in the middle of a sentence when it began to rain.

people.name: Tần Ngưng Sương
people.role: Founder of Băng Tâm Các (year 440, at 140); lies inside the Jade Vessel Array under the seat
people.cause: spent the last of her lifespan into the Jade Vessel Array to hold the lid, and lies inside it (1010, age 710)
people.appearance: Remembered as a slight scholar in southern grey, a jade vessel hung at her waist and ink on her wrist.

people.name: Ngô Thê Đồng
people.gloss: The phoenix perches on the parasol tree
people.role: Founder of Phượng Minh Cung (480, at 150); died on the ridge, where the Wutong Court keeps his ashes
people.cause: a failed breakthrough to Hóa Thần on the ridge, at 770

people.name: Phùng Yên Hà
people.gloss: Mist and rosy cloud; yên hà is also the love of landscape
people.role: Founder of Thúy Vi Tông (year 500, at 140); lies on the ridge under her pine
people.cause: lifespan worn down on the Metal ground of the ridge, which starved her Wood; died at 640

people.name: Mạc Quy Khư
people.gloss: Quy khư is the abyss at the sea's end where all waters return (Liệt Tử)
people.role: The oldest living person (age 1,440): a hermit on Dục Nhật Đảo by the gate of Phù Tang Cảnh, who remembers the world before the sects and answers one question a year
people.appearance: A small brown old man in a fisherman's coat, barefoot on the rocks, who looks no more than seventy until he turns his eyes on you; they hold five colours at once.
people.wants: To give the true answer to one person who will not use it, and to carry the vase back through the gate of Phù Tang Cảnh before he dies.
people.secret: He did not survive his tribulation; the vase did. The Quy Khư Bình drank the bolts meant for him, and what it spilled became the realm of fire and snow. In 699 he told Hoắc Hàn Quang to meet heaven with empty hands, because the truth would have sent every Nguyên Anh alive after the vase. Hoắc left his sword in his cave, and the lightning killed him. Mạc has slept through most of the last three springs, and he does not know that the year's questions have still been answered.

people.name: Thôi Khinh Hồng
people.gloss: Light as a wild goose (Lạc Thần Phú: phiên nhược kinh hồng)
people.role: Disciple of the founder; second head of Tùng Đào Cung (690-900), retired to the retreat at Thính Đào Nhãn; the sect's one Hóa Thần
people.appearance: A small, straight old woman with white hair cut at the jaw, a grey-green sash that stirs when there is no wind, and a wolf's tooth on a cord.
people.wants: To hear the fifteenth layer of the Pine Wave canon before she dies, and to hand it to someone who can hold it without a war.
people.secret: Kỳ Tùng Ẩn did not die of old age. At Thiết Tỏa Quan in 508 Chung Hoài Cực's strike cracked his core (C105), and the wound ate his life for 180 years. He marched on the Cold Ford in 668 knowing he was dying, to leave the sect a coast, and Chung let it stand because he knew it too (C136). She retired in 900 because she could neither order a war to keep land taken that way nor order the sect to give it up.

people.name: Thẩm Bắc Thần
people.gloss: Bắc thần is the pole star that keeps its place while the stars bow to it (Luận Ngữ)
people.role: Head of Củng Tinh Quán since 560, formations and star divination; keeper of the armillary Tuyền Cơ Nghi
people.appearance: A small, bald, very old Daoist with a face like a dried river bed, who looks at people as if they were a little out of focus and the sky behind them were not.
people.wants: To have the new ring found at a dusk winding and the Rudder written into the book as the abbey's oldest knowledge, not its newest shame; and to be heeded once before he dies.
people.secret: Úc Tri Vi (uc_tri_vi) showed him in 650 that Khuy Thiên's star near the pole is real, and he kept it out of the book for 550 years rather than correct the founder's sky and the Pivot's. Since Luân Hải Yến's (luan_hai_yen) sea chart came east he has been recutting the armillary at night: a new inner ring with the star on it and 650 cut on its rim in the old hand, turned by day by Phan Khắc Luân (phan_khac_luan) as a spare. In 1188, on the night Doãn Ngọc Hành held the Bắc Thần Ấn and the Weight in one hand (N-thien_xu-09), the Pole Star went out in the lake. He saw it in the mirror and told no one, because the omen is about the Pivot itself.

people.name: Tống Tọa Vân
people.gloss: Sit and watch the clouds rise (Vương Duy)
people.role: Abbot and founder of Vân Khởi Quán (540); the empty mountain's last student
people.appearance: A thin, very old man in patched grey hemp who walks slowly uphill and sits down wherever the path ends, as if he had been waiting there.
people.wants: To leave the abbey to someone who can sit as Thôi sat, and to die on Thủy Cùng Phong at the place where the water ends.
people.secret: Thôi taught him the first nine layers of the Empty Mountain Sutra before the gift of 500 (the last six went only to Phùng Yên Hà), and Thúy Vi does not know that he has them. Every year since 520, on the night of Thôi's death, a monk of the abbey has gone through the haze behind the sealed gate and read those nine layers aloud in the empty academy, as Tống promised Thôi: on the empty mountain no one is seen, but voices are heard. The traveller of 1195 heard Văn Nhân Hưởng (A048). Thường Độc Hoạt shows the readers the way.

people.name: Phan Vật Hoa
people.gloss: The riches of the land are the treasures of heaven (Vương Bột)
people.role: Mistress of Thiên Bảo Trai since 1050 (A185); holds the season auction, the red gold mine and Lạc Hà's debt of 1179
people.appearance: A small, upright woman who looks forty, dressed in plain grey with a single red-gold pin, whose eyes go to what you are carrying before they go to your face.
people.wants: To own the Lone Duck Ring outright when the loan's term runs out, and with it the key to her lord's treasury. If she must be paid instead, to be paid in people: thirty Lạc Hà contracts that run to 1230, so that her lord's children work her furnace and her floor for a generation after the ring goes home. After that, to be the one house in the west that no sect can afford to quarrel with.
people.secret: She is writing the terms of the thirty-contract lot now, and its one condition is a trap: all thirty signed and delivered by this year's autumn auction, a date the fifty-day road to Cựu Hà Viện barely allows, or nothing is struck off and the term runs on to the ring. She has had Tiền Ngũ Phân price Tô Hiểu Chu, the head's blood, highest of the thirty, so that Lạc Hà keeps him on the list and his father has to sign him away; and she lets Tiền sell Hách Ánh Hà her top price, because it is the price she wants Hách to hear. She knows everything about the debt that her lord does not. Kim Vạn Lý has been buying a third of the notes for Trầm Tịch Dương; she sold them to him at a premium and lets him think she does not know whose they are. Tiền sold Hách the name of the surety in 1180; she kept him on, because a steward with a known price is useful. And in 1190 she had her first refiner cut a second key from the ring. Khang Thiên Chùy told her the copy failed. She believes him.

people.name: Cát Lưu Quang
people.role: Head of Thối Tinh Môn since 1050, weapon forging from star iron; the only smith on the mountain who can hold the Rite of the Fallen Star
people.appearance: A short, thick man with a burnt beard and forearms speckled white with old spark scars, who listens to every blade he picks up before he looks at it.
people.wants: To put the Rite of the Fallen Star into Đinh Hỏa Lân's hands before his own fail, so that the forge fire outlives him, and to keep his first son at the anvil while he does it.
people.secret: Vưu was right. The sky seam of Thiên Ngoại Khoáng gave out in 790 (N-thoi_tinh-04), before he was born; the mine has given mountain iron since, and only the Thanh Bách star sings. The gate has sold the mountain iron to the Pivot as star iron, at star-iron prices, for four centuries, and he still does.

people.name: Thang Vô Tạ
people.gloss: Owes no thanks (from the founder's saying: the fee is the whole of the thanks)
people.role: Head of Phất Y Cốc since 1090, sword cultivation and swordsmen for hire; the valley's one Wind root
people.appearance: A tall, quiet man in an old grey robe with one long sleeve, who stands sideways to everyone as if he were about to leave.
people.wants: To put the whole of the Brushed Sleeve Step into Lộ Khinh Trần before Cửu Cao can say the boy was theirs, and to keep the valley out of the Pivot's war with Thính Vũ.
people.secret: Since the winter of 1199 he has held the founder's robe open for Lộ Khinh Trần, whose breath of Wind is far under the bar the robe answers to, by lending each fold his own Wind. Each fold costs him what a season of seclusion would have given him, and the boy bleeds at the nose after it; Liêu Vọng Phong (lieu_vong_phong) holds the lamp at the hall door. And he lost on Cùng Mục Phong: on the third day Tư Không cut his left sleeve through and then lowered his sword, called it even and walked away without a sect, so that the valley would keep its head. The mended seam is under his arm.

people.name: Ung Hạc Minh
people.role: Head of Cửu Cao Phái since 1095, crane riders and beast tamers; rider of the crane king Thanh Điền
people.appearance: A wiry, weathered woman with a laugh that carries across the marsh, crane down caught in her braid and a small bronze bell at her belt.
people.wants: To bring the old cranes home from the vein circuit before it kills them, without failing the Pivot.
people.secret: The founder's flight ledger for 803-806 records Tinh Tủy Mạch flown over every week and found empty: no guard, no fire, no tents. She knows the Pivot's watch was not kept, and she has not told Hình Thủ Tinh, who believes it has never been withdrawn.

people.name: Kiều Nguyệt Châu
people.role: Mistress of Hàm Nguyệt Trang since 1150: the moon pool, the spirit fish and the pearl beds of Hạo Nguyệt Hồ
people.appearance: A broad, unhurried woman with a diver's shoulders and a pearl in each ear the size of a quail's egg, who laughs before she says no.
people.wants: To find someone who will teach her grand-niece Ice before the girl's frost goes to waste in the pines, and to keep the manor a manor, not a room of the Lake Hall.
people.secret: Half of the doubled harvest comes from beds off the north shore that Băng Tâm may fish since 944 (C171). Since 1152 Lục Hàn Chu's skiffs have left them alone, and he takes one pearl in ten. That is why the manor's numbers never match the Lake Hall's. To make the tenth and the tithe both, she has had the shallows below the stilt-halls overseeded this year, and the spirit fish that feed there are dying.

people.name: Hà Thính Tùng
people.gloss: Listens to the pines (Lý Bạch: như thính vạn hác tùng)
people.role: Head of Vạn Hác Viện, the zither academy of the ravines; the one living player who has played its canon to the end
people.appearance: A long, thin old man with nails grown hard as plectra and a habit of tapping out the rhythm of whoever is speaking to him.
people.wants: To hear Quan Tịch Âm play the twelfth movement through to dawn, and to fill the terraces with good ears while the pines argue about it.
people.secret: In 1162 Vi Thanh Âm played him a piece in the academy's tablature that was not music. He recognised the rhythm of the pines' unwritten canon and understood what she was writing. He has told no one, and he has not decided whether that was kindness or a crime against his lord.

people.name: Nghiêm Linh Chi
people.role: Valley-mistress of Thải Chi Cốc since 1000: the herb terraces, the pills, and the river's orphans
people.appearance: A square, sun-browned woman in a field apron, with soil under her nails and a gourd at her hip that smells of every herb at once.
people.wants: To keep every child carried up the river, and to bring Lữ Niệm Hà's brother home from Lạc Hà before one of them dies.
people.secret: Since 1176 the River Hall's grain has been paid for with the oldest orphans' days on its dikes, and the valley keeps the wages left over. She read the first contract, in the autumn the grain ran short, and she has sealed every one since on the landing without opening it.

people.name: Giang Cửu Khúc
people.gloss: The nine bends of the river
people.role: Ferry master of Lãng Đào Môn since 1010: the nine landings, the river tolls and the rebuilt fleet
people.appearance: A barrel of a man with a river-boatman's tan and a voice that carries across three bends, who wears the toll seal on a cord round his wrist.
people.wants: Lữ Tẫn Chu home on a Lãng Đào ferry, the fleet back to its old size, and the Ngư Ca tolls whole again.
people.secret: The toll quarrel that started the Ferry War was his. For ten years before 1172 he charged Lạc Hà's boats at the Ngư Ca landing a toll the pines never set, and kept it. The pines went to war for his greed and he let them believe it was for his honour. Every spring letter he sends Lữ Tẫn Chu offers the boy a boat of his own, and Lữ has never answered one.

people.name: Bùi Phiêu Bình
people.role: Head of Bình Thủy Môn since 1110 (A156); master of the strait crossing and the sect's sea trade
people.appearance: A brown, loose-jointed man who looks fifty, with salt in his beard, a sailcloth fan in his belt and a laugh that carries across a harbour.
people.wants: To keep the crossing running every day until someone better takes the oar, and to see the whale-child Sa Kình Nhi build a foundation before he dies.
people.secret: He still has the ledger Phong Ý Nhàn gave him. Its last pages, which he learned to read at forty, record what the Geese Hall drew from Vô Định's stores in the spring of 802 under the founder's seal: nine hundred jars of grave-lotus resin and the stones of a buried array. He knows what rose over Chiết Kích Nguyên. He has shown it to no one, not even Trầm Tịch Dương, whose wife saved him.

people.name: Khấu Mục Vân
people.role: Head of Mục Vân Trang since 1060; horse lord of the western plain
people.appearance: A big, slow, sun-creased man in a felt coat that smells of horse, who looks at people the way he looks at colts, for a long time before he decides.
people.wants: To have the three stones paid back, with interest, by Trầm Tịch Dương's own hand, at a festival, in front of a herder. After that, nothing much.
people.secret: Đạp Vân is failing. Thôi Dương Giác's book told him why a spirit foal born on his night answers only him: the horse's Wind and his are one thread. He expects that when the horse dies, he will not be long behind it, and he has told no one, not even his daughter.

people.name: Châu Phi Vân
people.gloss: Flying clouds (Vương Bột: họa đống triêu phi Nam Phố vân)
people.role: Hall-mistress of Nam Phố Đường since 1100; the west's talisman maker
people.appearance: A slight woman with ink-grey fingertips and her hair pinned with a brush, who rises before the birds and has not missed a dawn in two hundred years.
people.wants: To meet the lord's war orders without painting another fire talisman, and to paint the whole Painted Beams talisman once, dawn and dusk together, before she dies.
people.secret: Every year since 1175 she has sent Lãng Đào's head Giang Cửu Khúc an unsigned bundle of ward talismans for his rebuilt ferries, stamped with no seal. Lạc Hà's enemy's boats sail under her wards. She has also 'lost' four of Lạc Hà's war orders since the Ferry War; her elder Kha Triêu Phi keeps a record of them and has told her that a fifth sends it to the Vassal Hall.

people.name: Úc Diệp Thanh
people.gloss: The sound of rain on leaves (Tô Thức)
people.role: Head of Xuyên Lâm Môn since 1170: staff and footwork, guides through the rain forest; the Tower's chính vassal and its least willing one
people.appearance: A broad, weathered man in a straw cape with a bamboo staff worn pale at the grip, who walks everywhere and is never out of breath.
people.wants: His nephew home and the Gate out from under the Tower without a war; and, for himself, someone who can teach the Thunder in his root.
people.secret: Khúc Phụ Thạch's daughter passes him the dates of the Tower's storm drills. While the Tower's Thunder disciples are up on Liệt Khuyết Phong, he searches the Gate's mines for the door Hầu Xuân Lôi sealed in 470 (C035). He has heard drumming under Tử Tinh Khoáng, and he wants what is behind it for his own root, not for the Gate.

people.name: Nghê Hồng Đậu
people.gloss: The red bean of longing (Vương Duy)
people.role: Mistress of Hồng Đậu Trang since 910: poisons and charms behind a gracious door (ma đạo); holder of Phi Hồng
people.appearance: A tall woman in red silk with a voice like warm water, who pours tea with both hands and has not aged a day in three hundred years.
people.wants: Tàn Hồng, the other sword. With both she could call herself heir of Lạc Anh Phái, and with that name claim the forest that the Pivot gave the Tower in 620.
people.secret: Her daughter's father is Ô Thiềm Tử, and he has never been told. And the guests who stay too long are not dead: they tend the beans in the back garden, under the charm of the second cup.

people.name: Thái Lê Tuyết
people.role: Abbess of Lê Hoa Am since 1020; keeper of the seal on Hoắc Hàn Quang's cave
people.appearance: A small, straight old woman with a shaved head under a white hood, whose hands are always cold and whose voice is always warm.
people.wants: To answer the Hall of Cold Law at Hòe Âm without opening the mountain, and to finish teaching Ứng Lê Âm the Sealed Cold Sutra before she rides down.
people.secret: She has written two answers for the Hall and signed neither. One swears the gate is barred to men, which is a lie. The other names the sword above the gate and the master the mountain does not speak of. In 1150 she turned the Tiêu boy away because the first thing he asked her was where the cold light was.

people.name: Đoàn Thanh Lãng
people.gloss: Clear waves (Khuất Nguyên: when the water is clear, wash your hat strings)
people.role: Head of Trạc Anh Đài since 1080; sea hunter of the frost coast; sworn brother of Băng Tâm's Thẩm Hàn Giang
people.appearance: A thick, quiet man with a seal hunter's squint and a white hide coat, who stands in freezing surf as if it were a warm bath.
people.wants: To keep the terrace from selling the Old Ivory's calf to Thiên Bảo, and to keep it out of the Pavilion's succession. Under that, to meet the Old Ivory once more in a boat and learn whether he would throw the iron or cut again.
people.secret: He knows Liễu Ngư Ca is Hàn Giang Môn's heir and has sworn to fight for him. Thẩm does not know he knows.

people.name: Hạng Dạ Bôi
people.role: Founder (970) and head of Dạ Quang Môn; the desert raider who knelt to Băng Tâm in 1121
people.appearance: A huge grey-bearded rider with a burn across one side of his face and a jade cup that glows on his belt at night.
people.wants: His son home before he dies, and one day to watch the Keeper of the Vessel kneel.
people.secret: The Pavilion burned the wrong fort. Dạ Quang's real hoard lies under the sand at Mai Sa Bảo, buried in 1050 (V073): enough stones to hire a war.

people.name: Đồng Hồng Lô
people.role: Head of Hồng Lô Cốc since 930 (A028); the furnace that is said never to cool
people.appearance: A short, broad old man with a burn-glazed face and no eyebrows, who carries a bronze censer on his belt and warms his hands on it while he talks.
people.wants: To form his Nascent Soul over the Red Furnace before his years run out, as Úy Thanh Diễm did over the green one.
people.secret: The bill of sale he sealed in 1144 gives Băng Tâm one boat of ash at the 1144 price in every ten years. This season Viên Chước has come for a whole boat, and Đồng is making up the difference to the ash count from the fire jade he saved for his Nascent Soul pill. Phòng Tẫn Thủ sells it for him to the outside crews.

people.name: Mai Lễ Tuyền
people.role: Head of Lễ Tuyền Phái since 930; healer of the plain, and the midwife who delivered the palace's head
people.appearance: A round, laughing old woman with plum blossom pinned in white hair, a gourd on one hip and a roll of needles on the other, who smells faintly of wine at every hour.
people.wants: For the school to be remembered for its healers, not its wine.
people.secret: The sweet spring cannot give a hundred jars a year. Since 1141 the cellars have cut it with lake water carted a fortnight's road up from Triêu Hà Hồ in barrels sealed as the healers' tinctures, and the Pivot's wine is half lake. She allowed it, because the other choice was telling the Pivot no. That, not the healers' qi, is why she moved the hall to the lake: the barrels are filled where the healers live, and nobody asks what a sick-hall sends. The Pivot has known since 1192 and fines the school forty pure jars a year. Since the fine first fell short in 1198 she has poured the founder's own last wine into the steward's count, two jars each short spring, from the store kept under the Spring House for the school's dead. Eleven are left.

people.name: Ninh Trúc Thực
people.gloss: The bamboo seed the phoenix eats (Trang Tử)
people.role: Head of Trúc Thực Viên since 1050; the spirit farmer who makes the bamboo seed every year
people.appearance: A broad, slow man with mud dried grey to the knee, a straw hat on his back and a red clay censer hung from his belt like a lantern.
people.wants: To find one disciple who can carry the censer into the grove after him.
people.secret: He has not bred a new bamboo. It is the old sixty-year grove, forced to seed every spring by his Fire. When he stops, every clump will flower at once and die, and the rats will come as they did in 990, but worse, because they have been breeding on the yearly seed for 150 years.

people.name: Hùng Phần Vũ
people.gloss: Burns the feathers to be reborn
people.role: Founder (1020) and head of Phần Vũ Đường; keeper of the Xích Hà Kỳ; a body cultivator of the vents
people.appearance: A bull-necked man with arms burned to a glossy red to the shoulder, who sits on the floor in his own hall because chairs break.
people.wants: His daughter home, and a hall that holds its own vents and is not a tenant at the palace's door.
people.secret: He did not read the Burning Feather Body off the red-stone walls. The founder gave it to him in 1020 with the banner, out of the Hall of Spoils: it is Xích Thành Môn's body canon. The one condition was that Phần Vũ never call itself Xích Thành's heir. The palace wanted the vents held by someone who owed it, and Xích Thành's arts kept where its own disciples would not be seen learning them. This spring he wrote that gift into the hall's answer to the palace's rent, one line in the lease, and the treasurer who keeps the Hall of Spoils' book knows what it means.

people.name: Quý Trường Kích
people.role: Thiên Xu Tông's war marshal in the War of Broken Halberds; held the ramparts of Cố Lũy
people.cause: fell at Chiết Kích Nguyên (age 243); buried in the Barrow of Ten Thousand Bones

people.name: Khương Vọng Nguyệt
people.role: Last head of Lạc Anh Phái (vanished sect, ruin slot V-1)
people.cause: vanished when Lạc Anh Phái split; presumed dead (age 210)

people.name: Hầu Xuân Lôi
people.role: Last head of Khải Lôi Môn (vanished sect, ruin slot V-2)
people.cause: struck down by his own tribulation (age 360)

people.name: Lạc Thiều Âm
people.gloss: The sound of the Shao court music
people.role: Last head of Cửu Thiều Cung (vanished sect, ruin slot V-3)
people.cause: fell in the War of the Nine Shao, the sect's last stand (age 280)

people.name: Mã Viễn Ảnh
people.gloss: A distant shadow of a sail
people.role: Last head of Cô Phàm Các (vanished sect, ruin slot V-4)
people.cause: lost at sea with the sect's fleet (age 145)

people.name: Hoắc Hàn Quang
people.role: A wandering ice swordsman; owner of the sealed cave abode in slot A-1, on the southern massif of Ngọc Hồ Sơn above the gate of Lê Hoa Am
people.cause: died in a failed Hóa Thần breakthrough tribulation (age 550)

people.name: Cao Đan Hà
people.gloss: Red glow of the evening sky
people.role: The most famous alchemist of her age; owner of the cave abode in slot A-2, in the southern mountains
people.cause: poisoned by her own pill (age 500)

people.name: Lôi Vô Danh
people.role: Quý Trường Kích's lieutenant, who survived Chiết Kích Nguyên and hid with the Thiết Mã banner; owner of the cave abode in slot A-3 (Thiên Tuyền Nguyên)
people.cause: the miasma he carried off Chiết Kích Nguyên in 803, which ate at his core for 147 years (C023, reworded 2026-11-25)

people.name: Cung Hỏa Vân
people.role: A fire cultivator; owner of the cave abode in slot A-4, among the vents of Tuyết Hỏa Giác
people.cause: vanished among the volcanic vents; his body was found years later (age 340)

people.name: Lương Lạc Mai
people.role: A wandering swordswoman; owner of the cave abode in slot A-5, in the southern mountains
people.cause: found dead in her sealed abode, cause unknown (age 460)

people.name: Mặc Huyết Sinh
people.role: A ma đạo master; owner of the cave abode in slot A-6; author of the Blood-Ink Canon
people.cause: killed by a coalition of righteous sects (age 590)

people.name: Đỗ Tinh Hà
people.role: First elder of Thiên Xu Tông (age 640); its second head, 760-1150, who stepped down for his disciple
people.appearance: Huge and slow, with a miner's shoulders and a seam of grey scar from collarbone to ear; he carries the rebel's spear like a walking staff.
people.wants: To find the Thiết Mã banner and tally before he dies, and to bury them with Quý under the barrow.
people.secret: He gave the order that sent Quý's army down onto Chiết Kích Nguyên knowing Lạc Hà's miasma array was laid there, because a war ended in one day was cheaper than ten more years of it. Lôi Vô Danh heard him give it, and took the banner so that no one could ever send that army anywhere again.

people.name: Hồ Tùng Nguyệt
people.role: First elder of Tùng Đào Cung (age 400) and keeper of the Hall of Voices, where the unwritten canon is taught
people.appearance: A plump, quick woman in grey-green with a teaching fan always in her hand, who laughs before she answers and remembers what you told her forty years ago.
people.wants: To know how much of the pines' canon Thúy Vi has written down from the Cold Ford families, and to bring that book home or burn it.
people.secret: She pays the spy from the Coiled Root Hall's purse, telling Nhiếp Cô Tân the boy is learning Thúy Vi's Haze Walk for his winter crossing. She has no intention of giving Nhiếp the Walk. What she asks the boy for, in every letter, is the shelf list.

people.name: Trầm Tịch Dương
people.role: First elder of Lạc Hà Tông and keeper of the treasury; its second head (940-1160)
people.appearance: A heavy, slow man in a plain brown robe, with a string of bone counting rods at his neck that clicks when he breathes.
people.wants: To see the Lone Duck Ring back in the treasury vault, where the founder left it, before he dies; and never to pay for another war.
people.secret: For twenty years he has been buying up Lạc Hà's debt to Thiên Bảo Trai a note at a time, through Kim Vạn Lý, out of a private hoard he began in 803. The sect calls it greed. He now holds a third of the loan, so a third of the interest the head pays goes to him, and she does not know her creditor is her own master. He means to tear the notes up on the day the ring comes home.

people.name: Quan Vũ Thanh
people.role: First elder of Thính Vũ Lâu (age 420); keeper of the old tower, the founder's grave and the south
people.appearance: A silver-haired woman with a soft voice and a straight back, who wears nine spare bronze links at her belt and an old straw rain hat she will not replace.
people.wants: A peace with Phượng Minh before her years run out, and the Tower's halls brought home to the rain.
people.secret: Phượng Minh did answer. Its first elder Vu Ngô Đồng gave her terms in 1185: peace for a fifth of Kinh Lôi Mạch's yield. She knew the head would refuse and would use the offer as proof of weakness, so she has kept the terms in her sleeve for fifteen years.

people.name: Tiết Hàn Mai
people.role: First elder of Băng Tâm Các and keeper of the Jade Vessel Array (age 440)
people.appearance: Thin and stooped now, her hands always cold, a frost-silk sash knotted the old way; she smells of the pine tea she brews for the grand elder.
people.wants: Time: a Nguyên Anh breakthrough, or a disciple careful enough to hold the Array after her.
people.secret: She has felt three of the Array's nodes go warm since 1199 and has told only the grand elder.

people.name: Quyền Thanh Lam
people.role: First elder of Thúy Vi Tông; master of the Field Hall: grain, herbs and spirit fields
people.appearance: Broad and slow, brown as a field in winter, with lime-burn scars on both forearms and soil under his nails that never washes out.
people.wants: To see the sect's fields feed it without buying a single grain, and to see his daughter reach Kết Đan before he dies.
people.secret: In 1006 he held back three baskets of the ridge's soil and buried them under the head's new hall, at Cù Thúy Bách's request, so that the founder's ground would lie under the sect wherever it went. Ngu does not know.

people.name: Vu Ngô Đồng
people.gloss: The parasol tree where the phoenix perches
people.role: First elder; keeper of the Wutong Court (the old seat) and the palace's spirit birds
people.appearance: A big, loud man in a green robe streaked with bird lime, with a red-crested spirit bird on each shoulder and seeds in every pocket.
people.wants: To see the head come back up the ridge, and to reach Nguyên Anh before the tree dies.
people.secret: The great wutong the old palace is built around is dying. For thirty years he has fed it his own Wood qi every night, and that is why his Kết Đan has stopped.

people.name: Doãn Hi Hòa
people.role: The head's disciple, named heir aloud in 1190 and not yet confirmed, age 70
people.appearance: Tall and quick, sun-browned, hair tied up with a gold cord; she is always the first on the training floor and the last to leave.
people.wants: To be confirmed before the seven seals at Thạch Kiều, and to form her core before she is ninety.
people.secret: Nhiếp Minh Tiễn lets her into the war-writ office at night. She has read every one of Ngũ Trấn Bắc's yearly writs against Thính Vũ, and she agrees with them.

people.name: Đàm Thanh Giang
people.role: The head's last disciple (age 90), a healer at the Pill Room's second furnace
people.appearance: A soft-spoken young man with a ferryman's sunburn that never fades and herb stains up to the wrist.
people.wants: To brew a pill that mends a cracked foundation, and to stand on the ice one winter without having to leave at dawn.
people.secret: Since 1190 he has brewed the Coiled Root Hall's winter wound pills one grade weak, so that no patrol he heals can hold out a night on the river-mouth ice where he meets Hướng Vãn Chu; Nhiếp Cô Tân thinks the frost-root is poor.

people.name: Tô Mộ Vân
people.role: The head's youngest disciple, age 24: the world's brightest young talent
people.appearance: A small, quick young woman with ink on her fingertips and a red jasper seal on a cord round her wrist.
people.wants: To build a perfect foundation on the Cloud Bridge at dusk, and to draw a talisman that keeps the evening glow after dark.
people.secret: Five years ago she followed the head into the locked gallery under the seat and read the first lines of the carving there by the head's lamp. The head did not see her. She has the lines by heart. She does not know they are the Deep Vein Scripture, the head's own secret art.

people.name: Mạnh Lưu Ly
people.role: The head's disciple, age 140, ambitious; rival of her master for the sect's future; the only root in the Tower that can hold the whole lineage
people.appearance: Small and quick, with skin so pale the veins show blue at her temples, and a sword of thin violet glass that hums before every storm.
people.wants: To be head while her master is alive to watch it, and to hold the whole lineage, sutra and canon, as no one has since the founder.
people.secret: She found her mother's letters in 1157. She knows she is the head's daughter, and she knows who ordered the rear guard to hold. She has decided nothing yet, and her master does not know she knows.

people.name: Sở Hàn Y
people.role: The head's disciple, age 60
people.appearance: A grave young woman in undyed white who wears the winter robe her name means even in summer.
people.wants: To be worthy of the surname.
people.secret: For three winters she has followed the Keeper and Tiết Hàn Mai under the seat and learned eleven of the 108 nodes by touch, more than anyone alive but Tiết. Tiết hears her behind them and walks slower.

people.name: Tư Không Hạc Niên
people.role: A wandering sword sage (age 500), bound to no sect; sits in the market of Tống Khách Thị and teaches no one
people.appearance: A tall, stooped man in a grey travelling coat with a crane on the sword guard at his back, who sits at the same corner table every day with one cup and does not drink from it until dusk.
people.wants: To see Cô Hạc's wind woken once, in a Wind-rooted hand that deserves his master's sword, before he lays it down; and the fruit's price paid. In 1088 its price was the first disciple Lăng Đạp Tuyết would ever make, and at the new year of 1200 he wrote from the market for Phó Ngạo Sương by name, by way of a Băng Tâm envoy to the pines.
people.secret: The traveller the market toasts (A138) was his master, the founder of Phất Y Cốc, who lived 110 years past the day his valley counts as his death. On Cùng Mục Phong Tư Không won, by cutting his own master's sleeve. He also knows what the Metal he put into Lăng Đạp Tuyết's root cost the boy in years, which Lăng has told no one.

people.name: Triệu Huyết Y
people.role: The last disciple of the ma đạo master Mặc Huyết Sinh (age 260), hunting for her master's abode
people.appearance: A tall woman with a quiet, pleasant face, always in a red robe that has darkened to the colour of old liver; a silver needle holds up her hair.
people.wants: To find the abode, read the walls and finish the canon; and to make Sở Ngọc Hồ's own disciple its next reader.
people.secret: She does not know the way to her master's abode, and the one man who does is the hound she most wants dead. Two of her three mountains are in the Pavilion's ground, which is half of why she courts Cung. The other half is that Cung is the first person since Mặc who understands her, and she has begun to teach her honestly. She has kept every letter Khang Tẩy Kim has sent her.

people.name: Lạc Đan Thanh
people.gloss: Vermilion and blue pigments; a painter's fame
people.role: The pill-seller of Vật Hoa Thị: a pigment-grinder's son who charges whatever he likes, and holder of the only map of the Peach Spring
people.appearance: A round, cheerful man with vermilion under his fingernails that no washing removes, who wears a painter's smock over a silk robe worth a house.
people.wants: To go into the Peach Spring when it opens in 1200 and come out remembering the way; failing that, to sell the painting for more than any lot has ever fetched at Vật Hoa Thị. This spring he sent Diêm Tử Tô word that he will tell him what Vi Ngưng Yên asked for in 1150, for one pill brewed in the Cold Furnace, for himself.
people.secret: He has been inside Đào Nguyên Cảnh once, at the opening of 1120, and came out with three peach stones and no memory of the road, as everyone does. The pill that made his name after 1120 is ground from those kernels, and one stone is left. His ledger of 1150 shows that Vi Ngưng Yên asked for the dusk herb by name, and that he wrote a warning beside the sale. He has never shown it, because it would clear him and shame her. The breakthrough pills he sells to cultivators who have already failed once hold a soul thread he buys each year from Hám Tàn Chung (ham_tan_chung) in the same market as the apricot clinic.

people.name: Giả Hồi Xuân
people.role: Healer of Hạnh Hoa Thị, the apricot-blossom market: cures what the alchemists of three sects will not touch
people.appearance: Small and plain, in a robe the colour of apricot blossom gone brown, with a roll of needles at her hip and lips faintly blue.
people.wants: To leave the clinic and the tree to Nhiêu Tử Uyển (nhieu_tu_uyen), and to teach her to cure without tasting.
people.secret: She learns each new poison Ô Thiềm Tử sends by tasting it first. A hundred and fifty years of them sit in her meridians, held down by her own needles, and that is why her lips are blue. She has perhaps forty years left, not three hundred, and has told only the abbess. She also knows how to wake the gardener Tề Vong Quy (te_vong_quy) and has not done it: his daughter asked, and his mistress did not.

people.name: Kim Vạn Lý
people.role: The richest merchant of the western plains: wool, wine, hulls and other people's debts, out of Nhạn Thanh Thành
people.appearance: A big, laughing man in plain wool with one gold coin on a cord at his throat, who remembers the name of every herder's child on the plain.
people.wants: To hand Kim Tích Phúc a house that does not need its founder, and to be buried with more owed to him than he owes.
people.secret: Since the cold year of 1120 (A171) killed the herds he had paid for, the house has run on credit from Từ Bỉnh Quyền (tu_binh_quyen) of Thiên Quyền Thị. He pays no debt until it is called. The lost bets are the one payment he never delays: losing to a sect head at her own festival is a gift no treasurer can call a bribe, and it buys the patience of everyone who could call his loans. Trầm's money sits in his hands for months between purchases, and he has used it to cover his own payments, though he has never yet failed to pass it on.

people.name: Đoạn Thương Hải
people.role: The only man to survive a Hóa Thần tribulation that killed his master (age 480); blind since, lives by the pool of Đàm Ảnh Thành
people.appearance: A broad, still man with burn-white eyes and a lightning scar from crown to collarbone, who sits on the pool's stone lip with his head tilted as if someone were speaking very quietly.
people.wants: To hear the sail again, and to learn whether his master was right about where the fleet went.
people.secret: He knows how he lived: the mirror drank the strike meant for him, and he has guessed that something drank Mạc Quy Khư's. He has told no one, because every Nguyên Anh on the continent would come for the mirror. He also knows that Diệp Tố Quyên did paint the morning of 705 for him in 1062. He heard the paper burn, and he let her tell him it had failed.

people.name: Vệ Văn Cơ
people.gloss: Letters and the loom of fate
people.role: A formation master for hire out of Tinh Hán Thành; Củng Tinh Quán's runaway, who sells the abbey's craft by the stone
people.appearance: Thin and stooped from a life bent over stones, in sand-coloured robes, with a habit of drawing figures in any dust he sits beside.
people.wants: To be paid for the Cloud Bridge's outer ring, and to stand once more in Củng Tinh's armillary hall before he dies.
people.secret: The old wards around the Vạn Cốt Trủng are written in Củng Tinh's star-script, and their cornerstone carries his master's mark from 806: Thẩm Bắc Thần laid the barrow's wards for the Pivot after the war. They are failing on the side that faces the old field. Vệ would not be paid to unmake his master's work, and he has not written to ask why it was laid the way it was.

people.name: Lâm Dã Hạc
people.gloss: A crane in the wild woods
people.role: A woodcutter's son with iron bones; the strongest loose cultivator of the pine sea, whom Tuần Tùng Đường wants for its Golden Core
people.appearance: Broad, sun-dark and bareheaded in all weathers, with a woodcutter's shoulders, his father's axe across his back, and the top of his left ear gone where a wolf caught it in 1190.
people.wants: A Golden Core on his own road, and then a Profound Metal method to carry him past the sixth layer of a Yellow one. He will not kneel to a sect for either.
people.secret: His foundation has a hairline crack from the cheap pill, and he knows a Kết Đan breakthrough on it may kill him. He has told no one, least of all Hứa Vãn Cung, who is waiting for him to try.

people.name: Cố Dạ Lan
people.role: War elder of Thính Vũ Lâu (age 560); came home at the Night Rain Edict in 906 and has never lost a duel
people.appearance: A tall, grey-haired woman with a smith's forearms and a miner's squint, who stands with her weight back and her sword hand always empty.
people.wants: One duel with Doãn Ngọc Hành, or with the wandering sword sage Tư Không Hạc Niên: the only two swords left she has not measured.
people.secret: In 951 she stood at the door of the guest master Văn Hải Khô's seclusion cell while the head drained him and took the Hollow Tide Scripture. The Tower was told he died of a deviation. She would keep the door again.

people.name: Lệ Tiêu Hồn
people.gloss: The soul melts away (Giang Yêm, Biệt Phú)
people.role: Master of the soul vaults and keeper of Kinh Lôi Mạch (age 380); heads the Thunder Hall
people.appearance: A thin, stooped man with bronze-stained fingers and white eyebrows, who smells of lamp oil and speaks so quietly that people lean in.
people.wants: The Xuân Lôi Cổ and the rest of Khải Lôi's canon, sealed inside the ridge in 470 (C035), and with them a way through his own tribulation.
people.secret: He has lit a lamp for the head. He took the hair for it in 1156, while Mạnh Dạ Vũ lay wounded after Đan Sơn Mạch. The vault law says a head has no lamp, and no one else knows this one burns.

people.name: Lý Hận Bích
people.gloss: The blood of resentment turns to jade (Lý Hạ: hận huyết thiên niên thổ trung bích)
people.role: Founder and head of Thu Phần Các (960): soul arts and grave wards among the graves of Lôi Trạch Thành (ma đạo)
people.appearance: A gaunt woman in undyed hemp mourning, with grave-earth in the hem and a small bronze bell at her wrist that rings when no one moves.
people.wants: To hear the oldest song of Lôi Trạch to its end before it is drunk dry, and to see a whole stone of grave jade ripen in her lifetime, not a fleck.
people.secret: The oldest graves do not sing poems. They sing what their head was chanting when his tribulation burned the city: passages of Khải Lôi's own canon. Cơ Ký Âm has written them down. She has sealed his copybooks and told the Tower nothing. And she has the river's drowned and the hamlet's unclaimed dead laid in the jade beds to be sung, though the abbess of Cốc Vũ pays rice every autumn for them to lie at the edge; the rice buys her censers.

people.name: Lăng Đạp Tuyết
people.gloss: Treads the snow to seek the plum (đạp tuyết tầm mai)
people.role: Founder and head of Ngạo Tuyết Phái (1105): the plum-blossom sword, the iron town of Thạch Khẩu, and the rule of no Metal, no sword
people.appearance: A lean, hard old man with a frost-burned face and bare feet in every season, who looks at a visitor's hands before their face.
people.wants: A Golden Core before his years run out, and his best sword kept at home whatever the sage was promised.
people.secret: He was born with no Metal at all. On the third winter Tư Không Hạc Niên gave him a Spirit Root Fruit (Linh Căn Quả), and the thin Metal it put in his root he raised by marrow-washing over sixty years. Every child he turns away at the plum gate is the child he was. The fruit's price was the first disciple he would ever make, and at this new year the sage wrote for Phó Ngạo Sương. Lăng wrote back that his first disciple was his dead daughter Lăng Nhược Mai, so the tiger has paid, and asked Trác Thiết Cán to recut the year on the tang of Phó's first sword.

people.name: Tạ Thanh Loan
people.gloss: The blue luan bird, messenger of the immortals
people.role: A founder (1110) and head of Bách Vũ Các; raises the palace's post birds and gathers the feathers for its fans
people.appearance: A quick, bright-eyed woman in a cloak of moulted feathers, with three small birds asleep along her shoulders and a bone whistle on a cord.
people.wants: The palace's writs carried on the pavilion's birds, and the pavilion counted among the palace's halls rather than its servants.
people.secret: In a hidden loft she has nine red-crested writ birds, hatched from eggs her nephew carried out of the Wutong aviary without Vu Ngô Đồng's leave. In 1199 he wrung the neck of the Court's breeding hen to take the last clutch, and the basket came lined with the hen's down; Tạ burned it and told her sister the eggs were Vu's gift. She is taking the nine to the Fire Court anyway, and she has promised Ổ the writ loft for his silence, over the girl who raised the birds.

people.name: Ôn Thủ Đăng
people.role: Head of Vọng Triều Đường; keeper of the lamp chain and the sea-wards of the gulf coast
people.appearance: A tall, salt-greyed man who never sits with his back to the sea and carries a lit bronze storm lamp even at noon.
people.wants: Every tower in the chain lit again: three have been dark for want of keepers.
people.secret: In 913 he was keeper of the Kim Sa lamp, and he sold its winter oil to a wrecker of the Lô Châu Biện, who burned it in false lamps on the reefs. On the festival night he asked his sworn brother Dịch Thủy Thanh (dich_thuy_thanh) to keep the lamp while he rowed the last casks out to the wrecker's boat. The storm tide came, Kim Sa Trấn drowned (V171), and Dịch drowned at a lamp with too little oil to last the night. Ôn still pays the wrecker's line. Each autumn he sails oil he renders himself down to the burned landing of Hải Diêm for Biện Ám Phàm (bien_am_pham), to keep her boats off his coast and 913 in her family, and he leaves the northern keeper's letter about her sails unanswered.

people.name: Viên Cô Yên
people.gloss: A lone column of smoke over the desert (Vương Duy: đại mạc cô yên trực)
people.role: A founder (1125) and head of Trấn Sa Đường, the caravan guards of Trường Vân
people.appearance: A square, sun-darkened woman in a dust cloak who sits with her back to a wall in every room and counts the doors.
people.wants: Proof that Dạ Quang means to raid again, put in front of the Pavilion, so that it finishes what it began in 1121.
people.secret: Tất Dạ Lang did not desert in 1196: she sent him. He sells Đồ Xích Linh false routes and sends Viên the camp's talk.

people.name: Lư Độc Điếu
people.gloss: Fishing alone in the snow on the cold river (Liễu Tông Nguyên: độc điếu hàn giang tuyết)
people.role: A founder (1140) and head of Lãnh Giang Phái; the man who pieced Hàn Giang's ice-hole sitting back together
people.appearance: A thin, stooped man with frost in his beard in every season, who speaks as if each word cost him a fish.
people.wants: The true manual of Hàn Giang Môn, or the ninth layer by any road.
people.secret: He suspects the Liễu family of Liên Giang keep Hàn Giang's real method. He took Liễu Thoa Nhi into the school hoping she would show him, and is ashamed of it.

people.name: Diệp Tố Quyên
people.gloss: Plain silk, the scroll before the painting
people.role: A founder (905) and head of Nhàn Vân Quán; paints the sky the pool holds, one cloud a day
people.appearance: A slight woman with ink in the creases of her fingers and a grey topknot pinned with a worn brush, who looks at the sky more often than at the person speaking to her.
people.wants: To finish the painting Kha left half-done at the pool's edge, the sky of the morning in 705 when Cô Phàm's fleet sailed, and to see that no one after her tries to.
people.secret: In 1062 she painted the morning of 705 out of the pool for Đoạn, using the founder's art. In the reflected sky the fleet did not sink. Its sails went into a fog bank west of Tịch Chiếu Đảo that is on no chart and was not there the day before. She burned the painting and has told no one, because the founder died painting that sky and because she thinks the fog is still there.

people.name: Mục Hàn Nhạn
people.role: Head of Nhạn Trận Môn since 1142; drills the plain's levies every spring and keeps the gate out of Lạc Hà's quarrels
people.appearance: A square, weathered man with a grey goose feather in his felt cap and a voice that carries the length of a lake shore without being raised.
people.wants: To keep Cảnh's word and the gate's files at home, and to make Lạc Hà pay at last for the file it lost on the bridge.
people.secret: Before he died in 1040 the founder told him why the gate swears never to break file. In the grey of 803 a young Kết Đan of the One Colour field ran past Thạch's line alone and empty-handed, and on his deathbed Thạch named him: Cảnh Trường Thiên. Mục kept it out of gratitude for the nine unpaid years until Kiều Thiết Dực's file died on the bridge in 1174. In 1175 he went to Cảnh and sold his silence for Cảnh's word that Lạc Hà will never again call or hire the gate's files for a war. Each spring since, Cảnh has flown down to drill the levy for nothing, and Mục bills the cities for a Lạc Hà war elder's drill and keeps the fee in the gate's chest.

people.name: Ân Thanh Linh
people.role: Mistress of Vũ Linh Đường since 1128: rain-bell warning arrays and bronze casting; keeps the warding bells on the walls of Thu Trì Thành
people.appearance: A neat, grey-eyed woman with burn scars on both wrists, who stops talking whenever a bell rings anywhere and resumes at the same word.
people.wants: That the bells on Thu Trì's walls never ring for a war in her lifetime; and the last word in her century of letters.
people.secret: Inside Thu Trì's walls she hung a second line of bells, tuned to the Hall of Echoes' own listeners. For fifty years she has known every ear the Tower keeps in the south, and she has written it all down. In the winter of 1197 one of those bells was sold to the Tower, and since 1199 the copper has not come. She has not taken the line down. To keep pouring she is melting the old warding bells off Thu Trì's walls, every third one, and leaving the city deaf in stretches.

people.name: Hứa Vãn Cung
people.gloss: Draws the bow (Đỗ Phủ: vãn cung đương vãn cường)
people.role: Founder and head of Tuần Tùng Đường (1191): road wardens and caravan guards of the pine sea, staff and bow
people.appearance: A broad, plain man with a broken nose and a staff worn smooth, who stands between people and the door without seeming to.
people.wants: A hall that outlives him on its own pelts: a real canon, a Kết Đan elder, the rule against shooting a running beast kept, and the road from Tùng Hạ to Cổ Độ never closed again.
people.secret: The cage of 1190 was in one of Trang Thiết Cước's own wagons, hired to a buyer riding south. Once this autumn he went out alone on the Bạch Lang road to find the wolf-king and shoot it standing, before Diêm Lạc Nhạn could; he came back without it, and means to go again.

people.name: Tiêu Vấn Phong
people.role: Founder and head of Tầm Kiếm Đường (1162); the Tiêu son turned away from Lê Hoa Am's gate
people.appearance: A lean, sharp-faced man in a hunter's leathers, with a sword whose guard is filed with hundreds of small notches.
people.wants: To make the abbess say under oath, before the lord, why the gate is shut to him, whether he wins the mountain or not.
people.secret: He filed the suit because he stopped believing in the cave twenty years ago. He carries a sealed letter that hands the hall to his nephew as a guides' guild, and he means to send it the day the abbess swears the gate shut.

people.name: Tưởng Bách Luyện
people.role: A founder (980) and head of Chân Kim Các, assaying and refining spirit ores
people.appearance: A lean, grey old man with silver burns on his fingertips, who holds every cup of tea a moment too long, as if weighing it.
people.wants: To leave the house rich and its name clean, and to be thought honest when he is dead.
people.secret: The second time, in 1194, he found out. His granddaughter Tưởng Ngọc Cân (tuong_ngoc_can) shaves the house weight and swaps a true copy in when anyone tests it. He denied it to the Pivot anyway, and it is the only lie he has told aloud. This spring he sent his grandson Tưởng Tri Chuẩn (tuong_tri_chuan), who tests the weights, to keep the house's counter at Bạch Ngân, fifty-five days off, and he is building a fourth furnace with the good-side money.

people.name: Dương Hảo Vũ
people.gloss: The good rain that knows its season (Đỗ Phủ: hảo vũ tri thời tiết)
people.role: Abbess of Cốc Vũ Quán since 958: rain-calling rites and spirit-rice terraces for the farmers of the south
people.appearance: A small, brown, smiling woman in a patched grey robe and a rice-straw hat, with mud to the knee and a cough she hides in her sleeve.
people.wants: Rain for every planting and no rain sold; her abbey whole again; and the dead of Lôi Trạch at rest before she is.
people.secret: Since 1180 everyone knows that the prior's pills are bought with sold rain, and she takes them. No one knows that since the spring she has kept back one in three and sent it to the grove for Hà Tĩnh Cần, who, the two villages that came back to pay told Lục Đạo Hoa, now holds each free rite twice and pays for it in years. The prior's pills are keeping alive the rival he pays to ruin.

people.name: Yến Bội Ngọc
people.gloss: Jade pendants beside the singing bells (Vương Bột: bội ngọc minh loan)
people.role: A founder (960) and head of Minh Loan Các; casts the ward bells of Lạc Hà's ships, caravans and Cloud Bridge
people.appearance: A stout, quick woman with burn-scarred forearms, three blue jade pendants at her throat and a laugh that carries across a market.
people.wants: To finish the Hundred-Bell Eaves on the mountain before she dies, whatever bronze it takes, and to learn what has been ringing the Cloud Bridge bells from below.
people.secret: Since last spring she has cast war bells for Hình Trọng Sơn's (hinh_trong_son) war party at the Miasma Watch, behind her lord's back, and taken his payment in the bronze the miasma gives back at its edge: the fittings of 803's dead. She tunes each bell by ringing it at the outer disciples in the casting pit and keeps the note that makes them run. The second half of the Hundred-Bell Eaves is going up in that bronze. Mao Tiểu Hưởng (mao_tieu_huong), who ran first, now wakes at that note, and Yến keeps her at the pit anyway because her ear is the truest on the floor.

people.name: Tào Mộ Tử
people.gloss: The purple of the evening hills (Vương Bột: yên quang ngưng nhi mộ sơn tử)
people.role: Head of Yên Quang Các since 1150; moved it to the wild mulberry wood in 1187; Lạc Hà's pill supplier
people.appearance: A lean, unhurried man in a smoke-grey robe with his sleeves tied, whose lips are stained faintly purple from seventy years of tasting pills.
people.wants: To make the miasma antidote, the one pill the Maple Hall cannot make, before his lord stops needing the pavilion at all.
people.secret: He knows what Hình Lạc Nhạn's tincture is for. The strength she asked for in 1197 is enough for a thousand paces of the grey, not three hundred. He made it and took his fee in miasma-root from the grey's edge, which he needs for the antidote. He has told no one, least of all Cảnh Trường Thiên, who has forbidden her the plain. Since the winter he has been testing the antidote on himself, a dose a week, and he has kept Khổng Ích Mẫu (khong_ich_mau) home from the Watch this year to write down every dose and every fit, so that if it kills him the next maker knows where to stop.

people.name: La Tử Vi
people.gloss: Tử Vi is the enclosure of the pole star, beneath the Canopy
people.role: Mistress of Hoa Cái Đường since 1141, pill refining from badland cinnabar and sulphur
people.appearance: A handsome woman of middle years in a vermilion coat, with a faint tremor in her left hand that she hides by holding a fan.
people.wants: To keep the Pivot's lease and the Hall's weight at the scale, and to finish the founder's Canopy Pill and reach Kết Đan by it before her years run out.
people.secret: The washers at Thần Sa Khoáng shake because the Hall roasts its poor ore beside the troughs, and Mục Hồng Sa's returns tell her so each season. Each spring she signs two Thanh Khoa boys onto the lease, and signs the sick off it as gone home to the farm, paid a third of the lease rate. She points to Dư Hoàng Nhi, who breathes the mercury room's air unmasked, as proof that the Breath protects anyone who does it right.

people.name: Văn Hàn Đăng
people.gloss: A lamp on a cold night
people.role: Head of Sương Tùng Các since 1170: talismans on pine-resin paper, the ward lanterns of the lake villages, and the only writing the pines allow
people.appearance: A quiet, round-shouldered man with ink to the second knuckle, who carries a paper lantern in daylight out of habit.
people.wants: To hang a wall lantern in every village on the lake before the thaw, as he promised, and never to have to open the founder's box.
people.secret: He is teaching Chu Ánh Tuyết to read the founder's hand from her old letters, so that someone can read the sealed box if he dies. In it are three ward-scripts the founder copied in 1135, line for line, from the wards an old ward-singer of the pines' Array Hall laid with three songs; he died the next year with them (N-tung_dao-05). Written as wards the scripts were allowed. A reader who knows the Array Hall's chant could sing the songs back from them: the pines' canon, written down.

people.name: Thân Vân Cẩm
people.role: Founder (1150) and head of Chức Hà Các; weaves fire-silk without the vents
people.appearance: A tall, quick woman with burn-pale fingertips and a red shuttle stuck through her hair like a pin.
people.wants: Silk that lasts: a banner to equal the Xích Hà Kỳ, hung in the palace's Hall of Virtue with her name on it; and Tang Tục Lạc, on whatever terms his mother names.
people.secret: Last winter Tang Tục Lạc brought her one strand of his mother's new silk to compare. It was reeled at the vent, against the founder's vow, and she has kept it, so she knows what the dowry is for. She means to say yes. Since spring she has cut the outer gate's rice by a third against the sixty dowry years, and tells the girls it is the palace's price.

people.name: Bàng Yên Tỏa
people.role: Head of Vụ Ẩn Môn since 1146: mist formations and concealment arrays along the cape's roads
people.appearance: A thin, grey, unremarkable man in an oiled cloak, easy to forget even when he is standing in front of you, which he has practised.
people.wants: To keep Vụ Ẩn Môn out of every quarrel coming toward it: no tithe to Thúy Vi, no bargain with Tùng Đào, no robbers on his roads, and no one reading the pages but the man who buys them.
people.secret: Since 1190 he has sold Thúy Vi's Hall of Rules a list of what passes under the mist, a page each new moon, for patrols on the Đồng Sơn road and for Nhạc Chính Hành's silence on the tithe. He gets the lines by asking each road's keepers what every fee was paid for, as if for the accounts. Ký Thất Lộ carries the pages to the milestone by Đồng Sơn Trấn. Thai Vãn Xa's other carts are on the next one.

people.name: Lục Thanh Sam
people.role: Founder and head of Hộ Lâm Đường (910): forest wardens; spirit wood for Thúy Vi's furnaces
people.appearance: A big, slow, grey-bearded man in a warden's bark-brown coat, with an axe on his back and a disc of pale heartwood on a cord at his throat.
people.wants: To see the Forest of First Light put up a spirit seedling again before he dies, and to hand the hall on still sending the wood.
people.secret: In 1150 Úy Thanh Diễm needed a great spirit tree for the night of his breakthrough over the Green Furnace. Lục sat the night of asking beside the Grandmother Fir of Sơ Hiểu Lâm, and the tree gave no answer. He felled it at dawn anyway and told the hall it had said yes. No spirit seedling has come up in that forest since. The only other person who sat that night is Mi Túc Thụ.

people.name: Kỷ Ngân Chúc
people.gloss: The silver candle by the painted screen, under the autumn stars (Đỗ Mục, Thu tịch)
people.role: Hall-mistress of Họa Tinh Đường since 1137, talismans painted with the Dipper in Mặc Yên soot
people.appearance: A slight, grey-haired woman in a black robe flecked with soot, who sits so still at the painting table that moths settle on her sleeves.
people.wants: To stop the forged Dipper without opening the box, by some proof that does not say why the true one holds; and to keep painting until the candle burns down.
people.secret: The rain-fast ink every talisman of the Hall carries is a forbidden song art with the blood taken out, and every copy of the Compact the Pivot's archive has made since 910 is written in it. Sử Ngưng Mặc (su_ngung_mac) has known since the first ink the Hall sold her: she came north to the founder's burial in 1137 to tell Kỷ that she would go on buying it.

people.name: Cơ Phượng Nghi
people.gloss: The phoenix comes in stately order (Kinh Thư: phượng hoàng lai nghi)
people.role: Founder of Cửu Thiều Cung (70) and maker of the Tiêu Thiều Quản

people.name: Lý Thiên Cổ
people.role: Founder of Khải Lôi Môn (160) and maker of the Xuân Lôi Cổ

people.name: Bùi Lộc Trại
people.gloss: Lộc Trại, the Deer Fence poem of 'không sơn bất kiến nhân', which Bùi Địch wrote with Vương Duy
people.role: Founder of Không Sơn Viện (180)

people.name: Khúc Hồ Già
people.gloss: The tune of the nomad reed pipe
people.role: Founder of Hồ Thiên Phái (210), maker of Phi Tuyết; died in the eruption

people.name: Đào Tân Phân
people.gloss: Petals in profusion (Đào Uyên Minh: lạc anh tân phân)
people.role: Founder of Lạc Anh Phái (230) and maker of the twin swords Phi Hồng and Tàn Hồng

people.name: Tôn Hà Khởi
people.gloss: The rosy cloud rises (Tôn Xước: Xích Thành hà khởi)
people.role: Founder of Xích Thành Môn (250)

people.name: Liễu Thoa Lạp
people.gloss: Straw cloak and hat (Liễu Tông Nguyên: cô chu thoa lạp ông)
people.role: Founder of Hàn Giang Môn (300)

people.name: Giang Bích Không
people.gloss: The blue sky over the river (Lý Bạch: cô phàm viễn ảnh bích không tận)
people.role: Founder of Cô Phàm Các (400), maker of the Viễn Ảnh Châm; swore the Strait Oath in 500

people.name: Thôi Bất Kiến
people.gloss: Not seen (Vương Duy: không sơn bất kiến nhân)
people.role: Last master of Không Sơn Viện (460-500); gave the hills to Thúy Vi's founder

people.name: Liễu Cô Chu
people.gloss: A lone boat (Liễu Tông Nguyên: cô chu thoa lạp ông)
people.role: Last head of Hàn Giang Môn; fell in the War of the Frost Coast

people.name: Diệp Phi Hồng
people.role: Khương Vọng Nguyệt's sworn sister and rival; kept Phi Hồng and carried it into the rain forest

people.name: Chu Liệt Nhật
people.role: Last head of Xích Thành Môn, who turned it to burning villages; destroyed under the first writ

people.name: Ô Kình Hải
people.role: Pirate lord who founded Thôn Hải Môn (640) and carried the sabre Kình Nha; killed in the Pirate Purge

people.name: Hạ Lang Tinh
people.gloss: The Wolf Star, the star of war
people.role: Founder of Phá Quân Môn (720), a vassal of Thiên Xu; led its rebellion and died when it was destroyed

people.name: Phù Vũ Tố
people.role: Keeper of the moulting lofts' feather rolls
people.appearance: An ink-stained thumb from marking the feather rolls.

people.name: Lâm Thê Ngô
people.role: Former Wutong Court aviary hand, home to roost his own birds
people.appearance: Perches a bird on the shoulder that faces his clouded eye.

people.name: Kiều Thúy Nhi
people.role: Catcher's daughter from the cinnamon woods
people.appearance: Birds settle on her head without being called.

people.name: Mã Tín Phi
people.role: Post rider for the pavilion's ordinary letters
people.appearance: Sounds his post horn at empty roads.

people.name: Kỷ Hồng Phiến
people.role: Binds practice fans at the fan bench
people.appearance: A grey streak in her fringe where a spark once caught it.

people.name: Ổ Tiểu Sào
people.role: Carries grubs to the hidden loft
people.appearance: Grins before he answers, then asks for the question again.

people.name: Khâu Tĩnh Minh
people.role: Keeps a daily record of the birds' moods
people.appearance: A notebook on a cord round her neck, written in daily.

people.name: Tạ Thanh Thước
people.role: Co-founder; keeper of the moulting lofts, where the hundred feathers are gathered
people.appearance: A stooped, soft-voiced woman with feathers in her hair she has forgotten are there.
people.wants: The hundredth feather for her fan, and her son home to see the socket filled.
people.secret: In the dark of each moon she sells her duplicate feathers by kind to the fan-maker Hàng Thải Vũ, to pay a stone-cutter for a marker for Ổ Tùng Lâm, whom the apes never gave back.

people.name: Giải Vân Tiêu
people.role: Master of the post birds; flies the palace's ordinary letters
people.appearance: A wiry, grinning man with bird droppings on both shoulders and a dozen seal impressions in his memory.
people.wants: A post-house of his own in Hà Loan with a roof of birds, and every seal on the road one he can read.
people.secret: He opens the second-sealed letters, copies the seal into a wax tablet, and closes them again with a spoon-heated knife; Chử Trì Âm has not yet noticed the replies arriving a day late.

people.name: Hàng Thải Vũ
people.role: Fan-maker; supplies Phượng Minh's inner gate with practice fans
people.appearance: Rows of old burn blisters along both forearms, one per inner-gate season.

people.name: Trần Dã Minh
people.role: Outer catcher of the jungle; father of Trần Tước Nhi at the Wutong Court
people.appearance: Lime-stick stain on every fingertip.

people.name: Nhiêu Tiểu Yến
people.role: The head's inner disciple; keeps the hidden loft
people.appearance: A whistle's red dent in her lower lip.

people.name: Quế Hoàng Oanh
people.role: Outer disciple; sings the birds in
people.appearance: A voice a head taller than she is.

people.name: Phòng Tiểu Cưu
people.role: Inner disciple of the post
people.appearance: Left ear sunburnt permanently pink.

people.name: Hoàn Trúc Lung
people.role: Servant cage-maker, the only one the pavilion allows
people.appearance: Walks as if the ground were a raft, swaying on dry land.

people.name: Tuyên Bách Minh
people.role: The old catcher who founded Bách Vũ Các with the Tạ sisters (1110) and refused to lead it
people.cause: fell from Triều Phượng Đỉnh at dawn, at 150 (N-bach_vu-02)

people.name: Ổ Tùng Lâm
people.role: Tạ Thanh Thước's husband; father of Ổ Linh Tước
people.cause: killed by the dark apes of Huyền Viên Lâm while netting

people.name: Tôn Hàn Thạch
people.role: Captain of the Desert Pavilion's guard
people.appearance: Squints even indoors; the caravan boys say he counts water by the mouthful.

people.name: Nhạc Băng Thiềm
people.role: Keeper of the burial glacier above the seat
people.appearance: Speaks so softly that the standing dead seem to lean in; lamp soot on both cuffs.

people.name: Quách Lẫm
people.role: Treasurer of the Pavilion; counts the frost coast's tax
people.appearance: Thumbnails black from checking every bill twice, lips pinched as if tasting the sum.

people.name: Lục Hàn Chu
people.role: Master of the Pavilion's skiffs on the frost coast
people.appearance: His nose was flattened by a pearl-bed raid, so the laugh comes straight from the chest, loud across water.

people.name: Văn Tuyết Khanh
people.role: Tiết Hàn Mai's disciple in the Array
people.appearance: Left sleeve pinned back for work; hums one cold note until the node answers.

people.name: Nhạc Thanh Sương
people.role: Inner disciple of the burial glacier
people.appearance: Nods to empty air as the standing dead go by; frost gathers on her pale lashes.

people.name: Mạc Ngưng Bích
people.role: Khương Lưu Ly's disciple
people.appearance: Touches the jade pin in her sleek braids whenever she is angry, which is most hours.

people.name: Tưởng Hàn Phong
people.role: Senior sword of the Plum Sword Hall, passed over for Hạ Lăng Hàn
people.appearance: White cloth strips on both palms, never unwrapped in the hall; the blood shows through by evening.

people.name: Ninh Bạch Hồ
people.role: Rider of the Beast Hall
people.appearance: White wolf hair on both sleeves; a knee that clicks when he mounts.

people.name: Quan Lăng Ba
people.role: Apprentice warden of the Ice Soul vein
people.appearance: Soot freckles across her nose, the rod-house stove's mark.

people.name: Âu Dương Tuyết
people.gloss: Snow (Âu Dương is a two-syllable surname)
people.role: Quartermaster of the seat and its mortal servants
people.appearance: Smells of boiled barley; counts under his breath whether or not there is anything to count.

people.name: Diêu Hàn Đàm
people.role: Keeper of the ice sables at the Beast Hall
people.appearance: Sable hairs in her braids; a crooked finger where a kit once bit through.

people.name: Mẫn Băng Hà
people.role: Skiff captain on the frost coast
people.appearance: Salt-white scar across the chin, shoulders as broad as a door.

people.name: Giang Sương Lạc
people.role: Desert-born inner disciple at the Desert Pavilion
people.appearance: Her Hồi Lan vowels climb at the end of every sentence; the sash sits a little high.

people.name: Kiều Tuyết Kỳ
people.role: Banner-bearer of the Desert Pavilion guard
people.appearance: Straight as his own banner pole; the brass cap has dented his thumb.

people.name: Phạm Lãnh Vân
people.role: Clerk of the Hall of Cold Law in Liên Giang
people.appearance: Ink to the second knuckle; the fine long hand the Pivot admires.

people.name: Vương Thanh Lẫm
people.role: The envoy's aide
people.appearance: Heavy braid pinned over one shoulder; ink at the corner of her mouth.

people.name: Hà Hàn Lộ
people.role: The treasurer's clerk
people.appearance: Reads with a finger under each line; lips split by the cold.

people.name: Tạ Ngân Sương
people.role: Khương Lưu Ly's youngest disciple
people.appearance: Gap in her front teeth, which shows whenever the halls ring with her laugh.

people.name: Lưu Hàn Ngạn
people.role: Frost-coast inner disciple, Thẩm's man
people.appearance: Coast-blue lining flashes under the white robe; the Liên Giang drawl is thick as fish stew.

people.name: Đinh Tuyết Tùng
people.role: Warden of the burial glacier
people.appearance: Eyebrows white with chisel dust.
