people.name: Cát Ngọc Trì
people.role: Keeper of the founder's cold well at the Desert Pavilion
people.appearance: Hems always damp from the well; a dried lily bulb pins her pale braid.

people.name: Trương Lãnh Hà
people.role: The outer disciple who reached Foundation without Ice
people.appearance: Nose broken and set crooked; frostbite has cut leaf-shaped scars into both ears.

people.name: Bạch Hàn Yên
people.role: Thunder-scarred watcher of the Ice Soul vein
people.appearance: Two fingers gone from the right hand; a faint blue web of burns climbs her neck.

people.name: Ông Tĩnh Hải
people.role: Tea master of the seat
people.appearance: Steam-pink hands, a stained apron under the robe, round shoulders.

people.name: La Băng Tuyền
people.role: Inner disciple born on the head's own peak
people.appearance: Windburn she never lets heal; herder's beads at one wrist.

people.name: Dương Lô
people.role: The guest alchemist's apprentice
people.appearance: Always the last to take his apron off.

people.name: Thân Ngưng Lam
people.role: Plum Sword disciple who copies the red-ink manual
people.appearance: Red ink under one thumbnail that no washing shifts.

people.name: Lăng Hàn Sinh
people.role: Skiffman and diver for ice-pearls
people.appearance: Deaf in one ear from the deep; coughs like a barking seal.

people.name: Tiêu Bạch Lộ
people.role: A Tiêu-clan son in the outer gate
people.appearance: Too well fed for the outer gate; clan-silk laces are tucked inside his boots.

people.name: Nghiêm Tiểu Tuyết
people.role: Youngest of the outer gate
people.appearance: Two pairs of mittens indoors; sits nearest every brazier, wrists thin as reeds.

people.name: Hầu Ngư
people.role: Fisher's son in the outer gate
people.appearance: Smells of fish brine; ice-pick tucked in his belt.

people.name: Chu Sương Linh
people.role: Passed the Frost Test last solstice
people.appearance: Eyes still red-rimmed; she touches her cheek where she wept, as if checking it.

people.name: Lý Hàn Tâm
people.role: Sở Hàn Y's first disciple
people.appearance: Looks fresh-washed, as if his mother still packed his sleeves.

people.name: Phan Đông Nhi
people.role: Outer disciple from the seal-hunters' village
people.appearance: Seal oil in the creases of her knuckles; the laugh is a bark.

people.name: Khổng Thiết Ngưng
people.role: Desert-born outer disciple at the Desert Pavilion
people.appearance: Forearms soot-black to the elbow; sleeps in a leather apron.

people.name: Uông Tuyết Nhạn
people.role: Three Frost Tests failed; leaving for Lãnh Giang Phái
people.appearance: The third hat this month lost to the lake; a cough hidden behind her hand.

people.name: Bùi Hàn
people.role: Tưởng Hàn Phong's disciple in the Plum Sword Hall
people.appearance: A cropped head and a wrist wrapped in a hand's width of cloth.

people.name: Sầm Bích Lan
people.role: Outer disciple from the oriole valley
people.appearance: Quill behind the ear, ink on the chin, a poem half out of every pocket.

people.name: Tề Lạc Băng
people.role: Reed-marsh boy in the outer gate
people.appearance: Breathes so slowly that his scarf barely moves.

people.name: Ân Tiểu Hàn
people.role: Outer disciple from the tide village
people.appearance: Quick brown eyes that never settle; a pouch of dried plums for the people she is paid by.

people.name: Lã Ngư Nhi
people.role: Waterfall village girl in the outer gate
people.appearance: Black hair heavy with water, wrung out before she enters any room.

people.name: Hàn Tiểu Bắc
people.role: Outer disciple from the sail-watchers' village
people.appearance: Tar under his nails; a rope burn across one palm.

people.name: Tô Lãnh Nguyệt
people.role: Desert Pavilion inner disciple
people.appearance: Practice characters inked on her cuffs, row after row.

people.name: Võ Băng Kiên
people.role: Caravan guard's son in the outer gate
people.appearance: Rolls like a caravan guard when he walks; one eyebrow split in two.

people.name: Quế Hàn Chi
people.role: Outer disciple from Lịch Thanh Thôn
people.appearance: Dirt under her nails even in winter; a seed in every pocket.

people.name: Trịnh Lăng
people.role: Mạc Ngưng Bích's disciple
people.appearance: Much-resoled squire's boots; takes a joke a full breath late, then laughs alone.

people.name: Thạch Tiểu Lộ
people.role: Raft village girl, newest in the outer gate
people.appearance: Counts on her fingers, loses the count at seven, starts again out loud.

people.name: Mã Đông Lâm
people.role: The horse village's only Water root
people.appearance: Bow-legged from the saddle; a horse's mane braided into his belt.

people.name: Hứa Băng Nhi
people.role: Beast Hall inner disciple
people.appearance: Freckles in a fur pattern across the nose; she sleeps in her boots.

people.name: Đào Hàn Mặc
people.role: Servant of the seat who cultivates by grace
people.appearance: Broom-callused right palm; one white streak at the temple.

people.name: Yên Tuyết Ngưng
people.role: Ice-hole village outer disciple
people.appearance: Sits cross-legged in any queue; no one has ever seen her sit down.

people.name: Liễu Tiểu Giang
people.role: Liễu Ngư Ca's young cousin
people.appearance: Sunburnt ears that stick out; a moustache shadow he is proud of.

people.name: Nhiếp Lăng Tuyết
people.role: Deputy steward of the outer gate; keeps the Frost Test roll
people.appearance: Her breath smokes even in the warm hall; she carries the roll under one arm like a child.

people.name: Kỷ Hàn Bách
people.role: Teacher of the primer at the outer gate; the seat's man at the lake
people.appearance: That voice, trained to carry across lake wind.

people.name: Mạnh Triều Sương
people.role: Skiff disciple who carries the Hall of Cold Law's letters along the frost coast
people.appearance: Burn-spotted lamp-maker's fingers; a whistle every harbour knows.

people.name: Lạc Ngạn Băng
people.role: Tax-reckoner of the Hall of Cold Law on the frost coast
people.appearance: Abacus beads click in her sleeve; she squints at anything not set in columns.

people.name: Thái Hàn Ngư
people.role: Ice-hole fisher and skiffman on the frost coast
people.appearance: His grandfather's wool cap; a three-fingered ice-fisher's mitten on the left hand.

people.name: Tống Ngư Lan
people.role: Thẩm Hàn Giang's disciple at the seat; the frost coast's voice among the inner disciples
people.appearance: Salt-streaked braids, and a shout held back behind her teeth.

people.name: Phí Thanh Sa
people.role: Keeper of the Desert Pavilion's caravan ledgers
people.appearance: Ledger powder has greened her fingertips; she weighs every coin on her palm before she takes it.

people.name: Mục Sa Hành
people.role: Caravan rider of the Desert Pavilion's guard
people.appearance: His gaze always rests on the horizon; the lips are sun-split.

people.name: Yên Lục Tuyền
people.role: Keeps the founder's cold well at the Desert Pavilion
people.appearance: Well-rope calluses on both hands; scribe's sleeves pinned neat.

people.name: Úc Hoàng Sa
people.role: Desert-born guard of the Desert Pavilion who passed the Frost Test on his third sitting
people.appearance: Upper tooth missing; stands bow-legged as a camel-driver.

people.name: Điền Hàn Tạc
people.role: Cuts the standing graves in the burial glacier
people.appearance: Chisel tucked behind his ear; grit in every knuckle crease.

people.name: Kha Lạc Tuyết
people.role: Watcher of the Ice Soul vein; the warden's niece
people.appearance: Tilts her head to the west when thunder is near.

people.name: Lâm Ngưng Phong
people.role: Plum Sword Hall swordsman of Tưởng Hàn Phong's side
people.appearance: Turns his clan's seal ring when he is slighted; boots too fine for the hall.

people.name: Đàm Tĩnh Thạch
people.role: Array Hall disciple who checks the lid stones of the Jade Vessel Array
people.appearance: Damp knees; the smell of lamp oil from the tunnels.

people.name: Lương Sa Băng
people.role: Desert-born rider of the Beast Hall
people.appearance: Sable's tail stitched to her cap.

people.name: Hoắc Tuyết Ngạn
people.role: Frost-coast boy in the outer gate
people.appearance: Speaks in the coast's sing-song; a fishing-line scar round one wrist.

people.name: Tiêu Lãnh Thu
people.role: Tiêu-clan daughter; sits her first Frost Test at the coming solstice
people.appearance: Powders her long plain face white; the clan's gloves are too small for her hands.

people.name: Phù Sương Nguyên
people.role: Has failed the Frost Test twice
people.appearance: Snow melting in his hair most mornings; goes blank mid-sentence, as if his voice had been blown out.

people.name: Nhan Bích Tuyền
people.role: Sits her third and last Frost Test at the coming solstice
people.appearance: Crosses her fingers behind her back; trips on dry ground; net-mender's calluses.

people.name: Đặng Tiểu Hà
people.role: Seal-hunter's boy, new in the outer gate
people.appearance: Wide, sleepy grin.

people.name: Nhậm Đông Tuyết
people.role: Outer disciple with a faint Ice the lake has not yet woken
people.appearance: Fine pale hair that stands up when she is afraid.

people.name: Hầu Lãng
people.role: Hầu Ngư's younger brother
people.appearance: Sits on a fishing hole as if it were a stool, heels drumming.

people.name: Ông Tiểu Trà
people.role: The tea master's grandniece in the outer gate
people.appearance: Careful step with every cup.

people.name: Từ Lạc Sương
people.role: Đàm Tĩnh Thạch's niece; wants the Array Hall
people.appearance: Chalk-white fingers from drawing patterns in the snow.

people.name: Vi Tử Hàn
people.role: Oldest of the outer gate; failed three Frost Tests and stayed
people.appearance: One shoulder worn down by other people's bags; stops mid-word, blank, until someone says his name.

people.name: Điền Tiểu Thạch
people.role: The grave-cutter's son in the outer gate
people.appearance: Grave-cutter's squint.

people.name: Mai Hàn Tịch
people.role: Skiff hand of the frost coast
people.appearance: Palms blistered at the bow oar; the eyes go pale grey when she judges ice.

people.name: Bì Tiểu Chu
people.role: Outer disciple lent to the coast; dives for ice-pearls
people.appearance: Hair that never dries; a pearl-seller's smile.

people.name: Diệp Lãnh Thư
people.role: Copyist of the Hall of Cold Law in Liên Giang
people.appearance: Covers the page with her sleeve as she writes.

people.name: Lữ Băng Triều
people.role: Frost-coast inner disciple sent down from the seat after a quarrel
people.appearance: Knuckles still swollen from the fist that cost him the seat.

people.name: Mạnh Tiểu Ngư
people.role: Mạnh Triều Sương's nephew; a skiff boy
people.appearance: Forearms like bailing buckets.

people.name: Phương Diêm Nhi
people.role: Salt-boiler's daughter at the Desert Pavilion
people.appearance: Salt-white lashes; a laugh that comes out as a cough.

people.name: Nghê Khô Tuyền
people.role: Oasis boy who failed the Frost Test three times
people.appearance: Rolls a coin across his knuckles, mouth twisted bitter.

people.name: Mông Sa Liên
people.role: Hồi Lan girl who passed the Frost Test; Giang Sương Lạc's disciple
people.appearance: Heavy harbour anklets that she refuses to take off.

people.name: Cát Lộ Châu
people.role: Cát Ngọc Trì's niece at the Desert Pavilion
people.appearance: Reed cuts on both hands; she cannot hold a laugh in.

people.name: Ngạc Thiết Phong
people.role: Caravan guard in training under Úc Hoàng Sa
people.appearance: Camel dust in his eyebrows.

people.name: Mã Thảo Nhi
people.role: Stable servant at the Desert Pavilion; Mã Đông Lâm's sister
people.appearance: Straw in her braid; a horse's patient stare.

people.name: Giải Tiểu Hỏa
people.role: Furnace boy of the guest alchemist's hall at Hàn Giao Chử
people.appearance: Eyebrows singed off once and never regrown; he cannot stand still.

people.name: Quý Tố Nga
people.role: Washer of the seat's undyed robes; Đào Hàn Mặc's mother
people.appearance: Hands bleached white, wrinkled to the wrist.

people.name: Trác Ôn Tuyền
people.role: Tea servant who warms the seat's water with qi
people.appearance: Palms always warm, steaming faintly in winter air.

people.name: Hoa Tuyết Nghi
people.role: Tạ Ngân Sương's disciple
people.appearance: Perfectly still face; one tiny line between the brows she is proud of.

people.name: Vu Mai Sương
people.role: Plum Sword Hall disciple; grinds the red ink
people.appearance: Red-stained cuffs; the hunched back of a grinder.

people.name: Lôi Tuyết Hiêu
people.role: Beast Hall rider
people.appearance: Owl feathers tucked behind one ear; unblinking pale eyes.

people.name: Thịnh Hàn Lôi
people.role: Keeps the lightning rods on the Ice Soul vein
people.appearance: Hair that stands on end near the rods; sets each foot down as if testing it.

people.name: Hoàng Tuyết Tịnh
people.role: Array Hall junior
people.appearance: Dark circles under the eyes; the lamp never trembles in her hand.

people.name: Cố Lăng Sương
people.gloss: She who stands above the frost
people.role: Grand elder of Băng Tâm Các, in seclusion on Băng Bích Nhai since 1010
people.appearance: A small woman wrapped in a grey fur gone white with rime, who has not cut her hair in two hundred years and wears it bound around her like a cloak.
people.wants: To keep the founder's last order, and to be sure before she breaks her silence.
people.secret: She was never passed over: Tần chose her for the watch and Sở for the hall, and told neither the other's task.

people.name: Thẩm Hàn Giang
people.role: Master of the Hall of Cold Law; voice of the frost coast in the Pavilion
people.appearance: Broad, weathered and loud for a Băng Tâm elder, with a fisher's hands and a laugh that the seat's halls are not built for.
people.wants: To be named heir, to make the frost coast the Pavilion's equal rather than its tax, and to rule at Hòe Âm this autumn for the men's lodge of the massif, whose men would then stand behind him.
people.secret: He has quietly kept the frost-coast towns' tax books in two sets for forty years: one for the seat, one that shows what the coast really pays.

people.name: Phó Ám Hương
people.gloss: Hidden fragrance (the plum's scent in the dark)
people.role: Master of the Plum Sword Hall; the last of Lãnh Hương Các (age 480)
people.appearance: A lean old swordsman with a plum-blossom scar on his left hand where his father's cape-pin burned him in the fire of Cô Thành.
people.wants: The red plum sword back from Phượng Minh before he dies; a disciple worthy of the pair.
people.secret: He has written to Phượng Minh's head Hoa Triêu Dương (hoa_trieu_duong) three times offering a duel for the sword, and has never sent the letters.

people.name: Khương Lưu Ly
people.gloss: Lapis glaze (lưu ly), clear and cold
people.role: The head's first disciple and the seat's heir candidate
people.appearance: Beautiful in the Pavilion's way, cold and exact, with a sword so clear it looks like a sliver of glazed glass.
people.wants: To be named heir, to know why she has not been, and to see Lê Hoa Am's gate upheld at Hòe Âm, because the seat will read a ruling against a women's vow as a ruling against the Keepers.
people.secret: Since the 1188 petition she has written to the Pivot's young disciples under a false name to learn what Doãn Ngọc Hành said of her master.

people.name: Ôn Sa Ngọc
people.role: Keeper of the Desert Pavilion (the old seat): caravans, trade and desert recruits
people.appearance: Sun-browned, the only elder who smiles in public, with sand always in the folds of her white robe.
people.wants: To keep the Desert Pavilion alive as the Pavilion's door to the desert, and to be buried in the sand, not the glacier.
people.secret: She is skimming a tenth of the caravan toll into sealed jars under her cellar floor, against the day the seat calls the old hall home. Phí Thanh Sa (phi_thanh_sa) keeps the books and has begun counting the jars.

people.name: Kha Tĩnh Ba
people.role: Steward and warden of the Ice Soul vein, Băng Phách Mạch
people.appearance: A quiet man whose left arm twitches when storms come; the scar of a lightning lash runs from his shoulder to his wrist.
people.wants: To make the seat believe the vein is warming without being asked what he did to it.
people.secret: Each night he opens a vent-sluice on Băng Phách Mạch by a hand's width to bleed the heat, which the Array Hall forbids. Quan Lăng Ba (quan_lang_ba) logs the drop and has told no one.

people.name: Lam Tuyết Điêu
people.role: Elder of the Beast Hall: the ice beasts and the sect's mounts
people.appearance: Wiry and wind-burned, a white sable usually draped across her shoulders, smelling of hide and snow.
people.wants: To breed a white sable pair that will not flee the vein's heat.
people.secret: She has been feeding the oldest wolf from her own plate and telling the hall it died in spring; it sleeps in the lamp-room under Diêu Hàn Đàm's (dieu_han_dam) bed, and the two women have not spoken of it.

people.name: Ngụy Thanh Hàn
people.role: Envoy of Băng Tâm Các to the Pivot and the vassals
people.appearance: Neat, soft-spoken, ink on his cuff; he bows exactly as deep as each listener's rank and never deeper.
people.wants: A second claim to Tinh Tủy Mạch that the Pivot cannot refuse.
people.secret: He is paying a Pivot land clerk in Pavilion silver to copy the rolls, and his aide Vương Thanh Lẫm (vuong_thanh_lam) has begun selling copies of the copies to the treasurer Quách Lẫm (quach_lam). Over wine he also lets the Hall of Trust's courier Thư Ngạn Hành (thu_ngan_hanh) read him each letter before it is delivered, paying in northern pepper, and files whatever names Cô Thành for the day the Pivot needs a lever.

people.name: Viên Chước
people.role: Guest alchemist of Băng Tâm Các (a Fire root in an Ice sect)
people.appearance: Red-cheeked and sweating even in the Pavilion's cold, the only man at Hàn Giao Chử who wears his robe open.
people.wants: To take a whole boat of ash at the 1144 price, and to win at the valley's dice what he lost there.
people.secret: He brings the Pavilion's ash purse to the snow-house table and has lost a fifth of it already.

people.name: Cung Mặc Sương
people.role: The head's second disciple, who hides a Darkness root
people.appearance: Small, pale, with black eyes that do not reflect the lamps; her frost leaves a faint grey stain where it melts.
people.wants: To stop starving half of her root.
people.secret: The Darkness root, and Triệu Huyết Y's offer.

people.name: Liễu Ngư Ca
people.role: Thẩm Hàn Giang's disciple; the hidden heir of Hàn Giang Môn
people.appearance: A tall, easy young man who sings fishermen's songs under his breath, badly, and sits on the lake ice the old Hàn Giang way.
people.wants: To find the Lone Fisher's Rod; to never have to choose between his master and his blood.
people.secret: His blood, and the ice-hole method.

people.name: Hạ Lăng Hàn
people.role: Phó Ám Hương's last disciple, heir to the white plum
people.appearance: Sharp-featured, a guard captain's daughter's bearing, red ink on her fingers from copying her master's manual.
people.wants: To bring the red plum home to Phó Ám Hương by duel, before Tưởng Hàn Phong's side can challenge her.
people.secret: She is breaking Bùi Hàn's (bui_han) sword wrist a little each practice bout, out of sight, so that he cannot call her out before she rides for Cô Thành. Phó Ám Hương (pho_am_huong) has not looked at the boy's hand.

people.name: Hạng Minh Sa
people.role: Dạ Quang Môn's heir, kept at Băng Tâm Các as surety since 1121
people.appearance: A desert man with a sabre scar and a ready laugh, the only warm-coloured robe in the Vessel Hall.
people.wants: To go home to Dạ Quang before his father dies, with Cung Mặc Sương beside him.
people.secret: After the lamps are out he spars with Liễu Ngư Ca (lieu_ngu_ca) in the Vessel Hall's back yard to learn the sword forms hostages may not be taught.

people.name: Đỗ Sương Nhi
people.role: Steward of the outer gate; keeper of the Frost Test on the frozen mere of Hàn Giao Chử
people.appearance: Round-faced and kind, with frostbitten earlobes from a hundred solstice nights on the lake.
people.wants: To get Trương Lãnh Hà (truong_lanh_ha) through the inner gate before she is too old to argue for him.
people.secret: Each solstice she pays Trác Ôn Tuyền (trac_on_tuyen) to keep a kettle warm behind the reeds for sitters who wet themselves, and signs the bill as repairs.

people.name: Hồ Tiểu Đàm
people.role: An oasis girl in the outer gate who has failed the Frost Test twice
people.appearance: Brown and freckled from the oasis sun, the warmest-looking face on the lake, wrapped in three borrowed furs.
people.wants: To pass the third Frost Test before the Desert Pavilion is offered to her.
people.secret: She is teaching her pot reed to grow in ice water, and is afraid the reed blooms only when she sits close, so that it is the reed and not she that answers.

people.name: Phó Thanh Mai
people.role: Plum-blossom swordsman of Lãnh Hương Các; father of Phó Ám Hương
people.cause: killed riding to break the siege of Cô Thành
people.appearance: Remembered as a lean man in plum-red sleeves with a sword scar through his left eyebrow.

people.name: Phục Thủy Hằng
people.role: Mate of the coast traders at Lãng Thạch; sailed under Tôn Viễn Hàng until 1187
people.appearance: A mate's whistle on a bleached cord, never blown since the fever.

people.name: Khuất Độ Sinh
people.role: Keeper of the Strangers' Hall; placed from Lạc Hà in 1176
people.appearance: Reed cuts healed white across both forearms.

people.name: Ba Lãng Nhi
people.role: Deckhand of the strait ferry
people.appearance: Wind-chapped lips she seals with wax.

people.name: Nhữ Thanh Cần
people.role: Yard hand at the shoal; placed from Lạc Hà in 1199
people.appearance: Plane curls caught in his hair.

people.name: Lãnh Triều Âm
people.role: Inner disciple; keeps the coast traders' shell till
people.appearance: A shell-button necklace she counts when she is angry.

people.name: Hoàn Khách Nhi
people.role: Copyist of the Book of Meetings, born in the Strangers' Hall
people.appearance: Ink on her lip from chewing the pen.

people.name: Ngô Bá Can
people.role: Poles the freight rafts from the crossing to the shoal
people.appearance: A ridge of raft-pole callus across both palms.

people.name: Lương Bạch Tần
people.role: First elder of Bình Thủy Môn and keeper of the Tide Hall; the last disciple of Phiêu Bồng Quán
people.appearance: A thin woman in undyed sailcloth with white streaks in her black hair and the Claw King's shell on her back like a door she carries with her.
people.wants: To go back to Phiêu Bồng Quán once before she dies and light the lamp her master kept, and to find one disciple who will stay.
people.secret: She teaches every heir Bùi names the Still Moon Tide's third-layer turn held instead of let go, so that each stalls at the close of the third layer. Four have; Bùi unnamed them and the sect calls him fickle. The rest of the inner gate she teaches true. Sa Kình Nhi reached the turn this spring and comes to her each month, and Lương is teaching her the same way.

people.name: Ông Tế Độ
people.role: Master of the crossing: runs the strait ferry from Tương Phùng Thị to Nhạn Thanh Thành
people.appearance: A square, silent man with tar under his nails, who carries the stern lamp ashore every night like a lantern for a funeral.
people.wants: To die at the stern lamp on a crossing, with no day missed in the log.
people.secret: He wins his tea money off night passengers with a weighted die cut by Hầu Bách Chu from a keel off-cut, and Ba Lãng Nhi has begun to count the odds.

people.name: Kiều Vọng Hải
people.role: Captain of the sect's coast traders; widow of the captain lost in 1187
people.appearance: A tall mangrove woman with a burnt-dark face who still wears her husband's oilskin, cut down to fit.
people.wants: To learn where Tôn Viễn Hàng's boat went down, and to see Lận Viễn Phàm answer for the lending.
people.secret: She is paying a Lãng Thạch scrivener from the coast traders' shell till to copy Lận Viễn Phàm's own charts, and the till is short; Lãnh Triều Âm, who keeps it, has not yet said.

people.name: Hầu Bách Chu
people.role: Shipwright of the Tide Hall; built the ferry, the coast traders and both lost boats
people.appearance: A stooped cane-raft man with sawdust in his eyebrows and three fingers on his left hand.
people.wants: One hull of his reaching the far shore and coming home with its paint dry.
people.secret: He is carving the third boat's figurehead in the likeness of his dead wife, behind a tarred sail, and tells the yard it is a gull.

people.name: Cù Bối Ngân
people.role: Purser: keeps the shell-coin till and the Book of Meetings at Tương Phùng Thị
people.appearance: Taps coins on her teeth while she counts.

people.name: Sa Kình Nhi
people.role: The head's youngest disciple and his fifth named heir; found beside the stranded whale on Tình Sa in 1190
people.appearance: A small, sea-burnt girl of eighteen with pale eyes and a whale's tooth on a cord.
people.wants: To sail the way the whale came, and to learn what her first words were.
people.secret: Every night she dives off Tình Sa to listen at the whale's grave for the tongue she lost, and has begun to understand a few words.

people.name: Ông Tiểu Phàm
people.role: Deckhand of the strait ferry; the master of the crossing's son
people.appearance: A rope-burn ring round one wrist, won by a bad bet.

people.name: Tôn Niệm Triều
people.role: Outer disciple and shipwright's apprentice; daughter of the lost captain
people.appearance: A tarred apron stiff as bark, and an adze scar through one eyebrow.

people.name: Đàm Thủy Sinh
people.role: Outer disciple placed from Lạc Hà's outer gate on Placement Day, 1199
people.appearance: Mouths every number of the passenger tally to himself, and is still wrong.

people.name: Ngô Tần Tần
people.role: Outer disciple who poles the cane rafts between the shoal and Lãng Thạch's harbour
people.appearance: Bare feet stained green from raft moss.

people.name: Doãn Bình Sơ
people.role: Founder of Bình Thủy Môn (520); wrote the Duckweed Drift Primer
people.cause: end of her years (500), on the ferry

people.name: Hạng Thiên Nhai
people.role: Second head of Bình Thủy Môn (860-1110)
people.cause: end of his years (500), in the Strangers' Hall

people.name: Tôn Viễn Hàng
people.role: Captain of the second deep-water boat lent to Lận Viễn Phàm
people.cause: lost at sea past the edge of the Cô Phàm charts

people.name: Tưởng Tri Chuẩn
people.role: The head's grandson from the silver mine, who tested the weights; sent back to keep the house's counter at Bạch Ngân
people.appearance: Lays a spirit-level on every table he sits at; his left foot drags from a dropped ingot.

people.name: Đường Noãn Hà
people.role: Keeper of the house's bath-house at Xuân Thủy Thang
people.appearance: Hair curled for good by bath-steam; her laugh carries through three walls.

people.name: Nghiêm Tuyết Ngân
people.role: Outer disciple from the silver mine, at the furnace bellows
people.appearance: One eyebrow singed off and never regrown; forearms corded like rope.

people.name: Cù Tiểu Hành
people.role: Inner disciple who writes up the morning's weighings on the square
people.appearance: Ink-blackened thumb, a pen behind the wrong ear, lips that move over every sum.

people.name: Ôn Bích Liên
people.role: Outer disciple of the Ôn clan, sent under the kin rule
people.appearance: Brass toll tokens jingle at her belt with every step.

people.name: Tiền Phân Vi
people.role: Inner disciple who runs the night crucible
people.appearance: Charcoal-black creases around the eyes; squints at daylight like a man just woken.

people.name: Tưởng Tiểu Quyền
people.role: Outer disciple, the Tưởng child for 1197, under her mother's scale
people.appearance: Her morning shout cracks on its last word; a front tooth is coming in crooked.

people.name: Tưởng Ngọc Cân
people.role: The head's granddaughter and keeper of the scales on the house's side of the square at Song Kiều
people.appearance: A small, quick woman in a miner's blue jacket over a merchant's silk, with a set of brass weights she clicks in her palm.
people.wants: The whole square: every basket of Ngọc Hành's ore weighed on her side and paying her fee, and the house after her grandfather.
people.secret: She shaves the house weight a hair light, so that ore weighed on her side comes out heavier than at the Pivot's scale, and since 1198 she has charged the miners a good-side fee to stand in her line. With the Pivot's scale idle, she raises the fee each season, and it now takes back most of what the light weight gives them. Quản Thập Thù swaps the true weight in whenever anyone tests the scale, and she pays him from the fee.

people.name: Phùng Xích Kim
people.role: Furnace master of the house, who refines the ore the house assays
people.appearance: A stooped man with red-rimmed eyes and silver-grey skin from a century of furnace fumes.
people.wants: A true piece of star iron to lay beside Thối Tinh's, and leave to say what he thinks of it aloud.
people.secret: Nights, he is assaying Thối Tinh's iron on the sly: Tiền Phân Vi's knife is his sample, and the blade will come back pitted before the apprentice asks a fourth time.

people.name: Ôn Song Ngọc
people.role: The house's go-between with the Ôn clan and its bridge tolls
people.appearance: Handsome and easy, with an Ôn jade at each wrist and a toll-ledger under her arm.
people.wants: The Ôn's fifth, and a desk where the coin of both squares passes through her hands.
people.secret: She is writing her own tenth into the doubled bridge toll she will announce at the quarter, and her grandfather Ôn Trọng Lương has not been told of it.

people.name: Lã Minh Nhãn
people.role: Assayer of the house on the square at Song Kiều
people.appearance: Hoarse by noon, with ore dust smeared across the left cheek like a signature.

people.name: Khương Tiểu Kim
people.role: Inner disciple from the spring of Xuân Thủy Thang, the best eye of her year
people.appearance: Smells faintly of the spring's sulphur; wide dark eyes that never blink during a weighing.

people.name: Nghiêm Bạc Sinh
people.role: Outer disciple from the silver mine
people.appearance: Pockets that sag with sweepings; silver flecks glint in his cuffs.

people.name: Ôn Tiểu Kiều
people.role: Outer disciple of the Ôn clan
people.appearance: Jade thumb-ring too big for him; he cannot sit through a lesson without changing seats twice.

people.name: Lương Diệm Chi
people.role: Furnace apprentice with a Fire root
people.appearance: Crescent burn on the chin that she calls her second smile; palms calloused pink from the tongs.

people.name: Quản Thập Thù
people.role: The oldest outer disciple, who carries the house's two weights and swaps them
people.appearance: Bent, with one drooping eyelid; pats the bulge in his left sleeve whenever anyone comes near.

people.name: Hạng Thử Kim
people.role: Co-founder of Chân Kim Các (980), who cast the house weight
people.cause: fumes of the furnace, at 195, before he reached Kết Đan

people.name: Trình Tố Âm
people.role: Reeler in the worm sheds; judges the year's bolts
people.appearance: The nail of her left thumb is worn away by the reel.

people.name: Cổ Chức Viêm
people.role: Weaves the season's charring robes
people.appearance: Wears fire-silk cuffs a rank above his own and turns his wrists to show them.

people.name: Lưu Cẩm Hồ
people.role: Stretches silk on the banner frames
people.appearance: The boys at the frame shed forget her name by the next day.

people.name: Văn Diệp Tang
people.role: Feeds the worms and works the reels
people.appearance: Presses one ear to every tray he passes.

people.name: Quan Bố Hành
people.role: Loads the bolts at the market table in Tang Điền
people.appearance: Counts under his breath in a clerk's whisper.

people.name: Tịch Diễm Ti
people.role: Would-be fire-setter at the looms
people.appearance: Burn-shiny fingertips on her right hand only.

people.name: Mặc Lam Y
people.role: Vat-stirrer for the guest dyer
people.appearance: Stained faintly blue to the hairline, as if the vats had marked her.

people.name: Nhiễm Thanh Lam
people.role: Guest elder: the indigo dyer of Lam Điện, hired for the pavilion's colours
people.appearance: An old woman with hands dyed blue to the wrist, who smells of indigo vats.
people.wants: Indigo for Lam Điện's children for one more year, and a dye of hers that outlasts the banner it colours.
people.secret: She is dyeing a bolt in a fast red she has told no one she can make, the red that would let the pavilion's silk be told from the palace's. She is waiting to see which way Thân Vân Cẩm (than_van_cam) answers the dowry before she hands it over.

people.name: Tang Mộng Kiển
people.role: Elder of the worm sheds; cousin of the palace's array keeper
people.appearance: A small, careful woman who carries silkworms in her sleeve to keep them warm.
people.wants: The sheds fed through the sixty years she will not sign for, and her cousin's line out of the pavilion's cellars.
people.secret: She is raising a second brood of worms in a shed corner on Hồ Tâm bank mulberry, a strain that spins a thicker thread, and has told the shed girls it is a sick brood. Tang Kế Ti (tang_ke_ti) would pay a bride's price for it.

people.name: Thành Kim Toa
people.role: The pavilion's factor at the Tang Điền silk market
people.appearance: Wears a ring on every finger, one a size too small, and twists it when haggling.

people.name: Mâu Tú Linh
people.role: Embroiderer of the pavilion's banners
people.appearance: Looks at a stranger's hands before their face; a silver needle through her lapel.

people.name: Đậu Hồng Ti
people.role: The pavilion's best young fire-setter
people.appearance: Eyebrows singed to stubble on one side.

people.name: Lã Tiểu Tàm
people.role: Outer disciple of the worm sheds
people.appearance: A cocoon's name written on a thread around her wrist.

people.name: Lương Kiển Sinh
people.role: Inner disciple; boils and reels the cocoons
people.appearance: Fingertips boiled smooth, with no prints left.

people.name: Phùng Tiểu Toa
people.role: Outer disciple at the looms
people.appearance: A fish-scale glitter on one cheek that she swears is not paint.

people.name: Ngưu Thải Diệp
people.role: Servant leaf-picker of the mulberry rows
people.appearance: Whistles through the gap where a front tooth was.

people.name: Hầu Tố Cẩm
people.role: A Tang Điền weaver; Thân Vân Cẩm's mother, who tried first
people.cause: died of burns from weaving fire into silk with her own Fire

people.name: Nhan Ti Nương
people.role: Master reeler of Hỏa Ti Trấn; the ancestor of Tang Điền's weaving houses
people.cause: burned with Hỏa Ti Trấn (V165, N-phuong_minh-01)

people.name: Lục Đa Cốc
people.role: Cleared the first Lục paddies; the harvest of 600 (A288)
people.cause: marsh fever, caught clearing the last of the flooded paddies; died at 162

people.name: Lục Thương Lẫm
people.role: Head of the Lục of Phong Đăng: the paddies, the granaries and three hundred tenant households
people.appearance: A big, sun-darkened farmer in a straw cape over a silk robe, who weighs a handful of rice by eye and is never wrong.
people.wants: A Lục inside the Tower, so that the family is counted by the Tower instead of counted first.
people.secret: In the drought of 1171 he paid the abbey's prior Thời Tri Tiết to bring rain to his own paddies only. The tenants' fields across the river stayed dry, and three Thiều children died that winter. The payment is in the prior's second receipt book.

people.name: Lục Kế Điền
people.role: Heir of the Lục; runs the paddies
people.appearance: A patient, greying man with mud to the knee, who looks older than his father and whose cart loses a wheel on the way to every pill-broker.
people.wants: A core before his father's grain tax eats the pill money again.
people.secret: He is forging the harvest tallies, a sack a week, to hide the family's real yield from the Tower's counters and pay for a pill. Lục Mãn Thương knows the figures to the sack and has not spoken.

people.name: Tống Thanh Miêu
people.role: Wife of the Lục heir; brought the family its only Metal
people.appearance: Pearl earrings too fine for the house. She weighs each coin on her thumb before she pays, then pays too much.

people.name: Lục Nhị Hòa
people.role: Keeps the Lục tallies beside the Tower's counters
people.appearance: Tally stick behind one ear; a reverent squint at every counter.

people.name: Lục Mạch Thu
people.role: Farms the far bank's paddies; married a tenant
people.appearance: Cracked brown hands. The dry bank's dust sits grey in his eyebrows.

people.name: Thiều Xuân Nương
people.role: A Thiều tenant's daughter married into the Lục
people.appearance: Grey streaks she has not tried to hide. A stare that does not blink first.

people.name: Lục Hạ Miêu
people.role: Half tenant, half landlord
people.appearance: A tenant's callused feet in landlord's boots a size too small.

people.name: Lục Ương Nhi
people.role: Refused at the Tower's gate by two points of Metal
people.appearance: A tight mouth. Her mother's Metal-grey eyes, which she will not look at in a mirror.

people.name: Lục Mãn Thương
people.role: Steward of the Lục granaries
people.appearance: Rice-flour on his fingers; a lamplight squint. Counts sacks under his breath as other men hum.

people.name: Hỗ Độ Hải
people.role: Hỗ captain who married the Thẩm daughter of Bạch Sa (A029)
people.cause: lost at sea with three ships, 1120 (age 130)

people.name: Hỗ Tế Xuyên
people.role: Head of the Hỗ house of Yên Ba: a coasting fleet and the port's warehouses
people.appearance: Small, quick and plainly dressed, with a counting-rod case at his belt and a sailor's habit of watching the sky while he bargains.
people.wants: A Hỗ child in Thúy Vi's inner gate, which the sect does not sell and he has never stopped trying to buy.
people.secret: One ship in ten of his fleet has a second hold, and the pills in it are Lạc Đan Thanh's copies under Thúy Vi's seal. If his cousin's books are ever weighed against the cargo, the port house will know.

people.name: Hỗ Trường Phàm
people.role: Admiral of the Hỗ fleet; the head's son
people.appearance: A weathered captain with a salt-white beard and a voice for the masthead.
people.wants: To tear out the second holds before another fleet goes down.
people.secret: He sails a lightened ship on the Bạch Sa run, its second hold stripped, under Hỗ Trạo Ca's name with the weight written as full, and Hỗ Yên Thủy's figures no longer match.

people.name: Mẫn Tú Chi
people.role: Keeps the Hỗ warehouses
people.appearance: Pine-soot in the grooves of her palms. A shawl worn indoors.

people.name: Hỗ Quan Lan
people.role: A poet who gave the ledgers to his daughter
people.appearance: Ink on the cuffs, a loose poet's collar, eyes that settle on the ceiling halfway through a sentence.

people.name: Trịnh Hải Âu
people.role: A harbour pilot's daughter; Hỗ Kinh Điểu's mother
people.appearance: Pilot's squint; a voice made to call across a harbour.

people.name: Hỗ Yên Thủy
people.role: Keeps the Hỗ ledgers
people.appearance: Ink smudge under the left eye. Reads ledgers upside down across the table.

people.name: Hỗ Trạo Ca
people.role: Captain of the Bạch Sa run
people.appearance: Barrel chest. His laugh clacks like a rowlock.

people.name: Hỗ Ngân Triều
people.role: Wants her brother's place at Vân Khởi Quán's school
people.appearance: Sixteen, plain as a post: long nose, a chin scar from a school bench. She stands very straight, as if someone might stop looking.

people.name: Nhan Dư Ti
people.role: A Hỏa Ti reeler's daughter who taught the Đới to reel (N-chuc_ha-01)
people.cause: the reeling-house damp settled in her lungs; died at 167

people.name: Đới Vạn Ti
people.role: Silk trader of Tang Điền; father of Đới Tàm Nương and Đới Liệt Cương
people.cause: a summer fever at 143

people.name: Đới Tàm Nương
people.role: Head of the Đới silk house of Tang Điền; its best reeler
people.appearance: A small, burn-scarred woman with a reeler's quick fingers and a voice that carries across the whole silk market.
people.wants: To sell every thread to Chức Hà and none to the palace's factor, and to live to see the factor beg.
people.secret: In her cellar she has reeled three bolts of true fire-silk, thread with fire set into it as Hỏa Ti once made it, from the old songs. The palace holds that the last fire-silk was given to its founder in 592 (N-phuong_minh-04). If it learns the Đới can make more, it will want the house, or the songs.

people.name: Đới Hậu Cẩm
people.role: Keeps the house's table at the Tang Điền silk market
people.appearance: A soft, round man in good brocade who never raises his voice and never lowers his price first.
people.wants: A peace with the palace before his mother's war eats the house.
people.secret: He sells Chiêm Lợi Châu one red cocoon a week from the cellar stock, to learn what the palace would pay. Đới Thu Kiển, the only other who has been in the cellar, has counted the shelves.

people.name: Long Tang Chi
people.role: A mulberry picker's daughter married into the Đới; keeps the pickers' tallies
people.appearance: Mulberry-green stain on her hem; knuckles swollen like walnuts.

people.name: Đới Thu Kiển
people.role: The house's best reeler after its head
people.appearance: Her fingers never stop moving, as if reeling thread from the air.

people.name: Đới Hỏa Tằm
people.role: Wants to ride in his great-uncle's levy
people.appearance: Practises a soldier's moustache. A spear blister on each palm.

people.name: Đới Lăng Y
people.role: Carries the house's samples to Chức Hà Các
people.appearance: Silk-thread bracelets on both wrists, each from a different weaver.

people.name: Đới Sơ Cương
people.role: Keeps the reeling sheds; Đới Liệt Cương's son
people.appearance: Ducks at every doorway, even those he fits. A frown line is carved between his brows.

people.name: Đới Hồng Kiển
people.role: Breeds the red-cocoon worms
people.appearance: Smells of boiled cocoons. Her hands are warm even in winter.

people.name: Đới Tân Tằm
people.role: Has just reeled his first unbroken thread
people.appearance: Pale, thin, winded by a flight of steps; careful hands, as of a boy who has just reeled his first thread.

people.name: Tiêu Chủng Hòe
people.role: Founder of the Tiêu of Hòe Âm; planted the locust road in 520 (A102)
people.cause: old age at 185

people.name: Tiêu Thừa Âm
people.role: Head of the Tiêu of Hòe Âm: the locust road, the dye works and the post inn
people.appearance: A broad old man with a hunter's stoop and locust pollen in his beard every summer, who walks the road with a pruning hook and greets each tree by the name of the child who planted it.
people.wants: To stand in the cave his father saw before he dies, and to have a Tiêu be the one who opens it.
people.secret: He told the twelve-year-old Vấn Phong to ask the abbess about the cold light before anything else. He suspects that question, not the boy's sex, shut the gate, and for fifty years he has let his grandson build a hall on the other story.

people.name: Tiêu Thủ Đạo
people.role: Keeper of the locust road and the post inn; Tiêu Vấn Phong's father
people.appearance: A quiet innkeeper with a ledger under one arm and a locust twig behind his ear.
people.wants: His son Tiêu Vấn Phong down from the mountain for one winter at the inn.
people.secret: Every dawn he walks the locust road to the last tree and back, and sends a Tầm Kiếm guide up the mountain with a basket of his wife's dumplings for Tiêu Vấn Phong, saying it is for the guides; he has told his own father he has not set foot on the road in three years.

people.name: Hà Thu Đình
people.role: Wife of Tiêu Thủ Đạo; Tiêu Vấn Phong's mother
people.appearance: Flour in the seams of her sleeves. A thimble on a ribbon that she turns while she listens.

people.name: Tiêu Thủ Tuyền
people.role: Master of the clan's dye works and the locust-bud trade; Tiêu Ngọc Hòe's father
people.appearance: Yellow to the wrists from the vats, loud, and always about to make a wager.
people.wants: To be rid of the dyers' debts and to see his daughter Tiêu Ngọc Hòe married well.
people.secret: He plays dice with Viên Chước on loaded dice, so that the guest alchemist's debt can never be settled and stays a hold over the Pavilion.

people.name: Tiêu Vấn Canh
people.gloss: He who asks after the plough
people.role: Farms the clan's valley fields; Tiêu Vấn Phong's younger brother
people.appearance: Sniffs the air before he speaks. Answers a beat late, as if the words had to walk to him.

people.name: Tiêu Thủ Tân
people.role: Keeps the clan's boats at Hòe Âm's landing; Tiêu Bạch Lộ's father
people.appearance: Rolls like a deck when he walks on dry land. A fish-hook scar lifts the left corner of his lip, so he always looks about to laugh.

people.name: Tiêu Uyển Âm
people.role: Runs the dye vats; the Tiêu daughter who refused the hermitage
people.appearance: Yellow-dyed fringe she keeps tucking behind one ear. Her chin goes up before she says no.

people.name: Tiêu Minh Khê
people.role: Sixteen; the next Tiêu son the head means to send to Lê Hoa Am's gate
people.appearance: All wrist at sixteen; his voice breaks mid-sentence, then he clears it like a man announcing himself.

people.name: Ôn Giá Hồng
people.role: Builder of the twin bridges of Song Kiều (900, A229)
people.cause: drowned holding the north bridge's pillar in the flood of 1112 (age 262)

people.name: Ôn Trọng Lương
people.role: Head of the Ôn of Song Kiều: the twin bridges and their tolls
people.appearance: Heavy, square and slow, with mason's hands and a toll-keeper's habit of looking at a cart's axles before its driver's face.
people.wants: The ore toll raised by a tenth, and a third bridge with an Ôn toll on it before the Pivot thinks to build one of its own, and a fifth of Chân Kim's good-side fee, since every miner in his granddaughter's line crosses his north bridge.
people.secret: The north bridge's eastern pillar has been cracked since the flood that killed his father. He has had it faced over twice, and the raised toll would pay to rebuild it before a loaded ore cart finds the crack.

people.name: Ôn Thục Hà
people.role: Keeper of the toll ledgers; Tưởng Ngọc Cân's mother, married into the Tưởng of Chân Kim
people.appearance: A neat grey woman with ink on her right sleeve and toll tokens on a cord at her wrist.
people.wants: To see Tưởng Ngọc Cân hold the scales of both houses.
people.secret: She waives the toll for the miners' widows and writes it off as flood closures in the north toll book. Ôn Trọng Lương has begun to audit the closures.

people.name: Ôn Thế Hoành
people.role: Toll-master of the twin bridges; Ôn Song Ngọc's father and the head's heir
people.appearance: A tall man in a toll-keeper's oilcloth coat who counts axles under his breath.
people.wants: To be named heir in his father's lifetime, and to bring his daughter home.
people.secret: He is keeping a third toll book with the true figures, to bargain with Ôn Trọng Lương when the heir is named, and has told his clerk son Ôn Hữu Toán to copy it.

people.name: Ôn Lập Trụ
people.role: The clan's bridge mason
people.appearance: Smells of river mud. A cracked canine shows when he grins at the water.

people.name: Lỗ Hạnh Nương
people.role: Rope-maker's daughter married into the Ôn; checks the bridges' hawsers
people.appearance: Hemp burns scar her forearms in neat parallel lines. Her laugh sounds like a rope snapping.

people.name: Ôn Thanh Lưu
people.role: Poles the toll ferry when floods close the bridges
people.appearance: Stoops like the pole she carries. The far bank hears her argue.

people.name: Ôn Hữu Toán
people.role: Toll clerk of the twin bridges
people.appearance: Counts on his fingers while you speak. A pinched nose with an ink smear that is always on it.

people.name: Ôn Bích Đê
people.role: Next in the clan's line for Chân Kim's outer gate
people.appearance: Turns her head in quick birdlike jerks. Freckles at the corner of each eye; found on the roof more often than not.

people.name: Tạ Bất Vong
people.role: Led the Tạ to Phong Lâm in 470 (A193)
people.cause: old age at 186

people.name: Tạ Cựu Đường
people.role: Head of the Tạ of Phong Lâm: the hall, the school and the letters
people.appearance: A thin, upright old scholar in a robe mended so finely the mends look like embroidery, with a swallow's nest over his study door that no one may clean.
people.wants: A Tạ in a great sect's inner gate again, which has not happened since the clan came to Phong Lâm.
people.secret: The Vương stopped writing in 1160. For forty years he has written both sides of the correspondence, in two hands, so that the clan does not learn its only rival may be gone and the Tạ may be the last of the old houses.

people.name: Tạ Tri Xuân
people.role: Schoolmaster of Phong Lâm and of the Tạ; Tạ Quy Yến's father
people.appearance: A soft-spoken man with ink-stained cuffs and a child's slate always under his arm.
people.wants: Tạ Quy Yến at Nam Phố Đường, away from the swallow breath.
people.secret: He has been forging the Vương's replies to his father's letters in the Vương's own hand, softening the rude ones, and Tạ Quy Hộc has begun to notice that the hand keeps changing.

people.name: Diêu Như Lan
people.role: Wife of Tạ Tri Xuân; keeps the swallows' nests and the clan's accounts
people.appearance: Swallow feathers pinned in her hair. Mulberry pollen yellows the creases of her smile.

people.name: Tạ Tri Thu
people.role: The clan's only trader: the maple grove's sap and timber
people.appearance: Gold tooth that flashes whenever he calls a stranger friend. Maple sap stains both sleeves.

people.name: Văn Bích Thu
people.role: Wife of Tạ Tri Thu
people.appearance: Five rings on the left hand, none on the right; she never lets the left rest on the table.

people.name: Tạ Quy Hạc
people.role: Teaches in the clan school; the heir nobody asks about
people.appearance: Chalk on the left sleeve. Chalk snaps in his hand; the school bench has collapsed under him twice.

people.name: Tạ Quy Nhạn
people.role: Sixteen; the next Tạ the head means for Lạc Hà
people.appearance: Sits with a stiff back copied from her grandfather. Looks straight at whoever is speaking.

people.name: Tạ Quy Hộc
people.role: Reads the hall's letters before the head does
people.appearance: Bitten nails. Ink on her lips from holding the pen in her teeth.

people.name: Hướng Cẩn Thư
people.role: Keeper of the abbey's grain rolls under the prior; walked out to the grove in 1180 and died there
people.cause: burned out his foundation holding a rite for the hermitage in the dry winter of 1186 (age 68)

people.name: Sử Vân Hòa
people.role: The abbess's attendant at the rite ground
people.appearance: Two rite-pole calluses across each palm; she counts her breaths aloud in a whisper.

people.name: Thái Hưởng Đoạn
people.role: A Tower reject who walked to the abbey
people.appearance: Bell-shaped birthmark on his neck, rubbed raw whenever a bell is mentioned.

people.name: Khang Vũ Ngưng
people.role: Rain-caller at the abbey's house in Thu Trì
people.appearance: Her left middle finger is dyed blue from the Thu Trì stalls; she tucks it away when buyers look.

people.name: Đường Hạ Thảo
people.role: Weeds the abbey's herb beds
people.appearance: Stammers on hard consonants, with soil packed for good under his nails; he laughs at a joke a half-beat after the room has moved on.

people.name: Vi Hòa Ca
people.role: Terrace novice from Ương Ca
people.appearance: Chipped front tooth; her voice rasps at the top of every note.

people.name: Tống Tiết Trúc
people.role: Pole-cutter in the lightning-bamboo grove, of the hermitage
people.appearance: Bare feet scarred from split cane; a streak of lightning-white hair at the left temple.

people.name: Thời Tri Tiết
people.role: Prior (giám viện) of the abbey: its stores, its tax, and the rain it sells at a posted price
people.appearance: A plump, pleasant monk with an abacus in his sleeve and the soft hands of a man who keeps the books.
people.wants: The abbey's granary full and its pills paid for, and Hà Tĩnh Cần's grove crawling back to the gate for a bowl of rice.
people.secret: He has taken a Thu Trì buyer's deposit for the rain of the next great drought, to be called by Dương Hảo Vũ, who does not know and who may not live through it.

people.name: Lục Đạo Hoa
people.role: Master of the spirit-rice terraces; a son of the Lục family of Phong Đăng
people.appearance: A tall, sunburnt man with a landlord's good boots and a farmer's hands.
people.wants: A terrace harvest no tax can reach, and a place for every boy the Bell Test turned away.
people.secret: He is paying his family's tithe on the terraces out of his own seed rice and telling the abbess the harvest covered it; the sacks will run out by autumn.

people.name: Lã Tiềm Dạ
people.gloss: Steals into the night (Đỗ Phủ: tùy phong tiềm nhập dạ)
people.role: The abbey's rain-caller in Thu Trì, who calls the Night Rain Market's rain
people.appearance: Tall, in a black rain cloak over the abbey's grey, seen in Thu Trì only on dry nights.
people.wants: A room above the market with a window on the rain, and no grey robe to wear in it.
people.secret: Each dry night she sells the rain to a Thu Trì dyer as well as to Kiều Mãn Lâu, and the second water comes thinner every time; the market's measure will tell within a month.

people.name: Lam Nhuận Chi
people.gloss: A moistened herb (Đỗ Phủ: nhuận vật)
people.role: Herb nun of the abbey's gardens
people.appearance: Sniffs every hand she shakes, as if reading it.

people.name: Hà Tĩnh Cần
people.gloss: Water celery in a quiet ditch
people.role: Rite master who walked out of Cốc Vũ Quán in 1180; keeps the hermitage in Lôi Trúc Lâm and calls rain for nothing
people.appearance: A small, sun-dark, frail woman in grey hemp gone white at the knees, with the pale mark of a rite bell's cord still on her wrist.
people.wants: To see the free rain come down as rain again, and to learn why her rites fail.
people.secret: She no longer thinks the failing is hers: she sleeps out in the grove by night to catch whoever is cutting the poles short, and the man she watches most is her friend Sở Lôi Duẩn.

people.name: Sở Lôi Duẩn
people.role: Keeper of Lôi Trúc Lâm, the lightning-bamboo grove; cuts the rite poles for the hermitage and for the abbey
people.appearance: Smells of green cane smoke; the ring finger of his left hand is gone at the knuckle.

people.name: Thiều Mộ Canh
people.role: A Lục tenant boy who failed the Tower's Bell Test and came to the terraces
people.appearance: Squints from staring at the Bell the day it stopped; wears a bandage on the shin for the third dropped pole this month.

people.name: Đổng Tiểu Ương
people.role: A planting singer from Ương Ca
people.appearance: Two back teeth missing from a fall at a planting dance, which she shows when she laughs.

people.name: Lô Tân Châu
people.role: A Hà Châu boy at the hermitage who wants the risen isle for rice
people.appearance: Eyes that drift to the horizon in mid-sentence; rope scars across both knuckles.

people.name: Vạn Tiểu Hòa
people.role: Ferry girl from Thượng Độ who carries the rain-caller's gear
people.appearance: Sunburn line across the nose that has never faded; shoulders wide from a ferry pole.

people.name: Tần Xuân Duẩn
people.role: Novice from the bamboo-shoot village
people.appearance: One trouser leg rolled higher than the other; bamboo-sheath fuzz on his sleeves.

people.name: Hạng Đảo Vũ
people.role: Founder of Cốc Vũ Quán (610): a coast rain priestess who called rain with Water
people.cause: spent the last of her core on the rite in a dry year, under the last rain she could call (age 398)

people.name: Thường Cự Luân
people.role: Journeyman of the array hall, who keeps its silver book
people.appearance: Silver-wire rings on every finger but the thumb, clicking whenever he reaches for a coin.

people.name: Tiêu Tĩnh Ảnh
people.role: Steward of the dusk walk, who keeps its register
people.appearance: The novices call her the Heron, for how long she stands over the register before she writes a line.

people.name: Khâu Bắc Hành
people.role: Outer disciple from the yak village, the lake watcher's lamp-bearer
people.appearance: Smells of yak butter and lamp smoke, so the lake birds know him in the dark.

people.name: Lỗ Tinh Sa
people.role: Inner disciple at Vẫn Tinh Khoáng, who sorts the star iron
people.appearance: Hefts every stone twice and says its weight aloud, and is never wrong.

people.name: Ổ Đồ Nam
people.role: Outer disciple of the chart room, who mixes its inks
people.appearance: Sniffs the ink pot before he stirs it; his thumbnails are black as beetles.

people.name: Uông Thạch Linh
people.role: Inner disciple of the array hall, sent on paid jobs
people.appearance: One silver tooth, which she says she won in a bargain.

people.name: Bồ Kim Quy
people.role: Outer disciple from the angelica village, who wipes the armillary's rings
people.appearance: Smells of angelica root; the abbey swears the wiping cloth jumps from her hand on purpose.

people.name: Tô Tinh Nghi
people.role: Prioress of the abbey and keeper of the armillary Tuyền Cơ Nghi
people.appearance: A tall, upright Daoist with ink-stained cuffs and a star-iron ring she turns while she talks.
people.wants: To carry the next warning to the Pivot herself, at the Bridge Court, in open session, so that this time it is written down.
people.secret: She has kept a second book of readings since 1188, in which she writes what she guesses the head will not tell her.

people.name: Phó Cương Đẩu
people.role: Master of the array hall, which lays formations for hire across the plateau
people.appearance: A busy, round man with a measuring cord around his neck and a cart of star-iron discs behind him.
people.wants: To be the one trade the plateau cannot do without: every granary, mine and camp ringed by his crews, and Vệ Văn Cơ (ve_van_co) out of work.
people.secret: He skims one disc in ten from the star iron Sầm Lạc Thiết (sam_lac_thiet) sends up and sells them at the Pivot's iron fair, and is lowering the count in Thường Cự Luân's (thuong_cu_luan) silver book to cover the gap.

people.name: Đổng Tịnh Hồ
people.role: Watcher of Tinh Lạc Hồ, who reads the Dipper in the lake each night
people.appearance: A pale, quiet woman who lives in a reed hut on the lake shore and is never seen by day.
people.wants: To be told truthfully whether the pole star is gone from the lake, or to see it back in the water.
people.secret: Each clear night she scratches the lake's true reading, pole gap and all, on a slate and buries it under her hut floor for whoever asks one day; Ngô Hoàng Thảo (ngo_hoang_thao) brings the tea and has seen the slates stacking.

people.name: Sầm Lạc Thiết
people.role: Keeper of Vẫn Tinh Khoáng, the abbey's mine of true star iron
people.appearance: A heavy, slow man who hums along with the array discs when they ring.
people.wants: Barley enough that the mine is never hungry, and one honest seat at the abbey's table.
people.secret: He is padding this spring's sack for Thối Tinh's buyer with plain iron painted dark, and Lỗ Tinh Sa (lo_tinh_sa), who weighs out the discs by hand, does not yet know why the heavy ones keep disappearing from her pile.

people.name: Bùi Thiên Đồ
people.role: Keeper of the star charts, including Khuy Thiên's
people.appearance: One milky eye, which he squints through a lens of rock crystal.

people.name: Trịnh Tiểu Đẩu
people.role: Inner disciple of the array hall
people.appearance: A laugh that startles the lake geese off the water.

people.name: Ân Chiếu Nguyệt
people.role: Inner disciple and the prioress's copyist
people.appearance: Broad cook's forearms stick out of narrow copyist's sleeves.

people.name: Ngô Hoàng Thảo
people.role: Outer disciple from the yak village who serves the lake watcher
people.appearance: Talks low, as if the wind were listening, and has tea stains down one sleeve.

people.name: Vu Đương Quy
people.role: Outer disciple at the star-iron mine
people.appearance: Lids droop mid-sentence, and his answer arrives a breath after the question.

people.name: Phan Khắc Luân
people.role: Outer disciple from the craftsmen's village, who carves armillary rings
people.appearance: Walks bow-legged, like the wheelwright carts he grew up under.

people.name: Lệnh Hồ Chiêm
people.role: Founder of Củng Tinh Quán (150), maker of the armillary Tuyền Cơ Nghi
people.cause: a failed breakthrough to Nguyên Anh at the armillary, at 470

people.name: Úc Tri Vi
people.role: Last head of Khuy Thiên Các, who went blind and brought his charts to Củng Tinh in 650
people.cause: a foundation cracked by a forced breakthrough gave way at 390, blind, in the abbey's chart room

people.name: Bành Dạ Hàng
people.role: Leader of the night riders over Tinh Tủy Mạch, born at the plateau mine
people.appearance: A cracked riding glove on his left hand, a crane quill behind each ear, and a cropped grey beard.

people.name: Hà Vĩ Lăng
people.role: Groom of the breeding reeds at Hạc Quy Thôn
people.appearance: A bent old man wading the reeds to the thigh; the chicks answer his grunt, the full-grown cranes never do.

people.name: Mộ Cao Yến
people.role: Rider found on the hawk-catchers' terrace in 1196
people.appearance: Sleeps with a hawk-catcher's glove under her cheek, and cannot stay in the marsh past the second bell.

people.name: Lộ Phi Sương
people.role: Rider from Tập Trận Khoáng, Lộ Khinh Trần's cousin, at the roc camp
people.appearance: A satchel strap rubbed thin, and his cousin's family nose.

people.name: Ngụy Hà Lô
people.role: Groom who digs the reed graves for the cranes
people.appearance: Mud in her braid, and shovel calluses across both palms.

people.name: Đậu Quang Lãng
people.role: Groom from Ba Quang Thôn, who rows the feed boats
people.appearance: Net-scarred fingers, and he looks up at every passing crane.

people.name: Sử Mạn Thanh
people.role: Groom who copies the flight ledger in the marsh hall
people.appearance: Ink-blacked fingers, and a key on a string round her neck.

people.name: Cừ Vân Lý
people.role: First rider and master of the winter terrace on Thương Ưng Đài, who finds the plateau's Wind children
people.appearance: A silent man in a cloak of crane down who smells of wind and felt, and squints even indoors.
people.wants: A Wind-born child from the mine this winter, found before Phất Y's head can reach the family.
people.secret: Each winter he tells the families of the children he takes that they will be home by spring, and keeps a tin of the children's toys in his terrace hut, sending one back every year so that it seems true. Mộ Cao Yến (mo_cao_yen) has begun to ask why her mother's toy never came.

people.name: Mai Lô Tuyết
people.role: Master of the grooms and the marsh; the strongest cultivator in the school who cannot ride
people.appearance: A slow, broad woman always wet to the knee, with reed cuts on her hands and a crane chick under her arm.
people.wants: To bring the old cranes home from the circuit to die on the reeds, not the road.
people.secret: She has hidden the three most worn-out cranes in a reed bed no one else knows, so the circuit cannot ask for them again, and Ngụy Hà Lô (nguy_ha_lo), who keeps the second ledger, has written them down as buried.

people.name: Tống Phi Thư
people.role: The letter rider: flies the Pivot's post to its vassals and the north
people.appearance: A cheerful rider with a satchel of sealed jade tallies across his back and wine on his breath.
people.wants: Khổng Tường Vũ on the same crane as him for one flight, before the roc eats her.
people.secret: At every vassal's gate where he drinks he repeats what the gate said to Vi Thừa Phong (vi_thua_phong), who has begun to write it up for the Pivot's records as the school's own report.

people.name: Khổng Tường Vũ
people.role: Beast tamer camped below the roc's cliff, who means to ride it
people.appearance: Roc-goat hair on her sleeves, and one eye narrowed against the cliff.

people.name: Ninh Vân Tước
people.role: Young rider from the hawk-catchers' camps
people.appearance: Hawk-claw scars up both forearms, and a crane feather braided into her hair.

people.name: Lư Thủy Điền
people.role: Groom from the crane village
people.appearance: Soft-handed for a groom, and yawning before the sun is fully up.

people.name: Hạ Tri Hàn
people.role: Groom from Cự Môn Trấn, of a family that fled Hắc Thạch Trấn in 874
people.appearance: Never sets his kit-bag down; an old spearhead wrapped in rag lies at the bottom of it.

people.name: Phạm Thanh Lô
people.role: The newest groom, from the raft village
people.appearance: Still smells of river pine, with raft-rope blisters on both hands.

people.name: Đồng Dược Hương
people.role: Crane doctor of the marsh
people.appearance: Crane blood on her apron, and a reed splint tucked behind each ear.

people.name: Tần Minh Cao
people.role: Founder of Cửu Cao Phái (700); the first to share breath with a crane of the nine marshes
people.cause: a spear wound from the flight over Phá Quân's fort in 872 reopened at 445; he died of it on the day the cranes came back
people.appearance: Remembered as a lean hawk-catcher with a crane feather braided into his beard.

people.name: Nhan Tuyết Linh
people.role: Rider who fell over Phá Quân Môn in 872 with the Pivot's letter
people.cause: brought down by Phá Quân's spears over the rebel fort, carrying the Pivot's message
people.appearance: Remembered as a young woman in a slate-grey riding cap, her crane's neck-ring sewn to her cuff.

people.name: Trác Hồng Đà
people.role: Keeper of the horse lines; an old rider of the knee of 1121
people.appearance: Left ear half gone to frost; he tilts his head to hide it.

people.name: Cổ Xích Nguyệt
people.role: Granddaughter of the first cup-bearer; pours for the young blades
people.appearance: A cup-shaped scar between thumb and finger where her grandfather's jade cup split.

people.name: Na Lạc Linh
people.role: Escort rider on the Đà Linh road
people.appearance: A camel bell tied into her braid, ringing at every step.

people.name: Đan Mục Lang
people.role: Groom of the horse lines
people.appearance: A long plain face that only the grey mare seems to admire.

people.name: Kiều Liệt Ca
people.role: Young blade; Cừu Lạc Nhật's disciple
people.appearance: Black veins climbing the back of the hand that holds the rope.

people.name: Thôi Kim Đới
people.role: Trấn Sa guard's daughter who rode out to Dạ Quang in 1197
people.appearance: A guard's blue sash cut down to a wristband she never takes off.

people.name: Diêu Lưu Ly
people.role: Blows the glass cups of the poorer riders
people.appearance: Counts glass beads in her pocket when she thinks no one is watching.

people.name: Đồ Xích Linh
people.role: Hạng Dạ Bôi's second wife and first blade; runs the Đà Linh road as a toll, and her band strikes the trains that ride without Dạ Quang
people.appearance: A lean desert woman in red felt, with a hawk feather knotted to her sabre and a smile that the Pavilion's envoys do not like.
people.wants: The road kept as it is: Dạ Quang's tally the highest the Pavilion pays, and every small train on it paying her for the privilege of arriving. The hostage kept at the Pavilion, because a son raised beside the keeper of the caravan road would ride with Ô Liệt Phong and end it. After that, Dạ Quang unbound, within her husband's lifetime or after it.
people.secret: Her band strikes the trains that ride without Dạ Quang while Ô Liệt Phong is out on the long leg; she reads his legs off the board at the Đà Linh well, and buys Trấn Sa's routes from Tất Dạ Lang so that the band never meets a Trấn Sa guard (she does not know Viên Cô Yên makes them false). The drivers it takes are fed to Cừu Lạc Nhật's sabre with Triệu Huyết Y's art. And she has Cổ Xích Nguyệt leave a cup at a caravan stop each season, so that the Pavilion stays uneasy and keeps her stepson.

people.name: Hạng Lưu Hỏa
people.gloss: Flowing fire (the seventh month's falling star)
people.role: Hạng Dạ Bôi's daughter; leader of the young blades, who ride in her mother's band
people.appearance: Her father's height and her mother's smile, in a riding coat with a night-glow cup sewn on the breast.
people.wants: To ride at the head of the road before her mother is finished with it, and once to see her half-brother and learn whether the hostage is soft.
people.secret: She skims a tenth of every toll her mother's band takes into a jar buried behind the cup tent, to buy riders who will follow her and not Đồ Xích Linh.

people.name: Ô Liệt Phong
people.role: Captain of Dạ Quang's caravan escorts since 1121
people.appearance: A weathered, tidy rider from the camel-bell town who keeps the escort's ledgers in a hand better than his master's.
people.wants: A road where any small trader can join his train without fear, and enough saved to retire to Đà Linh Trấn with a ledger-house of his own.
people.secret: He has begun posting false legs on the Đà Linh board, routes his escort never rides, to see whether wrapped riders come for them; the day they do, he will know whose band it is, and Đồ Xích Linh reads that board.

people.name: Cừu Lạc Nhật
people.gloss: Setting sun (and a surname that means vengeance)
people.role: Young blade; Đồ Xích Linh's disciple
people.appearance: Black stains in the knuckles of his sabre hand that he has stopped scrubbing.

people.name: Ổ Sa Nhi
people.role: Outer rider from the felt tents
people.appearance: A saddle-sore limp she hides by riding faster.

people.name: Mãn Xích Câu
people.role: Young blade who drinks with Hạng Lưu Hỏa
people.appearance: A chipped front tooth and a laugh that starts before the joke.

people.name: Hùng Đà Linh
people.role: Escort boy from the camel-bell town
people.appearance: The weave of a saddle blanket pressed into one cheek.

people.name: Tất Dạ Lang
people.role: A caravan guard's son who deserted Trấn Sa Đường for Dạ Quang
people.appearance: A neat wedge of beard he trims with a knife he swears was his father's.

people.name: Liêm Hỏa Nhi
people.role: Youngest rider; Hạng Lưu Hỏa's disciple
people.appearance: Hair singed short on one side where a cup-lamp caught it.

people.name: Lâu Minh Châu
people.role: Hạng Dạ Bôi's first wife, mother of Hạng Minh Sa; keeper of the loot at Huyết Đao Trại
people.cause: burned at Huyết Đao Trại when Băng Tâm fired the stockade (V074), at 61

people.name: Cổ Mạc Phong
people.role: The first cup-bearer: Hạng Dạ Bôi's sworn brother and co-founder
people.cause: killed holding the gate of Huyết Đao Trại against Băng Tâm (V074), at 241

people.name: Khang Lãng Sa
people.role: Triệu Huyết Y's disciple and letter-carrier; Khang Tẩy Kim's nephew
people.appearance: A sunburned river man with a gold-washer's pan on his back and three letters sewn into his coat at any time.
people.wants: To carry a letter that holds only good news, once, and to be asked to sit down while it is read.
people.secret: He gambles the letter-fees away at dice with the caravan drivers of Đào Sa Thị and owes forty stones to Xá Tiểu Sa's uncle, the dice-keeper, and he has begun to wonder whose letter he might sell to settle it.

people.name: Ngư Mộng Tê
people.role: Eldest of the U Lan children; the first of them to kill
people.appearance: A raftsman's daughter with heavy-lidded eyes who is never tired and never sits still, and who has stopped going down to Phóng Mộc on market days.
people.wants: To go south to the Tower, where Darkness is fed in the open, and to take Ấn Tiểu Mặc with her.
people.secret: She is drinking from one raftsman's hut a month, stopping a breath short, and keeps the count in scratches under the lichen of the gorge wall. Sung Ngọc Khê has found the scratches, and she has not yet decided whether to scare him or to teach him.

people.name: Sung Ngọc Khê
people.role: The U Lan child who will not drink; keeps the gorge's records
people.appearance: White to the wrist with lime dust on the backs of his hands, which he never wipes.

people.name: Khoái Hồng Ngạc
people.role: Khoái Thiết Ưng's foundling daughter; sells his blood pills in Tinh Hán Thành
people.appearance: Left ear notched where a mine-cart chain caught it. Smells of iron and cloves before she arrives.

people.name: Tòng Bích Linh
people.role: Keeper of Hám Tàn Chung's ledger; frees one soul a year
people.appearance: A neat woman with ink on her cuffs and a small green bell on her wrist that she rings once a year.
people.wants: To learn whether the breaths she rings free over the river arrive anywhere, and, before Hám dies, to be told by someone that the writing was not a sin.
people.secret: Each Hungry Ghost she enters the freed breath in the ledger as spoiled. This year she is writing Mật Thu Ninh's son in the same way a month early, so that the lamp will already be entered as lost on the night she rings it free.

people.name: Biệt Tri Phản
people.role: A former blood-pill seller of the Night Rain Market who sells ma đạo heads to the Pivot's hound
people.appearance: A thin man in a good rain cloak who sits with his back to walls and carries a ledger of faces.
people.wants: The name of whoever made the pill that killed his brother, and a cellar deep enough to hold the money.
people.secret: Under the inn at Thu Trì he has kept a pill-maker's daughter, nine years old, in a dry cellar for three years as the price of her mother's recipes. Cư Tiểu Lang carries her bowl down and has been told not to ask.

people.name: Dưỡng Khô Chi
people.role: An alchemist expelled from Thúy Vi's Furnace Hall; heals by moving sickness into something else
people.appearance: An old man with green-stained hands who keeps a dead tree for every patient in a grove behind his hut.
people.wants: A body that can hold what he moves, so that he need no longer put it into others.
people.secret: He is moving his own decay out of himself a year at a time, into a bound farm boy of Thiêu Hôi Thôn. He sent Tiển Hôi Nhi across the west so that the boy would not be seen to fail.

people.name: Cáo Sa Lang
people.role: A rider expelled from Dạ Quang Môn for drinking a caravan guard's blood; rides alone for hire
people.appearance: Rust-brown front teeth no scrubbing shifts. A voice worn soft as sand, a grin held a moment too long.

people.name: Mật Thu Ninh
people.role: A widow of Hòe Âm who keeps her dead son's breath in a lamp and feeds it her blood
people.appearance: A pale, upright woman of a good Hòe Âm house with a bandaged left wrist, carrying a clay lamp in both hands; things crack in her hands, and the lamp has twice.
people.wants: A body for her son, even a borrowed one, even for a day.
people.secret: She is haggling with Hám Tàn Chung for a second breath, her own, to put in the lamp beside the boy's so that the voice may be half right. He has named a price of thirty years, and she is counting what she has.

people.name: Ngao Tầm Phủ
people.role: An abode-robber of Hòe Âm who buys maps and sells what he finds
people.appearance: Two fingers short on the left hand. He says a cave took them; nobody believes the cave.

people.name: Chi Dạ Hành
people.role: U Lan child from Hầu Đầu Thôn; sleepwalks toward the village
people.appearance: Barefoot, fresh mud on his heels each morning, a rope-burn round the left ankle. Takes a breath before answering, then answers something else.

people.name: Ấn Tiểu Mặc
people.role: Youngest U Lan cultivator; Ngư Mộng Tê's pupil
people.appearance: Plait to her knees, never cut; she sometimes stands on it.

people.name: Tiển Hôi Nhi
people.role: A Darkness child who walked from the Thúy Vi karst to U Lan Cốc
people.appearance: Speaks slowly, carefully. A tremor in the right thumb sets the ink dancing on every letter.

people.name: Hạnh Liên Y
people.role: Triệu Huyết Y's second disciple; a fur-seller who carries news from the Pavilion's lake
people.appearance: Pink robe worn thin at the cuffs; fur hairs on the sleeves in every season.

people.name: Khích Tiểu Chung
people.role: Hám Tàn Chung's runner: finds the dying and brings word
people.appearance: His eyes rest on strangers' throats, never on their faces. He whistles through his teeth at funerals.

people.name: Bộ Thiết Sinh
people.role: A Huyền Thiết miner's son who climbed Hắc Ưng Phong to duel and stayed
people.appearance: Sweeps with a duellist's stance. A pale scar round his neck looks like a drawn string.

people.name: Cư Tiểu Lang
people.role: Biệt Tri Phản's apprentice; watches the Night Rain Market's doors
people.appearance: Split upper lip healed crooked: he seems to smile at nothing, and the inn girls look elsewhere.

people.name: Việt Đà Nhi
people.role: A caravan hand of Đà Linh Trấn who buys Cáo Sa Lang's blood to ride harder
people.appearance: Red-rimmed eyes that never quite close. Lips cracked into white seams.

people.name: Dung Tỉnh Nhi
people.role: A well-digger's boy of Đàm Ảnh Thành; Tra Hàm Tuyền's pupil
people.appearance: Earth-grey to the elbow, with a well-rope scar in a ring round the right palm.

people.name: Xá Tiểu Sa
people.role: A gold-washer girl of Đào Sa Thị who wants to be the woman in the red robe
people.appearance: A fleck of gold glitters in the web of her thumb, worked in by the river sand.

people.name: Hám Tàn Chung
people.role: The soul pedlar: buys the last breaths of the dying and sells them to cultivators who need them
people.appearance: A stooped, clean old man in a pedlar's grey coat, a black lamp on a pole over his shoulder and a cracked hand bell at his belt that never rings.
people.wants: To keep the ledger honest: every breath paid for, every price written down, no one taken who did not sell.
people.secret: Lạc Đan Thanh buys a thread a year from him for the breakthrough pills he sells to cultivators who have already failed once, and pays in silence. And the cracked bell holds his mother's breath, which he took in 1097 without asking her, the one entry missing from the ledger.

people.name: Sào Ẩn Lan
people.gloss: The orchid hidden in the nest
people.role: Keeper of U Lan Cốc, where the karst children whose Darkness wakes go when no sect will take them
people.appearance: A thin woman with ink-grey fingertips and a pale stone at her throat, who speaks very softly, as if someone in the next room were asleep.
people.wants: A Darkness method that does not take, found before her children need one.
people.secret: Most nights she drinks from Hầu Đầu Thôn, her own village, so that the children need not, and her brother's grandchildren wake tired. In 1193 Ngư Mộng Tê drank a raftsman of Phóng Mộc Thôn dry, and Sào buried him in the gorge. This year Đới Huyền Nghiên answered her letter at last: the hall pays him by the sheet to paint Lạc Hà's war orders in the dark ink, and he asks whether the gorge has room for one more.

people.name: Khoái Thiết Ưng
people.role: A Hắc Phong stockade boy who fled north with the captain's sabre: a blood duelist on Hắc Ưng Phong
people.appearance: A broad grey man with a sabre across his knees and a beard stained rust at the corners.
people.wants: To meet the climber who is still standing at the end, as none has been in forty years; until then to keep each loser bleeding on the rock until the stone has drunk him, while Bộ Thiết Sinh sweeps the blood off the step.
people.secret: He cheats: a chip of the peak's Darkness stone sits in his sabre's hilt and clouds a challenger's eyes in the last exchange. Khoái Hồng Ngạc grinds the chips down and sells them in Tinh Hán Thành as luck charms, and the price has begun to draw buyers up the mountain.

people.name: Tra Hàm Tuyền
people.role: Văn Hải Khô's disciple, left behind in the west: a well-drinker who holds the Hollow Tide Scripture
people.appearance: A dry, tidy old man who carries a gourd and never drinks from anyone's well while they watch.
