people.wants: To drink one well of Tình Sa to the bottom and live, and then to walk to the Tower and ask its head what Văn Hải Khô ate on his last night.
people.secret: He has had Dung Tỉnh Nhi dig a new well beside the bitter one at Tình Sa, and means to let the village drink from it for a season before he does. Last winter, in Dung's own village, he drank a well dry and sat on the lip for three days to watch what the children did.

people.name: Tra Cam Tỉnh
people.role: The Bitter Well of Tình Sa: a well-keeper's daughter who made the last well undrinkable; the river towns still tell it
people.cause: went into the last well of Tình Sa Thôn to spoil it for Văn Hải Khô (age 27)

people.name: Sách Viễn Thư
people.role: A wandering talisman master; Mặc Huyết Sinh's teacher and the first ink of the Blood-Ink Canon
people.cause: killed by his disciple Mặc Huyết Sinh, who made a brush from his hair (age 290)

people.name: Phan Tĩnh Ba
people.role: Weigher of the Shore House: the first ledger and the pearl scales at the Nguyệt Tân market
people.appearance: Spectacles of polished pearl-shell, through which she weighs you as she would a pearl.

people.name: Đàm Thiềm Đăng
people.role: Lamp-trimmer of the pool: fills and trims the shell false moon and feeds the spirit fish
people.appearance: His eyebrows were singed off by the shell lamp and never fully grew back.

people.name: Mông Bạch Giác
people.role: Outer diver from Tuyết Lộc; Mông Lộc Nhi's younger brother
people.appearance: Reindeer-hide hat, and a boast ready for any silence.

people.name: Nhan Bích Thủy
people.role: Inner disciple of the Shore House; sorts pearls at the Nguyệt Tân market
people.appearance: Her basket smells of brine at all hours.

people.name: Thư Ảnh Đàm
people.role: Inner disciple at the pool; knows the four hundred spirit fish by their dead names
people.appearance: Speaks to the fish by their dead names, under her breath.

people.name: Lã Tiểu Bối
people.role: Outer diver; Lã Tư Châu's cousin and his oyster-carrier
people.appearance: Drums his heels on every step he sits on, and does not stay sat.

people.name: Viên Tiềm Nhi
people.role: Inner disciple of the heir; the second-best young diver, and sure she is the first
people.appearance: Announces her breath-hold times unasked; the barrel chest comes from the diving.

people.name: Mục Tiềm Uyên
people.role: Keeper of the moon pool and the spirit fish; the elder who lights the false moon
people.appearance: A thin, stooped man whose hands are always wet and whose robe smells of the pool.
people.wants: To see the shallows below the stilt-halls left fallow before spring, and to die with more fish in the pool than he found there.
people.secret: He is carrying the spirit fish fry out of the overseeded shallows by night, a hundred in a basket each week, to a pond he dug behind Backwater Village; Đào Nguyệt Lân (dao_nguyet_lan) names each one on the way and says nothing to the mistress.

people.name: Lam Hàm Sương
people.gloss: Holding frost (a name her mother hoped for)
people.role: The mistress's true disciple and chosen heir; the first heir in four hundred years without the Kiều frost
people.appearance: A tall net-maker's daughter with a calm face; Kha Toán Châu's ledgers have inked her fingers.
people.wants: To be mistress without the frost, and to hear the shore families say her name before a Kiều child's.
people.secret: She is teaching herself the Ice method from scrolls she copied at the Lake Hall's market, and freezes a bowl of pool water every night to see whether the frost will take in a root that has none.

people.name: Kha Toán Châu
people.role: Steward of the shore house: the pearl ledgers, the market at Nguyệt Tân and the tithe to the pines
people.appearance: A neat, small man with an abacus of pearl beads, two brushes behind one ear.
people.wants: To die with both ledgers added up right, and to know before Kiều Nguyệt Châu does whether the north beds will be found.
people.secret: He shaves one pearl in a hundred from the tenth into a third, unwritten pouch buried under the shore house's third stair, against the day both ledgers are read aloud.

people.name: Quách Bất Trầm
people.role: Chief diver of the pearl beds
people.appearance: A rope of white scar runs round his ribs where an air-line once cut him.

people.name: Đào Nguyệt Lân
people.role: Breeder of the spirit fish under the keeper of the pool
people.appearance: Hums to the fish, a scale always stuck to her sleeve.

people.name: Kiều Vọng Thiềm
people.role: Outer disciple; Kiều Hàn Nguyệt's elder brother, born without the frost
people.appearance: Keeps his dry, unfrosted hand in his sleeve.

people.name: Mông Lộc Nhi
people.role: Diver of the north beds; descendant of the fisher who found the fist pearl
people.appearance: Reindeer-fur cuffs on a diver's arms; salt keeps her eyes red-rimmed.

people.name: Lã Tư Châu
people.role: Inner disciple of the shore house; wants the dead beds of Cựu Châu Trấn seeded again
people.appearance: Oyster shells clink in his pockets at every step.

people.name: Ngụy Tiểu Ngư
people.role: Outer disciple and net-mender from Sái Võng Thôn
people.appearance: Laughs a beat after the joke, loudest of all, with a net needle behind his ear.

people.name: Đinh Lưu Ly
people.role: Inner disciple of the heir; the manor's best young diver
people.appearance: Turns a coin over and over in her palm.

people.name: Đới Thiềm Quang
people.role: Founder of Hàm Nguyệt Trang (410); a Tuyết Lộc diver who said the moon in the lake is easier to catch
people.cause: walked out onto the lake at the full moon and was not found, at 310

people.name: Kiều Băng Liên
people.gloss: Ice lotus (the name she was given after 748)
people.role: Mistress of Hàm Nguyệt Trang (820-1150); kept the spirit fish alive through the freeze of 748; sank the boats in 942
people.cause: died of age in the pool hall, at 500

people.name: Thư Vấn Triều
people.role: Mạc Quy Khư's ferryman and keeper of the Book of Questions on Dục Nhật Đảo
people.appearance: A lean, sun-black boatman with a scholar's ink-stained fingers and a ledger wrapped in oilcloth at his belt.
people.wants: To be asked a question himself, once, and to answer it in his own name.
people.secret: He writes the year's answers in the old man's name and has sold the third one to a captain of Lận Viễn Phàm's boats for two hundred stones. He gave Cam Thủ Nguyện an answer about her son's boat that he invented, and cannot now bring himself to say that it was not Mạc's.

people.name: Khuyết Vãn Hà
people.gloss: Evening glow, the name her master gave her from her own
people.role: Cao Đan Hà's herb girl, now a hermit alchemist at Đào Hoa Thang; the one who sealed her master's abode
people.appearance: A small grey woman with cassia-brown hands and a basket on her back, who smells of every herb on the mountain at once.
people.wants: To learn whether her village's cassia was what killed her master, and to be told so by someone who knows.
people.secret: She has been dosing Phàn Đỗ Nhược's morning gruel with the cassia in small amounts, to see what it did to Cao Đan Hà. He does not know why he sleeps through noon, and she writes down how long.

people.name: Giản Thu Địch
people.role: Lương Lạc Mai's last disciple, a Wind-rooted flute hermit on Minh Cầm Phong who has kept her master's abode shut for 340 years
people.appearance: A long-boned woman in mine-grey with a bamboo flute through her belt like a sword, who stops talking whenever the wind changes and has never slept two nights running in the same place on the peak.
people.wants: To open the door once more and bury the flute with its player, and to be forgiven by a dead woman.
people.secret: Each night she plays the second flute's part through the sealed door, and lately the flute inside has answered in a tune she never taught anyone.

people.name: Kê Thính Đào
people.role: Đoạn Thương Hải's only disciple; a fisher girl the lightning struck in the strait
people.appearance: A wiry woman with salt-cracked lips and a fern of lightning scars down one arm, who describes the sea out loud whether anyone is listening or not.
people.wants: To cut the strait's storms to a price, and to out-sail Tần Đảo Ảnh before the blind man dies.
people.secret: She sells the blind master's weather readings to Lận Viễn Phàm's boat captains by the bolt and keeps a third, and has not yet told Đoạn Thương Hải why the pool's debt to the boats has grown.

people.name: Đậu Tiễn Xuân
people.role: Keeper of the Farewell Cup tavern in Tống Khách Thị, who pours the cup for the traveller of 900
people.appearance: A round, quick woman with resin on her sleeves and a laugh that carries across the market square.
people.wants: To pour the cup just once for someone who will tell her who it was for.
people.secret: She has watered the Farewell Cup's wine by a third for twenty years and pocketed the difference, and she has begun to wonder whether Tư Không Hạc Niên can taste it.

people.name: Phàn Đỗ Nhược
people.gloss: Đỗ nhược, a fragrant marsh herb
people.role: Khuyết Vãn Hà's disciple, who grinds her herbs and carries her pills down the mountain
people.appearance: Wipes his flattened nose on the back of his wrist, then on his sleeve; the old break never set straight.

people.name: Nhiễm Hàn Châu
people.role: A Frost-Test failure of Băng Tâm Các who hunts the cold light on the southern massif with a bought map
people.appearance: Frost took the tips of three fingers; the nails left are white, ridged. He keeps the hand in his sleeve.

people.name: Hác Tẫn Đăng
people.role: A vent-sitter of Tuyết Hỏa Giác who believes Cung Hỏa Vân's fire still burns in the cape
people.appearance: Eyebrows singed to stubble. She looks at a pilgrim's face first, decides before they speak.

people.name: Trâu Vọng Bằng
people.role: A beast tamer alone on Đồ Nam Đảo, waiting for the great Bằng to come back
people.appearance: Seabird droppings dried on his shoulders like epaulettes. A missing front tooth whistles when he talks.

people.name: Thư Tiểu Chu
people.role: Thư Vấn Triều's granddaughter, who rows the pilgrims' boat
people.appearance: Cropped hair always wet. Oar-callus wide as a coin on each palm.

people.name: Bốc Tuyết Nha
people.role: A girl of Hàn Mai turned away at the plum gate for having no Metal, come to ask the sword sage for what he gave Lăng Đạp Tuyết
people.appearance: Coughs into her sleeve. Plum petals are still pressed in her hem.

people.name: Bao Tiểu Quế
people.role: Khuyết Vãn Hà's herb boy
people.appearance: Bees follow him; his sleeves are cinnamon-brown.

people.name: Cam Thủ Nguyện
people.role: A widow of Cô Vụ Đảo who crosses to Dục Nhật Đảo every year to ask where her son's boat went
people.appearance: Back bent by forty crossings. A rope of white hair braided new each spring. Her hired boat has sprung a leak on three crossings in four.

people.name: Văn Nhân Chỉ Thủy
people.gloss: Still water (Trang Tử: no one mirrors himself in running water, only in still water)
people.role: A Hóa Thần master of water from before the calendar, whose name only Mạc Quy Khư remembers; left the world from Hạo Nguyệt Hồ in the year 40
people.cause: left the world: walked over the long lake into the moon (C025, A001); no body, and no word of where

people.name: Yến Tang Điền
people.gloss: Mulberry fields (the second half of thương hải tang điền)
people.role: The last disciple of Cô Phàm Các, left ashore in 705; searched the western sea for the lost fleet; Đoạn Thương Hải's master
people.cause: killed by his own Hóa Thần tribulation over the island sea (C180), at 460

people.name: Đỗ Xuân Triều
people.role: Banner man of the spring-flood rafts
people.appearance: Carries a rolled green banner on his shoulder even indoors.

people.name: Thiệu Tùng Lâm
people.role: Warden of the poacher watch at Việt Quất Thôn
people.appearance: Glances at every cart wheel as if pricing it.

people.name: Tô Miêu Nhi
people.role: Works the seedbeds with old Phú Hậu Thổ
people.appearance: A seed-husk tucked behind each ear.

people.name: Sầm Lãng Nhi
people.role: Raftswoman; Sầm Ngưu Tất's sister
people.appearance: Plain as a pot-lid, she says herself before anyone else can; her singing turns every head on the river.

people.name: Cảnh Lạc Phong
people.role: Takes the spirit honey at night in the hornet valley
people.appearance: Hornets single him out of any crowd; welts under both eyes, honey-gourds clinking at his belt.

people.name: Từ Kế Chi
people.role: Carries the hall's tallies for the dying Lục Lưu Mộc
people.appearance: Fidgets with a notched tally-stick when he thinks.

people.name: Phan Tiểu Hồ
people.role: Lại Hoành Chi's newest disciple; Bỉnh Thiết Phủ's friend
people.appearance: Split lip, crooked grin; the grin never reaches his eyes.

people.name: Đằng Bích Lưu
people.role: Raft master; rides the spring flood with the year's wood
people.appearance: A loud, weathered woman, river-scarred hands, a green banner rolled under her arm.
people.wants: To keep her son alive past this spring's flood, and to ride one more lead raft with him aboard.
people.secret: She is paying Nghệ Hoàng Phong (nghe_hoang_phong) in river pearls for a jar of the spirit honey meant for the lord, hoping it buys Lục Lưu Mộc a year; the hall's tally is a jar short each autumn.

people.name: Lại Hoành Chi
people.role: Warden of the eastern woods; sells spirit logs past the lord
people.appearance: A handsome, restless warden with a merchant's rings under his bark gloves.
people.wants: To be paid what the hall's wood is worth, and to be the man Thúy Vi's furnaces ask for by name.
people.secret: He is hand-picking Thiệu Tùng Lâm's (thieu_tung_lam) poacher watch to look away on the night of the second log, paying them out of the first log's price; the notch he forged in the 1199 tally is the only thing that would show it.

people.name: Mi Túc Thụ
people.role: The Listener: keeps the rite of asking
people.appearance: A thin woman with moss on her sleeves, who speaks so quietly that people lean in and looks at trees as if they were talking.
people.wants: To find one living spirit seedling in Sơ Hiểu Lâm before Lục Thanh Sam dies, so he can stop pretending the Grandmother Fir said yes.
people.secret: Each spring she plants a seedling she raised in a sleeve-pot at the edge of Sơ Hiểu Lâm and swears it was found there, so that Lục may believe the forest forgives him; Tô Miêu Nhi (to_mieu_nhi) carries the pot and thinks it is an offering.

people.name: Nghệ Hoàng Phong
people.role: Keeper of the poison hornets of Độc Phong Cốc
people.appearance: Hornet welts run in a string of beads up his neck, and birds go quiet around him.

people.name: Lục Lưu Mộc
people.role: Keeper of the hall's tallies; the head's son, with ten years left
people.appearance: Rests his shaking hands flat on his knees over the tally-sticks to hide them.

people.name: Lục Tiểu Sam
people.role: The head's granddaughter
people.appearance: Mud to the knee in every season, and her grandfather's grey eyes.

people.name: Bỉnh Thiết Phủ
people.role: Outer disciple; a poacher's son
people.appearance: An axe-callus on his right hand only.

people.name: Phú Hậu Thổ
people.role: The oldest outer disciple; an Earth root from before the re-lean
people.appearance: His back has bent to the shape of a hoe.

people.name: Tác Hà Thằng
people.role: Raftsman
people.appearance: A nap-flattened tuft of hair at every hour of the day.

people.name: Trúc Linh Lộ
people.role: Gathers spirit dew at Linh Lộ Tuyền
people.appearance: Dew always on her lashes, and a hem always wet from the spring.

people.name: Sư Tuyết Tùng
people.role: Co-founder of Hộ Lâm Đường (910); Lục Thanh Sam's sworn brother
people.cause: killed by the brown bears of Tông Hùng Lâm guarding a felled spirit log (N-ho_lam-02)

people.name: Trác Đào Sa
people.role: Master of the washing shed, who teaches the Sulphur Lung Breath
people.appearance: Coughs like a gourd of rattling seeds; his left hand is stained sulphur-yellow.

people.name: Kỳ Chu Sa
people.role: Keeper of the Mistress's furnace log, her friend from Thạch Kiều
people.appearance: Ash-grey hair pinned up with a brush-reed; the side of her right hand is inked from signing the Mistress's log.

people.name: Ngải Hoàng Thạch
people.role: Outer disciple at the washing troughs, a sulphur miner's son
people.appearance: Chest puffed out at the word 'crusts'; moves his lips when told anything, and is told twice.

people.name: Mễ Hòa Thu
people.role: Outer disciple from the barley village, who buries the Hall's dead
people.appearance: Face weathered brown before its time; hands gone square from the spade.

people.name: Chung Minh Hiến
people.role: Outer disciple at the market stall of Thiên Quyền Thị
people.appearance: Turns a pill-scale pendant between his fingers; grins at strangers like old friends.

people.name: Biện Lam Châu
people.role: Inner disciple of the mercury room, Mục Hồng Sa's niece
people.appearance: Mercury-room pallor around the eyes; a mask-strap line cut deep across both cheeks.

people.name: Cổ Tịch Đăng
people.role: Outer disciple who carries the founder's meals to the sealed room
people.appearance: Skinny, with tray-callused thumbs; his laugh arrives before his joke does.

people.name: Úy Đan Dương
people.role: Founder of Hoa Cái Đường (1060), blinded by his own pill in 1141; lives in a sealed room at the Hall
people.appearance: A gaunt, silver-skinned old man with clouded eyes, who sits with his hands on a bronze gourd and smells the air before anyone speaks.
people.wants: For someone to finish the ninth turn and pour it out, and for it not to be La Tử Vi.
people.secret: He is teaching Châu Dĩ An the ninth turn by smell, as she sets down each meal, so that the pill is finished by someone who will pour it into the badland sand. La Tử Vi holds the key to the gourd and thinks he talks to the girl about market prices.

people.name: Thiệu Ngân Hống
people.role: Master of the mercury room, the Hall's oldest refiner after the founder
people.appearance: Thin, in a leather mask with glass eyes, which he takes off only to eat.
people.wants: The roasting carted back to his masked room, and no second death like Tôn Luyện Hà's on his count.
people.secret: Since winter he mails a pair of mercury-room leather gloves down in the herb crates to Mễ Thanh Mạch, the shaking boy, and the Mistress's clerk is counting the glove store short.

people.name: Mục Hồng Sa
people.role: Foreman of the Hall's lease at the Pivot's cinnabar diggings of Thần Sa Khoáng
people.appearance: Big and red-handed; her teeth are pink from cinnabar dust.
people.wants: A full trough every day of the lease and a ten-year renewal signed in her name.
people.secret: She is raising spirit-geese behind the drying sheds for the Pivot governor's table, on the washers' spilled rice; the diggings' drover has started charging her for his silence.

people.name: Văn Thụy Đan
people.role: The Hall's seller at the market of Thiên Quyền Thị
people.appearance: Oiled seller's moustache; he pats his pill-purse the way other men pat a dog.

people.name: Dư Hoàng Nhi
people.role: Inner disciple of the mercury room, a sulphur miner's daughter
people.appearance: Rosy-cheeked in a room of grey faces; one fingernail has been dark for years.

people.name: Mễ Thanh Mạch
people.role: Outer disciple at the washing troughs, from the Hall's barley village; his hands shake
people.appearance: Hands that tremble at rest, tucked under his arms; every ox he has led to the troughs has gone lame.

people.name: Phí Tiểu Lâm
people.role: Outer disciple and herb gatherer from Tầm Dược Thôn
people.appearance: Mountain-root dirt under every nail; a scratched cheek from the last bramble.

people.name: Châu Dĩ An
people.gloss: So that there may be peace
people.role: Inner disciple who tends the founder's sealed room
people.appearance: Round washer's shoulders; a wrist-cord strung with her father's brass tags.

people.name: La Khởi Minh
people.role: Outer disciple, the Mistress's nephew
people.appearance: Pressed collar, town-clean among grey faces; fingers inked from counting other people's coin.

people.name: Tôn Luyện Hà
people.role: Co-founder of Hoa Cái Đường (1060), killed by the founder's pill in 1141
people.cause: the fumes of the eighth turn of the Canopy Pill, at 150

people.name: Diệp Tùng Yên
people.role: Steward of the pine-tappers at the Mặc Yên kilns
people.appearance: A thumb yellowed for good by pitch; she raps the tapping-rod on the floor before she speaks.

people.name: Nhiếp Tố Hàn
people.role: Painter of the Dipper's middle stars, a Khai Dương scribe's son
people.appearance: Paints left-handed, a dried persimmon in his sleeve against the kiln smell.

people.name: Hồ Bạch Yên
people.role: Outer disciple at the soot kilns, Hồ Mặc Nhi's elder brother
people.appearance: A cracked front tooth, and his lips move as he counts the kiln mouths, twice.

people.name: Thái Huyền Nhung
people.role: Outer disciple at the fungus-dye vats of Huyền Chi Thôn
people.appearance: Dyed blue-black to the wrist, and she coughs whenever the vat steam turns.

people.name: Tề Thu Ảnh
people.role: Inner disciple who paints the fourth star, Lạc Tố Bình's disciple
people.appearance: Two brass hairpins that are not Hall issue.

people.name: Nhậm Thanh Lưu
people.role: Outer disciple at the Pivot's seat, grinding the archive's ink
people.appearance: Left sleeve inked to the elbow, from copying with the book on his knee.

people.name: Liêm Ẩn Lộc
people.role: Outer disciple from the deer meadow of Lộc Uyển
people.appearance: Smells faintly of deer; a white forelock he blames on a stag.

people.name: Lạc Tố Bình
people.role: Chief painter of the Hall, holder of the Dipper Talisman Seal; selling the rain-fast stroke to Thính Vũ Lâu
people.appearance: A tall woman with ink to the elbow and a boxwood seal on a cord, who talks while she paints, which no one else dares.
people.wants: The second half of Hoàng Tiêu Diệp's price next spring, and her ink sold in every market south of the pines.
people.secret: She is selling the Hall's rain-fast stroke to Thính Vũ Lâu. She thinks the Tower wants the ink for its own writs. Its coast house wants the stroke to paint the Hall's Dipper without deer glue, so that the forgeries will hold in the rain and smell of nothing.

people.name: Lăng Mặc Khanh
people.role: Ink master of the Mặc Yên soot kilns in the vermilion pines
people.appearance: A black-handed old charcoal burner with burnt eyebrows and a cabinet of a thousand ink sticks, each labelled with its year.
people.wants: To make one ink in his last twenty years that no one, himself included, can date by its smell.
people.secret: Each winter he burns one kiln on the ash of the old pitch town and bottles the soot as 'burnt-town ink' for a grave-seller in Khai Dương, so the Hall's pine count has run short since 1190. Diệp Tùng Yên (diep_tung_yen), who counts the pines, has begun asking where the wood goes.

people.name: Hàn Thủy Mặc
people.role: The Hall's resident ink-maker at the Pivot's seat, who supplies the archive of the Compact
people.appearance: A neat, soft-spoken clerk in Pivot grey with the Hall's black cord at his wrist.
people.wants: To walk home to Khai Dương one day each month without the archive's eyes on his back.
people.secret: He has begun a second copy of the ink-order book and keeps it at his mother's house in Khai Dương, in case the first is ever taken for the Pivot's questions. Nhậm Thanh Lưu (nham_thanh_luu) copies it for him at night and does not yet know why.

people.name: Lục Thanh Chi
people.role: Keeper of the Hall's village and its fungus dyes
people.appearance: Wears her purse inside her sash, where no one in the village has ever seen it open; violet to the second knuckle.
people.wants: A good price for the violet, and the granary of Huyền Chi Thôn full by the first snow.
people.secret: She knows ten jars of seal violet are not for cloth, and she sold them anyway, because the dye pays for the village's winter.

people.name: Tân Cức Hoa
people.role: Inner disciple of the head; sweeps the head's room and is taught by the Silver Candle
people.appearance: Sweeps with a stoop and smiles a beat after everyone else has stopped.

people.name: Mã Tinh Bút
people.role: Inner disciple who paints the seventh star
people.appearance: Clean cuffs, in a hall where no one else has any.

people.name: Hồ Mặc Nhi
people.role: Outer disciple at the soot kilns
people.appearance: Sings off-key at the kiln mouths; her teeth are the only white thing on her by noon.

people.name: Phù Vũ Sinh
people.role: Outer disciple at the Pivot's seat, the ink-maker's apprentice
people.appearance: Laughs loud enough to be heard across the archive courtyard, and one ear is always inked.

people.name: Quan Lộc Nhi
people.role: Outer disciple from the deer meadow village; knew the forged Dipper by its glue
people.appearance: Re-pins a twig of deer-grass in her hair every hour, dark-eyed and small.
people.wants: For her uncle to shut his glue yard before the deer warden finds it.
people.secret: The glue in the forged Dipper talismans is boiled in her uncle's yard at Lộc Uyển, and she has been paying him to stop.

people.name: Kỷ Thu Tịch
people.gloss: An autumn evening (Đỗ Mục, Thu tịch)
people.role: Founder of Họa Tinh Đường (910); she painted the Dipper's stars and kept a forbidden book
people.cause: kiln soot in her lungs from three centuries of ink-making, at 317, at the painting table
people.appearance: A short fungus-dyer's daughter with violet nails, shown on the Hall's screen with a brush in each hand.

people.name: Hạ Cức Thi
people.role: Charm-singer of the back garden; keeps the gardeners under the Thorn and Ink Verses
people.appearance: Hums half a tone flat when she thinks no one is listening.

people.name: Tô Bôi Ngâm
people.role: The hand that pours the second cup at the Gracious Door
people.appearance: Her left earlobe is gone, so she turns her right side to every guest.

people.name: Doãn Thải Đậu
people.role: Bean picker in the back garden, raised as a foundling
people.appearance: Holds her hands over the lamp and feels nothing; the red on her fingertips never washes out.

people.name: Uông Lệ Trà
people.role: Door girl at the manor house; pours the first cup
people.appearance: Smiles a beat late, after her eyes have finished weighing the guest.

people.name: Bành Tri Hạp
people.role: Carries the manor's poison boxes to the Night Rain Market
people.appearance: Gold-edged front tooth, which he covers with his hand whenever he hears a price.

people.name: Khổng Vụ Kiều
people.role: Poison-kitchen hand; grinds the beans for the pastes
people.appearance: Smells of clove from ten paces, and has never been seen to touch bread with a bare hand.

people.name: Cung Hồng Tố
people.role: Door girl who gives no beans
people.appearance: A single red bean on a thread knotted at her nape.

people.name: Nghê Xuân Chi
people.gloss: A branch in spring (Vương Duy: xuân lai phát kỷ chi)
people.role: Mistress of the back garden at Tiêu Âm Mạch: the bean trellises, the poison beds and the gardeners who do not leave
people.appearance: A thin woman with earth under her nails and a hat of banana leaf, who looks at people the way she looks at a trellis that needs cutting back.
people.wants: To be mistress after her mother, to close the second cup, and to send the gardeners home before someone comes for them.
people.secret: She knows her father is Ô Thiềm Tử, and she has been answering his poisons with hers for a hundred and fifty years. He thinks his rival is a stranger in the market.

people.name: Liễu Đa Thải
people.gloss: Gather more (Vương Duy: nguyện quân đa thải hiệt)
people.role: Mistress of the gracious door at the manor house (27): she greets the guests and pours the tea
people.appearance: Round-faced and laughing, in rose silk, with a fan she never opens all the way.
people.wants: The second cup poured forever, and Nghê Xuân Chi's garden brought under her door.
people.secret: She wets Tề Vong Quy's (te_vong_quy) night tea with a sleeping draught so he does not wander the guests' wing in the dark.

people.name: Tiền Khổ Đằng
people.role: Poison-cook of the back garden
people.appearance: A squat, silent man with toad-skin gloves and stained teeth.
people.wants: Ô's price paid at his own stall, and the garden's pastes sold under his name.
people.secret: He sells his pastes at the Night Rain Market under Ô Thiềm Tử's (o_thiem_tu) mark at Ô's price, thinned by a third with garden water.

people.name: Quản Song Đậu
people.role: The manor's courier to the Night Rain Market in Thu Trì
people.appearance: The coin on his knuckles stops only when he is lying.

people.name: Tề Vong Quy
people.role: A Phượng Minh disciple who came to the gracious door in 1153 and has gardened there since
people.appearance: A tall man in a gardener's apron with a Fire sword's calluses on his right hand and a red bean on a string at his throat.
people.wants: His daughter gone from the garden before anyone learns whose she is, and one night with his sword in the open.
people.secret: He has found out Tề Niệm Quy (te_niem_quy) is the one scattering the beans, and walks the path behind her each night picking up the ones she drops; he tips Liễu Đa Thải's (lieu_da_thai) night tea into the trellis so that he can.

people.name: Kha Tiểu Đậu
people.role: Bean-picker with the best fingers in the garden
people.appearance: The dye-stall girls call her face a boiled turnip and her hands a gift.

people.name: Tề Niệm Quy
people.role: The charmed gardener's daughter, who scatters red beans on the forest path
people.appearance: Her pocket is full of red beans that click like a dice-cup when she walks.

people.name: Hồ Yên Độ
people.role: Road-watcher at the misty bridge of Yên Kiều
people.appearance: Smells of wet wool; one boot is tied on with cord.

people.name: Sầm Vãn Hương
people.role: The door's apprentice, who will pour the first cup after Liễu
people.appearance: Tugs her rose-silk cuff whenever a sentence is not true, and has not noticed.

people.name: Diệp Lạc Phương
people.role: A boy who says he is Diệp Phi Hồng's descendant and came for the sword's art
people.appearance: A jade ring too big for him, worn on his thumb, and a habit of counting his family tree on his fingers and losing it at the fifth name.

people.name: Hàn Tư Quân
people.role: Nghê Hồng Đậu's first disciple and lover, who tried to take Phi Hồng
people.cause: one red bean in a cup of tea

people.name: Lương Hỏa Tuyền
people.role: Packs the snow jackets and keeps the two-batch timings under Tần Tuyết Thán
people.appearance: Hands scarred pink by the jackets' hot copper; spare mittens stuffed in her coat.

people.name: Cao Hải Mặc
people.role: Captain of the fire-jade boat; an outer disciple for eighty years
people.appearance: Sun-creased boatman's neck; an unlit pipe between his teeth.

people.name: Dương Thang Nhi
people.role: The head cook's daughter; keeps the broth pot at the furnace mouth
people.appearance: Broth splashes down her apron; a lopsided braid tied with kitchen twine.

people.name: Khổng Viêm Sinh
people.role: Ngụy Đan Chu's disciple; copies the furnace roster
people.appearance: Narrow handsome face, burn-line across the chin, cinnabar on the thumb.

people.name: Nhan Đới Nhi
people.role: Rower on the fire-jade boat
people.appearance: Thick rower's forearms; a gold fire-jade chip sewn into her collar.

people.name: Tề Lục Tiền
people.role: Ash-boat oarsman who still plays dice in Hàn Tân Thành
people.appearance: Hat pulled over one ear; fingers that cannot stay off a die.

people.name: Bế Diễm Sương
people.role: Brews the one-season pills under Lương Hỏa Tuyền
people.appearance: Small coal-coloured birthmark on her neck; hums under her breath while she stirs.

people.name: Tần Tuyết Thán
people.gloss: Charcoal in the snow (help that comes when it is needed)
people.role: First elder; keeper of the snow jackets and author of the Snow Hearth Primer
people.appearance: A tall woman in a seal-skin coat over red felt, with frost on her sleeves and soot on her hands, who never raises her voice in the furnace hall.
people.wants: To see a Water root walk through the furnace hall's door as an inner disciple before she dies, which the rule forbids.
people.secret: She is writing a Water main method for the furnace hall. Her own share of this season's ash is paying for its test batches, and when it is done she means to put it before the council with a crew child already through its first layer.

people.name: Ngụy Đan Chu
people.role: The head's true disciple; the old Red Sun way
people.appearance: A lean young man with scorched forearms and a cinnabar-red robe he dyes himself, too bright for the valley.
people.wants: To be named heir of the Red Furnace and strip the snow jackets off it.
people.secret: He is cutting a Red Sun seal in the cellar to forge patents for the old one-batch way, and has Khổng Viêm Sinh (khong_viem_sinh) grind the cinnabar for the ink without saying what it is for.

people.name: Giải Bách Bộ
people.role: Keeper of the Satchel Hall: Thanh Nang Đường's healers inside Hồng Lô
people.appearance: A small grey woman with a green satchel across her chest, the only green thing in the valley.
people.wants: To keep the Satchel Hall's healers members of the sect, not a hired craft.
people.secret: She hides a lame marten pup under her satchel table from the cooks, and has taught it to fetch her sleeping herbs.

people.name: Nghiêu Vọng Kình
people.role: Captain of the ash boats; an outer disciple for a hundred years
people.appearance: A huge man in oiled seal-skin with a harpoon of whale rib across his back and salt in his beard.
people.wants: To raise his great-grandfather's boat and its fire jade from the reef off Kình Cốt point.
people.secret: He has drawn the reef's marks on a whale-rib chart and is paying an outside crew from Hàn Tân Thành out of his own ash share to meet him there, without telling Nghiêu Lãng Hoa (nghieu_lang_hoa).

people.name: Phòng Tẫn Thủ
people.role: Vent warden; keeps the furnace roster and the night watch
people.appearance: Grey queue singed short at the end; has not hurried in a century.

people.name: Dương Bát Oản
people.role: Head cook of the kitchens, the valley's first furnace
people.appearance: Face like a lumpy dumpling, flour in the eyebrows.

people.name: Nghiêu Lãng Hoa
people.role: Rows the second ash boat
people.appearance: Salt-bleached hair cut with a knife; a harpoon-calloused right palm.

people.name: Lại Tiểu Thán
people.role: Newest outer disciple; shovels snow into the jackets
people.appearance: Wide willing face blackened to the eyes with snow-soot; answers a moment late.

people.name: Ôn Noãn Tuyết
people.role: Tần Tuyết Thán's inner disciple; brews the two-batch pills
people.appearance: Spotless sleeves; carries a cooling-paddle like a staff.

people.name: Cúc Xa Tiền
people.gloss: Plantain, the herb of the cart tracks
people.role: Apprentice of the Satchel Hall
people.appearance: Pollen in his hair; a sidelong herb-gatherer's step.

people.name: Tiết Thừa Hỏa
people.role: Founder of Hồng Lô Cốc (650); carried fire from the volcanic isles
people.cause: went down into the vent below Kê Quan Khoáng to bring up fire in a blizzard and did not come up (age 389)
people.appearance: Remembered as a tall woman with singed brows and a coal-box always on her hip.

people.name: Nghiêu Phá Lãng
people.role: Last head of Kình Cốt Đường, the whale hunters' hall; his crews joined Hồng Lô
people.cause: went out on the whale road after a great spirit whale and never came back (V013)
people.appearance: Remembered as a giant, beard streaked white, a harpoon scar across the right shoulder.

people.name: Thai Bạch Thược
people.role: Last head of Thanh Nang Đường, the healers' hall in the cape's forest
people.cause: died in closed-door cultivation without naming an heir (V018)
people.appearance: Remembered as a tiny, severe woman in satchel green, a long unfinished braid down her back.

people.name: Lữ Tẫn Chu
people.role: Boat Hall disciple; the orphan of the Đào Sa raid
people.appearance: A quiet young man with river-brown skin and a bandolier of black needles ground from old boat nails.
people.wants: To learn who gave the order to burn the landing, and then to decide what he owes them.
people.secret: He has known since he was fifteen that the elder who sat beside him led the raid. He stayed in Lạc Hà to decide whether to forgive Lô Xướng Vãn or kill him. Last year he learned from a Counting House receipt that the order came from the head. On his fifteenth birthday Lô Xướng Vãn showed him ten years of passes stamped with the Nine Bends seal for a toll the pines never set, and that is why he has never answered Giang Cửu Khúc's spring letters, which offer him a boat. This spring he sent one pass down the river inside Giang Tiểu Loan's letters, addressed to Thương Bạch Phàm (thuong_bach_pham).

people.name: Hình Lạc Nhạn
people.role: Cảnh Trường Thiên's youngest true disciple; walked into the miasma
people.appearance: A tall, rangy woman with her hair cropped short after the miasma burned it, and a grey veil worn loose at the throat.
people.wants: To bring Thanh Sương home and put both swords in the head's hands, and to reach Kết Đan before Tô Mộ Vân does.
people.secret: She has promised the lost boy's sister, Đồ Tiểu Liên, that she will go back in. For three years she has been hardening her lungs on Yên Quang's evening-herb tincture to do it.

people.name: Tô Bình Chu
people.role: Steward of the outer gate at Cựu Hà Viện, the old seat; Tô Mộ Vân's father
people.appearance: A mild, round-faced man with chalk dust on his sleeves from the outer gate's slate boards.
people.wants: To see his daughter reach Kết Đan and his son off the envoy's list, in that order.
people.secret: Two hours each night he drills Tô Hiểu Chu (to_hieu_chu) in the sword forms the list-drawers test, so that the boy stops looking ordinary.

people.name: Tăng Vân Tiêu
people.role: The head's second disciple; runs the sect's caravans and market stalls
people.appearance: A well-fed man with a merchant's quick smile and three money pouches, one of them always empty.
people.wants: To touch the last stage of Trúc Cơ's peak once, before Tô Mộ Vân (to_mo_van) outranks him; he would sell a stall for it.
people.secret: He pays his caravan drivers in paper chits redeemable only at his own stalls and sells the cash he saves to Lạc Đan Thanh (lac_dan_thanh) for pills; the drivers' wives sell the chits at half price in Hà Khúc.

people.name: Miêu Thạch Lan
people.role: Array runner of the Bridge Hall; tends the galleries under the seat
people.appearance: A small, plain woman with a miner's lamp on a strap round her forehead and dust in every crease of her robe.
people.wants: To open the locked gallery once and learn what the head reads there.
people.secret: On new moons she takes a wax impression of the locked door's lock to cut a copy of the key from silver-pine, and Mạch Ngân Sương (mach_ngan_suong), who shares her shifts, files the blanks.

people.name: Nhiếp Ngọc Âm
people.role: The inner gate's best voice; sings the Evening Song at Tử Điện Thành
people.appearance: A slender woman with a clear, carrying voice and a zither always half out of its bag.
people.wants: To bring her mother out across the Petal Shore line before the next war closes it.
people.secret: Each month her packet to the soul-vault keeper grows a page longer, now padded with true news of who visits Sử Thu Thủy's (su_thu_thuy) rooms, the one thing her master never thought to keep from her.

people.name: Phương Toán Ngọc
people.role: Clerk of the Counting House
people.appearance: A brisk woman who clicks an abacus in her sleeve while she talks.
people.wants: To open the treasury vault with her own hands and count what is in it.
people.secret: At night she copies the trading purse's payment book line by line into a second book kept in Tả Mặc Trù's (ta_mac_tru) desk, because he never looks in his own drawers.

people.name: Sài Thanh Phong
people.role: Maple Hall disciple; the Wood root the move saved
people.appearance: A gangly man with green-stained nails who talks with his hands and his whole face.
people.wants: To be asked to speak for the move at the high table instead of in letters.
people.secret: He sends his defences of the move to Ngạc Viễn Sơn (ngac_vien_son) under the name of an invented outer-gate steward, and Ngạc has answered the steward politely for two winters.

people.name: Giang Vọng Phàm
people.role: Island hall disciple; the last blood of Cô Phàm Các's founder
people.appearance: A weathered woman who stands facing the sea whenever she stops walking.
people.wants: To sail on the third boat as more than ballast.
people.secret: She sleeps in the third boat's hold some nights, to be found aboard on sailing day so that her master cannot take her off at the quay again; Luân Hải Yến (luan_hai_yen) brings her bread.

people.name: Lô Niệm Ca
people.role: Boat Hall disciple; Lô Xướng Vãn's grandson
people.appearance: A thickset man with his grandfather's voice and none of his songs.
people.wants: To fight the Ferry War again and win it.
people.secret: He keeps a Tùng Đào raider, taken on the Ngư Ca bank last spring, in a drowned cellar under the old boathouse and asks him each new moon who held the ropes when his mother fell, since the man who cut them is dead and cannot be made to pay; Hình Trọng Sơn (hinh_trong_son) lends him lamp-oil from the Watch and asks nothing, which is a quiet breach of the 1175 peace.

people.name: Đặng Liệt Hàng
people.role: Leads the Geese Hall's dawn drill
people.appearance: A drill-ground rasp of a voice; he cannot slouch even asleep.

people.name: Hồng Vãn Tình
people.role: Leads the inner gate's choir
people.appearance: Wears a red scarf all summer, and her long arms conduct whether or not she means them to.

people.name: Mông Thiết Sơn
people.role: Guard of the Miasma Watch
people.appearance: Smells of grave-lime; his grey beard is plaited with it.

people.name: Tả Mặc Trù
people.role: Counting House clerk for Hạc Đinh Thị
people.appearance: His ears go red whenever a certain abacus clicks.

people.name: Vi Lan Châu
people.role: Pilots the Boat Hall's toll boats at Thủy Khẩu
people.appearance: Squints sidelong at every river, like a heron at a fish.

people.name: Lộ Hành Sa
people.role: Caravan steward of the steppe roads
people.appearance: A tarnished silver whistle at his throat, blown to end arguments and never to call anyone.

people.name: Cam Như Ý
people.role: Carries the envoy's letters to the vassals
people.appearance: A pocket sewn inside her travel cloak, and the soft hands of a clerk.

people.name: Xa Cổ Đạo
people.role: Teaches the outer gate oarsmanship one-handed
people.appearance: An empty left sleeve pinned across his chest.

people.name: Mạch Ngân Sương
people.role: Keeps the Cloud Bridge Array's silver-pine props
people.appearance: Silver flecks glitter in her eyelashes.

people.name: Luân Hải Yến
people.role: Keeps the island warden's charts; printed the Rudder star on a sea chart in 1196
people.appearance: Glances up at every ledge, nest-picker that she was.

people.name: Mộ Hành Vân
people.role: Enforcer of the Hall of Scales
people.appearance: The Hall's children say he is a door that walks.

people.name: Bạc Hy Vân
people.role: Keeps the Maple Hall's herb terraces
people.appearance: Her smile arrives a moment before the thing it is for.

people.name: Dịch Bách Lý
people.role: Steward of the rope bridges and the Tang Ma rope trade
people.appearance: The rope-sellers say a bridge could fall on that face and not improve it.

people.name: Phàn Kiến Sơn
people.role: Steward of the old seat's halls at Cựu Hà Viện
people.appearance: Smells of camellia oil; one sleeve is eaten ragged by the old halls' moths.

people.name: Trì Vãn Hương
people.role: Keeps the guest house on the Cloud Bridge
people.appearance: Moves so softly that guests start when she speaks.

people.name: Cận Thủ Chuyết
people.role: Collects the vassals' late tribute for the Hall of Scales
people.appearance: A ledger-case chained to his wrist; he is said to sleep with it.

people.name: Điền Hòa Lũng
people.role: Plants the Maple Hall's spirit rice
people.appearance: Squats to talk, as if to a seedling.

people.name: Hàm Tú Sa
people.role: Scout of the miasma's edge
people.appearance: A dry cough follows every sentence; one cheek is burnt dark by the Watch.

people.name: Kinh Nhạn Hồi
people.role: Leads the Geese Hall's bows
people.appearance: One shoulder drawn higher than the other by years of the bow.

people.name: Ngạc Viễn Sơn
people.role: The oldest inner disciple; stayed on the old seat to teach the outer gate
people.appearance: Laughs at a joke a full minute after it is told.

people.name: Đồ Tiểu Liên
people.role: Outer disciple; sister of the boy the miasma took
people.appearance: A thin, sunburnt girl who trains at dusk until the outer gate's steward sends her to bed.
people.wants: To be posted to the Miasma Watch, and to walk the plain behind Hình Lạc Nhạn when she goes back in.
people.secret: She has been saving ration millet in a clay jar to pay a Tân Khẩu boatman to row her to the miasma's edge on the next dark moon, with or without leave; Hồ Đăng Sơn (ho_dang_son) keeps the jar.

people.name: Tạ Quy Yến
people.role: Outer disciple of the Tạ family of Phong Lâm; due to be placed with a vassal
people.appearance: A courteous young man in an old-fashioned clan robe, with swallows embroidered at the hem.
people.wants: To be placed with a vassal that lets him write, not carry.
people.secret: He practises Châu Phi Vân's (chau_phi_van) seal in the margins of his exercises, so that when Placement Day comes his name will reach Nam Phố already approved.

people.name: Tô Hiểu Chu
people.role: Outer disciple; Tô Mộ Vân's brother
people.appearance: People say he has his sister's forehead and none of her hurry.

people.name: Hoàng Lan Chi
people.role: Dyer of the sect's robes; Tô Mộ Vân's mother
people.appearance: Madder-red to both elbows.

people.name: Mông Tiểu Thạch
people.role: Outer disciple; the Watch guard's son
people.appearance: Stands on tiptoe near anyone taller, and the Watch's plate hangs off his shoulders.

people.name: Phương Tiểu Lan
people.role: Outer disciple
people.appearance: Her bead bracelet clicks when she lies, and she knows it.

people.name: Sài Mộc Tê
people.role: Outer disciple
people.appearance: Leans toward every sunny wall, hopefully.

people.name: Điền Tiểu Mạch
people.role: Outer disciple
people.appearance: One thumb bent for life from transplanting.

people.name: Xa Tiểu Hổ
people.role: Outer disciple
people.appearance: Laughs before the joke arrives.

people.name: Bồ Tiểu Lô
people.role: Outer disciple at the reed harbour
people.appearance: Reed-cut shins and a level boatwoman's gaze.

people.name: Vũ Tri Thu
people.role: Inner disciple; runner for the Miasma Watch
people.appearance: Runner's calves; wind has split her lips.

people.name: Sử Thanh Lâm
people.role: Inner disciple; guards the Long River vein
people.appearance: A scar through one eyebrow, and hands as clean as a scholar's.

people.name: Thương Ngư Ca
people.role: Outer disciple; a fisher boy with a voice
people.appearance: A bird-thin chest with a voice that startles.

people.name: Đặng Tiểu Vân
people.role: Outer disciple
people.appearance: Bites her lower lip until it scabs.

people.name: Hồ Tứ Nương
people.role: Cook of the old seat's kitchen
people.appearance: Flour in her eyebrows, a burn-shine on one cheek.

people.name: Khúc Lão Điếu
people.role: Ferryman to the Evening Isle
people.appearance: Eyes the colour of river water in a bald brown head.

people.name: Mạch Tiểu Ngân
people.role: Outer disciple
people.appearance: Silver flakes glitter on her always-damp hands.

people.name: Tăng Tiểu Vũ
people.role: Outer disciple
people.appearance: Stifles yawns badly.

people.name: Thịnh Thiếu Hàng
people.role: Inner disciple; the Geese Hall's best cadet
people.appearance: Cocks his head to listen, as his father does.

people.name: Diêu Tiểu Đăng
people.role: Outer disciple
people.appearance: Lamp-oil on her sleeves; she does not blink.

people.name: Liêm Nhược Thủy
people.role: Inner disciple; copyist of the Hall of Scales
people.appearance: A pencil behind one ear, ink-grey thumb pads.

people.name: Cổ Tiểu Thiết
people.role: Forge boy of the armoury at Tử Điện Thành
people.appearance: Goes still whenever steel is near.

people.name: Nghê Tiểu Thảo
people.role: Outer disciple
people.appearance: Cannot sit three breaths; a mat-weave pattern is printed in one palm.

people.name: Nhậm Tử Hà
people.role: Inner disciple; makes the Maple Hall's pill moulds
people.appearance: Purple-stained to the wrist; no soap has ever lifted it.

people.name: Uông Bình Trù
people.role: Clerk of the Counting House's trade office at Hạc Đinh Thị
people.appearance: Rubs the callus on his forefinger when he lies.

people.name: Kỷ Minh Ước
people.role: Reads the oath contracts aloud at sunset for the Hall of Scales
people.appearance: A rich carrying voice from a small dry frame.

people.name: Hạng Kiều Sinh
people.role: Bridge Hall inner disciple; digs the galleries under the new seat
people.appearance: Rock dust ground into his knees.

people.name: Khấu Tịch Nhạn
people.role: Geese Hall inner disciple; captain of the second line
people.appearance: A dent in her brow where a well-rope slipped.

people.name: Quản Đan Phong
people.role: Maple Hall inner disciple; makes the pills that sell against Thúy Vi's
people.appearance: A tea-grower's wide hat tied under her chin with a purple cord.

people.name: Hạ Hầu Thanh Bích
people.role: Boat Hall pilot at Thủy Khẩu; wants a sea boat
people.appearance: A pilot's finger, broken and badly set.

people.name: Nhạc Trường Tín
people.role: Rider of the Vassal Hall; carries the tribute receipts
people.appearance: A satchel rubbed pale at the clasp.

people.name: Đinh Thủ Hoang
people.role: Guard of the Miasma Watch; lost two fingers to the grey
people.appearance: Two fingers gone from the left hand; a grey patch on the wrist.

people.name: Trương Vọng Thành
people.role: Watches the Thính Vũ border at the Long River vein
people.appearance: The lamp-counters call him the Owl, for his sleepless face.

people.name: Lục Bồng Sa
people.role: Steward of the island hall's stores at Triều Âm Thành
people.appearance: A greenish tinge to her face that never quite leaves it; one hand always finds a rail.

people.name: Thiệu Hồng Lô
people.role: The sect's own man in the armoury at Tử Điện Thành
people.appearance: Eats, sleeps and argues in his smith's apron.

people.name: Mặc Hướng Tây
people.role: Digs the graves on the Evening Isle, facing west
people.appearance: A sailcloth cap tied under his chin; spade blisters on both palms.

people.name: Thường Thủ Hà
people.role: Holds the dusk test on the steppe at Cựu Hà Viện
people.appearance: A long dry braid, pale eyes narrowed against the sun.

people.name: Ông Định Hóa
people.role: Caravan master of the steppe road to Vật Hoa Thị
people.appearance: A sheepskin vest over silk, a ring on every finger of the left hand.

people.name: Giản Bình Chương
people.role: Prices the buy-outs for the Hall of Scales
people.appearance: Taps an abacus bead before he speaks.

people.name: Uông Tú Ngân
people.role: Outer disciple who counts faster than the clerks
people.appearance: Her leg jiggles under every desk.

people.name: Bạch Văn Khế
people.role: Young inner disciple; copies contracts for the Hall of Scales
people.appearance: Sleeve cuffs gone grey with copying.

people.name: Hạng Sơn Quật
people.role: Outer disciple from the miners' village of Vân Gian
people.appearance: Walks with the wide careful steps of a man used to low roofs.

people.name: Đổng Xuyên Vân
people.role: Geese Hall cadet; the second-best bow
people.appearance: Chapped fisherman's hands that never miss.

people.name: Bàng Kích Vân
people.role: Geese Hall cadet of the war party
people.appearance: A goose pin and a toll token swing together on one cord.

people.name: Quản Thanh Diệp
people.role: Outer disciple; sweeps the Maple Hall's drying floors
people.appearance: People forget her plain, kindly face as soon as she leaves.

people.name: Ôn Hòa Miêu
people.role: Outer disciple; plants the Maple Hall's spirit rice
people.appearance: Squats like a rice-planter even in the hall.

people.name: Cao Vãn Ca
people.role: Young inner disciple of the Boat Hall; sings the fourth verse
people.appearance: A long thin throat that rings like a bell when she sings.

people.name: Lam Thất Âm
people.role: Outer disciple from Xướng Vãn Thôn; the choir's youngest
people.appearance: Hums with her mouth closed, as her grandmother does.

people.name: Mạc Triều Sinh
people.role: Outer disciple of the island hall
people.appearance: Chart-ink smears on both ears.

people.name: Cù Bích Trúc
people.role: Outer disciple of the island hall, due for Placement Day
people.appearance: Bamboo-brown arms; she tries not to smile.

people.name: Đinh Bắc Thạch
people.role: Young inner disciple; runner of the Miasma Watch
people.appearance: Draws a miasma scar on his wrist with charcoal each morning.

people.name: Tiêu Vọng Hôi
people.role: Outer disciple posted to the Miasma Watch
people.appearance: Squats to read the ground.

people.name: Trương Ngân Câu
people.role: Outer disciple at the Long River vein
people.appearance: Knotted cords at her belt, to count lamps by.

people.name: Ngũ Hỏa Liên
people.role: Works the bellows of the armoury at Tử Điện Thành (servant)
people.appearance: Singed eyelashes.

people.name: Khúc Tịch Ba
people.role: Outer disciple; rows for her grandfather the isle's ferryman
people.appearance: Has her grandfather's slow, level stare.

people.name: Chương Hoàng Sa
people.role: Outer disciple from Hà Khúc; likely to pass the dusk test
people.appearance: Blushes at praise.

people.name: Kiều Mộ Sa
people.role: Outer disciple from Bạch Dương Thôn
people.appearance: Her forehead is pink from practising in the noon sun.

people.name: Chung Mộc Ân
people.role: Outer disciple of Phong Lâm who has failed the dusk test twice
people.appearance: A hopeful smile and maple sap on his cuffs; things tend to fall near him.

people.name: Tào Bách Ma
people.role: Outer disciple; a hemp-trader's son whose father priced his buy-out
people.appearance: A dice cup rattles in his sleeve.

people.name: Lục Tiểu Tỉnh
people.role: Outer disciple from Liên Chu; a well-digger's daughter
people.appearance: Red dust on her sandals.

people.name: Âu Đẩu Sinh
people.role: Outer disciple; a herder from Ngưu Đẩu Thôn
people.appearance: Straw in his hair, eyelids at half-mast.

people.name: Phạm Thủ Ước
people.role: Young inner disciple; the youngest witness on the Hall of Scales' seals
people.appearance: Rolls his sleeves to the same fold every day.

people.name: Nhiêu Kim Châu
people.role: Young inner disciple at the trade office of Hạc Đinh Thị
people.appearance: Holds one palm flat, as if weighing the air.

people.name: Quách Ngân Đăng
people.role: Young inner disciple of the Bridge Hall; carries lamps in the galleries
people.appearance: A limp from a gallery cave-in, lamp-soot in the corners of her eyes.

people.name: Hứa Trà Nương
people.role: The head's tea servant (servant)
people.appearance: Stands very still, like someone who has heard everything.

people.name: Tần Tiểu Uyển
people.role: Serves the guest house on the Cloud Bridge (servant)
people.appearance: A face guests forget, and a tray carried exactly at their elbow.

people.name: Ngụy Thụ Căn
people.role: Oils the founder's maple stumps at the old seat (servant)
people.appearance: Smells of maple oil.

people.name: Hách Thần Hà
people.role: Outer disciple; the envoy's grand-niece
people.appearance: A dawn-red ribbon in her braid.

people.name: Hồ Đăng Sơn
people.role: Outer disciple from Tân Khẩu; held the rope at the miasma's edge
people.appearance: A rope burn across his left palm that has never closed.

people.name: Cảnh Trường Thiên
people.gloss: The long sky (the founder's line: the autumn water is one colour with the long sky)
people.role: War elder, master of the Geese Hall; the last of Nhan Tề Phi's field at Chiết Kích Nguyên
people.appearance: A lean grey man with a goose-feather pin in his topknot and an empty sword scabbard across his back, who stands at the edge of every room.
people.wants: That no one goes back onto Chiết Kích Nguyên for the sword, least of all his disciple Hình Lạc Nhạn. And that his word to Mục holds, which means no war on the plain.
people.secret: The miasma did not rise off the dead. In 802 the founder had an array of rot buried under the plain, to be sprung only if the field broke. When Quý Trường Kích's halberds broke it, Nhan Tề Phi sprang the array, pushed Thanh Sương into Cảnh's hands and told him to carry it home. The grey came up over both armies. He dropped the sword and ran. He went back that night for her body and not for the sword, and he told the sect she had fallen with the blade in her hand. He has been ashamed for 397 years, and his whole discipline grew out of that shame. He does not know that the Pivot's Đỗ Tinh Hà knew the array was there. Mục Hàn Nhạn (muc_han_nhan) has known since 1040, from Nhạn Trận's founder on his deathbed. Since 1175, the year after the gate lost a file on a rope bridge for Lạc Hà's hire fee, Mục has sold his silence for Cảnh's word that Lạc Hà will never again call or hire the gate's files for a war, and each spring Cảnh flies a month down to Lạc Nhạn Hồ to drill its levy for nothing.

people.name: Hách Ánh Hà
people.role: The head's first disciple; envoy to the eight vassals
people.appearance: A broad-faced island woman who laughs before she bargains, with a maple fan whose eight ribs are each painted with a vassal's mark.
people.wants: To be the one who brought the ring home, at a price the head will remember, and to make the eight vassals a council that sits under Lạc Hà's seal by choice rather than by debt, with each of them owing her a placement.
people.secret: Phan Vật Hoa's steward told her what the surety was in 1180: the Lone Duck Ring. She has not told the head she knows, and has used it with Phan to bargain the interest down a little each year. Now she is drawing the list for the thirty contracts, and she has left off the children she means to place herself: her grand-niece Hách Thần Hà, the Ngưu Đẩu herder Âu Đẩu Sinh, and Tạ Quy Yến, whom she has promised to Châu Phi Vân for a favour. She draws it at Vật Hoa Thị through the spring auction, where Tiền Ngũ Phân sells her his mistress's top price as the bidding days go. Children who have failed the dusk test only twice, or have not yet sat it, fill the count. Tô Hiểu Chu, the head's own blood, is on it so that no one can say only the poor are sold.

people.name: Quách Tiếp Vân
people.role: Master of the Bridge Hall; laid the Cloud Bridge Array and found the new seat
people.appearance: A small, stooped man who taps walls as he passes them and carries twelve hand flags made from a miner's jacket.
people.wants: To string the array's last ring, which would lift the seat's density past the old seat's, and to see the grandchildren of Vân Gian's miners come back up the mountain to live.
people.secret: The Counting House would not pay for the array's outer ring, so he signed Vệ Văn Cơ's fee for it in his own name. He has paid it for fifteen years out of his elder's stipend and the sale of his own pills. He owns nothing now but his flags, and the outer ring is still half paid.

people.name: Hình Trọng Sơn
people.role: Warden of the Miasma Watch at the ruin of Vô Định Thành; the sect's war party
people.appearance: A square, weathered man in ash-grey hemp who smells of lamp oil and keeps the Watch's green-flamed lantern at his belt.
people.wants: To break the Compact that Thiên Xu wrote over Lạc Hà's dead and take the river tolls back from Tùng Đào, with the Watch ready to call the plain to war the night the pact is signed.
people.secret: Since 1190 he has met Thính Vũ's war elder Cố Dạ Lan three times at the edge of the miasma. They are drafting a second pact like the founders' oath of 788 (C155). He has told no one: not his master, not his daughter, not the head. Since last spring he has bought war bells for the Watch from Minh Loan Các, alarms tuned to frighten men, which the head has not ordered. He pays Yến Bội Ngọc (yen_boi_ngoc) in the bronze the miasma gives back, which the Watch used to bury. And since last spring he has signed a night truce with the Tùng Đào captain at the Watch to keep the river quiet until the pact is ready: the lantern burns green on the nights the captain's ferries pass, so Lô Xướng Vãn (lo_xuong_van) sends his patrol boats out into an empty river and begins to think they are cursed.

people.name: Tông Thủ Tín
people.role: Master of the Counting House, the sect's books
people.appearance: A thin, ink-fingered man with spectacles of polished crystal and a voice that never rises.
people.wants: To keep the books clean one more year without anyone asking what the vault holds.
people.secret: Each week he pays a Hà Khúc widow, whose husband's wage chit he lost years ago, a copper from his own purse and enters it as rope waste; Uông Bình Trù (uong_binh_tru) has found the entry and thinks it is a bribe.

people.name: Lô Xướng Vãn
people.gloss: Sings at dusk (the fishing boats sing at dusk)
people.role: Master of the Boat Hall: the river boats, the tolls and the Evening Song
people.appearance: A barrel-chested riverman with a singer's deep voice and soot that never quite washes out of his beard.
people.wants: To teach the ninth verse to someone before he dies.
people.secret: On the river at night he is teaching Thương Ngư Ca (thuong_ngu_ca) the ninth verse, the one the sect cut from the boats' song in 805.

people.name: Chử Hồng Diệp
people.role: Master of the Maple Hall: spirit fields, herbs and the sect's pills
people.appearance: A wiry woman with sap-stained palms and a red maple leaf pressed in the clasp of her robe each autumn.
people.wants: To see one maple standing on the new seat.
people.secret: She is grafting cuttings of the last maple's stump onto a mountain birch behind the Maple Hall, and Ngụy Thụ Căn (nguy_thu_can) carries the cuttings up from the old seat in his oil can.

people.name: Bồ Tàn Chiếu
people.role: Keeper of the Evening Isle, Tịch Chiếu Đảo, where the sect's elders go to die
people.appearance: A bent old man in a reed rain-cape who speaks very little and counts on his fingers when he does.
people.wants: To choose his own rower.
people.secret: He is teaching Khúc Tịch Ba (khuc_tich_ba) to hold the boat in the surf, so that she and not her grandfather takes the oars on his last crossing, since Khúc Lão Điếu's hands shake.

people.name: Vưu Chước Kim
people.role: Guest elder (khách khanh): armourer of Tử Điện Thành
people.appearance: A big, burn-scarred, homely smith with a lightning-shaped scar down one forearm, who talks to blades more politely than to people.
people.wants: To hold Tử Điện once more and finish cleaning it.
people.secret: He is forging a star-iron blade in the forge's back room as the apology he has owed Cát Lưu Quang (cat_luu_quang) for thirty years, and Cổ Tiểu Thiết (co_tieu_thiet) carries the whetstone and keeps it quiet.

people.name: Sử Thu Thủy
people.role: Warden of the bay at Tử Điện Thành and of the Long River vein, on the Thính Vũ border
people.appearance: A sharp-eyed woman in a sea-grey coat who reads every letter twice and every face once.
people.wants: To see Thính Vũ's lamps counted at last, and one of them put out.
people.secret: She pays a Thính Vũ orchardist in Lạc Hà silver to keep her grandmother's lost orchard from the axe, and Sử Thanh Lâm (su_thanh_lam) thinks the silver goes to a tutor.

people.name: Từ Bình Hành
people.role: Master of the Hall of Scales, the sect's law
people.appearance: A square-bearded man who carries a grain-weigher's brass scale and sets it on the table before any hearing.
people.wants: To be shown one case where the Hall of Scales was wrong, and to rule on it.
people.secret: For eleven years he has quietly filed the left pan of his grain scale down by a grain so that defendants win the ties; Mộ Hành Vân (mo_hanh_van), who has broken no rule in sixty years, has not noticed.

people.name: Lận Viễn Phàm
people.role: Warden of Cô Vụ Đảo at Triều Âm Thành; keeper of what is left of Cô Phàm Các
people.appearance: A sunburnt islander with a sailor's squint and a roll of old sea charts always under one arm.
people.wants: To see the Rudder drawn on a sea chart that sails.
people.secret: He is selling shares in the third boat to the island's fishwives, more shares than the boat has ribs, and Lục Bồng Sa (luc_bong_sa) keeps the second book.

people.name: Thịnh Kinh Hàn
people.gloss: Startled by the cold (the goose ranks startled by the cold)
people.role: Cảnh Trường Thiên's true disciple; drill master of the Geese Hall
people.appearance: A tall, straight-backed man who walks in step with whoever is beside him without meaning to.
people.wants: To learn, once, whether he is any good in a real war.
people.secret: At night he fights the shadows of his own file in the Cloud Bridge's lower gallery to learn what he would do, and Thịnh Thiếu Hàng (thinh_thieu_hang) has twice watched from the dark.

people.name: Nhan Tề Phi
people.gloss: Flying together (the sunset clouds fly together with the lone duck)
people.role: The founder's daughter; war elder; wrote the elders' war art and carried Thanh Sương
people.cause: fell at Chiết Kích Nguyên at the head of the sect's field (C017)
people.appearance: Remembered in the Geese Hall's one painting: a broad woman in red-brown armour, a pale sword at her back.

people.name: Thiệu Song Phong
people.role: The first armourer; forged Tử Điện and Thanh Sương and the gates of Thiết Tỏa Quan
people.cause: died holding the iron gate of Thiết Tỏa Quan when Thiên Xu broke the fort (C105)

people.name: Trương Ánh Đào
people.role: Elder who held Hồng Vũ Thành in the War of the Petal Shore
people.cause: burned in Hồng Vũ Thành, holding it against Thính Vũ (C127)

people.name: Hạ Hầu Trường Phong
people.role: Fleet master of Lạc Hà in the Pirate Purge
people.cause: burned with his flagship holding the harbour mouth of Thôn Hải Môn (C153)

people.name: Lô Tiểu Ca
people.role: Boat Hall singer, Lô Xướng Vãn's daughter
people.cause: fell from the last rope bridge on the Ngư Ca border when Tùng Đào's raiders cut it in the Ferry War (A202)

people.name: Phong Ý Nhàn
people.role: Steward of Vô Định Thành's tallies; Trầm Tịch Dương's wife
people.cause: stayed in burning Vô Định Thành to send its archives out by boat (C158)

people.name: Tiết Ấn Thủy
people.role: Toll clerk of the gate-house: stamps the passes and keeps the toll books
people.appearance: Stamps each pass after a small pause, as though weighing the traveller.

people.name: Úc Lãng Hoa
people.role: Helmswoman of the awning boats of Ô Bồng; head of the Úc boat family
people.appearance: Her green headcloth has not been washed since her mother wore it.

people.name: Úc Tiểu Bồng
people.role: Outer deck child of the Úc awning boat
people.appearance: More often asleep against a coil of rope than awake, with its pattern printed on his cheek.

people.name: Tô Lệnh Chu
people.role: Inner disciple of the gate-house; checks passes on the first landing
people.appearance: An iron stamp swings at her neck; she reads faces as if they were passes.

people.name: Bồ Tẩy Sa
people.role: Outer disciple at the Đào Sa landing; a gold-washer's orphan of the burning
people.appearance: Two fingers crushed in a winch; ropes fray, tides turn and planks give way within a pace of him.

people.name: Ngô Dạ Độ
people.role: Inner disciple of the eighth-bend pilot; rowed the spring pig to the serpent
people.appearance: A small lamp in a tin hangs at her belt.

people.name: Kỷ Chu Nhi
people.role: Outer deck boy of the Đào Sa captain
people.appearance: Grins when he lies, which his captain has never noticed.

people.name: Thương Bạch Phàm
people.role: Mistress of the boats: the fleet, its building and its crews; saved the one ferry that did not burn
people.appearance: A tall helmsman's daughter with white hair cropped like a deckhand's and a burn across both palms.
people.wants: To see ten years of the Ngư Ca toll paid back to Lạc Hà in free crossings, and to tell Giang Cửu Khúc herself before he guesses.
people.secret: She is building a second, unnamed ferry in the Đà Công yard from Đào Sa wreck timber, to carry Lữ Tẫn Chu (lu_tan_chu) across the river if he ever comes, and has charged the hull to the fleet's repair account.

people.name: Giang Hồi Lan
people.role: The ferry master's son and heir; captain of the Đào Sa landing
people.appearance: His father's build and his mother's burned hands, and a half-healed scar where a Lạc Hà oar took him in 1173.
people.wants: To fight the Ferry War again and win it, and to put the names of the men who fired the landing on a post at Đào Sa.
people.secret: He keeps a Lạc Hà oarsman taken in 1173 in a flooded cellar under the gold-washers' sheds, and breaks one of the man's fingers each season until he gives up the names of the raiders; Thường Thiên Đào (thuong_thien_dao) holds the cellar key and has told no one.

people.name: Lại Bát Khúc
people.role: Pilot of the eighth bend, where the serpent sleeps
people.appearance: Never looks at the water directly while the boat is moving.

people.name: Sài Kết Lãm
people.role: Rope and rigging master; still buys Lạc Hà hemp
people.appearance: Hemp fibre in his eyebrows; he sniffs every coil before he buys.

people.name: Thường Thiên Đào
people.role: Warden of the Đào Sa landing and the gold-washers
people.appearance: Carries a jar of rusted nails at her belt and rattles it when she is deciding.

people.name: Lê Tiểu Phàm
people.role: Inner disciple; a crossing-keeper's daughter
people.appearance: Bounces on her toes while she waits, and has never finished a meal sitting down.

people.name: Mã Trường Cao
people.role: Inner disciple of the eighth-bend pilot
people.appearance: A tuft of hair that will not lie down, and a story that grows each time.

people.name: Thạch Thập Đinh
people.role: Outer disciple; a Đào Sa orphan of the burning, too old for the inner gate
people.appearance: Counts the coppers in his peg-hole hoard each night with a bent thumb.

people.name: Giang Tiểu Loan
people.role: Outer disciple; the ferry master's granddaughter
people.appearance: A white forelock coming in early, like her grandmother's.

people.name: Đổng Cựu Môn
people.role: Inner disciple; a descendant of the boatmen of fallen Phân Thủy Môn
people.appearance: Touches a splinter of gate-post wrapped in oilcloth before he speaks.

people.name: Uông Liên Chu
people.role: Founder of Lãng Đào Môn (790); made one gate of the feuding boat families
people.cause: died at the helm of the first ferry of spring, at 310

people.name: Lữ Thừa Lãng
people.role: Ferryman of the Đào Sa landing; father of Lữ Niệm Hà and Lữ Tẫn Chu
people.cause: burned on his ferry at the Đào Sa landing when Lạc Hà's raiders fired the boats, at 48 (A080)

people.name: Mẫn Tĩnh Ba
people.role: Sitter at the far end of the ice; Bồ Tọa Tuyết's disciple
people.appearance: Sits so still that sparrows land on her knees; you must say her name three times before she looks up.

people.name: Thân Vọng Giang
people.role: Second of the ice-fish escort under Sử Phá Băng
people.appearance: Broad flat whaler's hands; a voice that carries across a hundred oars.

people.name: Phương Diệp Chu
people.role: Phương Lô Hoa's nephew; counts the ice-fish
people.appearance: Chubby, earnest, moves his lips as he counts on his fingers.

people.name: La Tố Lân
people.role: Guts and sells fish at the Liên Giang stall
people.appearance: Fish scales glitter on her forearms to the elbow; she smells of brine.

people.name: Bùi Trường Tuyến
people.role: The head's disciple; sits the hole beside Liễu Thoa Nhi's
people.appearance: Reed-cutter's long arms; goes red whenever Liễu Thoa Nhi passes.

people.name: Mã Hàn Chu
people.role: Pavilion Frost Test failure who chose the river
people.appearance: Wind-split lips; he folds his hands whenever he is not rowing.

people.name: Chiêm Đống Nhi
people.role: Cuts the holes at first freeze and keeps the tally of the dead's holes
people.appearance: Tally cord of knotted hemp wound round her wrist, thick as a bracelet.

people.name: Bồ Tọa Tuyết
people.role: Grand elder: the last of the old ice-hole sitters of Liên Giang, who reached Kết Đan on the river alone
people.appearance: A tiny, ancient man in a frost-white straw cape who looks like a heap of snow until he speaks.
people.wants: To die sitting on the river, and before that to see one disciple reach the ninth layer.
people.secret: The stone under the ice: Lãnh Giang can never truly revive Hàn Giang under the Pavilion's licence. He has not told Lư, because it would break him.

people.name: Phương Lô Hoa
people.role: Steward of the school's boats and the head's wife
people.appearance: A brisk marsh woman with reed-flower pins in her hair and an abacus at her belt.
people.wants: To keep the school solvent and her husband sitting, and to see the Pavilion's clerk leave her books alone.
people.secret: Each spring she writes a tenth of the school's catch into the ledger as lost to ice, and sells it to Liên Giang for the boats' repairs. Phạm Lãnh Vân (pham_lanh_van) reads the books every spring and has begun to count the ice.

people.name: Sử Phá Băng
people.role: Captain of the ice-fish boat escort
people.appearance: A loud, red-faced boatman who breaks the morning ice in the harbour of Tuyết Đăng Trấn with his elbow.
people.wants: To hunt a whale with the terrace crews before he is too old to hold the harpoon.
people.secret: He sells every tenth sack of ice-fish roe to the smugglers he fights each season, and has Cù Băng Ngư (cu_bang_ngu) row the pay ashore.

people.name: Tiền Ngân Lân
people.role: Keeper of the fish market stall in Liên Giang
people.appearance: Fish-scale stains on the thumb; one gold tooth he is proud of.

people.name: Liễu Thoa Nhi
people.role: The head's disciple; Liễu Ngư Ca's younger sister
people.appearance: The Liễu family's narrow chin; a half-smile she turns on whoever is teaching her.

people.name: Cù Băng Ngư
people.role: Oarsman on the escort
people.appearance: Oarsman's shoulders; a lazy, sun-slackened grin.

people.name: Mạch Tiểu Điếu
people.role: Youngest outer disciple
people.appearance: Small for his age; cracked net-mender's fingertips.

people.name: Ngải Hàn Tịch
people.role: Inner disciple from Mộc Lan Thành; Phương Lô Hoa's disciple
people.appearance: Bright merchant's earrings she has not learned to take off for the ice.

people.name: Hồng Lạp Nhi
people.role: Outer disciple from the sail-watchers' village
people.appearance: Sail-cloth callus along the thumb; a sing-song coastal drawl.

people.name: Đái Tuyết Lạp
people.gloss: Wearing a snow hat (Liễu Tông Nguyên: cô chu thoa lạp ông)
people.role: Co-founder of Lãnh Giang Phái (1140)
people.cause: went through the river ice while sitting the seventh layer, at 88
people.appearance: Remembered as a broad, loud man with a gap-toothed laugh and fish-scale scars on both hands.

people.name: Đinh Ngân Câu
people.role: Grey sister of the mine-road watch at the Gate Hermitage
people.appearance: Notched left ear, a shaft-fall scar; she knocks twice on any wall before leaning on it.

people.name: Tôn Hàn Y
people.role: White nun who lays the hermitage's dead in the glacier, facing north
people.appearance: Two fingertips lost to frostbite on the left hand; she smells of cold lamp oil.

people.name: Doãn Hàn Bích
people.role: Cold Jade miner's daughter in the grey gate
people.appearance: Jade-green grit under every fingernail; her laugh arrives a breath late.

people.name: Chu Tuyết Thanh
people.role: White novice who copies names into the book of the dead
people.appearance: Lips stained black from licking the brush; the new white robe is still stiff at the folds.

people.name: Tiêu Ngọc Khê
people.role: Tiêu-clan daughter in the grey gate; carries letters to the Tầm Kiếm lodge
people.appearance: Clan-green ribbon sewn inside her sleeve where the grey cannot show it.

people.name: Khương Thạch Lựu
people.role: Grey novice who sharpens the gate's swords
people.appearance: Whetstone sparks have nicked her forearms white; one front tooth is chipped on a sword hilt.

people.name: Mạc Liên Sương
people.role: Herb nun who goes down to the miners with Úc Hàn Chân
people.appearance: Bright chilblains on both ears; the satchel rattles with glass phials.

people.name: Mạnh Tĩnh Chi
people.role: Prioress of the Gate Hermitage (the old seat) and captain of its law; the only other living person who has seen the seal
people.appearance: Tall and grey-robed, with a face like a closed door and a pear-wood sword she has drawn eleven times in two hundred years.
people.wants: To see the seal opened and answer the voice behind it, and to walk to it again in 1202.
people.secret: She adds an unsigned page to every letter Tiêu Ngọc Khê carries down to Tầm Kiếm, for the lodge's witness Tiêu Hòe Sinh: the old stair above the gate, saddle by saddle, as she climbed it in 1152, so that he can swear to a road before the Hall. She knows the sword at the top kills whoever draws it. It has spoken to her every winter since 1152 in a man's voice.

people.name: Ứng Lê Âm
people.gloss: Answering the pear blossom's sound (the bell)
people.role: The abbess's true disciple and bell-ringer of the Upper Hermitage
people.appearance: A round-faced woman with jade dust still in the creases of her knuckles, who hums the bell's note without knowing it.
people.wants: To keep the bell rung while the abbess rides to Hòe Âm, and never to be the one who sits against the seal.
people.secret: After the evening bell she teaches Diệp Quang Nhi (diep_quang_nhi) the bell's note on the quiet side of the wall, the one novice the hermitage does not know how to teach, and tells no one.

people.name: Hướng Thiết Lan
people.role: Captain of the grey sisters at the Gate Hermitage; a Metal root with no Ice
people.appearance: Broad in the shoulder, sunburnt from standing in the gate's glare, with a miner's short grey sword.
people.wants: To be let off the Hall of Cold Law's oath without swearing that no man has passed her gate in thirty years.
people.secret: Night by night she scrapes the spring entries out of the gate tally, one page at a time, so that no basket of larch mushrooms from Tịch Lang Tung (tich_lang_tung) shows in the book. Khâu Ngân Linh (khau_ngan_linh) is the sister who counts.

people.name: Úc Hàn Chân
people.role: Herbalist of the hermitage, who treats the valley's miners for nothing
people.appearance: Smells of crushed snow lotus; her sleeves are patched in the colour of every salve she makes.

people.name: Giản Tố Y
people.role: Keeper of the hermitage's register of the dead
people.appearance: Neck bent from forty years over a book; eyes the washed blue of old ink.

people.name: Tiêu Ngọc Hòe
people.role: A Tiêu-clan daughter among the grey sisters
people.appearance: Cowlick on the crown that no grey headscarf will flatten.

people.name: Bành Tiểu Thiền
people.role: Grey novice from the oriole valley
people.appearance: Her throat visibly bobs when she holds back a tune.

people.name: Diệp Quang Nhi
people.role: Novice in whom Light woke on the peak instead of Ice
people.appearance: Pupils go gold at dawn; she squints at the east all morning.

people.name: Thường Sương Mi
people.role: The newest white nun
