people.appearance: Flat plain face, a mole like a dropped seed on one cheek; the white robe a size too large.

people.name: Khâu Ngân Linh
people.role: Youngest of the grey sisters
people.appearance: Broom handle worn to the shape of her palm; a stare that counts.

people.name: Kỷ Hoa Ảnh
people.role: Founder of Lê Hoa Am (600); last disciple of Hoắc Hàn Quang; sealed his cave in 702
people.cause: died in seclusion against the seal, at 460
people.appearance: Remembered as a woman whose hair turned white on the night of the pear-blossom snow; her portrait in the hall has no mouth.

people.name: Liêu Thanh Nhu
people.role: Second abbess of Lê Hoa Am (790-1020)
people.cause: end of her years (440), the winter she handed on the bell
people.appearance: Remembered as broad-faced and slow of speech, with one eyelid that never fully closed.

people.name: Phương Kim Châm
people.role: Road healer, second on the fever roads
people.appearance: A stoop from carrying the sick on her back.

people.name: Giả Tuyền Phong
people.role: Seals the Pivot's hundred jars at the Spring House
people.appearance: Checks each door twice and the jar-seals three times.

people.name: Khấu Nhị Đảm
people.role: Night carter: carts lake water the fortnight's road up to the spring
people.appearance: Scarf wound twice across his mouth against the lake damp.

people.name: Lộc Thảo Nhi
people.role: Weeds the meadow gardens at Lục Dã
people.appearance: Hums to the herbs, and to nothing else.

people.name: Bạc Triều Âm
people.role: Taster's apprentice from the salt marsh
people.appearance: Her tongue is stained blue and she will not say from what.

people.name: Liên Thần Hà
people.role: Boatman of the Dawn Hall; rows the healers out to the villages
people.appearance: White nick through one eyebrow where an oar caught him.

people.name: Trương Hàm Chước
people.role: Vat-stirrer at the Spring House
people.appearance: A tongue-tip scalded pink; he tastes with the back of his mouth.

people.name: Nhạc Thuần Nhưỡng
people.role: Wine-master of the Spring House at the old seat (place 26): the sweet spring, the cellars and the Pivot's hundred jars
people.appearance: A heavy, soft-spoken man in a stained leather apron, with a cellar's chill on his skin and a seal on a cord round his neck.
people.wants: To clear the school's note without selling a cask, and to double the jars once the fine is lifted.
people.secret: The cut jars go to the Pivot and the palace. The pure spring wine goes to Kim Vạn Lý at three times the price, and Kim will not pay for the last forty jars: he sets them against the school's note. Nhạc has drawn up the pledge of the healers' sick-hall that Kim's factor asks for as surety, and means to set it before Mai on a drinking night, when she seals what she is given.

people.name: Hà Thanh Tô
people.role: Mai Lễ Tuyền's true disciple; keeper of the sick-hall at the Dawn Hall and leader of the road healers
people.appearance: A thin woman with cropped hair and herb-stained cuffs, always half-packed for the road.
people.wants: A second sick-hall at Hàm Trạch, paid from the cellars' money.
people.secret: One night a week she carries cots and medicine stock to a rented barn at Hàm Trạch, so that if the factor takes the Dawn Hall as surety for Kim Vạn Lý (kim_van_ly) the fever beds are not in it.

people.name: Cận Tri Vị
people.role: The school's taster: every cask, every pill, every poison; blind since 1150
people.appearance: A still woman with milky eyes who turns her head toward a cask before anyone has opened it.
people.wants: The cutting acknowledged as Mai's order, in writing, before the Pivot's steward dies.
people.secret: She is teaching her apprentice Bạc Triều Âm (bac_trieu_am) to taste poison by slipping a drop of foxglove into the girl's tea each month and telling her to find it. The girl has been sick for a week each time and does not know why.

people.name: Nhạc Dư Hương
people.role: The wine-master's son; leads the lake carts, which leave by night
people.appearance: Right palm callused by the cart whip, left palm soft as a merchant's.

people.name: Ngải Bạch Chỉ
people.role: Herb master of the school's gardens at Lục Dã Trấn
people.appearance: Smells of crushed mint, with one eye clouded white by a thorn.

people.name: Trác Linh Tuyền
people.role: Inner disciple of the sick-hall; a road healer
people.appearance: Her cooper father's mark, a ring of staves, is burned on her forearm.

people.name: Lư Tiểu Khúc
people.role: Cellar boy of the Spring House
people.appearance: Hiccups at dawn and blames the mash.

people.name: Sa Ấu Lan
people.role: Outer disciple of the Dawn Hall, from the salt marsh
people.appearance: Hands cracked from salt, a white seam along every cuticle.

people.name: Nhữ Tri Thu
people.role: Inner disciple of the herb gardens at Lục Dã
people.appearance: Chews the corner of a page when he thinks.

people.name: Khấu Đại Úng
people.role: Servant porter who takes the hundred jars to the Pivot each year
people.appearance: One shoulder a hand wider than the other, from the yoke.

people.name: Liêm Cam Lộ
people.role: Founder of Lễ Tuyền Phái (660); healer and brewer
people.cause: died at 330 in the cellars, sitting by the spring

people.name: Trọng Tế Thế
people.role: The healer who went into Cựu Khê first in 812 and died there
people.cause: died of the fever at Cựu Khê Trấn (V136)

people.name: Dương Tam Đao
people.role: Lieutenant of the Bobtail robbers; led the 1190 raid on the Đồng Sơn road
people.appearance: Three axe-scars across the left cheek, healed white. He is named for them.

people.name: Hầu Tiểu Lục
people.role: The youngest robber on the Bobtail ridge, who wants out
people.appearance: Ears like open doors. A bowl-cut he trims himself with a knife.

people.name: Tề Đoản Vĩ
people.gloss: Bobtail, named for the ridge he held
people.role: Old chief of the Bobtail robbers, who raised Khấu Thiên Tứ and Triều Ngũ Lang
people.cause: killed by a Thúy Vi road patrol on the Thạch Công road (N-loose_north-02)

people.name: Đinh Vạn Tác
people.role: Hemp smuggler of Đào Sa Thị; brings Lạc Hà's Tang Ma hemp over the border for Lãng Đào's ropes
people.appearance: Hemp fibre grey in the stubble of his chin; a rope-burn bracelet at each wrist.

people.name: Liêu Tẩy Sa
people.role: Gold-washer of Đào Sa who keeps her husband's smuggling ledger in her pan
people.appearance: One gold tooth she says she found. Hands bleached wrinkled, as if she had just come out of the river.

people.name: Liên Bất Ngữ
people.role: Fence for Ice beast cores on the frost coast; ships them south inside the ice-fish run
people.appearance: Smells of brine. His left eye wanders when he lies, which is often.

people.name: Thiệu Tàn Đăng
people.role: Phàn Cổ Đăng's Dao partner; died forcing the fire hall of Băng Hỏa Môn
people.cause: burned by the ward of Băng Hỏa Môn's sealed fire hall (N-loose_north-01)

people.name: Khổng Vọng Băng
people.role: Ice-cutter of the ruin crew; failed the Pavilion's Frost Test three times and took the road
people.appearance: Shoulders like a door. A blue-grey frostbite patch on the right ear, rubbed when he thinks.

people.name: Luyện Đắc Bảo
people.role: A Phù Kiều gambler of the Hàn Tân quay whose debts Tùng Đào bought
people.appearance: Flushed, soft face; chewed thumbnail. In every dice house his is the candle that gutters, whatever the draught.

people.name: Cù Lô Nhi
people.role: Ferry girl of the Cold Ford; the night ferryman's apprentice
people.appearance: Barefoot, tanned the colour of the reeds, braid tied off with a fish-hook.

people.name: Mạch Phục Linh
people.gloss: Poria, the fungus on old pine roots
people.role: Ginseng digger of Bạch Viên Lĩnh, the white apes' ridge
people.appearance: Seamed like dried ginseng root; the children of the apes' ridge call her the Root. Soil under every nail.

people.name: Bì Tứ Nương
people.role: Keeper of the Loose Table, the wineshop under the pines where Tùng Hạ's loose cultivators drink
people.appearance: Pine needle behind her ear, never the same needle. Round face flushed from the stove.

people.name: Hà Tiểu Băng
people.role: The oasis girl with more Water than the desert has bred; her mother will not let her sit the Frost Test
people.appearance: Hair so black it looks wet. Does not blink in the wind.

people.name: Hà Khổ Hàn
people.role: Frost Test failure turned caravan guard; Mông Thủy Hương's husband
people.cause: buried in a sandstorm at Phong Sa Nhãn guarding a salt caravan (N-loose_north-03)

people.name: Xa Linh Nhi
people.role: A Dạ Quang outer rider who left when the young blades took up the cups again; casts camel bells at Đà Linh Trấn
people.appearance: Brass dust on his forearms. One ear half deaf from the camel bells.

people.name: Ngũ Bất Tề
people.role: Storyteller of Trường Vân's caravan inns; a weak five-element root no gate would take
people.appearance: Bald crown ringed with long grey hair. His voice cracks on the vowels, carries no further than the next table; dogs sleep through his stories.

people.name: Nhung Tử Điêu
people.role: The last sable trapper of Lãnh Nguyệt Lâm
people.appearance: Nose broken twice, red with cold. Sable gloves with the fingers worn through.

people.name: Âu Vãn Chiếu
people.role: Guide of Phản Cảnh Lâm, who walks lost travellers out by the evening light
people.appearance: A frost-white streak through his black hair that does not melt indoors.

people.name: Lỗ Kinh Thạch
people.role: Moonstone miner with a Thunder root in an Ice sect's mountains
people.appearance: A pale, branching scar up the right arm like a fern, where the vein's lightning ran.

people.name: Tuân Tuyết Liên
people.role: Snow-lotus gatherer above Hòe Âm
people.appearance: Windburnt pink cheeks; snow-lotus pollen yellowing her sleeves.

people.name: Yến Lưu Huy
people.role: Snow-jade miner with a Light root; left the Pivot's outer gate after failing its Level Beam by five
people.appearance: Eyelashes dusted pale with jade grit; squints at any lamp.

people.name: Mặc Thán Nương
people.role: Charcoal-burner's daughter with a Darkness root; a woman in red has offered to teach her
people.appearance: Soot in the creases of her knuckles that never washes out. Her eyes widen in daylight.

people.name: Phàn Cổ Đăng
people.role: Boss of the frost coast's ruin-diggers, licensed by the Pavilion's Hall of Cold Law to dig the coast's dead halls
people.appearance: A small grey woman in a seal-fur coat patched from three coats, who carries an old bronze lamp lit even at noon and talks to it more than to her crew.
people.wants: To bring Thiệu Tàn Đăng's bones out of the fire hall of Băng Hỏa Môn and stand him in the ice above Mộc Lan, facing the sea he dug beside.
people.secret: The fire hall opens only to fire qi. She did not take Dư Chúc Nhi into the crew out of pity: she means to send the girl through the door that killed Thiệu. She also knows that Hồng Lô Cốc on the cape would teach a Fire root properly, and she has not told her.

people.name: Khấu Thiên Tứ
people.gloss: Heaven's gift (the old chief's joke: no one else gave the boy anything)
people.role: Chief of the robbers of Đoản Vĩ Cương, the Bobtail ridge; Triều Ngũ Lang's sworn brother from the camp
people.appearance: A long-armed old man in a lynx-skin cap with the bob tail left on, the camp's badge, and an axe hafted in lynx bone through his belt.
people.wants: To keep the ridge free of every sect for as long as he lives, and to sit across a fire from Triều once more before one of them dies.
people.secret: In the 1190 raid he saw Triều carry a six-year-old boy out of the mist and lowered his own axe to let them pass. The boy is Ký Thất Lộ, who has sworn to kill the band, and Khấu would let him try.

people.name: Dư Chúc Nhi
people.role: A Fire root born in an ice-cutters' village; the ruin crew's thaw-girl
people.appearance: A thin girl with chapped red hands that are always warm, frost-burn marks on her cheeks from the winter the village tried to cool her in the lake, and hair she cuts with a hot knife.
people.wants: A real Fire method and a teacher with fire in her, and enough stones sent home that Tạc Băng stops calling her a curse.
people.secret: She has twice gone alone to the sealed fire hall of Băng Hỏa Môn and felt its door warm under her hand, as if it knew her. She has not told Phàn, because Phàn's face changes whenever anyone says the hall's name.

people.name: Thư Phiêu Bình
people.role: Caravan guard for hire at Tùng Hạ Thị; taught the boy Hứa Vãn Cung the road
people.appearance: A tall woman of eighty-eight who looks fifty, with a bowyer's bow from her home village and a staff worn white at the grip.
people.wants: To be asked to guard a caravan that is not taking a road she has already seen.
people.secret: She has kept the pay of the last wolf-winter run in her boot since 1188, and Hứa Vãn Cung and Doanh Thủ Lộ each think the other drew it; she is waiting for one of them to ask.

people.name: Nhâm Độ Hàn
people.role: Night ferryman of the Cold Ford river mouth, who carries anyone across and remembers no one
people.appearance: A stooped man in a reed rain-cape who poles without a lantern and has never been seen to hurry.
people.wants: One night in a bed that does not rock, and for Cù Lô Nhi to take the dawn crossings without being told why.
people.secret: With every fare he scratches a tally on the keel board of the boat, and the board is nearly full; Cù Lô Nhi has seen it and has begun to read the marks.

people.name: Cát Châu Nương
people.role: Keeper of the dice house on the Hàn Tân quay; buys debts and gossip for Tùng Đào's first elder
people.appearance: A plump old woman with a pearl in each ear, one real and one glass, who never says which.
people.wants: The Cold Ford's every debt in one ledger, and the first elder owing her a seat.
people.secret: She has taken Luyện Đắc Bảo's last rooms as pledge and means to turn him out at first frost, whatever his sister Luyện Tố Y offers; she has told Hồ Tùng Nguyệt that it is the sister's key she wants, which is a lie.

people.name: Hô Diên Liệt
people.gloss: Fierce, of the old steppe clan Hô Diên
people.role: Free sabre of the desert road, hired by Hồi Lan merchants who trust neither Trấn Sa nor Dạ Quang
people.appearance: A bow-legged rider with a sabre on each hip, one from each of his parents' sides, and a face the sand has worn smooth.
people.wants: To be chosen by one side, and to refuse them on the day it happens.
people.secret: He pays Hà Khổ Hàn's widow's pond rent out of the Hồi Lan merchants' hazard money and has told the merchants he keeps it, so that Mông Thủy Hương will never learn it is anyone's charity.

people.name: Quản Tuyết Tung
people.role: Beast hunter of Lãnh Nguyệt Lâm; the man who sold the wolf-king's cub
people.appearance: A lean man in a white fox cape with a tame lynx at his heel and a string of wolf teeth he no longer wears.
people.wants: A buyer in Mộc Lan for a second cub, and the name of whoever shot his dog last winter.
people.secret: The wolf-king's mate still lives in a pit behind his hut at Liệp Hộ Thôn, starved by degrees so that her howl brings the pack down to his snares. Nhung Tử Điêu feeds her at night and is going soft.

people.name: Giả Chỉ Lộ
people.role: Guide to ruins in the northern markets; leaves his clients at the last turn
people.appearance: A smiling man in scholar's grey with ink on every finger and a map case on each shoulder, one for buyers and one he never opens; he stops to catch his breath on every stair, and his clients carry the cases the last stretch.
people.wants: A map of one ruin he has actually climbed to the top of.
people.secret: This month he has sold the Peach Spring walk to three parties who all set out on the same morning, and Lạc Đan Thanh's man has found out.

people.name: Mông Thủy Hương
people.role: Widow of Ngư Đàm Thôn raising a Water-gifted daughter she will not give to the Pavilion
people.appearance: A small brown woman with fish-scale silver on her sleeves from the ponds and her dead husband's undyed sash tied at her waist.
people.wants: Her daughter's Water in a safe place, and her husband's grave tended.
people.secret: She has written ahead to Ôn Sa Ngọc to bring Hà Tiểu Băng home from the frozen mere, and then written again, in secret, asking the Pavilion's gate to let the girl in.

people.name: Chiêm Thính Phong
people.role: A Wind root in a ruin crew; feels the draught of a buried hall through rock
people.appearance: A gangling young man who tilts his head at walls the way a dog does, with a strip of silk tied to his wrist that stirs when nothing else does.
people.wants: To be paid for the draught he feels, and for it to be a small one.
people.secret: For months he has felt a great draught under Phàn Cổ Đăng's own cellar and told no one, afraid it is a hall she wants and that she will stop paying him for small ones.

people.name: Mao Đinh Lang
people.role: River runner and hemp smuggler on the split-toll border; cuts the Thủy Khẩu toll chain when it suits him
people.appearance: Answers to Nail: the scar on his thumb is shaped like one, shown to anyone who asks about the river.

people.name: Phó Kết Thằng
people.role: Rope-weaver of Tang Ma Thành who wove the last bridge of 1174 and hung Lô Tiểu Ca's lamp from it
people.appearance: Rope-weaver's forearms. Two fingertips worn smooth as pebbles; she signs with a knot.

people.name: Trịnh Tiểu Độ
people.role: Deckhand of the free ferry at Thủy Khẩu
people.appearance: Beard of eleven hairs, combed with his fingers; a nose that peels all year.

people.name: Mẫn Bổ Võng
people.role: Net-mender of Tân Khẩu; mother of Đồ Tiểu Liên and of the boy the miasma took
people.appearance: Smells of tarred twine. Her left thumb has a groove you could lay a reed in.

people.name: Khôi Thảo Nhi
people.role: Gatherer of the grey moss that grows only at the miasma's edge
people.appearance: Grey-green to the wrists. A white band on one arm where a bracelet sat; she never says whose.

people.name: Cừu Quỷ Hỏa
people.role: Digger of burned Hồng Vũ Thành, who follows the spring ghost lights
people.appearance: Ash in his hair. Market children cross the road rather than look at the lopsided face under it; his right foot drags.

people.name: Mộc Tẩu Vũ
people.role: Runner of the Night Rain Market; failed the Tower's Bell Test in 1194
people.appearance: Startles at a dropped cup. Pats the pockets of a coat he does not own.

people.name: Mễ Thiềm Nhi
people.role: Toad-catcher of Độc Thiềm Lâm who sells venom to the market's alchemist
people.appearance: A green sheen at the wrists. She keeps a wall at her left side, moving so nobody can stand there.

people.name: Từ Bán Kiếm
people.role: Sell-sword out of the Night Rain Market; failed Phất Y Cốc's inner gate
people.appearance: A good sword in a bad sheath. Says the scorch on his collar came from a duel; drifts toward the door whenever anyone sits down.

people.name: Bành Nhị Hổ
people.role: Ridge hunter of Ô Diêu who sold his niece's hair and the pottery's map to the Tower, then wept at her false grave
people.appearance: Rice-wine breath at any hour. A thick red neck the dogs keep away from.

people.name: Trương Dã Đạo
people.role: Lieutenant of the Thạch Môn camp; a Xuyên Lâm guide struck from the road books
people.appearance: A road-book brand on the left wrist, scratched through with a nail.

people.name: Lỗ Tam Chùy
people.role: Runaway contract miner in the Thạch Môn camp, with a thread of Thunder
people.appearance: Hair stands on end in dry weather. The mine's grey is still in the creases of his hands.

people.name: Quản Thập Nhất
people.role: Quartermaster of the Thạch Môn camp; fences its loot through the apricot market
people.appearance: Spectacles on a string. The riders call her the Eleventh; nobody argues the count.

people.name: Phù Hỏa Sinh
people.role: Caravan guard of Lai Nghi taken by the camp in 1191, who stayed
people.appearance: A pale band on one finger. Sits where he can see both doors.

people.name: Yên Thủy Hoa
people.role: Pearl diver on the unlit boats, from the village that swore never to dive
people.appearance: Lips blue even in summer. A voice too loud for the room, because her ears ring.

people.name: Lan Bất Nhiên
people.gloss: The orchid that would not burn
people.role: Failed outer disciple of Phượng Minh Cung; now gathers spice herbs at Hương Liệu
people.appearance: Pepper-stained fingers. A shelf, ladder or stool breaks under her about once a month.

people.name: Đan Tẫn Lão
people.gloss: Old man of the red cinders
people.role: Picker of the Xích Thành Môn ruin, selling its red stone and what is carved on it
people.appearance: One cloudy eye; red dust ground into the creases of his knuckles.

people.name: Liên Quế Chi
people.role: Spice-herb gatherer of the Hương Liệu jungle
people.appearance: Smells of cinnamon. Whistles through the gap in her teeth.

people.name: Tuyên Đằng Nhi
people.role: Vine-climber and herb gatherer of Cô Vụ Đảo's jungle canopy
people.appearance: Barefoot always, toes that grip a rope like fingers.

people.name: Khâu Bạch Thủ
people.gloss: White-headed one of the mound (bạch thủ is also 'empty-handed')
people.role: The ruin-digger of Vô Định Thành and the only man who has walked the miasma of Chiết Kích Nguyên and come out (age 310)
people.appearance: Snow-white hair since he was ten, a brown unlined face, and a goat bell on a cord at his wrist that he silences with his thumb when he talks.
people.wants: To sell the plain once: one true map of the safe ways, to a buyer strong enough that he lives through the sale, for enough to die rich in Tân Khẩu.
people.secret: In 900 he reached the middle of the plain. The grey rises from carved stones laid in rings under the soil, and each stone bears a sunset cloud: Lạc Hà's founder's seal. He has known for three hundred years that the miasma was laid, and by whom, and that ten thousand of his friend's dead are Lạc Hà's work. In the ring nearest the old river road a blue sword lay where it had been dropped, among the bones, and he did not touch it.

people.name: Đồ Liệt Cơ
people.gloss: The fierce lady of the Đồ
people.role: Mistress of the bandit camp at Thạch Môn Trại on the Pivot road; the last chief of the Hắc Phong rogues (age 295)
people.appearance: Tall and heavy-shouldered, her left forearm a lacework of lightning scars, a hooked blade at each hip and one of them always clean.
people.wants: A Thunder-rooted heir for the camp before her lifespan turns (she has her eye on Bành Tiểu Điện), and one meeting with her brother before one of them dies.
people.secret: Twelve went over the wall in 940, not eleven. The twelfth was still on the rope when the Pivot's archers reached the wall, and the eleven below would have died with him. She cut it. He was her brother. He fell back inside, and that is why he lived.

people.name: Yến Hồi Độ
people.role: Ferryman of the free crossing at Thủy Khẩu on the Ngư Ca border; carried the Đào Sa raiders over in 1173
people.appearance: A narrow brown man in a split straw hat, his palms grooved by the pole, a stern lamp lit on his boat in daylight.
people.wants: To tell the whole of the Ferry War once, both halves of it, to someone who will make it count, before the war is fought again.
people.secret: He kept the slip. It is in Kha Triêu Phi's (kha_trieu_phi) hand. He also knows the toll that started the war was never set by the pines: Giang Cửu Khúc (giang_cuu_khuc) set it, and Yến was the first man told to collect it.

people.name: Giản Vạn Lộ
people.role: Seller of maps at the Night Rain Market in Thu Trì; a Nam Phố scribe turned out in 1174
people.appearance: A soft-spoken man with ink to the second knuckle, eyes that do not narrow in the dark, and a rolled map behind each ear.
people.wants: Khâu Bạch Thủ's true map of Chiết Kích Nguyên, and one find under his own name that Nam Phố will have to hear about.
people.secret: One of the three mountains to which Triệu Huyết Y has narrowed her master's abode is one he invented and sold her in 1176, with the False Cloud Seal on the map. She means to climb it, and he has seen what she does to a seller who lied.

people.name: Đoan Mộc Thính
people.role: Fortune-teller of Thiều Âm Thị and, in the rains, of the Night Rain Market; never wrong about the weather
people.appearance: A round, cheerful woman who tilts her head before she answers, as if the wind had told her first.
people.wants: To be asked once what the weather will do and to be allowed to say she does not know.
people.secret: She has no gift for weather at all. Her left knee, shattered at the Pivot's gate, aches before rain, and she pays the Thiều Âm Thị bell-ringer to tell her which way the pigeons fly.

people.name: Lộc Bất Quy
people.gloss: Lộc who does not go back
people.role: Sell-sword who guards buyers out of the Night Rain Market; a Pivot deserter of the Cinnabar Vein War
people.appearance: Grey at the temples, a Pivot sword with the Dipper filed off its guard, and a way of standing with his back to a wall.
people.wants: To be hunted by someone who is not Đồ Vô Cữu, and to be recognised by someone who does not mind.
people.secret: He teaches Từ Bán Kiếm the Pivot's steps for pay and leaves out the last pass on purpose, so that the boy cannot ever beat him.

people.name: Sầm Vãn Nương
people.gloss: The late-born daughter of the Sầm
people.role: Hunter's widow of Ô Diêu Thôn, raising a Thunder-rooted daughter that the Tower and a bandit camp both want
people.appearance: A potter's daughter's thick wrists, a hunter's knife she does not need, and clay always under one thumbnail.
people.wants: A door that Bành Nhị Hổ cannot find, and a daughter who stops practising in the yard.
people.secret: She has told her brother-in-law Bành Nhị Hổ that the girl died of fever, and dug a grave with a name on it behind the pottery. He has already sent condolence silver.

people.name: Bành Tiểu Điện
people.role: A hunter's daughter with an untrained Thunder root, born in a storm at the Tử Tinh mine
people.appearance: Seventeen, sunburnt and quick, her hair lifting a little whenever a storm is a day away.
people.wants: To use her spark in a real duel before the Tower comes for her.
people.secret: She slips out to the apricot market at night to trade spark-tricks to Đồ Liệt Cơ's riders for a bandit's blade, and the blade is under her bed.

people.name: Ân Thủ Sơn
people.role: Spirit-beast hunter of the Kinh Trập ridge; hunts the tiger king of Phục Hổ Cương
people.appearance: A broad, slow man with a face like a split gourd that children stare at, two fingers gone from his left hand, and a grey hound that never barks.
people.wants: To hold the tiger king's heart-core before the Tower hears there is one.
people.secret: He has known for two years where the tiger king sleeps and has told Sầm Vãn Nương nothing, because the kill would end his reason to come to her door.

people.name: Biện Ám Phàm
people.role: Smuggler of the unlit sails: carries the Night Rain Market's goods down the gulf and pearls back north
people.appearance: Salt-cracked lips, a sailor's squint, and a coat dyed black with mangrove bark so that she is a shadow on the deck.
people.wants: A second unlit boat, and Ôn Thủ Đăng's lamp dark for good.
people.secret: She waters the Kim Sa lamp's winter oil with fish oil on its way up, so that the lamp smokes and some ship is wrecked each season, which keeps her prices high. Ôn Thủ Đăng has not yet noticed.

people.name: Uông Tầm Phàm
people.role: Wreck-diver of Bích Không Cảng, the empty harbour of Cô Phàm Các; his father sailed on the first lost boat
people.appearance: Long-limbed and hollow-chested from diving, ears scarred by the deep, a Cô Phàm bronze sail-ring on his thumb.
people.wants: A berth on the third boat, and the last chart of his father's course.
people.secret: He leaves his best dive finds at Hầu Bách Chu's (hau_bach_chu) door for the third boat's hull, unsigned, and has told no one he is the one who sold Lận Viễn Phàm the bronze ring's twin.

people.name: Chúc Dư Âm
people.role: The musician of Thiều Âm Thị (A248): believed sent across the gulf in 1195, kept at Kích Khánh Đường
people.appearance: Thin, with a flute-player's calluses and the habit of stopping mid-word when a bird sings.
people.wants: To walk out of Kích Khánh Đường by the front gate in daylight, once.
people.secret: He steps on the broken chimes in an order that spells a letter to his sister Chúc Hiểu Nghi, and Lộ Văn Khánh has begun to notice that the same chimes ring every night.

people.name: Đồ Thiết Hống
people.role: Chief of the Hắc Phong rogues until the stockade fell in 940, father of Đồ Liệt Cơ and Đồ Vô Cữu
people.cause: killed at the gate when Thiên Xu cleared Hắc Phong Trại (V126), age 150

people.name: Bành Liệp Hổ
people.role: Spirit-beast hunter of Ô Diêu; husband of Sầm Vãn Nương
people.cause: killed by the tiger-kind of Phục Hổ Cương, age 57

people.name: Uông Viễn Lãng
people.role: A loose sailor of Cô Vụ Đảo hired onto Lận Viễn Phàm's first boat
people.cause: lost at sea with the first deep-water boat (N-binh_thuy-05), age 38

people.name: Kim Tích Phúc
people.role: Kim Vạn Lý's son: runs the wool caravans from Nhạn Thanh Thành to Vật Hoa Thị
people.appearance: His father's frame without the laugh, in a herder's felt coat; rain finds his bales on the one dry day of the month.
people.wants: A house with no gold in it, and a road that does not end at his father's door.
people.secret: He is forty bales short this year and is making up the weight by cutting the lead cart's wool with sheep-tail fur. Khang Viễn Đạc has smelled it and said nothing yet.

people.name: Tăng Bách Thông
people.role: Money-changer of Hạc Đinh Thị; father of Lạc Hà's caravan disciple Tăng Vân Tiêu
people.appearance: A small dry man behind a counter of shell, silver and stone, who bites every coin.
people.wants: To stop paying for Tăng Vân Tiêu's pills, or to see him pass the wall once.
people.secret: He gives change a stone light, one in forty, and banks the difference to buy back his son's failed-pill notes quietly so that the boy never knows. Tăng Phân Ly has found the strongbox.

people.name: Mễ Thanh Đại
people.role: Lạc Đan Thanh's agent in Lam Yên Thị, who buys Thúy Vi's pills and copies the seals
people.appearance: Neat, quiet and ink-stained, with a seal-cutter's loupe on a ribbon round her neck.
people.wants: To be given her own name by Lạc Đan Thanh, not another pigment's.
people.secret: She has begun to sell the copied seals to a second buyer, a Thúy Vi lay brother who pays double, and Đậu Tam Thất has noticed that the copies now arrive a day late.

people.name: Nhiêu Tử Uyển
people.role: Senior apprentice at the apricot clinic of Hạnh Hoa Thị, Giả Hồi Xuân's chosen heir
people.appearance: A farm girl's shoulders and a healer's clean hands; she rolls her sleeves to the elbow before anyone asks.
people.wants: To be Giả Hồi Xuân's heir and to cure her first poison, on herself.
people.secret: She swore never to taste poisons, and she has been taking a grain of each of Ô Thiềm Tử's venoms behind the screen at night, after the antidote, to learn them. Vu Ngân Kiều keeps count for her.

people.name: Phong Kính Sa
people.role: Vệ Văn Cơ's first apprentice; lays the granary rings and caravan wards his master no longer travels for
people.appearance: Sunburnt and quick, with a surveyor's cord wound round his forearm.
people.wants: Củng Tinh's Armillary Array Canon, by any door.
people.secret: He has copied Vệ Văn Cơ's wards onto the granary rings of Thạch Kiều Thành under his own name, and sells them to Bành Chẩm Thạch's clients at half the price.

people.name: Bành Chẩm Thạch
people.role: Formation master for hire at Thạch Kiều Thành, Vệ Văn Cơ's rival for the heartland's granary wards
people.appearance: Forearms plaster-white to the elbow. Raps every wall he passes, listening.

people.name: Hoàng Phủ Duyên
people.role: Broker of Tương Phùng Thị, the market of chance meetings: hires, marriages, partnerships and introductions, for a tenth
people.appearance: Plump and smiling, in a ferry-blue robe, with a book of names in her sleeve that no one has seen open.
people.wants: A match for her son that he will not run from.
people.secret: She is arranging a fourth marriage for Hoàng Phủ Chu with the daughter of a family that owes her, and has not asked the girl either; the wedding is set for the first rain.

people.name: Bàng Thủ Khế
people.role: Pawnbroker of Tống Khách Thị, who lends road money to outer disciples who failed the Frost Test
people.appearance: Pawnbroker's loupe on a string; he screws it into one eye to look at your face too.

people.name: Sử Quế Hương
people.role: Spice merchant of Hương Liệu Thị, who ships the far south's cassia north
people.appearance: Her fur collar has gone brown with cassia. A gold ring on every finger but the thumbs.

people.name: Khâu Phục Linh
people.role: Loose alchemist of Tùng Hạ Thị who brews pine-root wound pills for the road watch
people.appearance: A long, pitted horse-face the road watch jokes about. Resin-amber hands.

people.name: Hô Diên Linh
people.role: Camel-train master of Đà Linh Trấn, who carries Kim Vạn Lý's goods along the desert road
people.appearance: Camel-bite scar on the left shoulder, shown to strangers before he gives his name.

people.name: Quản Thận Ngôn
people.role: Kim Vạn Lý's ledger clerk at Nhạn Thanh Thành; Quản Phục Thu's brother
people.appearance: A soft-spoken young man with an abacus of jade beads and a better memory than the abacus.
people.wants: To be Kim Vạn Lý's clerk for the rest of the old man's life, and to give his sister a reason to forgive it.
people.secret: Once a month now he leaves one page out of the copy he sends to Quản Phục Thu, always the one that shows what Kim gives his old clerks.

people.name: Bào Thính Triều
people.role: Bào Tế Hải's daughter; a yard-born sailor who wants to sail south with Diêm Hải Tảo
people.appearance: Tall like her father, with salt-whitened braids and rope-burned palms.
people.wants: To sail south with Diêm Hải Tảo and not come back to the yard.
people.secret: She forged her father's seal on a passage letter for Diêm Hải Tảo's next ship, and has twice rowed out at night to check that the berth is hers.

people.name: Đái Song Lục
people.role: Kim Vạn Lý's bet-runner, who carries his wagers to the festival book and his losses home
people.appearance: Dice tinkle in his purse. One eye always half shut, as if about to wink.

people.name: Quan Liêm Chu
people.role: Master shipwright of the Bào yards
people.appearance: Plank-straight back; three fingertips gone, which he still counts on.

people.name: Đằng Thạch Lục
people.role: Lạc Đan Thanh's furnace boy at Vật Hoa Thị
people.appearance: Chin pocked with burns, not an eyelash left.

people.name: Vu Ngân Kiều
people.role: Junior apprentice at the apricot clinic
people.appearance: Thin as a reed, cheeks fever-bright; she sits down mid-sentence, gets up apologising.

people.name: Hà Khổ Sâm
people.role: Courier between the Night Rain Market and the apricot clinic
people.appearance: Bowed porter's legs, a face blotched yellow where the poison ran. Every road he takes has a bridge washed out.

people.name: Tăng Phân Ly
people.role: Daughter of the Hạc Đinh Thị money-changer, who keeps the counter when he naps
people.appearance: Her father's spectacles, a size too big, slide down her nose. She pushes them up with a knuckle.

people.name: Từ Thiên Toán
people.role: Grandson, clerk and heir of the Từ counting house
people.appearance: Hair oiled flat. A jade ring too big for his thumb, turned while someone else talks.

people.name: Ngư Họa Sa
people.role: Vệ Văn Cơ's second apprentice, a fishwife's daughter of the harbour
people.appearance: Salt-cracked heels. A fish-scale glitter on her wrist that never washes off.

people.name: Hoàng Phủ Chu
people.role: Hoàng Phủ Duyên's son, who runs her notes between the ferry and the teahouse
people.appearance: Round, good-natured face; sleep in the corner of one eye; collar rumpled by running.

people.name: Trịnh Hồng Tiên
people.role: Trịnh Chu Sa's daughter, who paints his wards and wants the cloud stamp he lost
people.appearance: Mulberry ink to the second joint of every finger.

people.name: Diêu Thiết Tiên
people.role: Guard on Kim Vạn Lý's western road; once an outer disciple of Phất Y Cốc
people.appearance: Caravan brand tattooed on the sword hand. He hardly speaks; his mouth turns down.

people.name: Bì Tiểu Thố
people.role: Street runner of Vật Hoa Thị who sells auction gossip by the word
people.appearance: Cowlick, black nails, eyes that count the coins at your belt.

people.name: Kỷ Minh Tiền
people.role: Tea and rice factor at Hồi Lan Thành for the Kim house
people.appearance: Ledger under one arm like a child; tea stains on every cuff.

people.name: Từ Bỉnh Quyền
people.role: Mistress of the Từ counting house in Thiên Quyền Thị: the lender sects go to when they cannot be seen borrowing from Thiên Bảo
people.appearance: Grey-haired and straight-backed, in black, with a brass steelyard weight on a cord at her wrist; she counts while she listens.
people.wants: To have the Từ weights accepted by the Pivot as its own standard, so that her house never needs a lord's protection.
people.secret: She holds enough of Kim Vạn Lý's paper to own the Bào yards and the wool road by autumn if she called it. She will not. She has read in his books what his lost bets buy, and a merchant who can make a sect head grateful is worth more standing than fallen. She has also offered Đặng Quân Bình half the face of Kim's forty years of unpaid tolls, and Đặng has not answered.

people.name: Bào Tế Hải
people.role: Master of the Bào ship-house at Yên Ba Thành, builder of the cape's merchant hulls
people.appearance: Broad, bald and salt-burned, with one shoulder lower than the other since a mast fell on it in 1130; he smells of pine tar.
people.wants: To build a hull that sails to the southern islands and comes back, which no ship of Yên Ba has done since Cô Phàm Các's fleet was lost in 705.
people.secret: In 1190 Kim Vạn Lý ordered the three hulls for Diêm deep-keeled and copper-sheathed for southern water, which means Kim knows she has a chart of the southern islands. Bào has not told her, because he wants to be on the ship when she sails it.

people.name: Quản Phục Thu
people.role: Debt broker of Ngũ Cốc Thành who buys bad paper at a tenth; granddaughter of the banker ruined in 1003
people.appearance: A narrow woman in mended grey who writes with her left hand and never sits with her back to a door.
people.wants: To close her grandfather's ledger paid in full, to buy back the four copies of the canon, and to see Kim Vạn Lý owe a debt he cannot pay.
people.secret: Her brother copies Kim's ledgers for her every new moon. She knows the house runs on Từ Bỉnh Quyền's credit. She has been offering to buy the small debts Kim leaves unpaid, Khúc Liệt Dương's year's wages and Nhạc's forty jars among them, so that she can call them all on one day and make Từ choose.

people.name: Quản Doanh Hư
people.role: Loose banker of Kim Cốc Thành, ruined with Kim Cốc Viên in 1003
people.cause: a heart demon after ruin; he died in a rented room in Vật Hoa Thị with his ledger closed

people.name: Mẫn Tế Thế
people.role: The first healer of Hạnh Hoa Thị; Giả Hồi Xuân's master
people.cause: spent the last of his lifespan in needles breaking a fever in the lamp-makers' quarter

people.name: Bào Thừa Phong
people.role: Founder of the Bào ship-house
people.cause: a fall from the slipway of the new yards he still owed for, at 170

people.name: Liêu Thính Kim
people.role: Appraiser of Thiều Âm Thị: bronze, bells and the old instruments the south ploughs up
people.appearance: Tall, with long ears weighted by bronze rings; she taps every object handed to her with a fingernail before she looks at it.
people.wants: One complete bell-set of Cửu Thiều Cung's age, and to hear it rung once in one room.
people.secret: She tells the farmers of Thê Ngô Lĩnh that their best finds are cracked, buys them at a tenth and sells them whole to Vưu Cẩm Thư. This season the farmer whose field gave up the great bell has begun asking for a second opinion.

people.name: Trịnh Chu Sa
people.role: Talisman seller of Đào Sa Thị who sells without the cloud stamp; sent away from Nam Phố Đường in 1120
people.appearance: Red-faced and burn-scarred down one arm, with cinnabar ground into the creases of his knuckles.
people.wants: The cloud stamp back, or the hall-mistress to say she was wrong.
people.secret: He sells his daughter Trịnh Hồng Tiên's finest wards under his own name at double the price, and tells her that he gave them to the boatmen.

people.name: Chiêm Thính Ba
people.role: Clerk of the note ledger at the Bell Wharf
people.appearance: Walks with a rigger's roll, as if the quay still moved under him.

people.name: Úy Chú Đồng
people.role: First pourer of the casting floor
people.appearance: A voice that cracks on the high notes, red-gold dust ground into her knuckles.

people.name: Mao Tiểu Hưởng
people.role: Placed from Lạc Hà in 1199; packs moulds
people.appearance: A coil of wool cord always at her wrist, in case a sheep wanders in.

people.name: Vệ Sóc Linh
people.role: Cloud Bridge ringer
people.appearance: Sleeps in his boots, as though the bells might call him up in the night.

people.name: Đồ Nê Hương
people.role: Packs moulds on the casting floor
people.appearance: A half-moon burn on her thumb from the bell she cast at entry.

people.name: Trì Viễn Lạc
people.role: Rides with the wool caravans
people.appearance: The claw scar on his cheek tugs whenever he frowns, and a spear is never more than a step away.

people.name: Thân Lạc Âm
people.role: Fits ward bells to ships at the Bell Wharf
people.appearance: Wears a gold hoop in one ear and says it was a gift.

people.name: Ngụy Trầm Âm
people.role: Elder and casting master on Tằng Loan Phong
people.appearance: A gaunt, silent man the colour of clay, with a face plain as a fired brick, deaf in his left ear from a bell he stood too close to.
people.wants: To strike his master's unstruck bell once, in the pit where Hoa Minh Hòa died, and then never cast again.
people.secret: At night he is teaching Đậu Tiểu Hỏa (dau_tieu_hoa) to pour on the cold furnace, against his own rule, because his good ear is failing and he wants a successor who can hear the bronze.

people.name: Thẩm Hưởng Nhi
people.role: Keeper of the forty bells on Lạc Hà's Cloud Bridge at Vân Kiều Trấn
people.appearance: A small, round-shouldered woman with a hand bell at her belt who tilts her head to listen before she answers anything.
people.wants: To know what rings the bridge bells from below, and to be allowed to say so.
people.secret: In 1197 she followed the note down to a locked door in the lowest silver gallery. On the new moon she heard someone behind it reading aloud, slowly, in the voice of Lạc Hà's head, and the bells answered every line. She has told no one, not even Miêu Thạch Lan.

people.name: Ông Hải Linh
people.role: Steward of the Bell Wharf, the pavilion's old seat on the coast
people.appearance: A loud, salt-tanned woman with a captain's ledger in one hand and a bell clapper in the other.
people.wants: A boat of her own, and the nerve to sail it past the edge of the charts after Nhạc Hải Âm's bell.
people.secret: For nine years she has kept a second ledger of what each captain confessed over her ale, and sells a page a month to a rival wharf's steward; Chiêm Thính Ba (chiem_thinh_ba), who writes the fair copy, adds a false line to each page to learn which captain comes asking.

people.name: Lỗ Hồng Phạm
people.role: Mould master of the casting floor
people.appearance: His back is bent like a bell yoke, and the clay under his nails is grey.

people.name: Khang Viễn Đạc
people.role: Rides with the caravans and fits their ward bells
people.appearance: Wears a sheepskin coat in midsummer and complains loudly about the heat.

people.name: Biện Tiểu Linh
people.role: Outer disciple, mould girl
people.appearance: Her arms shake under a full mould tray, the way reeds do in wind.

people.name: Uông Lạc Chùy
people.role: Swings the casting floor's hammer
people.appearance: A hammer-blister on every finger; he opens doors by leaning on them.

people.name: Sở Thanh Đạc
people.role: Outer disciple; caravan boy
people.appearance: A bell clapper forever spinning between his fingers, and he has never been seen to sit out a tuning.

people.name: Phí Ngọc Thanh
people.role: Rings the dusk tuning on the Cloud Bridge
people.appearance: Blinks slowly, like a cat in the sun.

people.name: Đậu Tiểu Hỏa
people.role: Bellows boy of the casting floor
people.appearance: No eyebrows to speak of; the bellows have eaten them.

people.name: Hoa Minh Hòa
people.role: Co-founder of Minh Loan Các (960); Yến Bội Ngọc's Dao partner
people.cause: killed when a great bell cracked in the casting pit in the cold winter of 1121, at 241

people.name: Nhạc Hải Âm
people.role: Ship-bell ringer; lost looking for Cô Phàm's fleet
people.cause: lost at sea aboard Lạc Hà's island warden's first boat, at 108

people.name: Lư Truy Phong
people.role: Rides the herds' south string at Liệt Mã Cương
people.appearance: A wind-split lower lip, and a coil of rope that never leaves his shoulder.

people.name: Trình Lục Phân
people.role: Clerk of the steward's room; carries the tribute account to Lạc Hà
people.appearance: Carries the ledger case like a baby, and wears a ferry token for a hairpin.

people.name: Ngải Đạp Sa
people.role: Placed rider from Lạc Hà, 1198
people.appearance: Salt-white eyebrows, and one boot a size too large.

people.name: Ngao Tuyết Nhi
people.role: Stable girl of the north paddock
people.appearance: Straw in her hair, and the print of a hoof on every apron she owns.

people.name: Thông Truy Điện
people.role: Second rider of the race string
people.appearance: Riding gloves cut off at the fingertips, and a ring of small bronze studs round her left ear.

people.name: Tần Mục Sơ
people.role: Herd boy of the long ride; Tần Thiên Lý's nephew
people.appearance: Fidgets, rubbing the back of his neck, and has his uncle's bowed legs.

people.name: Nghiêu Thư Nhạn
people.role: Copies the Wind room's letters
people.appearance: Ink-black thumb pad; her fine hand slants backward like a left-hander's.

people.name: Thôi Dương Giác
people.role: Elder of the manor; the last disciple of Phù Dao Quán, keeper of its Wind book
people.appearance: A narrow, weathered woman who stands facing into the wind out of habit, with a frostbitten left hand she keeps in her sleeve.
people.wants: To light the abbey on the steppe again with Wind-born disciples. Lạc Hà looked at Phù Dao Quán for its new seat and passed it over as the vassal's; she wants it given to her in writing.
people.secret: She has written to Phất Y Cốc and Cửu Cao Phái, the Wind sects of the Pivot's lands, offering the abbey's book in exchange for three Wind-born disciples. Selling a vassal's art to the Pivot's vassals without leave is a breach of the manor's oath to Lạc Hà.

people.name: Tần Thiên Lý
people.role: Herd master: the breeding herds, the remounts and the long ride
people.appearance: A bow-legged herder with a split lip from a mare's hoof and hands like saddle leather.
people.wants: The white bear gone from the north paddock before the spring foaling.
people.secret: Each autumn he has the oldest mares led down the south road to a knacker at Mã Độ and writes them into the book as winter deaths. Khấu Thanh Thảo (khau_thanh_thao), who keeps the herd books, has begun asking for the hides.

people.name: Khấu Thanh Thảo
people.role: Steward of the manor; keeps the herd books and the tribute ledger
people.appearance: A broad, quiet woman with ink on her cuffs and a reed pen behind her ear.
people.wants: Her father paid back at a festival, and her son free of the horse's long shadow.
people.secret: She is writing the manor's herds and debts into a second set of books in her son's hand, because she has seen her father's saddle restitched and has not asked why. Khấu Tiểu Câu (khau_tieu_cau) thinks it is practice.

people.name: Mạc Khiên Phong
people.role: Teaches the outer gate the bone art; the last junior of Phù Dao Quán
people.appearance: Shaven head, heavy shoulders, and a stance no push has ever shifted.

people.name: Dư Bôn Vân
people.role: The manor's race rider; won every race at the lord's festival in 1185
people.appearance: A wiry, grinning rider of thirty-five with a broken nose and a festival ribbon braided into her hair every day of the year.
people.wants: To race Lạc Hà's Geese Hall cadets on their own drill field and win on the third lap.
people.secret: She takes Kim Vạn Lý's bets through his grandson Kim Đắc Lộc (kim_dac_loc) and splits the winnings with the boy, so the old merchant is paying for her festival ribbons.

people.name: Kim Đắc Lộc
people.role: Outer disciple; grandson of the merchant Kim Vạn Lý
people.appearance: Silk riding coat, rained on twice, not yet creased where the saddle goes.

people.name: Tiết Bộ Vân
people.role: Outer disciple placed from Lạc Hà's outer gate as a rider
people.appearance: Rower's shoulders, freckles, and a burn-pink patch on his chin.

people.name: Mễ Địch Âm
people.role: Outer disciple; plays the herd home on the flute
people.appearance: Her reed pipe hangs on a red thread round her neck, and she hums through her nose.

people.name: Khấu Tiểu Câu
people.role: Inner disciple; the head's grandson
people.appearance: A bandaged hand, and the head's own slow stare.

people.name: Hứa Tịch Câu
people.role: Groom (tạp dịch); keeps the white bear
people.appearance: Smells of river ice; his shoulders sit uneven from thirty summers of two buckets.

people.name: Mẫn Bạch Câu
people.gloss: The white colt (time passing a crack)
people.role: Founder of Mục Vân Trang (740); wrote the Cloud-Herding Body Canon
people.cause: end of his years (500), on the long ride
people.appearance: Remembered as a tall herder with a cloud-white beard braided like a mane.

people.name: Khấu Thường Thanh
people.role: Herder of the manor; the head's father; shorted three stones in 901
people.cause: end of his years (120)
people.appearance: Remembered as a gaunt herder with a patient stoop and a mended felt cap.

people.name: Doanh Mộ Vũ
people.role: Dusk-line scribe; copies the lord's war orders for Kha Triêu Phi
people.appearance: A violet thread sewn into each hem, and a scribe's stoop on the left.

people.name: Ứng Triêu Hồng
people.role: Dawn-line scribe; Ninh Họa Vân's second at the talisman contest
people.appearance: Bark-beater's forearms, and a plain face that gives nothing away at a contest.

people.name: Đái Diệp Thư
people.role: Placed from Lạc Hà's Maple Hall this spring
people.appearance: Drying-floor sunburn to the elbows, a cowlick she wets flat each dawn, and she has never won a coin-toss.

people.name: Nhiêu Thạch Nhũ
people.role: Apprentice at the ink-house of the Jade Milk spring
people.appearance: Hands and neck blotched grey-brown from the ink; he studies the ground as he walks.

people.name: Mạc Tiểu Triện
people.role: Stall boy at Hạc Đinh Thị; stamps the cloud seal
people.appearance: A pencil stub behind each ear, and ink on his cuffs that he swears is from the seal.

people.name: Chúc Hiểu Hà
people.role: Inner disciple of the Dawn Hall; grinds the mistress's ink
people.appearance: Her head tilts toward any whisper, and she keeps her ink-pot lid pressed shut with one finger.

people.name: Thọ Ma Tử
people.role: Bark-beater at the paper mill
people.appearance: Bark-stripped palms; he whistles two notes of every tune and never the third.

people.name: Kha Triêu Phi
people.role: First elder; head of the dusk line and the hall's dealings with Lạc Hà
people.appearance: A handsome, grey-temple scholar in a dusk-violet robe a shade too close to Lạc Hà's, who quotes Vương Bột in every second sentence.
people.wants: To bring the hall back into its lord's favour, by Châu's war orders or by her fall, and to take the prize seal back from Lạc Hà's prodigy at the next contest.
people.secret: He knew what the fire talismans were for. The Boat Hall's master Lô Xướng Vãn told him in 1173, and Kha wrote the reed beds on the slip so that Châu would paint them. He keeps a record of the four war orders she has 'lost', copied by his scribe Doanh Mộ Vũ, and has told her that a fifth sends it to Lạc Hà's Vassal Hall; he would keep the hall for its lord after her.

people.name: Ninh Họa Vân
people.role: The hall's champion scribe; lost the prize seal to Tô Mộ Vân in 1190
people.appearance: A tight-mouthed woman of fifty with a callus on her brush finger the size of a pea.
people.wants: The prize seal back from Tô Mộ Vân at the next contest, won by her own hand and not by a rematch her mistress arranged.
people.secret: She pays Ứng Triêu Hồng (ung_trieu_hong) to sit by Tô Mộ Vân's stall at Hạc Đinh Thị and copy the girl's stroke in her sleeve notebook, so that Kha's promised rematch is won before it is fought. Hồng has begun to fill the notebook with what she admires.

people.name: Đới Huyền Nghiên
people.role: Ink-grinder at the Jade Milk spring; paints the hall's dark talismans at night, paid by the sheet
people.appearance: A pale, careful man who smells of wet stone and wears gloves to keep the ink off his skin, and lately to keep it in.
people.wants: Enough stones by the sheet to buy his mother a house below the karst, before he has to go up it.
people.secret: This year he answered Sào Ẩn Lan's letter at last, and asked whether there is room in the gorge for one more.

people.name: Văn Tang Chỉ
people.role: Paper master of the hall's mill at Tang Ma Thành
people.appearance: Dusted white with paper pulp; he sneezes in threes.

people.name: Trác Thư Lan
people.role: Keeps the hall's talisman stall at Hạc Đinh Thị
people.appearance: Six rings on her counting hand, and a laugh she turns on and off at the till.

people.name: Lý Khê Thư
people.role: The hall-mistress's youngest disciple; writes talismans on petals
people.appearance: A round-faced girl of sixteen with petal stains on her sleeves and a habit of humming while she paints.
people.wants: To be taught the dusk half by anyone at all, before Kha's fragments are lost with him.
people.secret: She writes dusk-ward petals at night from the fragments Doanh Mộ Vũ (doanh_mo_vu) lent her, and floats them in the brook to see whether they answer. One has begun to sink slowly instead of floating.

people.name: Tạ Quy Hồng
people.role: Outer disciple of the Tạ family of Phong Lâm
people.appearance: A good Tạ-family coat let out at the hem; he straightens his brush case whenever anyone looks at it.

people.name: Hàn Tiểu Chúc
people.role: Outer disciple who paints the stern-lamp talismans for Vãn Đăng's boats, in the dark ink
people.appearance: Salt-burnt, with grey hands he keeps tucked in his sleeves.
people.wants: Charms that keep Vãn Đăng's boats lit through the winter storms.
people.secret: The lamp charms on his village's boats are painted in the dark ink, and his own hands show what it does.

people.name: Phùng Lục Ý
people.role: Outer disciple placed from Lạc Hà's outer gate, 1196
people.appearance: An abacus bead on a string at her throat; she looks at a visitor's purse before the face.

people.name: Văn Tiểu Tang
people.role: Outer disciple at the paper mill
people.appearance: Rope-burn across both palms; he weaves a hemp bracelet as he walks, and stops to rest every twenty steps.

people.name: Nghiêm Họa Đống
people.role: Founder of Nam Phố Đường (880); the dawn half of the founders' art
people.cause: end of her years (500), at dawn, with a brush in her hand
people.appearance: Remembered in the hall's dawn scroll as a woman with a brush in each fist and the sky behind her head.

people.name: Ôn Châu Liêm
people.role: Co-founder of Nam Phố Đường; the dusk half of the founders' art
people.cause: end of his years (500) at Châu Liêm Trấn, before he had written the dusk half down
people.appearance: Remembered as a heavy, laughing man in a bay merchant's pearl-beaded cap, looking at the hills rather than the page.

people.name: Chung Thiết Tuyền
people.role: Master of the ice drills: holds the inner-gate test on the frozen ore tailings
people.appearance: A frost-split lip; he sits with his left foot a hand's width forward.

people.name: Dương Tầm Mạch
people.role: Seam-finder: walks the old mines of the mountain for iron the forge can use
people.appearance: Lamp-soot in the lines of her face, and a miner's squint she keeps even in daylight.

people.name: Hạ Tuyết Nhận
people.role: Inner disciple of the ice drills
people.appearance: A bruise shaped like a plum petal on one cheek, which she says she earned.

people.name: Doãn Mai Cốt
people.role: Outer disciple at the Plum Gate; tends the grave trees
people.appearance: Walks as if every step were on ice, with a pruning knife he never uses.

people.name: Trương Luyện Phong
people.role: Outer disciple of the forge; quenches the school's blades
people.appearance: Forearms speckled with scald scars from the quench, and a neck as thick as a post.

people.name: Hầu Thạch Nhãn
people.role: Outer disciple; carries the lamp for the seam-finder
people.appearance: A tin lamp-cap tied under his chin, and eyes slow to take the daylight.

people.name: Sở Băng Chi
people.role: Inner disciple of the first disciple
people.appearance: Braid hacked off at the nape, bare feet horn-hard.

people.name: Trác Thiết Cán
people.role: Smith of the iron town and the founder's sworn brother; forges every sword the school carries
people.appearance: A short, enormous miner's son in a striped tiger-hide coat, with forearms like the mountain's ore.
people.wants: To see Phó Ngạo Sương go to the sage with a sword worth the price.
people.secret: Lăng asked him this summer to recut 1125, the year on the tang of Phó's first sword, so that his dead daughter would stand first. He refused, and he is forging Phó a travelling sword from the last good iron in the seam.

people.name: Phó Ngạo Sương
people.role: The founder's first disciple and the school's best sword; the price the sword sage wrote for
people.appearance: A tall weaver's daughter with a plum-branch hairpin and a long white scar on her neck from a tiger's claw.
people.wants: A master past Trúc Cơ, which the school cannot give her.
people.secret: Every month she slips Phí Tầm Mai (phi_tam_mai) a short sword-form to send with her letters to Ninh Hàn Chi in the pines, so the girl turned away at the plum gate is learning the plum blade by post.

people.name: Mạc Chiết Chi
people.role: Keeper of the plum gate at the old seat above Hàn Mai
people.appearance: A plum twig behind one ear; he sniffs the sky before he speaks.

people.name: La Thiết Mai
people.role: The founder's last disciple
people.appearance: Goes barefoot in the snow, and shows off the frostbite blister on each heel.

people.name: Cung Hàn Nhạn
people.gloss: A wild goose in the cold
people.role: Inner disciple of Phó Ngạo Sương
people.appearance: Weaver's calluses across her right palm, and a pearl-grey sash she keeps spotless.

people.name: Dư Hổ Văn
people.role: Outer disciple and smith's boy; his family were miners of Thạch Khẩu
people.appearance: One shoulder higher than the other from the bellows, and ears that stick out through the soot.

people.name: Phí Tầm Mai
people.role: Outer disciple at the plum gate; the one Hàn Mai child of her generation with Metal
people.appearance: Wears a plum petal pressed flat in a locket; her step startles easily.

people.name: Ân Lãnh Phong
people.role: Inner disciple who duels the road wardens for practice
people.appearance: A fresh cut under one eye every month, a crooked grin, and he cannot stand still in the queue for his fines.

people.name: Lăng Nhược Mai
people.role: The founder's daughter; died to the tiger that emptied Thạch Khẩu Trấn
people.cause: killed by the spirit tiger of Thạch Khẩu on the mountain road, at 42
people.appearance: Remembered as a girl with her father's frost-burned cheeks and a short sword worn on her back like a school satchel.

people.name: Cổ Thiết Liệt
people.role: Leader of the second file; Đổng Kiên Lũy's man at the Lake Shore
people.appearance: Drills facing the sun, so he squints even indoors.

people.name: Đường Thủ Tuyến
people.role: Leads the file hired out to Lạc Hà's caravans
people.appearance: Wears a leather thumb-guard even at table.

people.name: Liêu Kiên Thạch
people.role: Placed from Lạc Hà's Geese Hall cadets this spring
people.appearance: His nose was set crooked by a cadet's elbow, and he tells everyone whose.

people.name: Thiều Vũ Hàng
people.role: One of Mục Tân Vũ's ten
people.appearance: Breathes so slowly that the drill-master counts her twice.

people.name: Bộ Thanh Lăng
people.role: One of the ten; keeps the founder's notes
people.appearance: Carries the drum case against his chest, the way other men carry a child.

people.name: Lương Bổ Khuyết
people.role: Weeds the burial rows; a descendant of the 803 file
people.appearance: Hums under her breath while she weeds, black crescents under every nail.

people.name: Sách Bất Ngôn
people.role: Levy girl who stood the line last spring
people.appearance: Walks light on her left foot, a toe bound in grey cloth.

people.name: Đổng Kiên Lũy
people.role: Elder and master of the spring levy on Lạc Nhạn Hồ; the gate's war voice
people.appearance: A huge farmer-built man with a drumstick through his belt and a laugh like a buffalo.
people.wants: To march the gate's files into a real war with his own drum at the front before he dies.
people.secret: Each levy day he drinks the gate's wine to the lees and tops the casks up from the lake; Cát Trì Cổ (cat_tri_co) beats the drum on his bad mornings and keeps a tally of the casks.

people.name: Mục Tân Vũ
people.role: The head's daughter and true disciple; the point of the first file
people.appearance: A tall, rangy woman with her father's square jaw, a grey feather in her braid and a point-sword worn high on the back.
people.wants: To lead a file into something real, and to prove that the founders' art works by walking it into the grey.
people.secret: She has promised Hình Lạc Nhạn a file of ten to walk into the miasma with her, breathing in turns the way the founders did. For two years she has drilled the ten at night on Hắc Thứu Đài from Thạch Liệt Hàng's notes, which Lương Thủ Hàng (luong_thu_hang) took out of the Roll of Files for her. Đổng Kiên Lũy knows and has said nothing.

people.name: Lương Thủ Hàng
people.role: Keeper of the Roll of Files and the burial rows
people.appearance: A thin, bald, plain-faced man with a writing board on a cord round his neck and the names of the dead under his fingernails.
people.wants: To see every gap in the burial rows filled with a name, and the Roll of Files made to carry them.
people.secret: In a second book hidden among the row markers he writes the real names the Roll refuses, and Lương Bổ Khuyết (luong_bo_khuyet), who asks each spring whose gap is whose, carries the ink up from the lake.

people.name: Cát Trì Cổ
people.role: Levy drummer on Lạc Nhạn Hồ
people.appearance: Carries a drumstick through her hair like a pin.

people.name: Ngô Bất Tán
people.role: The one survivor of the file lost on the Ngư Ca border in the Ferry War
people.appearance: A short, heavy man who walks with a stiff left leg and stands in file even when he is alone.
people.wants: To hear Tùng Đào's name said aloud at the gate once, and answered.
people.secret: On rest days he walks the Ngư Ca bank counting the raiders' ferries, and has asked Lô Tiểu Ca (lo_tieu_ca) to hold a boat for him one night this autumn.

people.name: La Nhất Hàng
people.role: Inner disciple; a levy boy who stood the line test
people.appearance: Rarely blinks, and stands wherever he is put until someone moves him.

people.name: Tôn Lạc Hồ
people.role: Outer disciple from the river ford
people.appearance: Her fingertips are wrinkled as if she lived in the river, which she nearly does.

people.name: Hạng Cô Nhạn
people.role: Outer disciple placed from Lạc Hà
people.appearance: Stoops as if listening down a well shaft.

people.name: Lam Tề Vũ
people.role: Inner disciple; one of Mục Tân Vũ's ten
people.appearance: Re-ties her braid without noticing, and shifts from foot to foot on every post.

people.name: Ninh Bắc Hàng
people.role: Inner disciple; Đổng Kiên Lũy's grandson and one of the ten
people.appearance: Smiles half a second after the others, as if checking it first.

people.name: Thạch Liệt Hàng
people.role: Founder of Nhạn Trận Môn (806); led a file of forty out of the grey at Chiết Kích Nguyên
people.cause: the grey in his lungs: the miasma of 803, at 280

people.name: Quản Tề Phong
people.role: Second head of Nhạn Trận Môn (1040-1142)
people.cause: failed breakthrough to Nguyên Anh, at 312

people.name: Kiều Thiết Dực
people.role: File leader hired to Lạc Hà in the Ferry War
people.cause: went down with the rope bridge on the Ngư Ca border in the Ferry War, at 74

people.name: Thi Đàm Tĩnh
people.role: Pool House painter; paints sitters from their reflections
people.appearance: Never looks a sitter in the eye, only at the reflection beside them.

people.name: Hàm Nhất Vân
people.role: Teaches the novices to grind ink at the abbey
people.appearance: Ink so deep in his right palm that it reads as a tattoo.

people.name: Giải Thanh Nghiễn
people.role: Placed from Lạc Hà, 1199
people.appearance: Silver-pine resin under his thumbnails, and a patient, slightly puzzled face.

people.name: Liêm Huân Hương
people.role: Burns agarwood soot at the ink house
people.appearance: Her hair smells of agarwood smoke, and the paintings seem to know her.

people.name: Doãn Trục Nhi
people.role: Carries scrolls for Đới Kim Trục
people.appearance: A gold-leaf ring too big for his finger, worn on his thumb.

people.name: Cù Tiểu Can
people.role: Cuts canes for the paper mill; Cù Lục Trúc's grandson
people.appearance: His fingers tap out brush strokes on his knee when he thinks no one sees.

people.name: Bào Ảnh Nhi
people.role: Pool House painter; Đinh Hồng Thụ's cousin
people.appearance: Sits as if the chair might be a trick.

people.name: Mễ Phù Vân
people.role: Elder and keeper of the Pool House at Đàm Ảnh Thành; runs the abbey's scroll trade
people.appearance: A handsome, well-fed man in a grey silk robe of better cut than the abbey allows, with a jade weight on his scroll-case.
people.wants: To sell the abbey's scrolls at the Counting House's own rate with himself named steward of the trade, and Diệp Tố Quyên out of its way.
people.secret: He has the servants' rice store locked and doles it out by the ladle at dusk to make up the tenth; when Ô Lão Nghiễn (o_lao_nghien) asked for the old measure, he was moved to the boat shed for the first frost.

people.name: Tần Đảo Ảnh
people.role: The head's last true disciple; paints the blind master's days at the Pool House and hunts for the sail in the pool
people.appearance: A thin woman with her sleeves tied back and a smear of blue ink along one jaw, who paints standing up and never sits until she is told to.
people.wants: To paint the sail Đoạn heard out of the pool, and to learn where her mother's face went.
people.secret: She has painted a reflection-double of herself, as her mother did, to sit in her place at the morning lesson while she sleeps off her nights at the pool. The double is getting better at sitting still than she is. Last month Mễ Phù Vân corrected its brushwork for an hour and did not notice.

people.name: Cù Lục Trúc
people.role: Steward of the abbey's paper mill at Lục Trúc Thôn and the canes of Vạn Can Lâm
people.appearance: A broad, stooped man with pulp to the elbows and a straw hat he wears indoors.
people.wants: One honest sheet-count year, and his grandson Cù Tiểu Can (cu_tieu_can) given a brush instead of the mill.
people.secret: He has ground a quarter of the abbey's finest silver-pine inkstick into the mill's size so his sheets take ink better than any other; Khương Trầm Mặc (khuong_tram_mac) counts her stock each month and blames her apprentices.

people.name: Khương Trầm Mặc
people.role: The abbey's ink-maker at Trầm Hương Trấn
people.appearance: Tucks her burnt fingertips into her sleeves whenever anyone looks.

people.name: Đới Kim Trục
people.role: Carries the abbey's door scrolls to the island markets; signs some of them
people.appearance: A quick young-looking man with gilt scroll-ends on his pack and a different hat in every market.
people.wants: A stall on the mainland with his own name on the sign, and no master above it.
people.secret: He is selling a copy of the abbey's island route book, the tides and customs days, to a Triều Âm smuggler, and Doãn Trục Nhi (doan_truc_nhi), who carries his scrolls, rides along and keeps the price.

people.name: Liễu Bạch Miêu
people.role: Inner disciple who draws only outlines
people.appearance: The outline of a brush is inked on the inside of her wrist.

people.name: Mẫn Tầm Vân
people.role: Outer disciple at the paper mill
people.appearance: His sleeves are always wet with pulp.

people.name: Đinh Hồng Thụ
people.role: Painter of the Pool House; Tần Đảo Ảnh's one friend there
people.appearance: Mangrove-root lines inked up both forearms, and her hems are always wet.

people.name: Nghiêm Thu Lộ
people.role: Outer disciple placed from Lạc Hà on Placement Day
people.appearance: Chews her fingernails to the quick, and counts brushes under her breath.

people.name: Ô Lão Nghiễn
people.role: Servant of the Pool House; grinds its ink and tells the blind master the colour of the clouds
people.appearance: Ink-black rims to his ears from leaning over the stone.

people.name: Kha Đạm Mặc
people.role: Founder of Nhàn Vân Quán (905); first to paint with qi in the ink
people.cause: walked into the pool of Đàm Ảnh Thành at dusk with his brush and was found drowned in the morning, at 250

people.name: Tần Vãn Kính
people.role: Painter of the Pool House; Tần Đảo Ảnh's mother
people.cause: qi deviation: her reflection-double kept her face, at 98

people.name: Ngạc Trì Hỏa
people.role: Levy captain on the palace road, Tang Điền to the Fire Court
people.appearance: The lobe of his left ear is gone, and he says a pirate's hook took it.

people.name: Sài Tĩnh Lan
people.role: Keeps the sitting rolls at the Lower Mouth
people.appearance: Coughs into her sleeve before she reads any name aloud.

people.name: Đồ Lãng Quyền
people.role: Wharf brawler in the road levy
people.appearance: Answers each question one behind, knuckles flat as river stones.

people.name: Khánh Mặc Thạch
people.role: Weighs the stone sent to the Fire Court
people.appearance: Lead filings rattle in her pocket whenever she walks.

people.name: Cát Xích Vân
people.role: Keeps watch at the Lower Mouth on moonless nights
people.appearance: Voice like gravel under a cart wheel.

people.name: Nhiếp Hôi Sinh
people.role: Ash-born boy who left the palace's outer gate for the hall
people.appearance: Packs and unpacks the same bundle each dusk, ash still grey in its folds.

people.name: Lãnh Nham Nương
people.role: Keeps the cooled lava where the hall's dead stand
people.appearance: She taps each grave marker with a tin ladle as she passes.

people.name: Tào Tẫn Kiên
people.role: First elder of Phần Vũ Đường; master of the sittings; negotiates the hall's lease with the palace
people.appearance: A compact, grey-cropped man with a burned-smooth face, who listens with his head tilted as if hearing the vent.
people.wants: To be head after Hùng, confirmed by the palace, with the vents still the hall's.
people.secret: In 1162 the palace treasurer Vưu Cẩm Thư (vuu_cam_thu) promised him, privately, that the palace would back his succession over the girl if he saw her sent. He did. Now he is settling her rent for the hall. His draft gave the palace the cooled lava where the outer gate sits and the dead stand, and names the leaseholder as the head 'whom its lord confirms'; sealed, it makes the palace's word the hall's succession. Hùng struck the lava out and added a line about the canon given with the banner in 1020, and Tào carries it up without knowing what it means.

people.name: Trang Hôi Y
people.role: Keeper of the Lower Mouth, the hall's sitting places on the vent's flank below the palace's Nest
people.appearance: A grey-dusted woman who smells of sulphur and keeps a knotted cord with one knot for every disciple now in the vent.
people.wants: Every knot kept tied for one more year, and one sitter of each year's class past the sixth layer.
people.secret: She is writing a second roll in her own hand of every sitter who burned in the vent since 1162, with the cause, to put in the Hall of Spoils' book as proof that the palace's rent counts the hall's dead as structures. Three of the names are men Tào Tẫn Kiên (tao_tan_kien) sent in, and she has not told him she is writing it.

people.name: Đới Liệt Cương
people.role: Captain of the hall's levy; guards the road between Tang Điền and the Fire Court
people.appearance: A loud silk-trader's son with a broken nose who wears the hall's red sash over a merchant's coat.
people.wants: The levy off the palace road, and one duel on the Fire Court's stair.
people.secret: He is forging the tribute stubs to show his levy at half strength, so the envoy Bình Viễn Khách (binh_vien_khach) counts fewer days, and his silk-trader father in Tang Điền ties the forged bundles. The envoy's own clerk has begun to count the road posts.

people.name: Hác Đan Thạch
people.role: Steward of the hall: red stone and charcoal for the Fire Court, and the tribute ledger
people.appearance: His eyebrows are white with stone dust in every season.

people.name: Bao Viêm Nương
people.role: Hùng Diễm Nhi's milk sister; holds the cord for her at the Lower Mouth at the dark of the moon
people.appearance: Shows the milk-white cord scar across her left palm to anyone who doubts her.

people.name: Long Chước Sinh
people.role: Inner disciple of the levy
people.appearance: A chin scar he says a palace fan gave him; a mulberry ladder did.

people.name: Kinh Tiểu Hỏa
people.role: Outer disciple on the cooled lava
people.appearance: Sits down on every landing to catch his breath, in a blue caravan shirt a size too large.

people.name: Nguy Hồng Tảo
people.role: Outer disciple from Ngũ Thải Thành, the head's own city
people.appearance: A front tooth chipped on a harbour bollard, shown when she grins.

people.name: Thượng Quy Vũ
people.role: Inner disciple; an ash-born boy who left the palace's outer gate for the vents
people.appearance: Will not wash the palace soot from his fingertips, and nobody has asked why.

people.name: Bốc Thán
people.role: Servant charcoal burner
people.appearance: His snore carries across the charcoal pit.

people.name: Kê Thủ Liệt
people.role: Hùng Phần Vũ's first disciple; the first who died in the vents
people.cause: died in the vent at the hall's first sitting (A310)

people.name: Tuân Hà Y
people.role: Hùng Phần Vũ's Dao partner; mother of Hùng Diễm Nhi
people.cause: died in the vent's mouth attempting the Red Wall Rebirth (N-phan_vu-04)

people.name: Tiết Hoành Sa
people.role: Road sword, Khúc Liệt Dương's second on the western roads
people.appearance: Road dust in the creases of his face, and an unlit pipe he chews rather than smokes.

people.name: Thôi Ấn Thư
people.role: Paymaster of the contract house
people.appearance: A small iron abacus at her belt, and a smile she brings out only to count.

people.name: Liêu Vọng Phong
people.role: Outer disciple from the plateau mine, who came with Lộ Khinh Trần
people.appearance: A soot thumbprint on his sleeve from the lamp; he stares at the ceiling whenever wind rattles a door.

people.name: Hoắc Ngọ Lộ
people.role: Outer disciple from the hot steppe, one contract sealed
people.appearance: Two tight braids, and red dust on her boots.

people.name: Âu Dương Tuyền
people.role: Inner disciple at Can Tương Khoáng, who carries the ore to Thối Tinh Môn
people.appearance: Ore dust ground into his knuckles, a polishing rag in his pocket that is not his, and he needs a joke explained twice.

people.name: Mạnh Thư Cầm
people.role: Inner disciple of the contract house, who presses the Seal
people.appearance: The Seal's brass stud on a cord, and not a hair out of place.

people.name: Yên Lạc Tụ
people.role: Outer disciple who sweeps the hall of sleeves
people.appearance: Broom worn to a stump; her eyes go to every visitor's sleeve.

people.name: Lam Khế Ngôn
people.gloss: A word given in a contract
people.role: Keeper of the contracts: she decides where the valley's swords are hired
people.appearance: A neat woman in a grey coat with ink on two fingers, who reads a client's hands before their letter.
people.wants: To keep the Tower's triple fee and the Pivot's standing fee both coming in, which means the war writ buried every spring, and to hire the valley's swords to anyone who pays, not only to the Pivot's friends.
people.secret: Since 1190 she has hired a company, under the name of a camel train of Đà Đội, to guard Thính Vũ Lâu's iron on the southern road, and she sealed it without the Pivot line: the only valley contract that would not end if the Pivot called. Nine of the company have died. She books each death on the Đà Đội camel road, has Giang Bích Sa write the train's stages and its dead into the road book and pays her a higher copying fee at every renewal, and pays Thôi Ấn Thư more for her silence each time a sleeve comes home.

people.name: Khúc Liệt Dương
people.role: Swordswoman back from twenty years on the caravan roads
people.appearance: Burnt dark by the road, with a scar that pulls one corner of her mouth into a smile she does not mean.
people.wants: To ride south and see for herself that the company's contract is kept, and a first hire for Viên Tịch Chiếu.
people.secret: She is collecting the names of the nine southern dead from the drivers' talk at the valley mouth, over the wine Yên Lạc Tụ (yen_lac_tu) buys, and has seven in a list in her saddle bag.

people.name: Âu Dương Kiên
people.role: Warden of Can Tương Khoáng, the ore the valley's swords are made of
people.appearance: A square, slow-spoken miner with a sword he uses mostly to point at ore.
people.wants: Hứa Ngân Sơn out of the shaft before the roof goes, and his son wed to a polisher.
people.secret: He keeps back one sack in twenty from the Thối Tinh Môn cart, in a hollow he cut in the old shaft, and tests it with a pestle. The lump he rang this spring sang a clear note, which he has told no one. His son Âu Dương Tuyền (au_duong_tuyen), who loads the carts, has noticed the loads run light.

people.name: Kiều Tĩnh Sơn
people.role: Master of the outer gate and its dry-road primer
people.appearance: Chalk to the elbows of his robe, and a voice that never rises.

people.name: Lộ Khinh Trần
people.role: Inner disciple with a breath of Wind, born at the windy mine on the plateau
people.appearance: A red crust under one nostril; he turns his head toward every draught.

people.name: Viên Tịch Chiếu
people.role: Inner disciple from the sand-eye hot spring
people.appearance: A scabbard that has never been scuffed, and a half-packed kit under her bed.

people.name: Giang Bích Sa
people.role: Outer disciple from the camel-train village
people.appearance: Ink in the grain of her nails, and a cloth for every blot.

people.name: Cát Dã Bình
people.role: Outer disciple from the dog-herding village
people.appearance: Two rough-coated dogs at his heels, sunburnt to the neck.

people.name: Hứa Ngân Sơn
people.role: Outer disciple at Can Tương Khoáng
people.appearance: Miner's cough, a lamp scar on his forehead; in any gallery the one lamp that goes out is his.

people.name: Quách Lĩnh Thù
