people.gloss: Takes the fee (and nothing past it)
people.role: Founder of Phất Y Cốc (560, A225); a Wind-rooted hired sword who cut the valley's saying on its lintel
people.cause: walked out of the valley in 790 and was never seen there again (the valley counts his death from that day); seen off from Tống Khách Thị in 900 (A138) and went to die alone, age 430
people.appearance: Remembered as a lean swordsman of the grass with a hawk's pinion in his hair, said never to have been seen hurrying.

people.name: Liễu Hành Vân
people.role: Second head of Phất Y Cốc (790-1090), who turned a hermit's valley into a house of hired swords
people.cause: a failed breakthrough to Nguyên Anh at 450, the year she handed the valley to Thang Vô Tạ
people.appearance: Remembered as a short, brisk woman with a seal cord round her neck and a ledger under her arm.

people.name: Chúc Hiểu Nghi
people.gloss: A dawn wish; the phoenix's stately coming
people.role: The head's youngest disciple; the only Light root in the palace
people.appearance: A slight young woman with a market girl's quick eyes, who holds her head tilted as if listening for something behind the room.
people.wants: To find her brother, and to learn why the head chose her.
people.secret: She has worked out that the Tiêu Thiều Quản is Light, that she is the palace's only Light, and that the tune in the head's breathing is the Shao. She has told no one, not even Bạc Địch Thanh.

people.name: Du Diễm Ca
people.role: The grand elder's last disciple; a fan duelist
people.appearance: Long-limbed and restless, with chrysanthemums painted on his fan and ink on his cuffs from poems he does not show anyone.
people.wants: To be the one who carries the Red Plum to Băng Tâm, and to meet Hạ Lăng Hàn with an open hand rather than a closed fan.
people.secret: Four letters each way since 1196, signed Cúc (Chrysanthemum). In the last one he told her where in the Hall of Spoils the sword hangs.

people.name: Sử Niệm Huỳnh
people.gloss: She remembers the glimmer (her mother's name)
people.role: Sử Hoành Dực's daughter; second at the vein fort of Đan Sơn Mạch
people.appearance: Her father's build and her mother's calm, with her mother's old hairpin worn every day.
people.wants: Her father out of the war, and a peace letter written in her own hand.
people.secret: She is writing to Cố Dạ Lan (co_da_lan), who killed her mother, asking to meet under a white banner on the pass. She has burned two drafts and sent none.

people.name: Mao Khải Đán
people.role: Steward of the outer gate; plays the dawn flute and holds the Feather Kindling
people.appearance: A bent, smiling old man with a stonemason's hands and a bamboo flute worn smooth at the holes.
people.wants: Kha Thanh Miêu kept out of the Wutong Court, and a flute-player to follow him.
people.secret: He passes or fails each child at the Feather Kindling by the first note of the dawn flute: a flat note fails. He has never written the rule down, and Minh Tảo Hà (minh_tao_ha) has begun to play the flat note on purpose.

people.name: An Thúy Vũ
people.role: Bird keeper of the Wutong Court
people.appearance: A quiet woman in green with a blue-backed spirit bird that never leaves her collar.
people.wants: Vu Ngô Đồng to take his palms off the tree for one night.
people.secret: She is raising a red-crested chick on the great wutong's fallen seed, to see whether a bird can carry the tree's life. It is the seed Kế Chu Sa (ke_chu_sa) cannot brew without.

people.name: Thư Ngạn Hành
people.role: Envoy of the Hall of Trust to the northern sects
people.appearance: A long, courteous man with a port-city accent and the cleanest hand in the palace.
people.wants: A letter from Băng Tâm that names Cô Thành, in someone's hand.
people.secret: He reads every Hall of Trust letter aloud to Ngụy Thanh Hàn (nguy_thanh_han) over wine before delivering it, and Ngụy pays in northern pepper.

people.name: Đằng Phi Diễm
people.role: The inner gate's best fan; holds the top step of the stair
people.appearance: Tall, red-haired from the vent and unsmiling, with not one burn on her sleeves.
people.wants: Kết Đan before Du Diễm Ca.
people.secret: She practises the Feather Fan at night against a post of black stone from the Ash Seat's lip, which is forbidden, and her sleeves have begun to scorch. Vi Tịch Hôi (vi_tich_hoi) has seen and says nothing.

people.name: Hùng Diễm Nhi
people.role: Hùng Phần Vũ's daughter, the palace's ward since she asked to go at twelve; serves at the Nest on the vent's lip
people.appearance: Thick-armed and short-haired, with the burn-mottled skin of the vents under her inner-gate red.
people.wants: Her father's hall free, and the chair of it her own.
people.secret: She feeds her cousin Hùng Liệt Nha (hung_liet_nha) small true things so he keeps writing Tào Tẫn Kiên that she trusts him, and writes the real ones to Trang Hôi Y (trang_hoi_y) down the hundred paces.

people.name: Tang Tục Lạc
people.role: Tang Kế Ti's son; carries silk between the Nest and Chức Hà Các
people.appearance: A good-looking, easy man who always has a fire-silk scarf that is not quite the palace's colour.
people.wants: Thân Vân Cẩm's yes, and a trade that is his own.
people.secret: He practises the Nest's splice on a spare reel in the stable at night to prove to his mother Tang Kế Ti (tang_ke_ti) he can keep the array, and has ruined two reels.

people.name: Bạc Địch Thanh
people.role: Flautist of the Hall of Rites
people.appearance: Tilts his head whenever a door creaks, as if it were a note.

people.name: Thì Văn Bính
people.role: Clerk of the Hall of Virtue
people.appearance: Ink to the second knuckle of both hands.

people.name: Kiều Đan Lô
people.role: Alchemist's apprentice at Chu Sa Tuyền
people.appearance: Yellow-stained fingertips from cassia and turmeric.

people.name: Can Hải Trì
people.role: First mate of the palace fleet
people.appearance: Rubs the rope scar on his wrist whenever a knot slips.

people.name: Ô Trầm Châu
people.role: The fleet's diver
people.appearance: Says the broken nose and heavy brows are his father's, and no one dares ask.

people.name: Mông Chu Tiêu
people.role: Lieutenant of the vein fort at Đan Sơn Mạch
people.appearance: Shifts from post to post every hour, with a glove on one hand only and the other forearm flour-pale.

people.name: Ngạc Thiểm Hồng
people.role: The vein fort's clerk at the Fire Court; pays for the Tower's thunder with the fort's watch rota
people.appearance: His hair lifts before rain, a full hour before the sky agrees.

people.name: Thương Tẫn Quy
people.role: Steward of funerals: carries the ashes to Quy Vũ Lĩnh
people.appearance: Walks slowly, as if the urns on her back were still full.

people.name: Ổ Linh Tước
people.role: Second bird keeper of the Wutong Court
people.appearance: Strokes the red-crested skin purse at his belt when he lies.

people.name: Cảnh Vũ Ca
people.role: Inner-gate fan duelist
people.appearance: Smiles with her mouth closed over a stained, chipped tooth.

people.name: Từ Cam Tuyền
people.role: Healer of the Hall of Benevolence at Hoàng Vân Thành
people.appearance: Smells of lavender before she is seen.

people.name: Cốc Thu Thành
people.role: Granary steward of Hoàng Vân Thành
people.appearance: Chalk tallies run down one sleeve, which he reads back to himself.

people.name: Bối Tàng Ngôn
people.role: Keeper of the Hall of Spoils' inventory
people.appearance: Pale from seventy years in the dim hall, with a cloth always in his fist.

people.name: Chiêm Lợi Châu
people.role: The Hall of Trust's factor at Tang Điền's silk market
people.appearance: A silk cuff pulled over a missing finger, rings on the rest.

people.name: Đái Liệt Dương
people.role: Adjutant of the Hall of Righteousness
people.appearance: Black armband worn to rags, never taken off.

people.name: Vi Tịch Hôi
people.role: Attendant of the Ash Seat at the Nest
people.appearance: One eyebrow burnt away by the Ash Seat's fumes and never regrown.

people.name: Trâu Kết Tuyến
people.role: Array apprentice of the Nest
people.appearance: Silk-thread cuts across her fingertips, fine as hairs.

people.name: Miêu Trúc Sinh
people.role: The outer disciple who took seventy years to pass the Feather Kindling
people.appearance: Smiles a beat after the joke, carefully, as if checking it is safe.

people.name: Nhậm Cương Thủ
people.role: Captain of the Wutong Court's guard
people.appearance: The plum scar across his nose goes white in the cold.

people.name: Bình Viễn Khách
people.role: Envoy to the palace's vassals
people.appearance: A sash of wine-red thread, re-tied in each host's colour on arrival.

people.name: Kha Thanh Miêu
people.role: An outer disciple of pure Wood whom the great wutong answers
people.appearance: A round-faced girl of eighteen with green under her fingernails, who talks to the potted wutong saplings in the outer court.
people.wants: To not be the tree's food.
people.secret: She goes to the great wutong at night and asks it questions, and it answers; she has begun answering back, telling it the court's news. An Thúy Vũ (an_thuy_vu) has seen her footprints in the dew.

people.name: Ma Tiểu Hòa
people.role: Outer disciple from the rice plain
people.appearance: Rice-straw hat pushed back, whatever the weather.

people.name: Vũ Thạch Đẩu
people.role: Outer disciple from the stonemasons' village
people.appearance: Forge-burn freckles up one arm.

people.name: Địch Tiểu Chước
people.role: Inner disciple, ash-born
people.appearance: His mentor's tilt of the head, copied a half-inch too far.

people.name: Minh Tảo Hà
people.role: Apprentice to the dawn flute
people.appearance: Thin lips held in a flute-embouchure even when she is not playing.

people.name: Thành Dã Cúc
people.role: This generation's child from Cúc Viên Thôn
people.appearance: Wears a fresh chrysanthemum behind one ear every day.

people.name: Trạm Ba Thanh
people.role: Deck hand of the palace fleet (outer gate)
people.appearance: Sun-bleached eyebrows, white against a brown face.

people.name: Phục Lâm Sinh
people.role: Outer disciple, a jungle hunter's son
people.appearance: A sleeve that moves on its own, with a small snout at the cuff.

people.name: Ngũ Lạp Mai
people.role: Outer disciple from the plum village
people.appearance: Feather-down clings to her hair; she turns her head away when a bird is carried past.

people.name: Bốc Thự Dao
people.role: Copyist of the Hall of Rites (outer gate)
people.appearance: Mismatched sleeves, one ink-dark and one white.

people.name: Hòa Thiện Khê
people.role: Granary hand at Hoàng Vân Thành
people.appearance: Whistles through the gap in his teeth when he counts sacks.

people.name: Nguy Bạch Thạch
people.role: Outer disciple of the Wutong Court, ridge-born
people.appearance: Taps his knuckles on whatever is nearest.

people.name: Điêu Ngọc Xuyến
people.role: Outer disciple from Ngũ Thải Thành
people.appearance: A magistrate's daughter's lacquered nails, chipped only on the thumb.

people.name: Bào Lạc Hải
people.role: Cook of the Fire Court's kitchens (servant)
people.appearance: Wears the wooden spoon like a sword.

people.name: Trần Tước Nhi
people.role: Aviary girl of the Wutong Court
people.appearance: Names every feather quill in her braid, and has buried six of the chicks she named.

people.name: Hoàng Ánh Sa
people.role: Runner of the vein fort (outer gate)
people.appearance: Sits on the ridge stones to breathe between posts, cinnabar crescents under every nail.

people.name: Bì Thuần
people.role: Old sweeper of the bird courts (servant)
people.appearance: Bent nearly double over a broom, with a leaf forever stuck in his collar.

people.name: Lương Diệp Nhi
people.role: Outer disciple from the longan village
people.appearance: Pushes her jaw forward like a ram before she argues.

people.name: Ứng Liệt Tâm
people.role: Inner disciple, ash-born
people.appearance: A fire-scar fan across the back of his left hand, shown on purpose.

people.name: Dư Tân Hỏa
people.role: Errand boy of the Nest
people.appearance: New boots a size too good for a charcoal carrier.

people.name: Đổng Lục Y
people.role: Flute-cutter of the Hall of Rites
people.appearance: Cuts flutes for the whole Hall and has never been heard to play one.

people.name: Thịnh Phong Đăng
people.role: Letter runner of the Hall of Trust (outer gate)
people.appearance: Sleeps on his feet, leaning on a lantern pole.

people.name: Xa Ngư Nương
people.role: Net crew of the palace fleet
people.appearance: One ear swollen shut by sea water, a long time ago.

people.name: Lưu Hỏa Nha
people.role: New outer disciple
people.appearance: Giggles whenever something simmers.

people.name: Nhan Quy Vũ
people.role: Keeper of the red feathers of the dead at the Wutong Court (Hall of Rites)
people.appearance: Sews a red feather into her hem for every soul she keeps.

people.name: Dương Hộ Thụ
people.role: Tender of the great wutong at the Wutong Court
people.appearance: A counting-string round his wrist, knotted to a leaf-count he will not say.

people.name: Khang Kiên Dực
people.role: Holds the gate of the Wutong Court under Nhậm Cương Thủ
people.appearance: The wine-flush climbs from his collar whenever the head is mentioned.

people.name: Sầm Liệt Dực
people.role: Ash-born fan duelist of the Hall of Righteousness
people.appearance: Two stair-challenge burns, one on each shoulder, which he calls medals.

people.name: Cù Chấn Uy
people.role: Veteran of the Cinnabar Vein War in the Hall of Righteousness
people.appearance: Grey in his beard at forty, and a dead woman's fan-tassel sewn to his sleeve.

people.name: Mã Phá Lãng
people.role: Helmsman of the palace fleet's flagship
people.appearance: The ear notched by a pirate's grapple turns to every shout.

people.name: Hách Đan Tâm
people.role: Night watch of the vein fort at Đan Sơn Mạch
people.appearance: A thunder-charm in her left ear, tilted always toward the ridge.

people.name: Khổng Tế Dân
people.role: Rides the famine roads with the granary carts of the Hall of Benevolence
people.appearance: Blushes to the neck at every thank-you.

people.name: Lữ Chu Hống
people.role: Grinds cinnabar at the furnace on Chu Sa Tuyền
people.appearance: Cinnabar-red dust in the part of her hair.

people.name: Mẫn Tín Văn
people.role: Counts the vassals' tribute for the Hall of Trust
people.appearance: Two tally-sticks behind his ears, one for coin and one for rice.

people.name: Sài Tẫn Nhiên
people.role: Tends the Ash Seat's coals at the Nest between breakthroughs
people.appearance: Looks at the sky before speaking, and says nothing if it is cloudy.

people.name: Tuân Lễ Chính
people.role: Keeps the audience roll of the Hall of Virtue
people.appearance: Gold thread at his cuff, never the same colour twice.

people.name: Hàn Ngọc Tiêu
people.role: Tunes the flutes sold at Thiều Âm Thị
people.appearance: Plays a note in her head before she answers.

people.name: Liêu Nhung Hỏa
people.role: Gathers the vent birds' down for the Feather Kindling
people.appearance: Knits bracelets of chrysanthemum fluff and gives them away.

people.name: Hoàn Vọng Lĩnh
people.role: Rides the western march with the Wutong Court's hawks
people.appearance: A spyglass through his belt like a dagger.

people.name: Lạc Tước Ca
people.role: Feeds the spirit birds of the Wutong Court
people.appearance: A whistle always curled in her cheek, so that she lisps.

people.name: Đỗ Thanh Duẩn
people.role: Cuts the bamboo shoots that feed the Wutong Court
people.appearance: Eight small scorch-lines on the left forearm, one per sitting.

people.name: Ông Trúc Thanh
people.role: Plays the second part of the dawn flute at the Wutong Court
people.appearance: His eyes shut when he blows.

people.name: Trì Quy Lộ
people.role: Carries the urns up the long road to Quy Vũ Lĩnh
people.appearance: A string of small urn-stoppers at his throat, clicking when he nods.

people.name: Ngưu Đại Hữu
people.role: Water carrier (tạp dịch) of the Wutong Court's kitchens
people.appearance: Walks with the stoop of a yoke he put down years ago.

people.name: Khương Lĩnh Mai
people.role: Sword in the Wutong Court's guard, admitted on Wood
people.appearance: Goes grey and silent when the Feather Kindling is named, and leaves the room.

people.name: Chu Nhiên Tâm
people.role: Ash-born inner disciple of the fan forms
people.appearance: Rolls her sleeves to hide a worn cuff under a too-bright tassel.

people.name: Tôn Xích Minh
people.role: Runner of the Hall of Righteousness
people.appearance: Mouth half open, ready for the next word.

people.name: Quách Tiểu Đào
people.role: New outer disciple from Tang Âm Thôn
people.appearance: Two burnt feather-ends in her hair, kept as charms.

people.name: Lương Đạo Tuệ
people.role: Granary cart hand of the Hall of Benevolence
people.appearance: Straw in his hair, even at the table.

people.name: Lam Ánh Hồng
people.role: Copies petitions in the Hall of Virtue
people.appearance: Ink-blue lips from licking her pen.

people.name: Giang Triều Sinh
people.role: Deck hand of the palace fleet
people.appearance: Walks with a sailor's roll even on dry land.

people.name: Hồ Ngân Lân
people.role: Diver of the palace fleet
people.appearance: Holds a drowned-bell pendant in her teeth when she dives.

people.name: Phàn Thính Đào
people.role: The admiral's grandson, put to the oars
people.appearance: Chin held high over raw oar-blisters.

people.name: Võ Chu Thạch
people.role: Cinnabar miner's son at the vein fort
people.appearance: Rock-grey skin, and he sleeps with one hand on the wall.

people.name: Diệp Đan Sa
people.role: Signal girl of the vein fort
people.appearance: Banner dye on her fingertips, red on one hand and black on the other.

people.name: Trần Bách Thảo
people.role: Herb girl for the healers of Hoàng Vân Thành
people.appearance: Her nose wrinkles at every smell, even good ones.

people.name: Đinh Tích Cốc
people.role: Granary hand at Hoàng Vân Thành for fifty years
people.appearance: Knocks on every wall he passes, listening.

people.name: Liêm Tố Cầm
people.role: Strings the qin sold at Thiều Âm Thị
people.appearance: Silk-string grooves in her fingertips, one for each string.

people.name: Lục Minh Sanh
people.role: Shop boy of the music market
people.appearance: Flute-reeds tucked behind each ear.

people.name: Tiền Hỏa Hậu
people.role: Watches the furnace fire through the night at Chu Sa Tuyền
people.appearance: Eyelids red from the furnace glare.

people.name: Khúc Quế Diệp
people.role: Carries herbs up to the furnace
people.appearance: Smells of cassia before she arrives.

people.name: Thái Hỏa Linh
people.role: Rings the bell at the Ash Seat
people.appearance: A bronze bell at her wrist, silenced by a pinch of cloth.

people.name: Lưu Tứ Nương
people.role: Cook (tạp dịch) of the Fire Court's kitchens
people.appearance: A ladle burn up the back of one hand, which she shows off like a medal.

people.name: Hùng Liệt Nha
people.role: Hùng Diễm Nhi's cousin at the Fire Court; writes Tào Tẫn Kiên what she does
people.appearance: Smiles a beat late, after he has checked who is watching.

people.name: Vương Thanh Đằng
people.role: Miêu Trúc Sinh's first pupil
people.appearance: Silver-fine hair already at twenty-six, tied in a bamboo ring.

people.name: Bùi Thanh Hà
people.role: Outer disciple of the Hall of Rites at the Wutong Court
people.appearance: Whistles through the gap between her front teeth.

people.name: Ân Tri Lễ
people.role: Rides with the palace's envoy to the vassals
people.appearance: Bows a hand's width deeper than his rank requires.

people.name: Cổ Hồng Phiến
people.role: Practises the fan forms before dawn on the Fire Court's stair
people.appearance: A cheek scar from a fan-edge, traced when she lies.

people.name: Văn Trúc Y
people.role: Wood girl of the Wutong Court, Kha Thanh Miêu's bunk-mate
people.appearance: Pauses under the great tree and looks up, every time.

people.name: Nhiếp Tẫn Sa
people.role: Grand elder; keeper of the Nest and the Ash Seat at Chúc Dung Khẩu
people.appearance: Tall and stooped, with the white crust of old salt burns up both forearms; he wears a vent attendant's plain hemp and goes barefoot on the hot rock.
people.wants: To carry the Red Plum to Phó Ám Hương himself, tell him who burned his father, and let Phó decide what follows.
people.secret: The rider he burned out of the saddle at Cô Thành in 724 was Phó Thanh Mai. He still carries the red-ink note folded in his sleeve.

people.name: Sử Hoành Dực
people.gloss: Wings spread wide (the phoenix's wing-mark is righteousness)
people.role: War elder; master of the Hall of Righteousness (Nghĩa Đường)
people.appearance: Broad and grey-bearded, with a lightning scar like a fern down his left side and one fan of a pair always at his belt.
people.wants: Cố Dạ Lan dead and the right wing back beside the left; failing that, war with Thính Vũ while he can still lead it.
people.secret: In council in 1090 he spoke for keeping Băng Tâm's red sword hidden. He knows the palace holds it the way the Tower holds his wife's fan, and cannot stand to hear it said.

people.name: Tang Kế Ti
people.gloss: Mulberry; she who carries on the silk
people.role: Keeper of the Nest Array, the fire-silk lattice that carries the vent's fire into the seat
people.appearance: A thin woman with burn-calloused fingertips and a reel of grey thread always turning in one hand.
people.wants: To mend the Nest Array before it fails, without being the keeper who broke the founder's vow; and Chức Hà's silk bound to the Nest by her son's marriage, at the palace's price, for sixty years.
people.secret: Last winter, alone at night, she reeled one hank of new fire-silk at the vent's mouth. It holds. She has told no one, and she means to reel more. When her son asked Thân Vân Cẩm to marry him, she named the dowry: all the pavilion's silk to the Nest at the palace's set price for sixty years. With every bolt of Chức Hà's in her splices, any strand that holds can be written down as theirs.

people.name: Liên Thiều Nghi
people.gloss: The Shao, and the phoenix's stately coming (Thư Kinh)
people.role: Master of the Hall of Rites (Lễ Đường) at the Wutong Court: music, funerals, the score archive
people.appearance: A long-faced woman with a musician's flat fingertips and a habit of tapping out a beat on whatever is in front of her.
people.wants: The Shao restored whole and played openly as the palace's rite music, and the Vân Môn Khánh found to prove her reading.
people.secret: She suspects the head holds the Tiêu Thiều Quản: one night in 1154 she heard pipes through the ridge palace's walls playing a movement her score does not have.

people.name: Trình Hi Quang
people.role: The head's chief disciple; runs the Hall of Virtue (Đức Điện) for her
people.appearance: Neat, soft-spoken and handsome, with ink on his right hand and a go stone he turns over in his left.
people.wants: A peace with Thính Vũ signed in his hand, with the right wing fan returned in the same treaty.
people.secret: He has guessed that Quan Vũ Thanh never gave the terms to her head. He has not told his master, because she would send them by another road; he means to carry the next offer himself, with a clause he added on his own: the Tower returns the right wing fan.

people.name: Điền Phong Niên
people.role: Master of the Hall of Benevolence (Nhân Đường): granaries, healers, the outer gate's rice
people.appearance: A short, sun-browned man who still rolls his trousers to the knee and walks the paddies before every council.
people.wants: Granaries full to the next famine.
people.secret: He keeps a sealed granary of four hundred sacks off the books at Hoàng Vân Thành for a famine the palace says will not come. Cốc Thu Thành (coc_thu_thanh) is the only other who knows.

people.name: Kế Chu Sa
people.role: The palace's alchemist, at the furnace on Chu Sa Tuyền
people.appearance: A sharp-chinned woman whose lips are stained red from tasting cinnabar, with a fever flush she never loses.
people.wants: Vu Ngô Đồng's Nguyên Anh pill, brewed without the dying tree.
people.secret: She is trying a substitute for the pill on the outer gate's tea servants, a thimble at a time, and logs their headaches in her book. Kiều Đan Lô (kieu_dan_lo) has noticed the servants' cups.

people.name: Vưu Cẩm Thư
people.role: Master of the Hall of Trust (Tín Đường): treasury, the Hall of Spoils, tribute and envoys
people.appearance: A handsome, heavy-lidded woman in brocade the colour of old embers, who carries the Hall of Spoils' three keys on a red cord.
people.wants: The Nest paid for without a rent on the vents.
people.secret: She keeps a private book pricing everything in the Hall of Spoils, the unnamed red sword included, in case the palace must sell to pay for the Nest. Bối Tàng Ngôn (boi_tang_ngon) dusts the sword and does not know.

people.name: Phàn Vọng Hải
people.role: Admiral of the palace fleet at Thạch Cơ Thành (Hall of Righteousness)
people.appearance: Big-shouldered and salt-cracked, with a diver's slow breath and a laugh you hear before you see the ship.
people.wants: A coast with no unlit sails, and the pirate's sabre in his own hands.
people.secret: He pays Ô Trầm Châu (o_tram_chau) to bring up the lost sabre for himself and not for the palace, and means to keep it if it is found.

people.name: Hách Chu Lăng
people.role: Warden of Đan Sơn Mạch, the cinnabar vein on the Pivot's border
people.appearance: A square, red-handed woman with a thunder burn across her jaw and cinnabar dust in every seam of her armour.
people.wants: Cố Dạ Lan before the vein's snow.
people.secret: She sends Mông Chu Tiêu (mong_chu_tieu) a dozen men a month under false names, off the palace's muster, to hold the vein wall if the palace stops paying.

people.name: Chử Trì Âm
people.role: Guest elder: a Thính Vũ swordsman taken in 1156 who stayed; writes to Quan Vũ Thanh for the head's disciple
people.appearance: A grey, narrow man who sits with his back to walls and wears the Tower's blue under a guest's plain robe.
people.wants: Word that someone at the Tower reads his letters.
people.secret: He makes a small clay figure of Kỷ Vãn Tình (ky_van_tinh) each night and sets it in his window facing the pass, and has filled a shelf.

people.name: Thích Hồng Linh
people.role: Fan master of the inner gate (Hall of Righteousness)
people.appearance: Lean and burn-freckled, with both sleeves scorched to the elbow and a closed fan she uses as a pointer.
people.wants: Her best fan to outlast the stair duels.
people.secret: She writes to Tào Tẫn Kiên (tao_tan_kien) in the vent-village tongue, asking him not to sit the last sitting. She has sent it three times and he answers with weiqi moves.

people.name: Lộ Văn Khánh
people.role: Steward of Thiều Âm Thị, the music market below the old palace (Hall of Rites)
people.appearance: A tidy, smiling man with a clerk's ink-stained cuffs, who collects old scores and never plays in public.
people.wants: The Shao played openly, and his name on the one who kept it.
people.secret: He is hiding the musician of 1195 at Kích Khánh Đường and writing down his tunes, one a night, in a cipher of flute-fingerings.

people.name: Nguyên Chước Ly
people.gloss: Blazing Li, the trigram of fire
people.role: The founder's first disciple; commander in the War of the Vermilion Caves; the Fire Court stands on her pyre
people.cause: burned out by the fire she had taken in, the winter the Fire Court was raised (age 182)

people.name: Liên Khánh Dao
people.role: The founder's Dao partner; wrote the Shao Remnant Score
people.cause: qi deviation, playing past the seventh movement of her own score (age 400)

people.name: Lâu Liệt Hà
people.role: Commander at Cô Thành (722-728) and of the palace fleet in the Pirate Purge
people.cause: went down into the burning hold of Thôn Hải Môn after Ô Kình Hải and did not come up (age 261)

people.name: Hề Bính Hỏa
people.role: Master of the Hall of Righteousness after Lâu Liệt Hà; fell in the Thunder Vein War
people.cause: killed by the lightning stored in Thủ Lôi Bảo as he burned it (age 342)

people.name: Dụ Đan Huỳnh
people.role: Warden of Đan Sơn Mạch; Sử Hoành Dực's Dao partner
people.cause: killed by Cố Dạ Lan on Đan Sơn Mạch in the Cinnabar Vein War (age 174)

people.name: Tang Sơ Ti
people.role: A reeler's girl of Hỏa Ti Trấn who gave the last fire-silk to the Nest Array and kept it first
people.cause: old age at 188, at the Nest

people.name: Thiệu Hoa Tâm
people.role: Keeper of the frost pans in the paper yards: melts the frost that presses the paper
people.appearance: Frost-pink fingers wrapped in birch strips; a voice roughened by the pans' steam.

people.name: Đường Mặc Chiếu
people.role: Writer of the lantern papers: the ward sheets the lantern-walker carries round the lake
people.appearance: Slow scribe's blink; a brush tucked in the belt like a sword.

people.name: Cầu Áp Sương
people.role: Outer disciple; presses paper in her first of three years
people.appearance: Broad plain face freckled with pulp; a paper cut on every fingertip.

people.name: Ô Tiểu Mặc
people.role: Inner disciple at the ink hut; burns pine soot at the charcoal kilns
people.appearance: Eyelashes grey with kiln ash; a voice that seldom rises above a murmur.

people.name: Bành Tiểu Đăng
people.role: Outer disciple from the north shore; carries lanterns
people.appearance: Lantern-pole callus on one shoulder; grin full of broken teeth.

people.name: Liên Bích Phù
people.role: Inner disciple of the lantern papers
people.appearance: Wet heels; a raft-rope scar around one ankle.

people.name: Tất Hành Chỉ
people.role: Inner disciple of the paper road; carries the pavilion's paper to the palace
people.appearance: Wiry road-walker's calves; permits rolled under his arm.

people.name: Nhạc Hoa Bì
people.role: Paper-mistress of the pavilion: birch bark, resin, frost and the paper road to the palace
people.appearance: A tall woman with resin-stained hands and a birch-bark hat, who can tell a sheet's maker by its smell.
people.wants: To buy next winter's bark with the north shore's silver and clear the lake villages' old debts from the ledger.
people.secret: She is training Bùi Tố Chỉ (bui_to_chi) to smell a sheet's maker in secret, against the founder's rule that first-years learn no craft, because the girl's hands are better than her own.

people.name: Khổng Dạ Hành
people.role: The lantern-walker: carries and hangs the ward lanterns round the lake villages each autumn
people.appearance: A long-legged man with a pole of unlit lanterns over his shoulder and a different village's scarf every week.
people.wants: To drink free in every village on the lake, and to sell one more wall lantern before he is stopped.
people.secret: He keeps the lanterns he has taken down in a stable at Hồ Khẩu and relights them for headmen who ask, so that each post shows a light when Văn Hàn Đăng counts.

people.name: Quản Sương Thư
people.role: Ink-maker: pine-soot ink from the charcoal kilns
people.appearance: Soot-black to the elbow with a white stripe where the sleeve ends; her stare never leaves your hands.

people.name: Chu Ánh Tuyết
people.role: The head's only disciple
people.appearance: Ink-dot freckles on the left cheek; she holds her breath when she writes.

people.name: Hạng Băng Tường
people.role: Inner disciple; grandson of a family driven out of Nghênh Nguyệt by the ice wall
people.appearance: Wind-bitten ears; ink under the nails even after washing.

people.name: Bùi Tố Chỉ
people.role: Outer disciple and paper-presser
people.appearance: Pulp-soft palms; a bark curl always stuck in her hair.

people.name: Cao Hàn Chúc
people.role: Outer disciple from the north shore, where Băng Tâm's fishers work
people.appearance: Talks in a north-shore dialect; his feet never rest.

people.name: Nghê Tùng Yên
people.role: Inner disciple of the ink-maker
people.appearance: Dark-ringed eyes that never droop; a faint burn scar on one wrist.

people.name: Chiêm Thư Sương
people.role: Founder of Sương Tùng Các (1060); a ward-writer of the pines' Array Hall who left to write
people.cause: died at her writing desk with the brush in her hand, at 210
people.appearance: Remembered as a small stern woman with a quill-callus on every finger and pine resin in her white hair.

people.name: Cát Lĩnh Hành
people.role: Guide of the eastern passes; once a Pavilion mine guard
people.appearance: Mine guard's squint; hides a limp on level ground.

people.name: Lạc Tầm Chân
people.role: Keeper of the map wall
people.appearance: Chalk to the elbows; one eye screwed shut whenever he reads a map.

people.name: Ngô Hàn Đạc
people.role: Pavilion Frost Test failure who followed Thang Phục Tuyết to the lodge
people.appearance: Hair parted as the Pavilion parts it; goes absent mid-drill, as if the lesson had not reached him.

people.name: Mông Thạch Sinh
people.role: Miner's son who cuts steps on the ice stair of Hồi Lộ Phong
people.appearance: Rock dust in the lines of his palms; a pickaxe swing in his walk.

people.name: Âu Dã Lộc
people.role: Hunter's boy from the oriole valley; Hách Tùng's runner
people.appearance: Ears that go red when he is praised; the satchel strap is worn through.

people.name: Vạn Kiên Bối
people.role: Porter for the guides' envoy parties
people.appearance: Thick porter's neck; counts a belt of knotted cords when nervous.

people.name: Quách Độ Ảnh
people.role: Sài Mộ Kiếm's best pupil in the sword yard
people.appearance: Fresh shave over an old scar on the jaw.

people.name: Sài Mộ Kiếm
people.role: Guest elder and sword teacher of the hall; the man Tư Không Hạc Niên beat in 1130
people.appearance: A tall, grey, beautifully dressed swordsman gone to seed, who drinks with his left hand so that his right stays steady.
people.wants: A second duel with Tư Không Hạc Niên before one of them dies.
people.secret: For a year he has sent the sage unsigned insults under Quách Độ Ảnh's (quach_do_anh) name, so that Tư Không comes for the pupil and takes him away from the hall.

people.name: Tịch Lang Tung
people.role: Co-founder and chief guide of the hall
people.appearance: A cheerful, bow-legged mountain guide who carries a basket on his back in every season.
people.wants: To get Hướng Thiết Lan off the Hall of Cold Law's oath without making her lie.
people.secret: Every spring he builds a hut a little higher in the larches above the gate, where neither the hermitage nor the lodge may go, and Ngưu Phá Sơn (nguu_pha_son) carries the planks up in the mushroom basket.

people.name: Thang Phục Tuyết
people.role: A Pavilion outer disciple who failed the Frost Test three times
people.appearance: A stiff, careful man who still sits like a Băng Tâm disciple and hates that he does.
people.wants: To prove that a Pavilion reject can make a swordsman.
people.secret: Each solstice night he sits his pupils through a Frost Test of his own on the lodge pond and fails whom he likes, so that none can leave him for the Pavilion. Ngô Hàn Đạc (ngo_han_dac) has now failed it twice here too.

people.name: Lữ Hồi Lộ
people.role: Guide of Hồi Lộ Phong's ice stair
people.appearance: Hands like rope; a pilgrim's bead string worn smooth.

people.name: Tiêu Hòe Sinh
people.role: The head's nephew; the hall's witness for the passes before the Hall of Cold Law
people.appearance: Neat clan sideburns; a purse that clinks when he sits.

people.name: Ngưu Phá Sơn
people.role: Porter and climber
people.appearance: Taller than the lodge doorway; counts planks on his fingers and still carries one too many.

people.name: Đường Tiểu Kiếm
people.role: A silver-miner's son in the outer gate
people.appearance: Silver dust still in his hair; ears that stick out.

people.name: Hách Tùng
people.role: Inner disciple from the oriole valley
people.appearance: Cheerful as a shopfront; a map tube slung across his back.

people.name: Thái Trường Thanh
people.role: The abbess's grand-nephew, among the men she will not take
people.appearance: The abbess's long jaw on a boy's face, which is why the hall teases him.

people.name: Tiêu Kiến Quang
people.role: The Hòe Âm hunter who found the sealed sword cave in 930 (A108); great-grandfather of Tiêu Vấn Phong
people.cause: old age (105), still searching the mountain for the cave
people.appearance: Remembered as a short, wiry hunter with one white eyebrow where the cave's cold light singed it.

people.name: Nghiêm Kim Ngân
people.role: Keeper of the sick-houses below the terraces, where anyone carried to the gate is treated
people.appearance: Sleeves yellowed to the elbow by forty years of poultices.

people.name: Nghiêm Bạch Truật
people.role: Keeper of the lingzhi beds on the Bối Dược terraces
people.appearance: Straw sandals mended with three kinds of twine; she tells the lingzhi the news.

people.name: Nghiêm Bạc Hà
people.role: Outer disciple; weeds the lingzhi terraces
people.appearance: The corner of her mouth is permanently green from the mint she chews.

people.name: Nghiêm Hoắc Hương
people.role: Inner disciple of the sick-houses; Nghiêm Hồi Hương's twin
people.appearance: Looks at the ceiling while his hands work on a wound.

people.name: Nghiêm Xuyên Khung
people.role: Outer disciple of the trade office at Đào Thanh Thành
people.appearance: Mouths sums under his breath and clicks a spare abacus bead against his teeth.

people.name: Ung Lộ Nhi
people.role: Inner disciple of the long houses; kept her own name
people.appearance: Rests a hand on the rail at every landing; a net-knot is tied round her smallest finger.

people.name: Nghiêm Hạ Khô
people.role: Outer disciple of the fields; a Bạch Lang orphan
people.appearance: Watches the road, not whoever is talking to her.

people.name: Diêu Tẫn Đan
people.role: Guest elder and the valley's furnace-master; the last alchemist of Lăng Tiêu Các
people.appearance: A gaunt man with burn-scarred forearms who keeps a bronze censer with a live coal in it on a chain at his belt.
people.wants: To learn whether anyone of Lăng Tiêu still lives who remembers whose furnace it was, before they come looking for him.
people.secret: He is copying the pill hall's forbidden recipes onto Phùng Lục Ngạc's (phung_luc_ngac) practice sheets, a page a night, so something of Lăng Tiêu outlives him; he tells her they are exercises.

people.name: Lữ Niệm Hà
people.role: The mistress's true disciple; a ferryman's daughter of Đào Sa, orphaned in the Ferry War
people.appearance: A wiry woman with a ferryman's hands, who keeps a burnt nail from the Đào Sa landing on a string round her neck.
people.wants: To walk her brother out of Lạc Hà and onto the valley's landing, and never again to put a child under fifteen on the dike list.
people.secret: She is buying the oldest orphans' dike days back from Ông Khổ Sâm (ong_kho_sam) one name at a time out of her own pill-sale stipend, and has bought nine; Ông has noticed the coin and priced the days up.

people.name: Mai Thủ Điền
people.role: Field-warden of the herb terraces; holds the Grain Rain canon after the mistress
people.appearance: A bent old farmer with a hoe he will not let anyone else carry and a knee that tells him the rain.
people.wants: To keep the terraces tended by weeders of fifteen and over, and to die in his own field with a seed of his herb in each hand.
people.secret: Each flood season he hides six of his best weeders in the disused drying-shed on dike-list mornings and has them written down as sick; Nghiêm Kim Ngân (nghiem_kim_ngan) signs the sick-roll and asks no questions.

people.name: Phùng Lục Ngạc
people.role: Alchemist of the valley, the only one the guest elder teaches
people.appearance: Smells of hot bronze; her singed eyebrows grow back crooked.

people.name: Ông Khổ Sâm
people.role: Steward of the valley's trade at Đào Thanh Thành: pills down the river, grain up it, and the orphans' dike contracts
people.appearance: Rubs a ginseng-root charm whenever a price is named.

people.name: Nghiêm Hồi Hương
people.role: Inner disciple; a flood orphan of Hà Bạn Trấn
people.appearance: Hums as she walks, her left hand curled round the packet as if it were warm.

people.name: Nghiêm Phục Linh
people.gloss: Poria: the fungus under the pine root
people.role: Outer disciple of the terraces
people.appearance: The other children call him the pine fungus for his pitted grey face; sparrows settle on him, he stands so still.

people.name: Nghiêm Tục Đoạn
people.role: Inner disciple; a bone-setter's apprentice
people.appearance: A wolf-tooth charm swings against forearms knotted from setting bones.

people.name: Nghiêm Ngũ Vị
people.gloss: Schisandra: the five-flavour berry, every taste at once
people.role: Inner disciple of the steward; carries the valley's pills down the river
people.appearance: Pockets full of dried schisandra berries; he smiles slightly before he names a price.

people.name: Đậu Sa Nhi
people.role: Outer disciple; a gold-washer's daughter of Đào Sa
people.appearance: Gold-flecked dust under her nails that no washing shifts.

people.name: Tần Tử Chi
people.role: Founder of Thải Chi Cốc (480); one of the lingzhi pickers who left the world
people.cause: went up the valley in her ninetieth year of seclusion and was found sitting under a lingzhi, at 310

people.name: Cố Hoài Sơn
people.role: Master of Thải Chi Cốc before Nghiêm Linh Chi; the picker who carried her out of the flood
people.cause: died hoeing his terrace, at 300

people.name: Thương Tôi Kim
people.role: Refiner of the red gold furnace
people.appearance: A forearm tattooed with the furnace vow, one line scratched out.

people.name: Phòng Tứ Giá
people.role: Appraiser of the auction floor
people.appearance: Heavy rings on every finger but the one she weighs with.

people.name: Tuyên Thạch Nha
people.role: Placed from Lạc Hà this spring; weighs ore for the vault book
people.appearance: A string of brass weights clinking at her belt.

people.name: Mâu Hồng Sa
people.role: Ore sorter at the red gold mine
people.appearance: A gold-flecked front tooth, picked up in the pit.

people.name: Tả Thức Bảo
people.role: Inner disciple of the auction floor; copies the lot book
people.appearance: A collar buttoned to the chin on the hottest days.

people.name: Quan Tẩy Lan
people.role: Brook washer (hired); Quan Tẩy Ngọc's younger sister
people.appearance: A strand of brook weed always tangled in her hair.

people.name: Đoan Tri Lung
people.role: Cage-keeper of the living lots
people.appearance: Bite-scar crescents up both arms, each one named.

people.name: Khang Thiên Chùy
people.role: First refiner of Thiên Bảo Trai, master of the red gold furnace at Xích Kim
people.appearance: A heavy, bald smith with a burn-glazed scalp and forearms like furnace bars, who speaks as little as the hammer allows.
people.wants: To make one thing in his life that will never go to auction, and to see the ring go home to its owners whole.
people.secret: The second key works. He finished it in 1199 and told the mistress it had failed. It sits in the furnace's ash-pit in a lump of slag, and he means to give it to whoever brings the ring back to Lạc Hà, so that the ring is the only key again.

people.name: Tiền Ngũ Phân
people.role: Steward of the auction at Vật Hoa Thị; the man who sold the surety's name
people.appearance: A plump, smiling man in a good silk coat with frayed cuffs, who calls every buyer by name and every name by its price.
people.wants: To clear his table debts to Kim Vạn Lý and one day to call the auction floor his own.
people.secret: In the lot he is selling Hách Ánh Hà he shaves a stone off each child's price and pockets the difference in a silk lining, to pay Kim Vạn Lý's table before the autumn auction.

people.name: Hồ Tầm Kỳ
people.role: Buyer of living lots: beasts and beast parts for the season auction
people.appearance: A lean, travel-browned woman in a fur collar from the north, with a scar through one eyebrow from a bear's paw.
people.wants: A living lot no one has ever seen at auction, and her own name on the lot-book beside it.
people.secret: She is forging bills of health for sickly beasts in Mộc Lan, and one of them, a fire-eyed mule, will die within the week in a rich man's stable.

people.name: Ân Toán Châu
people.role: Clerk of the vault and the loan books
people.appearance: Grey ash worked into the creases of her knuckles and a wheeze she muffles in a sleeve.

people.name: Viên Hồng Kim
people.role: Furnace hand at the red gold mine
people.appearance: Eyelashes burned off at the furnace door.

people.name: Ngụy Minh Giám
people.role: The mistress's youngest disciple, an appraiser on the auction floor
people.appearance: A tall, sharp-chinned girl of eighteen who squints at everything as though it were a coin of doubtful weight.
people.wants: The mistress's floor and the mistress's eye, and to learn what the unpriced line in the vault book means.
people.secret: At the back of the lot book she grades the mistress's own lots in red ink, a stone high or low, to prove she can; Tả Thức Bảo copies the book and has not yet seen the pages.

people.name: Cát Kim Sa
people.role: Outer disciple; ore sorter at Xích Kim
people.appearance: Red-gold dust glitter on his cheekbones that no wash removes.

people.name: Tống Thạch Mạch
people.role: Outer disciple placed from Lạc Hà's outer gate, 1199
people.appearance: A new bruise on one shin every week.

people.name: Khổng Linh Thanh
people.role: Outer disciple; crier of the season auction
people.appearance: A silk scarf wound round her throat to save the voice.

people.name: Quan Tẩy Ngọc
people.role: Washer (tạp dịch) who rinses the finest refinings in the brook at Khê Thanh
people.appearance: Water-wrinkled fingertips and bare, cold-reddened feet.

people.name: Diêm Hóa Kim
people.role: Founder of Thiên Bảo Trai (350); a refiner who bought a mine before his lord heard of it
people.cause: end of his years (500), at the furnace

people.name: Ung Thiên Kim
people.role: Second mistress of Thiên Bảo Trai (760-1050); made Vật Hoa Thị the west's treasure market
people.cause: died in the vault furnace refining the studio's ingot; the furnace burst

people.name: Thiện Thừa Củ
people.role: Master of the Thiên Cơ Hall: the seat's Seven-Star Array and the 129 boundary steles of the Compact
people.appearance: Grey dust in every crease of his hands, a carpenter's square tucked in his belt, and the patience of a man who measures twice.
people.wants: To mend the kink in the Seven-Star Array before the next stele walk, whoever's border it touches.
people.secret: In his cellar he is redrawing the kink-patch plates of the great array with the border drawn the old way, so that on the night he is finally allowed he can swap them in before dawn; only Tả Khắc Thạch's yearly measuring book would prove the stele ever moved.

people.name: Đặng Quân Bình
people.role: Master of the Ngọc Hành Hall: weights and measures, the assayers, the coin and the treasury
people.appearance: Neat and colourless, with a black touchstone at her throat; she weighs a coin on her fingertip while she talks.
people.wants: To catch Chân Kim Các's swap in the act and see the open scales honest again.
people.secret: A Song Kiều porter carries one basket of ore across both squares each dawn at her silver, and she reads his weights herself, to catch Quản Thập Thù's swap with her own eyes before she writes it to the treasury.

people.name: Hình Thủ Tinh
people.role: Warden of Tinh Tủy Mạch, the Star Marrow Vein, whose guard was doubled in 1189
people.appearance: Snow-burnt, with pale eyes narrowed from a life on bright stone, in a fur-lined coat over his armour.
people.wants: To hear the vein's watch order read aloud once, so that he can stop wondering whether it still stands.
people.secret: Once a month he sends Ung Hạc Minh's night crane down to Quý Thủ Lũy's barrow lamp with a flask of oil, against orders, because the old woman's lamp has been going out.

people.name: Trọng Khắc Kỷ
people.role: Junior judge of the Bridge Court, who sits on the river and toll cases
people.appearance: Plump, smiling, in a bench robe of better cloth than the Chief Judge's, with a jade ring he turns while he listens.
people.wants: A house in Thạch Kiều with a river view and a bench seat that is his own.
people.secret: He has pre-sold the autumn ruling on the Hà ford to Lạc Hà and to Tùng Đào and will give it to whichever pays second; his clerk Từ Tri Tiết has seen both receipts.

people.name: Nhiếp Minh Tiễn
people.gloss: The whistling arrow that announces war
people.role: Writ officer of the Dao Quang Hall, keeper of the writ ledger
people.appearance: Lean and weathered, a falconer's leather guard still on her left wrist, ink on her right.
people.wants: A ledger the Pivot can read without shame, and the heir briefed before the heir is crowned.
people.secret: She is rewriting the broken-terms columns of the old writs so that the Pivot looks the wronged party in each, and Ngũ Trấn Bắc quotes her figures in this spring's draft.

people.name: Quý Thủ Lũy
people.role: Keeper of the barrow watch at the edge of Chiết Kích Nguyên; Quý Trường Kích's granddaughter
people.appearance: Grey-skinned and frail from the miasma, with a cough she does not apologise for and a lamp-pole she uses as a staff.
people.wants: To learn why her family went down onto the plain, and to be laid beside them.
people.secret: She is digging into the barrow's flank a handspan a night toward a banner-pole she believes lies there, and Ngũ Trấn Bắc has promised to send a stonecutter's boy to help.

people.name: Bộc Trầm Chu
people.gloss: The sunk boat (phá phủ trầm chu: sink the boats and break the pots)
people.role: Harbour master of Tinh Hán Thành; captain in the Pirate Purge
people.appearance: A barrel of a man gone soft, burn-scarred down one arm, with a voice that fills a tavern.
people.wants: One last good winter of wine and a ship's bell named for him.
people.secret: He has sold the true place of Kình Nha to three collectors, each for a cask, and all three have hired boats; the first sails at the full moon, and Diêm Hải Tảo's agent is one of them.

people.name: Bách Vong Ngôn
people.gloss: Forget the words once the meaning is got (Trang Tử)
people.role: Envoy of the Khai Dương Hall to the Tùng Đào lands; the envoy who forgot his message in 1080
people.appearance: Mild and round-shouldered, with long fingers he keeps in his sleeves and calluses on their tips that he says are from the brush.
people.wants: To play one whole air under the open sky inside the seat's walls.
people.secret: He is teaching Ngạc Tri Âm a second melody of his own composing, with one of the Shao's airs hidden in its fifth bar, to see whether the head's ear will find it in the dusk bell.

people.name: Đồ Vô Cữu
people.role: Guest elder and the Pivot's hound: hunter of deserters, rogues and the ma đạo
people.appearance: Wiry and scarred with lightning-tree burns, he wears no sect colours and sits with his back to the wall.
people.wants: Triệu Huyết Y's name struck through on his hunting roll.
people.secret: He has stopped filing his reports with the head and keeps them sewn in his coat lining: a woman who matches Triệu Huyết Y has taken a room in Thạch Kiều, and he means to take her himself, alone.

people.name: Hoàng Phủ Tịch
people.role: Senior archivist of Tàng Ước Các, who expects the archive
people.appearance: Tall and stooped from the low shelves, with a clerk's habit of sniffing paper.
people.wants: The archive, and the keeper's key-cord at his own neck.
people.secret: While Sử Ngưng Mặc naps he presses her keys into soft wax, so that he can open her shelf on the night she dies without waiting to be given the cord.

people.name: Từ Tri Tiết
people.role: Clerk of the Bridge Court and the junior judge's disciple
people.appearance: Plainly dressed, with a ledger always open on her forearm and a pencil of lead behind her ear.
people.wants: To leave the junior judge's service with her own name clean.
people.secret: She copies one of Trọng Khắc Kỷ's bought rulings each week into a second ledger hidden in the Court's rice jar, with the date the money came.

people.name: Phòng Bách Kế
people.role: The Pivot's resident envoy at Thính Vũ Lâu, who makes the yearly count
people.appearance: A forgettable man in a rain cape, counting under his breath.
people.wants: To be believed by one person at the seat before he is old.
people.secret: He has sent a third count, half true, to Thính Vũ's spymaster Nhiếp Vô Thanh to see whether she answers; she has, once, on a pressed leaf.

people.name: Cừu Bất Ngữ
people.role: Đỗ Tinh Hà's last disciple, a spearman of the Dao Quang Hall
people.appearance: A heavy, silent young man with black-iron dust ground into his knuckles for good.
people.wants: To hear his master's last order before it is spoken.
people.secret: Each night he scratches one more letter into the black-iron ingot he was found on, learning to write Đỗ Tinh Hà's name, and means to lay it in his hands at the barrow.

people.name: Tả Khắc Thạch
people.role: Stele warden of Giới Bi Phong, keeper of the western boundary steles
people.appearance: Weatherbeaten, chisel in his belt, his palms grey with stone dust he never fully washes out.
people.wants: A border that agrees with his book.
people.secret: He has begun to ease the Thủ Bi stele back toward its old place, a rope's length a night, and has told his son Tả Tiểu Bi to say nothing if the Thiên Cơ Hall's men ask.

people.name: Chử Bình Quân
people.gloss: Level weight (a quân is thirty cân)
people.role: Master of the outer gate on Thạch Quyền Phong, keeper of the Level Beam
people.appearance: Short, broad, yak-wool coat over the sect grey, with forearms like a herder's; she lifts the heaviest weights on the rack one-handed.
people.wants: A beam that no one can file and no one can pity.
people.secret: She teaches Hạ Hầu Thạch his letters at night in her gate office, because his Metal of thirty cannot carry the Canon but his eyes might read it.

people.name: Nhiễm Thừa Nghiệp
people.role: Công Tôn Duẫn's disciple and Doãn Hi Hòa's open rival
people.appearance: Square-jawed and restless, always half a step ahead of his master in a corridor.
people.wants: The Seal for his master, and Doãn Hi Hòa laid flat in front of the whole floor.
people.secret: He has greased the third rung of the heir's practice ladder to drop her in the next trial, and Cừu Bất Ngữ saw him do it and, being mute, cannot say.

people.name: Cát Thối Phong
people.role: Guest armourer of the seat, son of Thối Tinh Môn's head
people.appearance: Burn-flecked forearms, a leather apron over guest's blue, and a laugh that carries from the forge to the gate.
people.wants: To reforge Trầm Sa Kích in his own name, and to be a head's son who is also a master.
people.secret: He sells the guard's worn blade-steel back to the smelters at the seat's price and draws the credit twice; his father Cát Lưu Quang's accounts show the ingots both ways.

people.name: Doãn Thường Hi
people.gloss: Thường Hi, mother of the moons, sister to the sun's charioteer
people.role: Outer disciple; Doãn Hi Hòa's niece and the head's kin
people.appearance: Round-faced and cheerful, in a borrowed yak-wool coat, with the Doãn ledger-keeper's ink stain already on her finger.
people.wants: To pass the Level Beam on her own weight, under her own name.
people.secret: She has filed a pebble to the weight of a Metal forty and means to ask Uất Trì Thu to swap it in at the solstice, and has not understood what it would do to Chử Bình Quân.

people.name: Mặc Kinh Trập
people.gloss: Kinh Trập, the solar term when thunder wakes the insects
people.role: Inner disciple with a Thunder root from Cùng Mục Phong, whom Thính Vũ has tried to buy
people.appearance: Small and sharp, hair standing up in dry weather, a burn on one palm from a stone she picked up as a child, and her left foot never still.
people.wants: To learn what Lệ Tiêu Hồn would teach, and then to say no to his face.
people.secret: She writes to Lệ Tiêu Hồn through a herder boy of Cùng Mục Phong under a false name, asking only about thunder-stone, and Đái Hổ Thần reads the replies first.

people.name: Giải Đồ Nam
people.gloss: Plans for the south, like Trang Tử's roc
people.role: Keeper of the boundary rolls and the Compact's great map
people.appearance: Map-roller callus on one shoulder; his eyes flick to the door before he answers anything.

people.name: Sài Thiết Diện
people.gloss: Iron face: a judge's man who cannot be moved
people.role: Bailiff of the Bridge Court
people.appearance: Coughs like a mine-shaft; the club hangs from his belt on a loop worn shiny.

people.name: Nguyên Hảo Khách
people.role: Keeper of the seven witness-houses of the Compact at Thạch Kiều
people.appearance: Rings on all ten fingers; his smile reaches the table a moment before the guest's purse does.

people.name: Chiêm Như Ngọc
people.role: The Pivot's resident envoy at Lạc Hà Tông
people.appearance: Back as straight as a drawn bow; she keeps her laugh for letters.

people.name: Vi Thừa Phong
people.role: Envoy to the vassals, who rides Cửu Cao's cranes
people.appearance: Rubs a bruised hip when he thinks no one is watching; feathers always caught in his hair.

people.name: Đái Hổ Thần
people.role: Drillmaster of the seat guard, Dao Quang Hall
people.appearance: A whistle on a cord, frost-cracked lips, two fingers gone from the left hand.

people.name: Phàn Truyền Phong
people.role: Keeper of the old beacon line, which she is quietly relighting
people.appearance: Soot to the elbows; turns a flint-striker over as other people fidget.

people.name: Long Thủ Chuẩn
people.role: Keeper of the seat's Seven-Star Array
people.appearance: Never seen sitting; candle wax scars her palms and her eyelids hang heavy.

people.name: Thịnh Hàm Quang
people.role: Array keeper on Tinh Tủy Mạch
people.appearance: Pale lashes, bright eyes, bad knees she walks off slowly.

people.name: Hồng Chuẩn Bình
people.role: Assayer of the open scales at Song Kiều
people.appearance: Voice worn to a rasp by the morning shouting; a ledger-pad strapped to his forearm.

people.name: Mạch Ngân Trụ
people.role: Master of the mint at Bạch Ngân
people.appearance: Bites every coin he is handed, even the ones he struck himself; a die-stamp bruise on the heel of one thumb.

people.name: Tông Bình Hành
people.role: Keeper of the standard scales of Thiên Quyền Thị
people.appearance: A beam-balance tattooed small inside one wrist; the tallest woman at the market, she stoops to the scale.

people.name: Ngưu Trọng Đĩnh
people.role: Overseer of the black-iron mine at Huyền Thiết
people.appearance: Shoulders like a cart-yoke; black-iron rime in the creases of his neck.

people.name: Hác Thủ Nhai
people.role: Guard captain on Tinh Tủy Mạch
people.appearance: Heavy brows, a notched ear; he says nothing for a long time before he speaks.

people.name: Mộ Viễn Sơn
people.role: A young guard on Tinh Tủy Mạch who watches Băng Tâm's border
people.appearance: A thin boy with a sentry's squint; his hand half-lifts in a wave before he remembers.

people.name: Lâu Tịnh Hương
people.role: Steward of the seat's stores, the incense and the old bridge stones
people.appearance: Smells of scented wood; a prim bun, a pinch of ash on one cheek.

people.name: Sa Định Ba
people.role: Captain of the sea patrol at Tinh Hán Thành
people.appearance: A gold hoop in one ear; she walks with a harbour roll, as if the deck were still moving.

people.name: Cốc Hiểu Tinh
people.role: Warden of the gate of Khai Dương Thành
people.appearance: A lantern scar in the shape of a crescent on his forearm; the stoop of a man who has leaned on one gate for forty years.

people.name: Chúc Đan Sa
people.role: The seat's pill-maker, who brews with Hoa Cái Đường's cinnabar
people.appearance: Cinnabar-red at the wrists; her cheeks flush every time she lifts a lid.

people.name: Ngạc Tri Âm
people.gloss: One who knows the music: tri âm, a true friend
people.role: Junior envoy and Bách Vong Ngôn's letter-carrier
people.appearance: Thin calves; her fingers drum a tune on her satchel when she thinks no one hears.

people.name: Ổ Tiểu Đàn
people.role: Servant who tends the scented-wood fires of the Pivot's hall
people.appearance: Sandalwood smoke in his clothes; eyelids that droop by noon.

people.name: Bồ Lộc Minh
people.role: Warden of the deer meadow of Lộc Uyển
people.appearance: Antler-velvet stains on his sleeves; a gentle voice for deer, none for people.

people.name: Kế Thanh Khoa
people.role: Outer disciple from the barley plateau
people.appearance: Barley-awn nicks across her wrists, sunburnt ears, a square chin.

people.name: Phục Ngưu Nhi
people.role: Outer disciple, a carter's son
people.appearance: Spread cart-boy's toes; a pocket that rattles with betting knucklebones.

people.name: Mông Bạch Lạc
people.role: Outer disciple who cooks for the outer gate
people.appearance: Flour to the elbows; a round curd-pale face that goes pink over the stove.

people.name: Thượng Hải Đông
people.role: Outer disciple and falconer
people.appearance: A leather gauntlet he never takes off; a talon scar under the left eye.

people.name: Liên Phi Mã
people.role: Outer disciple from the steppe
people.appearance: A broad steppe grin missing a canine; a wine-skin worn like a second belt.

people.name: Hoàng Phiêu Bồng
people.role: Outer disciple, a nomad girl
people.appearance: Wind-chapped lips, an eagle-bone charm braided into her hair, eyes that look past the wall.

people.name: Khuông Lũy Thạch
people.role: Outer disciple at the sixth layer
people.appearance: Taps every wall he leans on and listens; his hands are mortar-grey.

people.name: Cận Hồ Dương
people.role: Outer disciple from the dry edge of the steppe
people.appearance: Fire-red cheeks; singed ends to her plait.

people.name: Tăng Kiên
people.role: Outer disciple from the marshal's village
people.appearance: A rolling goatherd's gait; he sweeps with a broom he oils like a blade.

people.name: Xa Đà Linh
people.role: Outer disciple from a camel-train village
people.appearance: Cracked heels; a string of copper cash around her neck clicks when she walks.

people.name: Bạc Thủ Quần
people.role: Outer disciple, a shepherd
people.appearance: Dog hair on his coat that never stops shedding; a staff callus on one palm.

people.name: Trì Kết Thằng
people.gloss: Knots the cord, the oldest writing
people.role: Outer disciple, a rope-maker's daughter
people.appearance: Rope-burn rings on her fingers; braided cords knotted into her cuffs.

people.name: Tư Mã Độ
people.role: Outer disciple, a ferryman's son
people.appearance: A knee that jiggles under every table; a laugh too loud for any room.

people.name: Hàng Tố Nhung
people.role: Outer disciple who stitches the winter coats
people.appearance: Needle-pricked fingertips; felt-white fuzz on her sleeves.

people.name: Uất Trì Thu
people.role: Outer disciple who tries to cheat the beam
people.appearance: Files his nails to a point; his eyes move faster than the rest of him.

people.name: Mi Kim Bảo
people.role: Outer disciple, a Thạch Kiều merchant's son
people.appearance: Moves his lips when he reads; wears a silk cord on a cheap wooden token.

people.name: Lịch Minh Châu
people.role: Outer disciple, a pearl diver's daughter
people.appearance: A salt-white streak in one eyebrow; ears that pop when she laughs; the long breath of a diver.

people.name: Lưu Tinh Thạch
people.role: Inner disciple of the Dao Quang Hall
people.appearance: Nose broken across the bridge more than once; the neck of a man who has hauled ore.

people.name: Tư Đồ Ngân
people.role: Inner disciple of the Thiên Cơ Hall
people.appearance: Gold flecks in her freckles; she cocks her head at anything that hums.

people.name: Tả Tiểu Bi
people.role: Inner disciple, the stele warden's son
people.appearance: Chalk-white sleeves; the bored, drooping mouth of a boy raised among stones.

people.name: Hạ Hầu Thạch
people.role: The oldest disciple of the gate, admitted at 107 on a filed weight; teaches the weights
people.appearance: Wheat-straw beard at a hundred and seven; his shoulders still lift when a heavy weight is named.

people.name: Giản Thư Hàn
people.role: Second clerk of the Bridge Court, who keeps the hearing record
people.appearance: Mouths every word she hears; her right hand is cramped from a lifetime of writing.

people.name: Thích Mặc Sao
people.role: Copyist of Tàng Ước Các, who recopies the Compact's rolls one shelf a year
people.appearance: Soft round shoulders; his head tilts toward the shelves as if they whispered.

people.name: Bàng Tịnh Biên
people.role: Indexer of the archive's letters, Hoàng Phủ Tịch's eyes in Tàng Ước Các
people.appearance: Quick small hands; a smile that arrives half a second late.

people.name: Cảnh Lệnh Hàm
people.role: Copy clerk of the writ ledger, Dao Quang Hall
people.appearance: Chews his lip while he copies; the corners of his pen-case are worn bare.

people.name: Tần Thủ Quan
people.role: Captain of the seat gate, Dao Quang Hall
people.appearance: Rain-stiff cloak; a jaw that works as if chewing iron.

people.name: Phó Dịch Lam
people.role: Courier of the Khai Dương Hall between the seat and the witness-houses
people.appearance: Blistered heels; a plain brown scarf pulled up to the eyes; she never seems out of breath.

people.name: Bùi Kiến Chứng
people.role: Keeper of the third witness-house at Thạch Kiều
people.appearance: A face like a trodden loaf, nose broken twice, in the best cloth in the witness-house.

people.name: Cù Luyện Thạch
people.role: Deputy overseer of the black-iron mine at Huyền Thiết, who picks the miners' children for the outer gate
people.appearance: Fast, stubby fingers that tick down a list; a mine-lamp scar on the chin.

people.name: Mạch Tuệ Kim
people.role: Coin striker at the Bạch Ngân mint
people.appearance: Counts what she looks at; a silver-blue bruise on one thumbnail.

people.name: Hầu Cân Lượng
people.role: Clerk of the open scales at Thiên Quyền Thị
people.appearance: Clears his throat before every sentence; blue pill-market chalk on his cuffs.

people.name: Ân Tạc Vân
people.role: Steward of the array-stone quarry at Trận Thạch Khoáng, who cuts the stele blanks
people.appearance: Quarry grit under the skin of both palms; a slow, deep laugh.

people.name: Lư Kiểm Phàm
people.role: Steward of the harbour scales at Tinh Hán Thành
people.appearance: Jingles a ring of keys whenever he fines; salt-split lips.

people.name: Nghê Tuần Đăng
people.role: Keeper of the watch book on Tinh Tủy Mạch
people.appearance: Sleep-crumpled hair; a pencil chewed to splinters.

people.name: Tiết Hàn Bia
people.role: Sentry of the barrow watch at Lang Yên Trại
people.appearance: Hood always up on a smoke-grey cloak; a stare that makes sentries look away.

people.name: Ninh Tịch Danh
people.role: Keeper of the seat's rosters under the seat steward
people.appearance: A smooth, forgettable face; his thumb smooths every page before it turns.

people.name: Đạt Dã Lan
people.role: Outer disciple, a yak herder's daughter
people.appearance: Yak-wool braids, wide cheekbones, a bellow that carries across the gate.

people.name: Đạt Kiên Ngưu
people.role: Outer disciple at the primer's sixth layer, who failed the Level Beam once
people.appearance: Heavy shoulders; the pout of a boy who has just watched the pan rise.

people.name: Thác Bạt Lư
people.role: Outer disciple from the yurt village
people.appearance: Grins a beat after the joke is over; felt cap pulled low.

people.name: Hạ Hầu Điền Vân
people.role: Outer disciple, Hạ Hầu Thạch's great-niece
people.appearance: Hair in a neat bun held by a wooden pin; her great-uncle's long-lidded eyes.

people.name: Âu Thiên Tước
people.role: Outer disciple who herds the outer gate's goats
people.appearance: Lips pressed tight over a tune he will not whistle; goat hair in his sleeves.

people.name: Liên Thanh Đề
people.role: Outer disciple, Liên Phi Mã's cousin
people.appearance: A sharp little chin; a coin-purse sewn into her sleeve.

people.name: Sách Trục Thủy
people.role: Outer disciple whose Metal stands at thirty-six
people.appearance: A braided queue, a bone thumb-ring (the second; the first went down a well), a sleepless stare.

people.name: Khuông Thanh Ngõa
people.role: Outer disciple, a mason's daughter
people.appearance: Stone-nicked knuckles; a plait coiled round her head like a rope.

people.name: Úc Kỳ Sinh
people.role: Outer disciple who gathers milkvetch for the seat's pill-maker
people.appearance: Root-stained fingers; smells of dry earth.

people.name: Bồ Trà Nhi
people.role: The youngest outer disciple, who churns the butter tea
people.appearance: Butter on her sleeve; a laugh that rings like a churn.

people.name: Sầm Lũy
people.role: Gate guard of the outer gate on Thạch Quyền Phong
people.appearance: Red-rimmed night-guard's eyes; a spear-butt callus on one palm.

people.name: Phục Đồ Lan
people.role: Foot courier of the Khai Dương Hall, Phục Ngưu Nhi's sister
people.appearance: Mud to the knee even in dry weather; the thin calves of a runner.

people.name: Trì Truyền Thanh
people.role: Runner of the Bridge Court
people.appearance: Cannot keep his heels still on the step; a torn left sleeve tied with string.

people.name: Cung Trực
people.role: Guard of the seat gate
people.appearance: Puppy-chewed bootlaces; a long, solemn face.

people.name: Lộ Tinh Thiết
people.role: Inner disciple of the Dao Quang Hall, a spear trainee
people.appearance: A jaw that twitches when anyone says peace; lean forearms.

people.name: Nhan Bạch Châm
people.role: Inner disciple, apprentice at the Bạch Ngân mint
people.appearance: Silver filings glint in her eyelashes; an even, careful stride.

people.name: Viên Tỉnh Sinh
people.role: Inner disciple sent back to the Huyền Thiết mine
people.appearance: A curved back; a serene, unhurried look.

people.name: Trang Tuyền Cơ
people.role: Inner disciple of the Thiên Cơ Hall, who cleans the Seven-Star Array's nodes
people.appearance: Soot-grey palms; thumbs a pilgrim's bead string while she scrubs.

people.name: Doanh Hàn Ngọc
people.role: Inner disciple of the vein watch on Tinh Tủy Mạch
people.appearance: Cracked thumbnails; checks the wall behind him before he sits.

people.name: Thích Huyền Yên
people.role: Inner disciple, archive copyist in training
people.appearance: Cramped copyist's shoulders; a hair-ribbon the colour of pine soot.

people.name: Cổ Hào Ly
people.role: Inner disciple, apprentice to the standard scales at Thiên Quyền Thị
people.appearance: Fingers that hover over a weight as if reading it; a cocky tilt to the chin.

people.name: Ân Lăng Thạch
people.role: Inner disciple of the Thiên Cơ Hall, stone-cutter at the quarry
people.appearance: A bulged mallet-arm; rock-flour in her hair.

people.name: Đoan Thí Ngân
people.role: Inner disciple, assay apprentice at Song Kiều
people.appearance: Silver-thread scars on his fingertips; his voice cracks on the grade.

people.name: Đổng Tô Hương
people.role: Head of the seat's kitchen, a servant
people.appearance: A scalded left forearm; points her ladle like a spear.

people.name: Hà Khắc Thủy
people.role: Keeper of the seat's water clock and its one dusk bell
people.appearance: A stillness that makes clock-hands seem nervous; patient forearms.

people.name: Hướng Nghiên Thạch
people.role: Servant of Tàng Ước Các who grinds the ink and dusts the shelves
people.appearance: Ink-blue lips from licking the grinding stone; a shy, sideways walk.

people.name: Hàng Thất Kết
people.role: Servant who knots the inner disciples' seven-knot cords
people.appearance: Knot-calloused fingertips; the half-smile of someone who already knows.

people.name: Phàn Bối Sơn
people.role: Porter on the Thạch Kiều road, who carries the Bridge Court's case boxes
people.appearance: Back bowed in a permanent bow; a tump-line groove across the forehead.

people.name: Vu Tịnh Giai
people.role: Servant who sweeps the Bridge Court steps
people.appearance: A broom taller than she is; bare, chapped ankles.

people.name: Diêu Dưỡng Hạc
people.role: Servant who feeds Cửu Cao Phái's message cranes at the seat
people.appearance: Feathers tucked in his collar; whistles quietly through his teeth.

people.name: Phương Trực Ngôn
people.gloss: Square and plain-spoken: trực ngôn is speech that does not bend
people.role: Chief Judge of the Thiên Quyền Hall, who sits at the Bridge Court in Thạch Kiều Thành and holds the Weight
people.appearance: Small, square-shouldered, in the plain grey robe of the bench; she speaks so quietly that the Bridge Court is built to carry her voice.
people.wants: To finish the 1188 judgement and read it in open court, and to have the rule of the seal and the weight written into the Compact itself, so that no head can take the Weight again.
people.secret: Her unfinished judgement found for Băng Tâm. She does not know why the head took the case, only that she had asked the archive for the vein's guard rolls the day before he did.

people.name: Ngũ Trấn Bắc
people.gloss: Guard of the north; ngũ is a file of five soldiers
people.role: Master of the Dao Quang Hall, the war-writ office: the Pivot's hawk
people.appearance: Square, sunburnt, with cropped grey hair and a soldier's habit of standing at the edge of every room; the iron-hooped drum hangs behind his chair.
people.wants: A war against Thính Vũ Lâu now, while the Pivot can still win it, and the marshal's banner found so that the Pivot has a marshal again.
people.secret: He has traced Lôi Vô Danh's road after 803 from the soldiers' names scratched on the stones of Vi Thành Trại and the old ration rolls, and he is close to the abode on Thiên Tuyền Nguyên. He has told no one, not even Đỗ, because he means to be the one who raises the banner.

people.name: Mâu Tri Viễn
people.gloss: One who knows what lies far off
people.role: Master of the Khai Dương Hall and chief envoy of the Pivot
people.appearance: Long-faced and handsome in a dry way, in a robe a shade finer than the seat allows, with the white jade tally hung where a sword would be.
people.wants: To make the peace with Thính Vũ Lâu that ends the counting, and to be named first elder for it.
people.secret: In 1197 Công Tôn Duẫn asked him to sound the great sects on whether they would confirm Doãn Hi Hòa, named heir in 1190. He did it, quietly, through their envoys at the witness-houses, and keeps the answers in a sealed letter he has shown no one, not even Công Tôn: four of the seven would refuse her. He is drafting the terms on which Thính Vũ, at least, would change its answer, and the first term is an end to the count.

people.name: Sử Ngưng Mặc
people.role: Keeper of Tàng Ước Các, the archive of the North Star Compact
people.appearance: Bent and frail, sharp-eyed, black to the wrists from grinding ink; she keeps the archive's keys on a cord around her neck and touches them when she speaks.
people.wants: To find the tally's lost half before her years run out, and to leave the archive to a keeper who will keep it as she has.
people.secret: In 1188 the head came to the archive at night, took the guard roll of Tinh Tủy Mạch for 803, and she sealed the shelf behind him without asking why. She has forgotten that she herself copied a duplicate of it in 803, among the dead lists, without reading what she copied. She has also known since the first ink Họa Tinh Đường sold her archive that its rain-fast stroke is the blood-ink writ of Thorn and Ink Verses with the blood taken out: the copy the Pivot seized at Cửu Thiều Cung's fall (C005) is on her own shelves. She came north to the founder's burial in 1137 to tell Kỷ Ngân Chúc that she would go on buying the ink, and she does.

people.name: Công Tôn Duẫn
people.role: The head's chief disciple and steward of the seat; the elders' man
people.appearance: Broad, weathered, in a plain robe with ledger strings at the sleeve; he walks like a man on a deck and keeps a straight blade hanging point-down at his back.
people.wants: The Seal. He has wanted it for a century and has stopped being ashamed of it.
people.secret: In 1197 he asked the envoy Mâu Tri Viễn to sound the great sects on the named heir, and Mâu has never shown him the answers. The courier Phó Dịch Lam, who carried the replies home, told him which four sects' envoys kept her waiting a month. Now she carries his own letters to those four witness-houses at Thạch Kiều under Mâu's seal, asking whether they would confirm him instead. Each letter says what the seat's night-watch book says, that Doãn Hi Hòa goes into the war-writ office at night, and what she tells him on the training floor, that she agrees with every writ. As steward he keeps that book.

people.name: Thích Minh Thư
people.role: Copyist of Tàng Ước Các, who found the 803 guard roll and gave it away
people.appearance: Thin and freckled, with soot-grey fingertips and a habit of reading other people's handwriting upside down across a table.
people.wants: To see the Compact kept as it is written, even against the Pivot, and to keep her place in the archive while she does.
people.secret: She is the source of the guard roll Ngụy Thanh Hàn holds. If Băng Tâm brings its second claim, the archive will know the copy by its hand within an hour.

people.name: Hề Văn Ước
people.role: First Chief Judge of the Thiên Quyền Hall (510-1062), who wrote the Compact's wording
people.cause: a qi deviation on the bench between two cases (age 762)

people.name: Trình Bạch Tiết
people.gloss: The white tally, an envoy's credential
people.role: Envoy of the Pivot to its vassals, killed at the start of the Phá Quân Rebellion
people.cause: killed on the stair of Phá Quân Môn carrying the Pivot's refusal (age 170)

people.name: Quý Bất Hối
people.role: Quý Trường Kích's son, who held the north rampart of Cố Lũy
people.cause: fell at Chiết Kích Nguyên beside his father (age 113)

people.name: Nhiếp Văn Lôi
people.role: Author of the Văn Lôi Kinh and first master of the Hall of Echoes; a drummer's boy of fallen Khải Lôi
people.cause: killed at Chiết Kích Nguyên covering the founder's withdrawal (C017)
people.appearance: Remembered with drum-callused palms and one ear always turned to the sky.

people.name: Diêu Trảm Hoa
people.role: The founder's war captain on the Petal Shore
people.cause: burned with Hồng Vũ Thành in the War of the Petal Shore (C127)
people.appearance: Remembered as a red-bearded man who fought bareheaded in the rain.

people.name: Văn Hải Khô
people.role: A ma đạo master of the Hollow Tide Scripture; guest elder after the Night Rain Edict
people.cause: died in seclusion at the Tower; recorded as a qi deviation
people.appearance: Remembered as a grey, dry man whose handshake left the hand cold.

people.name: Tạ Thiết Trụ
people.role: The Tower's first lightning-rod man; held Thủ Lôi Bảo for nine days
people.cause: burned with Thủ Lôi Bảo in the Thunder Vein War (V161)
people.appearance: Remembered as a huge man who stood bareheaded on the wall in storms.

people.name: Kỷ Vãn Tình
people.role: The head's Dao partner and Mạnh Lưu Ly's mother; commanded the rear guard at Đan Sơn Mạch
people.cause: killed holding the pass at Đan Sơn Mạch (N-thinh_vu-08)
people.appearance: Remembered as a tall ferryman's daughter who laughed loudly and wore her hair cut short for the sword.

people.name: Khúc Thanh Điện
people.role: Thunder prodigy of the inner gate, born under the new seat; Hầu Vọng Xuân's disciple, courted by Mạnh Lưu Ly
people.appearance: A wiry young woman with gold dust still in the creases of her knuckles and hair that stands up a little before a storm.
people.wants: To be the best Thunder sword in the Tower, and to choose her own master, which the Tower does not allow.
people.secret: Her father is Xuyên Lâm Môn's informer at the mine. For three years she has passed him the dates of the Tower's storm drills, and she knows that Úc Diệp Thanh reads them.

people.name: Ung Thính Thiền
