people.gloss: He who listens to the cicadas
people.role: The head's last disciple, blind from birth; a root like the head's own
people.appearance: A thin young man with milky eyes, who turns his whole body toward whoever speaks and plucks a qin with three strings missing.
people.wants: To hear the founder's chain ring on the old tower once, as the head says it did in her day, and not to be anybody's weapon against Mạnh Lưu Ly.
people.secret: Among the four thousand lamps in the vaults he can hear one burning to the note of the head's own breath. The vault law says a head has no lamp. He has told no one.

people.name: Tào Mặc Toán
people.role: Clerk of the Tower's stores; the Pivot's counter
people.appearance: A neat, forgettable man with an ink callus on his middle finger and a habit of moving his lips as people pass.
people.wants: To die in his bed in Thạch Kiều Thành with both his ledgers burned unread.
people.secret: He pads the Tower's stores count by one sack in fifty so the Pivot's envoys never learn the exact number, and sends them a second copy each season. Tiết Thu Bạch (tiet_thu_bach), who tallies the stores, has found the padding.

people.name: Úc Đả Diệp
people.role: Xuyên Lâm Môn's surety at the new seat since 1170; the head of Xuyên Lâm's nephew
people.appearance: A big, easy man in a green Xuyên Lâm tunic under a borrowed black cloak, a bamboo staff over his shoulder.
people.wants: To go home to Xuyên Lâm when his son Úc Yên Vũ is grown, and not be thanked for staying.
people.secret: Nights on the ridge road he teaches the outer gate's mine boys the Xuyên Lâm staff forms, against the rule that the surety be taught nothing back; Sa Bất Ngữ (sa_bat_ngu) keeps the door and listens to the road.

people.name: Đàm Vãn Chung
people.role: Mạnh Lưu Ly's first disciple; rings the evening bell at the new seat
people.appearance: A solid, freckled woman with a bell-rope callus across both palms.
people.wants: For her master to be head without the price coming out of her mother's grave.
people.secret: She has copied Mạnh Lưu Ly's mother's letters in her own hand and hidden the copy in the evening bell's tongue-case, in case the originals are burned.

people.name: Bộc Thủ Chung
people.role: Steward of the outer gate; rings the Kinh Trập Bell Test
people.appearance: A stooped, kindly man with a herder's crook he uses as a pointer.
people.wants: For Nhạc Cửu Hương to hear the bell once more before the yard is closed to him.
people.secret: For three springs he has rung the bell a hair louder for Nhiêu Hạ Lôi (nhieu_ha_loi), who has not reached Metal 45, to see whether the girl will walk in on it. Tưởng Lậu Thanh has begun to test his bronze.

people.name: Tôn Tuyệt Bích
people.role: Cố Dạ Lan's youngest disciple; the inner gate's best duelist
people.appearance: A hard, hawk-nosed man with two names stitched in red on his left sleeve.
people.wants: A third loss he can learn from, to someone worth a red stitch.
people.secret: He is writing to the two men who beat him to arrange a third duel on neutral ground, and has told Phương Đoạn Vũ (phuong_doan_vu), who would forbid it, that the letters are to a cousin.

people.name: Diệp Ẩn Thư
people.role: Inner disciple who reads a righteous sword manual by night
people.appearance: A quiet woman with ink-stained cuffs, who sheathes her sword before she bows.
people.wants: To teach a righteous sword to one student who will not be sent south as a weapon.
people.secret: She leaves a copied page of the manual each week in the washing shed for Khúc Tiểu Thạch (khuc_tieu_thach), who has no Fire and nowhere to be a weapon, and checks that it has been turned.

people.name: Lục Nhĩ Thính
people.role: Hall of Echoes: keeps the inn at the Thu Trì ferry
people.appearance: Wears a rain-cap even under a roof, and her palms keep the grooves of ferry rope.

people.name: Kiều Tiểu Vũ
people.role: The market master's son, who wants the sword and not the abacus
people.appearance: Grins like a stall-keeper whenever he forgets himself; the thumb says swordsman.

people.name: Thạch Vũ Liên
people.role: The forge master's daughter; casts the cups of every rain-chain
people.appearance: Tilts one ear toward the nearest bell as she walks.

people.name: Yên Trích Thủy
people.role: Lư Tàn Hà's last disciple; will keep the withered lotus
people.appearance: Rain always in her sleeves; she stands as still as a heron.

people.name: Giang Hạnh Hoa
people.role: Copyist of the soul vaults; writes the names on the lamps
people.appearance: Pale as lamp-wax; the vault boys swear she casts no shadow.

people.name: Mai Độc Ca
people.role: Apprentice and servant to the guest alchemist
people.appearance: Sticks out a green-tinged tongue for customers as a guarantee.

people.name: Mục Trập Sinh
people.gloss: Born at the waking of insects
people.role: Drill sergeant of the War Hall on Liệt Khuyết Phong
people.appearance: A drum-skin tattooed round one forearm; you hear his voice before you see him.

people.name: Hà Lạc Vũ
people.role: Rain faction disciple at the old tower; sings to the founder's chain
people.appearance: A green ribbon knotted round one wrist, and a clear voice that carries along the eaves.

people.name: Phan Tích Lịch
people.role: Young Thunder sword in Mạnh Lưu Ly's circle
people.appearance: Amethyst dust ground into his cuffs that no laundress has shifted.

people.name: Quách Tử Tinh
people.role: Keeps the Tower's amethyst seams at Tử Tinh Khoáng; feuds with Xuyên Lâm's foremen
people.appearance: A scar through one eyebrow, red knuckles, and a ledger that sticks out of his belt.

people.name: Hoàng Tiêu Diệp
people.role: Keeps the Tower's house at Lãng Hoa Thành on the coast
people.appearance: Salt in her hair, a coast-house key on a cord, and never a seat with her back to the window.
people.wants: The second half of the stroke next spring, and the glue buyer's trips north ended for good.
people.secret: Three painters in the coast house forge the Dipper talismans of Họa Tinh Đường, the Pivot's vassal, in glue bought from a yard at Lộc Uyển, where the Pivot forbids anyone to hunt the deer (A086). Lạc Tố Bình thinks the Tower wants the stroke for its own writs.

people.name: Ông Vũ Hoa
people.role: Warden of Vũ Hoa Khoáng and its rain-flower pebbles
people.appearance: Holds each flower-stone up to the light before sorting it; pebble-dust on his sleeves.

people.name: Thái Canh Lậu
people.role: Keeps the water clock at night for the Hall of Rules
people.appearance: Cocks his head at drips, and carries a bruise-coloured under-eye from the night watch.

people.name: Lăng Ngân Lộ
people.role: Runner for the Hall of Echoes on the ridge
people.appearance: Blows a reed whistle on a thong before she turns a corner.

people.name: Tiêu Ứng Lôi
people.role: Thunder Hall guard on Kinh Lôi Mạch
people.appearance: A lightning scar like a fern down one wrist; he does not blink when he is lied to.

people.name: Lộ Tiêm Tiêm
people.role: Rain faction sword at the old tower
people.appearance: Leans on a boat-pole as if it were a staff, in a ferryman's wide-footed stance.

people.name: Bồ Ngọc Châm
people.role: Tends the lightning burns after storm drills
people.appearance: Smells of camphor, and her apron carries every salve in the Tower.

people.name: Từ Vãn Hà
people.role: Mạnh Lưu Ly's second disciple
people.appearance: Touches a silver pin whenever she wants to be believed.

people.name: Tạ Kế Trụ
people.role: Keeps Tạ Thiết Trụ's guardhouse on the new seat
people.appearance: Stands bareheaded on the wall in storms, his grandfather's stance to the inch.

people.name: La Tố Y
people.role: Courier from the old tower to the vassals
people.appearance: A courier's satchel worn through at one corner; she will tell you about the meal at Hồng Đậu Trang before you ask.

people.name: Đoàn Kim Sa
people.role: A Sa Kim boy in Hầu Vọng Xuân's drills, with no Thunder
people.appearance: Gold flecks in his teeth, and one eyebrow that never rests.

people.name: Vi Quan Vân
people.role: Reads the storms for the drills on Liệt Khuyết Phong
people.appearance: Squints at the sky as if it owed him money, one wet finger raised.

people.name: Nhiêu Hạ Lôi
people.role: Outer disciple from the cone: holds the Thunder the canon is written for, and too little Metal for the inner gate
people.appearance: A sturdy, soot-cheeked girl with cropped hair singed at the ends, who stands at the front of every Bell Test and is never called.
people.wants: To be let into the inner gate on her Thunder, by the rule or against it.
people.secret: Since 1198 she has bought marrow-washing pills at the Night Rain Market on credit from Ô Thiềm Tử's apprentice, to push her Metal up. They are working a little, and they are poisoning her.

people.name: Châu Tiểu Đàm
people.role: Outer disciple from Thu Trì, admitted on Metal 31; homesick for the rain
people.appearance: A soft-faced boy who keeps a cup on the window sill to catch rain and is disappointed by the ridge's dry thunder.
people.wants: To be sent back to the old tower to serve in the rain.
people.secret: He hears the Kinh Trập bell in his chest each spring and deliberately does not walk in, so the ridge will send him south. Bộc Thủ Chung (boc_thu_chung) has noticed his Metal is rising anyway.

people.name: Nghiêm Tố Tố
people.role: Outer disciple whose brother deserted to Xuyên Lâm Môn in 1177; his lamp still burns
people.appearance: A tall, solemn girl with a bamboo comb she says is from home, though it is from Xuyên Lâm.
people.wants: To see her brother's lamp, and him, within the same year.
people.secret: Each month she tops her brother's lamp with a thimble of oil stolen from Thang Tiểu Chúc's (thang_tieu_chuc) jar, so it burns bright when the vault's law would let it dim.

people.name: Trần Sậu Vũ
people.role: Outer disciple from Kinh Điện Khoáng
people.appearance: Swaggers two sizes bigger than he is, under a badly stitched eyebrow.

people.name: Đặng Tiểu Hòa
people.role: Outer disciple from Ương Ca; sings the planting song at the gate
people.appearance: A rice-straw hat pushed back, and a singing voice that carries over the graves.

people.name: Mã Thiết Câu
people.role: Forge boy at Tử Kim Khoáng
people.appearance: Charcoal ground into his eyelashes, a quench-burn across the back of one hand.

people.name: Lữ Ngân Xuyến
people.role: Outer disciple from the apricot market
people.appearance: Apricot stains on her sleeves, and a tray she never puts down.

people.name: Văn Diêm Trích
people.role: Best drop-counter of his year
people.appearance: Moves his lips to the rhythm of dripping water.

people.name: Khúc Tiểu Thạch
people.role: Khúc Thanh Điện's little brother
people.appearance: Gold flecks on his nails, and not one singed hair on him.

people.name: Yến Lạc Hồng
people.role: Outer disciple from Thu Trì who wants to go back south
people.appearance: Wears a Thu Trì fisher's hat indoors, and packs and unpacks her bag every feast day.

people.name: Đào Kinh Trập
people.role: Outer disciple born on the day of Kinh Trập
people.appearance: A star-shaped birthmark under one ear, shown to every visitor.

people.name: Thiều Mộ Vũ
people.role: Outer disciple from the Lục family's farms at Phong Đăng, admitted on Metal 30
people.appearance: Tenant-farmer's brown forearms; she stands as if in a ricefield even on stone.

people.name: Sử Hỏa Tiêu
people.role: A cone boy admitted on Fire, with no Thunder
people.appearance: Sleepy-smiling, with a stove-poker on his shoulder.

people.name: Cát Liên Châu
people.role: Another cone child admitted on Fire
people.appearance: Clacks an iron bracelet against a copper one when she is waiting.

people.name: Chu Ngọc Trích
people.role: Outer disciple at the Tower's coast house in Lãng Hoa
people.appearance: Salt in her eyebrows, and a ledger-ruler tucked behind one ear.

people.name: Lưu Thạch Khê
people.role: Mine boy at Vũ Hoa Khoáng
people.appearance: His pocket clicks with pebbles; his face tells you the rest.

people.name: Thân Thủ Nhất
people.role: A quiet outer disciple who wants the Hall of Rules
people.appearance: Bows exactly a hand's depth to every elder, and counts the steps to each door.

people.name: Liên Vũ Tình
people.role: Outer disciple kept at the old tower
people.appearance: Wet broom, wet sleeves, and a damp pigtail that drips down her back.

people.name: Vũ Nhất Tuyến
people.role: Outer disciple who wants a duelist's sleeve
people.appearance: Walks one pace behind his master and copies his limp.

people.name: Âu Tiểu Linh
people.role: A second Thunder girl in the outer gate, Metal 38
people.appearance: An apricot-coloured sash, and quick basket-weaver's fingers.

people.name: Diêu Tiểu Phong
people.role: Descendant of the Petal Shore captain
people.appearance: Wears a dented captain's helmet at the gate as a rain-pot.

people.name: Kim Tiểu Sa
people.role: Outer disciple from the gold-sand mine
people.appearance: Gold dust under his nails that no scrubbing shifts; the pan-hand trembles.

people.name: Bì Thiết Nha
people.role: The outer gate's strongest boy
people.appearance: Grins a beat after the joke, showing one chipped front tooth.

people.name: Tống Lôi Nhi
people.role: A Tử Tinh girl with Thunder and Metal 46, due to pass the Bell Test this spring
people.appearance: Wrists like a miner's; a thunder-glass bead swings at her neck.

people.name: Hầu Tiểu Cổ
people.role: Hầu Vọng Xuân's nephew, with no Fire
people.appearance: The drumstick's case strapped across his back like a bow.

people.name: Tần Liên Âm
people.role: Keeper of the founder's rain-chain at the Rain Tower
people.appearance: Polishes the bronze cup at her neck as she talks.

people.name: Phí Thanh Giang
people.role: Steward of the Rain Tower's cisterns and the south's grain tax
people.appearance: A scale-beam tattooed on one wrist, and grain dust in the creases of his neck.

people.name: Lư Hà Tịnh
people.role: Rows the dead out to the withered lotus at Tàn Hà Hồ
people.appearance: Oar-callused hands that never shake; a mourning-white cord at her wrist.

people.name: Bành Chú Thiết
people.role: Draws the bronze wire for the Iron Rain chain at the storm forge
people.appearance: Taps every link of the chain with a hammer as he passes.

people.name: Mạc Tinh Lôi
people.role: Night watch of the life lamps in the soul vaults
people.appearance: Hair pinned up with a wick-trimmer, and pupils as wide as an owl's.

people.name: Đinh Ẩn Thanh
people.role: Listener of the Hall of Echoes in the harbour taverns of Lãng Hoa
people.appearance: Dice-callused fingertips, an easy loser's smile, and a front tooth missing.

people.name: Bạch Khắc Thì
people.role: Reader of the Hall of Rules: keeps the sect rules and reads the charge at trials
people.appearance: Reads in the dark with his eyes half closed; his voice is lower than the water clock.

people.name: Cung Trảm Vân
people.role: The War Hall's pace-setter on the storm climb of Liệt Khuyết Phong
people.appearance: Calves like rope, and a rain-streaked face that nothing bothers.

people.name: Kiều Ngân Châu
people.role: Weigher of the Night Rain Market and keeper of the guest stalls' leases
people.appearance: A bone abacus at her belt, and a bracelet of weights that chimes when she moves.

people.name: Ngụy Thạch Hoa
people.role: Sorts the rain-flower pebbles at Vũ Hoa Khoáng
people.appearance: A pebble in her cheek that she thinks no one has noticed.

people.name: Trác Kinh Phong
people.role: Holds the outer door of the soul vaults under Kinh Lôi Mạch
people.appearance: Stands with his back to the door and one hand on the latch; the latch has come off in that hand twice.

people.name: Viên Thanh Lộ
people.role: Writes the Rain faction's letters home from the ridge
people.appearance: Ink on her left sleeve, a paper fold at her belt, and a jaw that sets when she is crossed.

people.name: Tất Thiên Hưởng
people.role: Young Thunder sword of the Thunder Hall
people.appearance: Ore-hauler's sloping shoulders, and eyes that follow other men's swords.

people.name: Hồ Bách Lý
people.role: Steward of the mule road that carries the south's barley up to the ridge
people.appearance: Talks to his stick, under a barley-sack hat.

people.name: Âu Hành Vân
people.role: Teaches the outer gate the drop-counting drill before the Bell Test
people.appearance: A drop-counter's slow blink, and a pebble bag at his hip.

people.name: Liễu Thu Trích
people.role: Sweeps the founder's cistern at the Rain Tower
people.appearance: Forearms like a stair-sweeper's, hem always wet.

people.name: Quan Minh Tuyền
people.role: Quan Vũ Thanh's grand-nephew at the Rain Tower
people.appearance: An embroidered rain cap with the Quan crest, a size too bright, and hands that have never carried a bag.

people.name: Đậu Tam Thủy
people.role: Cistern servant (tạp dịch) of the Rain Tower for eighty years
people.appearance: Hunched, gap-toothed, humming to the cisterns.

people.name: Lâm Vũ Mi
people.role: Outer disciple kept at the old tower
people.appearance: Hair in a boatman's knot, and a faded rope burn across one palm.

people.name: Cát Viêm
people.role: Cone-born outer disciple who helps tend the lightning burns
people.appearance: Big and pale; he stops on the stair to get his breath back, and his hands are very clean from the salves.

people.name: Phùng Tôi Hỏa
people.role: Bellows boy at the storm forge
people.appearance: No eyebrows at all, and he is already working on a third attempt.

people.name: Đường Lạc Đồng
people.role: Casts the bronze cups new disciples wear at the neck
people.appearance: Sleeves rolled to the elbow, and mould sand in her hair.

people.name: Đồng Vũ Thạch
people.role: Picks rain-flower pebbles from the stream at Vũ Hoa Khoáng
people.appearance: Looks about twelve; smells of wet gravel and keeps a pebble behind each ear.

people.name: Mạc Tiểu Điện
people.role: Outer disciple from Tử Tinh Khoáng with a Thunder root
people.appearance: A splinter of thunder-glass on a cord round his wrist.

people.name: Giản Thiết Sơn
people.role: Carries the War Hall's practice swords up Liệt Khuyết Phong
people.appearance: Squashed wrestler's ear, bruises in three colours, a face that still hopes.

people.name: Nhạc Cửu Hưởng
people.role: The oldest outer disciple on the ridge
people.appearance: White-bearded, in an outer disciple's grey that his dignity does not quite fill; the bell has rung for him once.

people.name: Trịnh Cam Đường
people.role: Keeps the seat's kitchen fire, which goes out at dusk
people.appearance: A poker on her hip, forearms like loaves, and soot to the eyebrows.

people.name: Thôi Ẩn Phong
people.role: Runner for the Hall of Echoes between the ridge and Hạnh Hoa Thị
people.appearance: An ordinary brown coat that no one ever remembers having seen.

people.name: Chung Hải Đường
people.role: Outer disciple at the Tower's coast house in Lãng Hoa
people.appearance: Fish-scale glitter in her hair, and a chatter that never dries up.

people.name: Lạc Kim Bảng
people.role: Ferry boy at the Thu Trì inn of the Hall of Echoes
people.appearance: Jug-eared, with a ferry-rope sling over one shoulder.

people.name: Hoắc Thu Lan
people.role: Clerk of the Night Rain Market's scales
people.appearance: A bone weight on a cord round her neck that she has never lost.

people.name: Phạm Tịch Liên
people.role: Lake-grave keeper's daughter at Tàn Hà Hồ
people.appearance: Long arms, a rower's posture, and a gaze that does not blink.

people.name: Uông Hồng Tiêu
people.role: Cone girl admitted on Fire, who reads the clouds for the drills
people.appearance: Her face turned up to the sky, a cloud-grey ribbon in her hair.

people.name: Lỗ Cảnh Sơn
people.role: Keeps the water clock's cistern full at night
people.appearance: A bucket on each shoulder, and a night-walker's silent step.

people.name: Tiết Thu Bạch
people.role: Tallies the salted meat and barley in the seat's stores
people.appearance: An abacus bead strung on her braid, and ink-black thumbs.

people.name: Cao Thừa Phong
people.role: Outer disciple who wants to climb Liệt Khuyết Phong with the inner gate
people.appearance: His chin always lifted toward the peak; he cannot wait at the foot of anything.

people.name: Sa Bất Ngữ
people.role: Xuyên Lâm Môn's servant (tạp dịch), sent with its hostage
people.appearance: Bald and silent, with a cook's burn-scarred hands; his ears seem to listen on their own.

people.name: Lã Tiểu Hạnh
people.role: Outer disciple from the apricot market
people.appearance: Folds a scrap of poem into her sleeve and hums when she thinks.

people.name: Biện Trầm Thạch
people.role: Gate boy of the soul vaults
people.appearance: Cocks his head at every footstep, a ruin-dust smudge on his chin.

people.name: Thang Tiểu Chúc
people.role: Carries oil for the life lamps
people.appearance: Walks with one hand on the wall, a thimble of lamp oil in her sleeve.

people.name: Hạ Mạch Tuệ
people.role: Farm girl from Phong Đăng who carries the grain tax
people.appearance: Grain-sack calluses across both shoulders, and she thinks aloud about rice.

people.name: Thẩm Hôi Y
people.role: Cone-born outer disciple at the Rain Tower
people.appearance: A wide rain hat that hides everything but her mouth.

people.name: Khâu Thính Triều
people.role: Boatman of the Rain Tower on the lotus lake
people.appearance: A bald crown and a long, wind-cracked face like a boiled turnip; the boatmen call him Radish to his face.

people.name: Thường Bích Ngân
people.role: Tôn Tuyệt Bích's shadow in the practice yard
people.appearance: Copies Tôn Tuyệt Bích down to the sleeve; the War Hall tells them apart only by height.

people.name: Hạng Đan Hà
people.role: Carries the vaults' copies to the seat
people.appearance: A satchel strap across her chest, and a foot that never stops tapping.

people.name: Nhiếp Vô Thanh
people.gloss: Without a sound; the surname is three ears
people.role: Mistress of the Hall of Echoes: the Tower's ears in every inn of the south, and its judge of spies
people.appearance: A plain, heavy-lidded woman in grey who sits with her head tilted toward the nearest door, a small bronze bell sewn inside her collar.
people.wants: To keep the Tower out of a war with the Pivot that it would lose, without breaking her oath to a head who wants that war.
people.secret: She has kept the Pivot's clerk Tào Mặc Toán alive since 1166 and uses him as a channel. For thirty years she has sent Doãn Ngọc Hành true numbers and true intentions, so that the Pivot never panics and never strikes first. By the letter of her oath it is treason.

people.name: Hầu Vọng Xuân
people.role: True disciple of the Thunder Hall; a ridge-born Thunder who claims Khải Lôi's blood
people.appearance: Broad and sunburnt, scarred from the left ear to the collarbone in a white fern of lightning, with a peach-wood drumstick pushed through his belt.
people.wants: To open the realm Hầu Xuân Lôi sealed in 470 (C035), take the Xuân Lôi Cổ and the rest of Khải Lôi's canon, and raise the Gate That Opens the Thunder again, inside the Tower or out of it.
people.secret: The drumstick hums near three places on the ridge. He has told his master about one.

people.name: Kiều Mãn Lâu
people.gloss: The tower full of wind (before the mountain rain)
people.role: Master of the Night Rain Market in Thu Trì Thành; the Tower's purse
people.appearance: A plump man in a black rain cloak lined with red silk, an iron abacus at his hip and a different ring on every finger.
people.wants: The whole of Họa Tinh's rain-fast stroke by next spring, so that his Dipper needs no glue and no nose can tell it from the Hall's.
people.secret: He gives the Tower's couriers their forged Dipper talismans for nothing, and this year they have passed three of the Pivot's gates on them.

people.name: Thạch Liên Hoàn
people.role: Forge master at Tử Kim Khoáng: the Tower's rain-chains, swords and lightning rods
people.appearance: A short, square man with burn-mottled arms and no eyebrows, who stops talking when the sky darkens and goes to his anvil.
people.wants: One lightning rod that does not bring the strike to the man who holds it.
people.secret: He is recasting Mạnh Lưu Ly's (manh_luu_ly) glass sword a third time, in a storm, and has not told her. It carries the flaw he put in the second on purpose, so that it breaks if she is ever made to raise it against the head.

people.name: Phương Đoạn Vũ
people.role: Drillmaster of the War Hall; one of four who came out of the rear guard at Đan Sơn Mạch
people.appearance: A lean, sunken-cheeked man in a soaked grey robe, always soaked, because he drills in the rain and does not change.
people.wants: To die on the climb of Liệt Khuyết Phong, not in the rain of the pass.
people.secret: He is writing out Kỷ Vãn Tình's last order a line a month in a letter to Mạnh Lưu Ly (manh_luu_ly), and has stopped on the line that names the head.

people.name: Hứa Thanh Diêm
people.role: Envoy of the Tower to the south and the vassals; went with Quan Vũ Thanh to Phượng Minh in 1185
people.appearance: A round-faced woman in a green-lined rain cloak who carries her own tea and never drinks a host's.
people.wants: Vu Ngô Đồng's terms in writing, in the Tower's own hand, before Quan Vũ Thanh's span ends.
people.secret: She passes Vu Ngô Đồng (vu_ngo_dong) the Rain faction's moods in her tea notes, a season at a time, under cover of talking about leaf, and he has begun to answer in the same code.

people.name: Tưởng Lậu Thanh
people.gloss: The sound of the water clock
people.role: Master of the Hall of Rules and keeper of the Tower's water clock; runs the Kinh Trập Bell Test
people.appearance: A bony old man who speaks in the rhythm of dripping water and taps a bronze cup with one finger while he listens.
people.wants: The water clock never again to need a hand between its drops.
people.secret: He keeps a second water clock, set a drop behind the first, to learn whether it is the Tower's rule or its clock that is slipping, and it has drifted by an hour a year. Thái Canh Lậu (thai_canh_lau), who tends the first, has not been told.

people.name: Lư Tàn Hà
people.role: Grand elder; one of the founder's four living disciples, keeper of the withered lotus and the lake graves of Tàn Hà Hồ
people.appearance: A tiny, brown old woman who sits on the lake shore in every rain without a hat, her hands folded in her sleeves.
people.wants: To be put into the lake herself on a night of rain, with a lotus to hear it.
people.secret: By night she has Lư Hà Tịnh (lu_ha_tinh) row out the ashes of the deserters the Tower's law refuses a burial, and lowers them beside the founder.

people.name: Ô Thiềm Tử
people.role: Guest alchemist (khách khanh): the Night Rain Market's pills and poisons
people.appearance: A fat, damp, yellow-eyed man who keeps live toads in his sleeves and tastes everything he brews.
people.wants: A poison no one will ever think to cure, and the quiet to finish tasting it.
people.secret: He has brewed one pill that is not a poison, a cure for the Hollow Tide deviation, and is keeping it from Kiều Mãn Lâu because it would sell for too little. Mai Độc Ca (mai_doc_ca) has found the first batch and is selling it under the counter.

people.name: Ninh Tịch Đăng
people.role: Keeper of the life lamps in the soul vaults; holds the wick shears
people.appearance: A tall woman with ink on her fingers and wax in her hair, who blinks slowly in daylight after a month underground.
people.wants: Never again to be asked to cut a wick.
people.secret: She writes the lamp roll twice, one for Lệ Tiêu Hồn and a true set kept by Giang Hạnh Hoa (giang_hanh_hoa), who keeps her own list of the lamps that have gone out.

people.name: Phàn Lô Kiên
people.role: Steward of the coal road from Thạch Thán Khoáng to the forge, under Hầu Thiết Anh
people.appearance: A basket-strap groove worn into each shoulder, and a tally cord knotted round his wrist.

people.name: Nghê Bách Đoán
people.role: Second hammer of the anvil hall and Cát Đoán Nhạc's sworn brother
people.appearance: His beard is singed to a flat line along the jaw, and the hammer has deafened his left ear.

people.name: Cát Tĩnh Chùy
people.role: Inner disciple of the anvil hall, Cát Thối Phong's son, raised by his uncle
people.appearance: No scars at all, which the hall thinks improper.

people.name: Doãn Ma Kính
people.role: Outer apprentice of the polishing house, from the calamine camp
people.appearance: A polishing-paste stain across one cheek that she wears like a seal; her heel taps the treadle out of time.

people.name: Kha Ô Lan
people.role: Outer apprentice, a coal-carrier's daughter who wants the pool
people.appearance: Coal ground so deep into her palms that the creases look inked.

people.name: Tất Kim Thanh
people.role: Inner disciple and seller at the gate of Thiên Ngoại Khoáng
people.appearance: A gap-toothed grin, a too-fine blue coat, and a little bell sewn at the cuff to announce himself.

people.name: Ông Thiết Xuyên
people.role: Outer apprentice and third hammer of the anvil hall, a star-mine boy
people.appearance: Swings left-handed; the right wrist is wrapped in a strip of red cloth.

people.name: Cát Đoán Nhạc
people.role: First son of the head and master of the anvil hall; has no Fire, and signs for the coal
people.appearance: His father's frame without the scars, in a black felt apron that never comes off.
people.wants: The anvil hall's coal never short for the Pivot's blades, and the Rite kept from a steppe boy who will carry it down the mountain.
people.secret: He is keeping ten sacks a month of the forge's coal in his own cellar under the anvil hall, so that when the old man falls Đinh Hỏa Lân will have none to learn by. Phàn Lô Kiên (phan_lo_kien), who counts every basket, has noticed the road weighs light.

people.name: Bàng Lãnh Tôi
people.role: Quench-keeper of the snow-melt pool below the forge; holder of the founder's tongs
people.appearance: A thin old man with blue-white hands who stands knee-deep in the pool from dawn and never seems to feel it.
people.wants: Kha Ô Lan holding the River Tongs after him, and his pool kept by a coal-carrier's daughter.
people.secret: He is already teaching Kha Ô Lan (kha_o_lan) the quench by night, knee-deep in the pool in the cold hours, so that whatever the head answers the girl will have it done.

people.name: Hầu Thiết Anh
people.role: Overseer of Thiên Ngoại Khoáng, the mine of the iron from beyond the sky
people.appearance: A broad, laughing woman with iron dust in her hair, who carries the mine's tally sticks in her belt.
people.wants: The Pivot's weighers at Song Kiều never to ask, and one long run of good dice.
people.secret: She skims one ingot in thirty off the mine's tally into a disused gallery, to buy her way out if the weighers ever come. Mẫn Hắc Châu (man_hac_chau) has found that the gallery's tally sticks do not match the count.

people.name: Đinh Hỏa Lân
people.gloss: A fire unicorn (đinh is the fire of a lamp)
people.role: Journeyman smith from Phất Y Cốc's steppe; the gate's best Fire root after the head, being taught the Rite
people.appearance: A lean, sun-dark man from the dry steppe who laughs at the snow and works the forge bare-chested in winter.
people.wants: The Rite whole, and one day a forge of his own on the hot steppe.
people.secret: He copies each lesson of the Rite onto scraps in the steppe's fire-marks and sends them home to Thập Giáp Thôn in the coal baskets, by the road swords who pass the gate. Hoắc Ngọ Lộ (hoac_ngo_lo) carries the latest one.

people.name: Cát Thanh Diệm
people.role: The head's granddaughter, in whom a little Fire came back
people.appearance: One eyebrow burned off and never grown back; her grandfather's square jaw.
people.wants: To be taught the Rite after Đinh, for her father's sake, though he would not thank her for it.

people.name: Kha Thán Sinh
people.role: Outer apprentice, a coal-carrier's son
people.appearance: Pole-callus across the back of his neck; it takes him two tries to answer to his name, wearing a puzzled look.

people.name: Đàm Kính Nguyệt
people.role: Outer apprentice of the polishing house
people.appearance: Pumice-smoothed fingertips; she pitches her voice low so as not to disturb the blades.

people.name: Tào Bách Sinh
people.role: Outer apprentice from Thanh Bách Thành, the city that sold the star
people.appearance: Good boots he is clearly still paying for, and a clerk's inked thumbnail.

people.name: Mẫn Hắc Châu
people.role: Inner disciple at the star mine, born at the black-iron diggings
people.appearance: Black iron dust under every nail; she weighs her rice in her palm.

people.name: Diêu Lạc Tinh
people.role: Founder of Thối Tinh Môn (330); the first to quench star iron in the mountain river
people.cause: a qi deviation at the anvil at 350, striking the ninth blow of a blade he did not finish
people.appearance: Painted on the gate wall as a lean man with white eyebrows and snow melting off both shoulders.

people.name: Nhạc Bá Chùy
people.role: Elder smith who forged the halberd Trầm Sa Kích for Quý Trường Kích in 600
people.cause: stopped eating the winter he heard the halberd lay under the barrow, at 336
people.appearance: A stooped smith in the gate's portrait, one shoulder dropped lower after sixty years at the anvil.

people.name: Hoắc Tịch Ca
people.role: Leads the nightly autumn chant at the graves under Bào Thu Xướng
people.appearance: Pale cord of scar across his throat; tilts his head left when he listens.

people.name: Tiết Ấn Sương
people.role: Ward-setter at the jade beds
people.appearance: Chalk dust ground into the lines of her palms; a single silver seal-ring on a string at her neck.

people.name: Chử Ẩn Thạch
people.role: A hunters' son of the ridge; the Cave Hall's second dark singer
people.appearance: Eyes that go milk-pale in lamplight; he sells the teeth of his own necklace one by one.

people.name: Cam Thủy Ngâm
people.role: Sweeper from Mãn Võng who heard the graves from the boats
people.appearance: Broad bare feet that leave wet prints on dry stone; a fishhook scar through one eyebrow.

people.name: Hứa Tàng Thư
people.role: Clerk of the copy room
people.appearance: Hair parted tidy at dawn, undone by noon in the copy room's draught; a ruling-stick tucked behind his ear.

people.name: Thường Địch Âm
people.role: Flute-cutter in the tribulation-bamboo grove
people.appearance: Drums her fingers on any surface; a bamboo-splinter scar runs down her lower lip.

people.name: Tôn Dư Tẫn
people.role: Grave-sweeper from the hamlet on the ruin of Lôi Trạch
people.appearance: Left sleeve grey to the elbow with grave dust; the third broom this year snapped in his hand.

people.name: Bào Thu Xướng
people.gloss: An autumn song (Lý Hạ: Bão gia thi)
people.role: Singing master of the Pavilion, who leads the autumn chant at the graves
people.appearance: A soft-spoken old man with a zither on his back, his voice able to fill a valley without being raised.
people.wants: To hear Lương Thanh Mộ's voice another autumn, and to have the river's drowned lie where the abbess's rice pays for them to lie.
people.secret: On his watch nights he is leaving the censer of the jade beds unlit, so that a few of the drowned strangers' graves go unsung; the head counts the jade at the beds and not the smoke, and the count is due at the first cold wind.

people.name: Thẩm Thổ Bích
people.role: The head's true disciple; keeper of the grave-jade beds
people.appearance: A square-shouldered, plain-faced woman with a jade-cutter's lens on a cord and dirt to the elbows.
people.wants: One whole stone of grave jade for her Kết Đan, and the head's seat after the head.
people.secret: She has promised Tiết Ấn Sương a fifth of the stone's price and is arranging, through Kiều Mãn Lâu's man, that the pills come back short and the fifth never does.

people.name: Cơ Ký Âm
people.role: Copyist of the songs of the graves; he has written down what the oldest dead sing
people.appearance: Thin and short-sighted, he writes with his left hand and holds his right over his ear, as if shading it from a wind.
people.wants: To finish the oldest song, and to have the dead's words read by someone who will not burn them.
people.secret: He kept a second copy of the drum passages, sewn into the lining of his winter robe, and he has played their cadence once on a grave drum. Something under the ridge answered.

people.name: Bùi Song Khê
people.role: Grave singer from Song Khê
people.appearance: Hoarse brook-water laugh; two white hairs she refuses to pull.

people.name: Ôn Tịch Nhai
people.role: The cave hunters' son: keeps the Pavilion's Cave Hall at Thủ Động Trại, one of its two dark singers
people.appearance: Short, heavy, in ridge furs, with a cave lamp on his belt that he never lights.
people.wants: A hunters' child who sings the cave's dead as well as Chử Ẩn Thạch does, and the Cave Hall's censers lit by hunters' fees.
people.secret: The child he kept is still in the cave: the family sends the fee each season, and he feeds her through the door and listens to what she hums.

people.name: Điền Xướng Ương
people.role: The planting singer of Ương Ca whom the graves answered
people.appearance: Sways as though still keeping the planting beat; sunburnt neck.

people.name: Phùng Cổ Âm
people.role: A drummer's descendant who hears the drum in the oldest songs
people.appearance: Taps a drum rhythm on her knee without knowing it; fringe cut crooked with her own knife.

people.name: Cam Võng Nhi
people.role: A fisher girl from the Pavilion's village
people.appearance: One dark curl hangs wet however dry the day; hands rough from the nets.

people.name: Nhan Thu Mặc
people.role: Cuts tribulation bamboo for the grave flutes
people.appearance: Lopsided from carrying canes; bore-nicks across both thumbs.

people.name: Tang Mộ Sinh
people.role: A foundling found among the graves of Lôi Trạch
people.appearance: One grey eye, one brown; hums a tune in his sleep that nobody taught him.

people.name: Lương Thanh Mộ
people.role: First elder of Thu Phần Các and the head's sworn sister; one of the voices in the graves
people.cause: went down into the deepest grave of Lôi Trạch to renew the oldest ward from inside, and did not come back

people.name: Hướng Vãn Chu
people.role: True disciple of the Cold Ford Hall; holds the third plot of the Heir's Garden, sown in the salt marsh
people.appearance: Tall and sun-dark, with salt in her braid, a punt-pole of tempered bamboo over her shoulder and her father's squint.
people.wants: To make the salt marsh grow rice, and to end the Cold Ford feud without her father's war.
people.secret: She has met Đàm Thanh Giang every winter since 1190 on the river-mouth ice. She also knows what lies under that ice: the six Tùng Đào patrolmen her father killed in 1172.

people.name: Kiển Viễn Chí
people.gloss: Polygala root; the herb's name means 'far ambition'
people.role: The foundling prodigy of the inner gate; Thiệu Thanh Đài's disciple
people.appearance: A thin young man with quick hands and a fixed look, who wears the plain inner-gate robe with a strip of older green silk sewn inside the collar.
people.wants: To be named heir in his master's place, and to learn who left him on the step.
people.secret: He has found the Furnace Hall's bolt of that silk. Its sewing ledger names the inner disciple Tề Tử Tô as the one who drew a robe from it in 1165.

people.name: Phạm Thủ Điền
people.role: Master of the outer gate and its spirit fields
people.appearance: A slow, grey-bearded man who uses his hoe as a staff and as a pointer.
people.wants: To see one Earth-only outer disciple pass the inner gate in his lifetime.
people.secret: He has marked two Earth disciples a half-grade up in the gate ledger so that they may sit the inner test; if the Hall of Rules audits the ledger it will find his hand.

people.name: Quyền Tiểu Mạch
people.role: Keeper of the seed vault; the first elder's daughter
people.appearance: Round-faced and freckled, with her father's slow walk and a knee that jiggles through every meeting.
people.wants: Kết Đan before her father dies, or the courage to stop trying.
people.secret: She was told to burn the seed of the sect's first rice when it failed; instead she plants a single row of it each spring in her mother's herb garden.

people.name: Bao Nham Tỉnh
people.role: Steward of the Cliff Hall; keeper of the founder's grave and of the old life trees
people.appearance: A stooped, weathered man with two water buckets on a yoke and a voice he almost never uses.
people.wants: To be buried among the life trees he waters.
people.secret: He grafts cuttings from dead disciples' life trees onto living ones so that no one he walks down the mountain to tell will lose a tree; the Hall of Rules would call it fraud of the roll.

people.name: Quản Ảnh Hồ
people.role: Last disciple of the burned Minh Kính Đường; practises its mirror method under an exception
people.appearance: A pale woman with burn-scarred hands who sits by water whenever she can.
people.wants: To die by water, still at Trúc Cơ, with the mirror method taught to one person.
people.secret: She is teaching the still-water method to the servant girl who fetches her water, against the exception that forbids her to teach it; the Hall renews the exception next year.

people.name: Uông Mục Địch
people.role: Keeper of the sect's spirit cattle at Mục Ca Thành; a Trúc Cơ in his last two years
people.appearance: A white-haired, brown-faced herder with a bamboo flute through his belt and no teeth on one side.
people.wants: Kết Đan in spring with the herd listening, or a quiet place under the cattle's tree.
people.secret: He has taught the lead cow to bow to one tune and charges the Mục Ca herders a copper to watch.

people.name: Thẩm Tịnh Sa
people.role: Steward of the port house's books at Yên Ba Thành; first cultivator of the Thẩm clan of Bạch Sa
people.appearance: A neat man with ink on his middle finger and an abacus in his sleeve.
people.wants: A clan hall in Bạch Sa with his name on the lintel, paid for with clean books.
people.secret: He keeps a second set of the port house's books in which every pill price is two parts in a hundred high, and sends the difference home to the Thẩm clan; Diêm Hải Tảo has trusted his sums for thirty years.

people.name: Tề Tử Tô
people.role: The Furnace Hall's senior inner alchemist; a heretic in the making
people.appearance: Thin, sharp-boned and very still, with perilla-purple stains on her fingers.
people.wants: To finish reading the Rotting Canopy Canon before the sealed shelf is found open.
people.secret: She is copying the forbidden canon into her wound-pill recipes a line at a time, and one batch in forty carries a trace of it; Dư Tục Đoạn's patients are drinking it.

people.name: Âu Dương Tân Di
people.role: The founder's last blood, kept on the ridge by the Cliff Hall
people.appearance: A slight young woman with the founder's long eyes, which everyone on the ridge tells her.
people.wants: To go down to the new seat and grow magnolias like any other disciple.
people.secret: One night a month she walks down the mountain to the new seat and back before dawn, and Bành Lạp Mai lies in her bed to cover for her.

people.name: Thang Hạ Khô
people.gloss: Self-heal; the herb withers in summer
people.role: Cliff Hall fighter
people.appearance: Pine soot ground into the lines of his palms that no wash lifts.

people.name: Tiền Bán Hạ
people.role: Keeper of the Green Door list
people.appearance: Quick cloth-seller's fingers that smooth every sleeve she passes.

people.name: Hàn Mộc Tê
people.role: Keeper of the osmanthus terraces at Thương Thúy Lâm; copyist of the Bách Thảo books
people.appearance: A copyist's right thumb cramped into a hook.

people.name: Cảnh Bồ Anh
people.role: Field Hall disciple
people.appearance: Smiles slowly, a beat after everyone else.

people.name: Võ Hàn Lô
people.role: The Cold Ford Hall's best fighter on ice
people.appearance: A hoarfrost-white patch in his left eyebrow.

people.name: Nhâm Liễu Ngạn
people.role: Ferry disciple of the Cold Ford Hall
people.appearance: A small dry cough she hides in her sleeve.

people.name: Bạch Hợp Hoan
people.gloss: Silk tree, the tree of joined joy
people.role: Marten Yard disciple
people.appearance: A marten-claw scratch on the back of one wrist, always fresh.

people.name: Phí Tùng Chi
people.role: Steward of the spirit-wood stores
people.appearance: Sniffs every lamp he passes.

people.name: Đường Tịch Chiếu
people.role: The envoy's letter-writer
people.appearance: Sits so straight a ruler looks bent beside her.

people.name: Khang Thạch Tuyền
people.gloss: Spring over stones (Vương Duy: the clear spring flows over the stones)
people.role: Array runner of the Array Hall
people.appearance: Taps each stone he passes with his ring.

people.name: Tuân Vân Mẫu
people.role: Array Hall mica-grinder
people.appearance: Mica glitter dusting her cheekbones and sleeves.

people.name: Ngải Thanh Hao
people.role: Healing House disciple; keeps Thanh Nang Đường's own method
people.appearance: A child's round face on a grown frame.

people.name: Thi Trà Yên
people.role: Grower of the sect's spirit tea at Trà Viên Thôn
people.appearance: A slow, deep voice for so small a woman.

people.name: Bành Lạp Mai
people.role: Cliff Hall disciple
people.appearance: A scowl she puts on for company.

people.name: Đổng Hồ Đào
people.role: Field Hall disciple
people.appearance: A stoop from forty years under low branches.

people.name: Liêm Trúc Ảnh
people.role: Clerk of the Hall of Rules
people.appearance: A Tùng Đào cut to his collar, the only one in the Hall of Rules.

people.name: Kê Lăng Hoa
people.role: Port house disciple; the one who followed the peach petals
people.appearance: A peach-petal birthmark behind one ear that she says appeared the day she came back.

people.name: Tất Quế Lạc
people.gloss: Osmanthus falls (Vương Duy: a quiet man, the osmanthus falls)
people.role: Array Hall disciple; Tất Hành Vụ's granddaughter
people.appearance: Her grandfather's quick, bent walk.

people.name: Đậu Tam Thất
people.role: Steward of the sect's pill shop in Lam Yên Thị
people.appearance: Turns a jade thumb ring whenever he lies.

people.name: Thường Độc Hoạt
people.role: The head's oldest living disciple; a hermit on Thủy Cùng Phong
people.appearance: Wind-grey hair down to his waist.

people.name: Mễ Điền Nhi
people.role: Earth-rooted outer disciple who dug a fourth plot beside the Heir's Garden
people.appearance: A broad, short girl with mud to the elbows and a city accent she cannot lose.
people.wants: A plot the sect will count as its own.
people.secret: She sells a stalk a month of the fourth plot's three spirit grasses to a Thạch Kiều Thành broker to pay off her father's debts; Phạm Thủ Điền has not asked where the coin comes from.

people.name: Phù Liên Kiều
people.role: Outer disciple from Tùng Hạ Thị; Tùng Đào's man in the outer gate
people.appearance: A handsome, easy-smiling young man who learns everyone's name on the first day.
people.wants: To go home a hero of the pines with the canon's list complete, and to find a reason to stay.
people.secret: He has begun to forge the lists he sends Hồ Tùng Nguyệt, because the shelves are open and nothing is worth stealing; the false pages are filled with names of Cold Ford children he has grown fond of.

people.name: Hướng Tiểu Lâm
people.role: The warden's son
people.appearance: A fish scale always stuck to his sleeve.

people.name: Cam Lệ Châu
people.role: Port house outer disciple
people.appearance: A white scar from an eagle's talon along her jaw.

people.name: Đinh Lão Hòe
people.role: Cook of the Cliff Hall
people.appearance: Carries his ladle like a sceptre.

people.name: Uông Tiểu Ngưu
people.role: Herder boy of the outer gate
people.appearance: Dung-caked boots he no longer notices.

people.name: Trịnh Ma Thằng
people.role: Outer disciple; braids the herb-drying lines
people.appearance: Lifts his chin hopefully at every elder he passes.

people.name: Lê Đan Tất
people.role: Lacquers the sect's pill boxes
people.appearance: Lacquer-red stains on her hands that never itch.

people.name: Trương Mặc Thán
people.role: Fire-tender of the green furnaces
people.appearance: Smells of charcoal in every season.

people.name: Vương Phục Linh
people.role: Thiệu Thanh Đài's second disciple
people.appearance: A pale scar on her chin.

people.name: Khâu Hải Đới
people.role: Port house runner
people.appearance: Wears a belt wrapped twice round a thin waist.

people.name: Nguyễn Mãn Diệp
people.role: New outer disciple
people.appearance: A little resin always sticky on her fingers.

people.name: Lỗ Kiên
people.role: Builds the field terraces' stone walls
people.appearance: Fingers cut flat by stone.

people.name: Sầm Ngưu Tất
people.role: Raftsman of the spirit wood
people.appearance: A bow-legged raftsman's stance.

people.name: Liêu Tiểu Độ
people.role: The newest outer disciple
people.appearance: A thin braid with a life-tree leaf pinned in it.

people.name: Đới Hoa Mạch
people.role: Field worker of the outer gate
people.appearance: A broad farmer's nose burnt red by spring sun.

people.name: Trác Bạch Truật
people.role: Inner disciple of the herb gardens; copyist
people.appearance: Fingertips dyed grey from old paper.

people.name: Chương Dã Mật
people.role: Keeper of the seat's spirit bees
people.appearance: Healed bee-sting welts like beads along her neck.

people.name: Phong Hàn Nha
people.role: Outer disciple who keeps crows
people.appearance: A crow's feather stuck in his hair, always on the same side.

people.name: Tịch Thu Diệp
people.role: Outer disciple who reads to the field workers
people.appearance: A red leaf pressed into the band of her cap.

people.name: Vạn Tiều Ca
people.role: Outer disciple who sings in the fields
people.appearance: A mouth that hums even in his sleep, they say.

people.name: Ứng Lâm Tuyền
people.role: Water-carrier of the Healing House
people.appearance: A limp from the spring's steps.

people.name: Thời Hải Thúy
people.role: Diêm Hải Tảo's youngest disciple
people.appearance: Hard, bare feet in every weather.

people.name: Khuất Phong Phàm
people.role: Weather-reader for the pill ships
people.appearance: An earlobe pierced twice for luck.

people.name: Cổ Đồng Du
people.role: Oils the seat's halls against the haze
people.appearance: Blinks slowly, as if the answer were far off.

people.name: Phòng Thạch Hộc
people.gloss: Dendrobium, the orchid that roots in rock
people.role: Cliff Hall disciple who tends the old life trees with Bao Nham Tỉnh
people.appearance: Moss under her nails from the old trees.

people.name: Lệ Khương Hoạt
people.gloss: Notopterygium, a root of the high slopes
people.role: Cliff Hall fighter; Thang Hạ Khô's sworn brother
people.appearance: A bent nose from a cliff-path fall.

people.name: Viên Sơn Thù
people.role: Forest-born disciple who chose the Cliff Hall
people.appearance: A wild fringe she trims with a kitchen knife.

people.name: Ô Thạch Tùng
people.role: Gatekeeper of the Cliff Hall; props the founder's pine
people.appearance: Walks without a sound on the loudest gravel.

people.name: Bồ Đỗ Trọng
people.gloss: Eucommia, the bark that mends bone
people.role: Oldest of the Cliff Hall's inner disciples
people.appearance: Squints at the sky for rain before every sentence.

people.name: Chiêm Đan Sâm
people.role: Furnace Hall brewer, second to Tề Tử Tô
people.appearance: A burn ring round his wrist from a cauldron handle.

people.name: Lư Sa Sâm
people.role: Field Hall disciple who keeps the grain tally
people.appearance: A round, generous laugh she cannot keep down.

people.name: Ngô Câu Đằng
people.role: Array Hall disciple who walks the Spring Return array each dawn
people.appearance: A walking stick worn smooth at the top by a dawn grip.

people.name: Sử Tế Tân
people.role: Investigator of the Hall of Rules
people.appearance: A knot of hair so neat it looks painted.

people.name: Vân Tử Uyển
people.role: Keeper of the osmanthus terraces at Thương Thúy Lâm
people.appearance: Hums half a tune and never finishes it.

people.name: Hồng Mộc Hương
people.role: Steward of the rite of asking, before a spirit tree is felled
people.appearance: His eyes drop whenever anyone mentions an axe.

people.name: Tân Thương Truật
people.role: Cold Ford Hall fighter of Tân Hàn Chu's line
people.appearance: A boatman's rope scar across both palms.

people.name: Chử Hoài Sơn
people.role: Steward of the Cold Ford Hall's stores and boat lamps
people.appearance: A pleasantly blank face that gives nothing away.

people.name: Kiều Côn Bố
people.role: Captain of a port-house pill ship
people.appearance: Smells of fish and herbs together.

people.name: Ninh Ích Mẫu
people.role: Healer of the Green Door Day
people.appearance: A midwife's strong forearms.

people.name: Hà Ngải Diệp
people.role: Outer disciple whose life tree is slow
people.appearance: A dried mugwort sprig tucked behind one ear.

people.name: Cung Hoàng Tinh
people.role: Earth-rooted outer disciple from the Pivot's Thạch Kiều Thành
people.appearance: Red soil dried on his shins.

people.name: Tạ Kinh Giới
people.role: Outer disciple waiting on his First Leaf
people.appearance: Dark rings under his eyes from watering before dawn.

people.name: Cổ Thiên Môn
people.role: Oils the seat's halls with her brother
people.appearance: Oil-stained apron strings she retie constantly.

people.name: Lục Hương Phụ
people.role: Hộ Lâm Đường's head's niece in the outer gate
people.appearance: Her uncle's long jaw.

people.name: Khương Mạch Môn
people.role: Vương Phục Linh's cousin in the outer gate
people.appearance: Dimples she is annoyed at.

people.name: Lỗ Tiểu Điền
people.role: Lỗ Kiên's sister; Earth-rooted, from Lạc Hà's Ngũ Cốc Thành
people.appearance: A stiff, unbowed walk.

people.name: Đồng Tô Mộc
people.role: Spirit-wood raftsman
people.appearance: A bruise somewhere new every week.

people.name: Tôn Ngân Hoa
people.role: Helps keep the seat's spirit bees
people.appearance: A honey-sweet scent the bees find irresistible.

people.name: Đồ Hoàng Liên
people.role: The envoy's letter-runner
people.appearance: A quick, nervous glance over his shoulder.

people.name: Kế Tang Chi
people.role: Sits the nights of asking beside Hồng Mộc Hương
people.appearance: A head that nods at the quietest moments.

people.name: Sài Quế Chi
people.role: Furnace Hall fire-tender
people.appearance: A nose that twitches at every smell.

people.name: Vưu Thiên Ma
people.role: Array Hall junior
people.appearance: A coil of measuring cord always on her wrist.

people.name: Hình Hoàng Bá
people.role: Junior clerk of the Hall of Rules
people.appearance: Spotless hem edges even on the slope.

people.name: Lương Cốc Nha
people.role: Field Hall inner disciple
people.appearance: A wheat-gold plait to her waist.

people.name: Trì Kim Anh
people.role: Seed vault junior, born at the new seat
people.appearance: Pale as a cold jar in the seed vault.

people.name: Tào Phòng Phong
people.role: Cliff Hall disciple
people.appearance: A bow-legged climber's stance.

people.name: Bạc Thanh Hà
people.role: Cliff Hall disciple
people.appearance: A big gap-toothed grin on a plain, round face.

people.name: Đinh Tiểu Tùng
people.role: Kitchen servant of the Cliff Hall; the cook's grandson
people.appearance: Peeling-knife scars up the left forearm.

people.name: Ô Ngọc Trúc
people.role: Sweeps the founder's grave; the gatekeeper's daughter
people.appearance: Pine needles pressed into her braid.

people.name: Hàn Sơn Dược
people.role: Water-carrier of the cliff path
people.appearance: Short of breath after every flight of steps.

people.name: Vệ Lô Căn
people.role: Cold Ford outer disciple who cuts the salt-marsh dikes
people.appearance: Dike mud to the knees all year.

people.name: Nhiêu Lô Hoa
people.role: Cold Ford outer disciple
people.appearance: A fish-scale earring.

people.name: Ung Hàn Thảo
people.role: Võ Hàn Lô's disciple at the Cold Ford Hall
people.appearance: A steady gaze that skirts one stretch of river.

people.name: Lâu Mẫu Lệ
people.role: Deck hand on a port-house pill ship
people.appearance: A tuft of beard he is proud of.

people.name: Giả Mục Túc
people.role: Herder at the spirit cattle station
people.appearance: A cowherd's long stride.

people.name: Mộ Bạch Cập
people.role: Marten Yard junior
people.appearance: Sleepy marten kits peeking out of both cuffs.

people.name: Lam Cát Cánh
people.role: Came through the Green Door with a broken arm
people.appearance: A forearm set slightly crooked.

people.name: Chu Mộc Qua
people.role: Runner of the sect's pill shop in Lam Yên Thị
people.appearance: A pocket that clinks as he walks.

people.name: Tiêu Hoắc Hương
people.role: Healing House junior
people.appearance: A midwife's brisk, clean-nailed hands.

people.name: Cù Thúy Bách
people.role: Grand elder; keeper of the Cliff Hall on the old seat, the founder's grave and the founder's pine
people.appearance: Tall and bony, with hands cracked like bark and grey hair cut at the jaw; she wears the old ridge robe of undyed hemp, and it is dry, because she will not stand in the haze.
people.wants: To see her disciple Hoàn Cô Bách named heir, so the sect remembers what the ridge made it. Failing that, to be buried beside the founder and never moved.
people.secret: She nursed the founder's last century and watched her stiffen like bark, a Wood root starved on Metal ground. She believes the ridge shortened Phùng's life, and she has never said it, because saying it would mean the move was right.

people.name: Úy Thanh Diễm
people.role: Master of the Furnace Hall; keeper of the Green Furnace, the maker of Thúy Vi's pills
people.appearance: A lean man with soot in the creases of his knuckles and a green tint to his lips from three centuries of tasting pills.
people.wants: To brew the pill that killed Cao Đan Hà correctly, so that her last work is not a poison. For that he needs her Purple Smoke Furnace (Tử Yên Lô) from her lost abode.
people.secret: He knows what the pill was meant to do: carry a Nguyên Anh through the Hóa Thần tribulation. He believes he can make it, and he has told no one, least of all the head.

people.name: Hướng Dạ Đăng
people.role: Warden of the Cold Ford Hall at Hàn Tân Thành; the sect's hawk on the Tùng Đào border
people.appearance: A weathered, thick-necked man with a fisher's squint, a white scar through one eyebrow from the ice of 904, and the quay lamp hung at his hip, unlit by day.
people.wants: To push the border back to Lô Khẩu marsh and the old resin-tax villages, and to see his daughter head of the sect.
people.secret: In 1172 he caught a Tùng Đào patrol on the ice of the river mouth and put all six of them under it. The Pivot never heard, and Tùng Đào believes they deserted.

people.name: Diêm Hải Tảo
people.gloss: Diêm for the salt; hải tảo is sargassum, a seaweed in the herb book
people.role: Keeper of the port house at Yên Ba Thành: the sect's sea trade and the cape's coast
people.appearance: Short, brown and salt-cracked, with a sailor's rolling walk, a whale-cast brass lock on a cord at her throat and a laugh that carries across a harbour.
people.wants: To find her father's sabre Kình Nha at the ruin of Thôn Hải Môn far in the south (place 217), and to learn whether the chest was left for her or only with her.
people.secret: The chest of salt had a false bottom. Inside was a sea chart of the southern islands in Ô Kình Hải's hand. She has kept it for four hundred years and never sailed it.

people.name: Thiệu Thanh Đài
people.gloss: Green moss (Vương Duy: the returning light shines again on the green moss)
people.role: The head's true disciple and the sect's best healer-grower; holds the first plot of the Heir's Garden
people.appearance: Slight and soft-spoken, with grey-green eyes and her sleeves always rolled; a mirror furred with moss hangs at her waist.
people.wants: To keep the sect as her master made it, quiet and green, whether or not she is the one who leads it.
people.secret: She does not want to be head. She planted moss so that she would lose, and she is afraid her disciple has guessed.

people.name: Hoàn Cô Bách
people.role: The grand elder's true disciple and the Cliff Hall's champion; holds the second plot of the Heir's Garden
people.appearance: Tall and hard-faced, burnt dark by the ridge wind, with a cypress banner-pole across his back and hands calloused from cutting stone.
people.wants: To be named heir and bring the sect's heart back up the mountain, or at least the inner gate's teaching.
people.secret: He is afraid of the haze. As a boy he was lost in it on the slope for a night and nearly drowned in a ditch, and the ridge is the only place he can breathe. He has never told Cù.

people.name: Tất Hành Vụ
people.role: Master of the Array Hall; the elder who taught the Haze Walk away
people.appearance: A wiry old man who walks fast and talks faster, with array chalk on his cuffs.
people.wants: To hear the Haze Walk's ninth layer read correctly by someone other than himself before he dies.
people.secret: He is teaching the ninth layer in pieces to his granddaughter Tất Quế Lạc, folded into her chalk drills, and has told the Array Hall it is only a game.

people.name: Khổng Đương Quy
people.gloss: Angelica; the herb's name means 'ought to return'
people.role: Keeper of the Herb Gardens and of Bách Thảo Viện's books
people.appearance: Small and stooped, always smelling of angelica root, with a burn scar along one cheek from 932.
people.wants: A shed of Bách Thảo Viện rebuilt, with its books under one roof.
people.secret: She replants the academy's lost herbs in rows across Quyền Thanh Lam's fields, among what he takes for weeds, and he has begun to plough around them without a word.

people.name: Nhạc Chính Hành
people.role: Master of the Hall of Rules; ridge-trained, called the Avalanche
people.appearance: Square, unsmiling and grey at the temples; he stands very straight and speaks in the fewest words he can.
people.wants: A sect where no exception is left to renew.
people.secret: Every decade he signs the Hall's exception for Quản Ảnh Hồ without reading it, the one rule he bends, because he cannot bring himself to ask what her mirror method does.

people.name: Lô Dã Hương
people.role: Keeper of the Marten Yard on Ngân Điêu Đài, where silver martens are bred to find spirit herbs
people.appearance: Sharp-faced and quick, with a fur collar that turns out to be a live silver marten asleep.
people.wants: A pup in her line that finds a ginseng a thousand years old.
people.secret: She sells Hồng Lô Cốc pups she has quietly spayed, so that no vassal ever breeds its own silver marten line.

people.name: Biện Vãn Tình
people.role: The sect's envoy to the Pivot, the vassals and Tùng Đào
people.appearance: Elegant and quick-eyed, in a robe cut in the Tùng Đào fashion and dyed Thúy Vi green.
people.wants: A peace so long that her letters are the only thing crossing the border.
people.secret: She tells Hồ Tùng Nguyệt the dates of the warden's winter drills so that Tùng Đào's patrols stay off the ice, and calls it keeping the peace.

people.name: Lã Trác Thạch
people.role: Guest elder for refining: jade-cutter, needle-smith and furnace-mender at Bích Ngọc Khoáng
people.appearance: Grey with stone dust and thick in the wrist, missing the last finger of his left hand to a jade saw.
people.wants: A jade seam without a flaw, and one seal cut from it that he would never sell.
people.secret: He is slipping jade pill needles, which bend, in among the steel ones to see whether the Furnace Hall notices; Úy Thanh Diễm tastes every batch and has so far said nothing.

people.name: Dư Tục Đoạn
people.gloss: Teasel root; the herb's name means 'rejoins what is broken'
people.role: Elder of the Healing House at Lam Yên Thị; the sect's bone-setter and the Green Door Day's healer
people.appearance: A long-armed, gentle man with a healer's satchel and green-stained fingertips.
people.wants: A Green Door Day every day of the month.
people.secret: He fills the poor's satchels on the Green Door Day with the Furnace Hall's wound pills from his own stock, and Tề Tử Tô has begun to count the shortfall in her batches.

people.name: Âu Dương Thanh Lô
people.role: The first Furnace Master and the founder's Dao partner; wrote the Green Furnace Canon
people.cause: killed at Bách Thảo Viện when a cauldron of untamed pill fire burst (V029)

people.name: Hướng Đông Lâm
people.role: The first Warden of the Cold Ford
people.cause: fell on the quay of Hàn Tân when Tùng Đào took the Cold Ford (C136)

people.name: Tân Hàn Chu
people.role: Led the sect's boats in the Cold Ford War
people.cause: drowned under the river-mouth ice leading the last attack of the Cold Ford War

people.name: Giản Chiếu Thanh
people.role: Head of Minh Kính Đường, the sect's branch hall on the forest river
people.cause: killed by his own tribulation breaking through to Nguyên Anh (V033)

people.name: Mẫn Triều Âm
people.role: Keeper of Lam Triều Các, the sect's coast pavilion
people.cause: killed when Thôn Hải's pirates burned Lam Triều Các (V010)

people.name: Bốc Kình Thăng
people.role: Captain of the third whaleboat; the first to take Ngạc's new iron
people.appearance: Shouts as if over a gale, even indoors.

people.name: Đậu Thủy Lăng
people.role: Diver of the seal inlet; learns the palm from Phí Nhạn Tâm
people.appearance: Seal-fur gloves she wears even in summer.

people.name: Bốc Hải Đồng
people.role: Bốc Kình Thăng's son; bails the third boat
people.appearance: A notched ear where the winter dive caught him.

people.name: Kim Hải Yến
people.role: Seal-oil boiler's daughter of the Sóc Phương families
people.appearance: The smell of rendered oil follows her through every door.

people.name: Lam Nhạn Thanh
people.role: Novice of the palm hall, raised at the ruin of Tê Nhạn Quán
people.appearance: Duck down clings to his hair from the ruin.

people.name: Cố Lãng Hoa
people.role: Harpooner in Ngạc's boat; wants the bow seat on the day of the calf
people.appearance: Her throwing arm is a hand's width thicker than the other.

people.name: Đổng Thoa
people.role: Đổng Võng's sister; mends the whaleboats' lines
people.appearance: A splicing callus on her thumb as big as a coin.

people.name: Phí Nhạn Tâm
people.gloss: A goose's heart (that always flies home)
people.role: Elder of the terrace; the last monk of Tê Nhạn Quán and keeper of its palm
people.appearance: A bald, bony monk in a fisher's oilskin, who fingers goose-bone beads while gutting fish.
people.wants: The halls of Tê Nhạn Quán roofed again before he dies, and the geese left in them undisturbed.
people.secret: He feeds the geese in the ruin three sacks of terrace grain a month, entered in the store book as seal feed, and the steward Bào Thiết Thủ has begun to wonder why the seals are so fat.

people.name: Đoàn Tố Ba
people.role: The head's daughter; best diver on the terrace, who rows the sixth boat with her divers
people.appearance: Long-armed and sea-browned, with salt-white hair she has had since she was twenty.
people.wants: To dive under the ice shelf where no one has gone, and to make the sixth boat the only crew on the coast that is not for sale.
people.secret: She has taken Kim Hải Yến into the dark-of-the-moon dives, against the old rule that the sixth boat's divers be terrace-born, and tells her father the crew is as it was.

people.name: Ngạc Hải Tiêu
people.role: Harpoon captain of the terrace's whaleboats
people.appearance: A big whaler from the Whale Bone Village with a harpoon scar from cheek to collarbone.
people.wants: A name on the coast above Đoàn Thanh Lãng's, and the head's seat before the calf is grown.
people.secret: He has promised each captain a new hull from the calf's second half and is counting votes for the next council, where he means to put the head ashore for the cut line of 1080.

people.name: Lỗ Châu Nương
people.role: Pearl diver; the monk's disciple
people.appearance: One seed pearl in her left ear, the only one she has never sold.

people.name: Bào Thiết Thủ
people.role: Boat-master of the terrace; was in the boat in 1080
people.appearance: Tar-black fingernails and a forearm scarred by a hundred splinters.

people.name: Nghê Tiểu Lãng
people.role: Harpooner in Ngạc's boat
people.appearance: Two toes lost to frostbite, which he shows to new crew.

people.name: Tân Bạch Âu
people.role: Outer disciple descended from the White Gull hall
people.appearance: A fresh gull feather in her braid each week.

people.name: Đổng Võng
people.role: Net-maker's son in the outer gate
people.appearance: Net-twine calluses and a yawn that never quite finishes.

people.name: Quản Tiểu Kình
people.role: Ngạc's nephew in the outer gate
people.appearance: Flinches at every harpoon crack; keeps his pale hands out of the spray.

people.name: Vu Bích Triều
people.role: Diver; Đoàn Tố Ba's disciple
people.appearance: Freckles across her nose like seal whiskers.

people.name: Khuất Thanh Anh
people.role: Founder of Trạc Anh Đài (830)
people.cause: dragged under by the white whale Old Ivory off the terrace, at 290

people.name: Chung Quy Nhạn
people.role: Last abbot of Tê Nhạn Quán; elder of the terrace (1095-1160)
people.cause: end of his years, sitting on the terrace facing the marsh, at 340

people.name: Lã Đoán Cương
people.role: Second smith of the forge at Tẩy Kiếm Tuyền
people.appearance: Missing the last two fingers of his left hand, which he calls his tithe.

people.name: Ninh Hà Viễn
people.role: Caravan lieutenant to Bàng Trấn Nhạc on the Hồi Lan road
people.appearance: He counts under his breath, even the steps of a stair.

people.name: Lã Tinh Nhi
people.role: Lã Đoán Cương's daughter; works the forge bellows
people.appearance: Eyebrows shaved to stubble, one nicked into a permanent question.

people.name: Ổ Sa Hổ
people.role: Night-watch caravan guard; Ổ Sa Nhi's brother
people.appearance: A nose broken twice, set once.

people.name: Nghiêm Sa Lộ
people.role: Outrider of the watch at Đà Linh
people.appearance: Chewed pen-ends tucked behind both ears.

people.name: Khúc Đăng Hà
people.role: Trường Vân lamp-seller's son who dusts the cup shelf
people.appearance: Wax-yellow fingertips from the lamp trade.

people.name: Cam Diêm Nhi
people.role: Cam Thiết Bình's sister; cooks at the long table
people.appearance: Salt-white scars across both palms from the pans.

people.name: Tống Thối Kim
people.role: Master smith of Trấn Sa Đường and the Pavilion's sword-smith; keeps the forge at Tẩy Kiếm Tuyền
people.appearance: A short, burn-speckled old smith with forearms like temple bells and no eyebrows.
people.wants: One blade he can call finished before his hands fail, and a hall that never has to draw it in the head's war.
people.secret: He tempers every tenth blade of the hall's war order a hair too soft, and has told no one, so that Viên Cô Yên's war would break its own swords in the first week.

people.name: Bàng Trấn Nhạc
people.role: Caravan captain of the hall; the head's husband
people.appearance: A big, slow-spoken man who never draws his sabre first and always draws it second.
people.wants: To keep the hall from war until his wife's hair is white, and then walk the Hồi Lan road with her unarmed.
people.secret: He sends Ô Liệt Phong the hall's rota two days ahead, by Cam Thiết Bình's hand and behind his wife's back, so that the one honest Dạ Quang train never meets a trap of Viên Cô Yên's making.

people.name: Nhiếp Cô Đăng
people.role: The hall's watcher on Dạ Quang's escorts
people.appearance: A thin rider who travels alone with one lamp and a book of every camp Dạ Quang's escorts have made since 1125.
people.wants: To end her days at a lamp's distance from the one honest man on the road, and never to write the last page of the watch.
people.secret: She keeps two watch-books: the true one, which clears Ô Liệt Phong, and the one she carries to Viên Cô Yên, which still suspects him, so the watch is never ended.

people.name: Võ Kình Sơn
people.role: Striker at the forge; cousin of a Pavilion outer disciple
people.appearance: Left thumbnail gone black from a missed strike.

people.name: Mễ Tiểu Chùy
people.role: The master smith's apprentice
people.appearance: Walks to the beat of the bellows.

people.name: Vi Sa Yến
people.role: Inner guard from the sheep sheds
people.appearance: A front tooth knocked out by a ram, which she shows off as a trophy.

people.name: Viên Tiểu Yên
people.role: The head's niece and ward
people.appearance: Ink under her fingernails from letters written by the last lamp.

people.name: Cam Thiết Bình
people.role: Outer guard from the salt-boiling village
people.appearance: Salt-cracked heels and a shield strap he has worn through twice.

people.name: Đàm Trì Mã
people.role: Outrider for the watcher
people.appearance: A horsehair braid at his collar and a voice that carries a li.

people.name: Viên Trường Hà
people.gloss: The long river (Vương Duy: trường hà lạc nhật viên)
people.role: Caravan-guard captain of Trường Vân; father of Viên Cô Yên
people.cause: killed by Dạ Quang raiders below Viên Đề Hạp, a night-glow cup left on his chest, at 60

people.name: Đào Lương Khê
people.role: Sluice-keeper of the flood terraces; keeps the rain book's copy
people.appearance: Speaks with a lisp on her sibilants; a sluice key hangs on a cord at her neck.

people.name: Chiêm Dạ Tuần
people.role: Walks the rat fence at night
people.appearance: Eyes that stay wide open in daylight; a rat-bite scar across the back of his left hand.

people.name: Phó Tống Thực
people.role: Drives the seed cart on the tribute road
people.appearance: Road song always half-hummed; counts the carts on his fingers and loses the count by the fourth.

people.name: Ứng Sơ Hoa
people.role: The heir's only disciple; carries his harvest knives
people.appearance: Soot-dark fingertips from her Fire practice; the satchel of knives clinks at every step.

people.name: Diêu Lãng Nhi
people.role: Terrace hand from Bích Lãng
people.appearance: Salt-cracked heels; squints at the horizon like a girl still waiting for a boat.

people.name: Ngô Lê Thạch
people.role: Servant ploughman from the ridge
people.appearance: Limps from an ox-kick; mud caked in one ear.

people.name: Chu Thu Điền
people.role: Hand on the lower rows
people.appearance: Ledger pencil behind his ear; he pats his grain-town belly before every question.

people.name: Úy Thương Điền
people.role: Elder of the Water Fields (Thủy Điền), the flood terraces below the grove; keeper of the garden's rain record
people.appearance: A lean, sun-dark woman with her trousers rolled to the thigh and a gourd at her hip, who looks at the sky before she looks at anyone.
people.wants: One fallow year for the grove, before the land and the rats decide it for them.
people.secret: Since 1150 she has kept a second grove at Tử Trúc Lâm, grown from old sixty-year seed she saved before 1050, against the day the head's grove fails. Planting it says she expects him to fail, so she has never told him.

people.name: Mẫn Tiết Thanh
people.role: The head's true disciple and expected heir; runs the seed harvest
people.appearance: Quiet, with green-stained fingers, he stands with his weight on one leg like a heron.
people.wants: The censer in his own hands one spring, and to learn what test he failed.
people.secret: Nights, he warms a seedbed in the lower rows with hot kitchen bricks, trying to seed bamboo without Fire; three rows have sprouted, and Ứng Sơ Hoa, who carries his knives, has seen the ash.

people.name: Khuất Liệp Nguyên
people.role: Rat warden of Trúc Thử Nguyên, the bamboo rats' plain three tiles from the garden
people.appearance: Wiry and homely in a rat-skin cloak, missing the tip of his nose to a bamboo rat the size of a dog.
people.wants: A count of rats the head must answer to, and the hawk-keeper's debt cleared by spring.
people.secret: He is not culling the northern runs: the hawk-keeper of Bách Vũ pays by the sack, so he hands Úy Thương Điền the alarming count and keeps the rats fat.

people.name: Sầm Đạo Hương
people.role: Carries the seed tribute to Hoàng Vân Thành and the Wutong Court each autumn
people.appearance: A tidy woman in a blue travelling coat, always smelling of cooked rice, who knows everyone's name at the granary gate.
people.wants: A seat in the Hall of Benevolence, and to be the one the palace hears the garden's news from.
people.secret: She has told Từ Cam Tuyền at the palace that the head's seed will fail, and is selling the rest of the story one cart at a time to find what the palace will pay to hear it first.

people.name: Kha Tùng Canh
people.role: Steward of the lower bamboo rows; father of Kha Thanh Miêu, now at the palace
people.appearance: Brass ring of row keys at his belt; his chin lifts whenever his daughter is named.

people.name: Ân Cốc Vũ
people.gloss: Grain Rain, the spring solar term
people.role: Úy Thương Điền's inner disciple; tends her hidden grove at Tử Trúc Lâm
people.appearance: Moss-green sleeves; stops dead mid-step to listen to something no one else hears.

people.name: Tần Tiểu Duẩn
people.role: Outer disciple; Mẫn Tiết Thanh's first disciple
people.appearance: Zither-string grooves cut across both index fingers; a ponytail pulled tight enough to lift her eyebrows.

people.name: Lý Bích Ba
people.role: Outer disciple of the Water Fields; works the sluices
people.appearance: Brick-red from the terrace sun; white sluice-rope scars circle both wrists.

people.name: Yên Mạch Nhi
people.role: Outer disciple on the rat plain; Khuất Liệp Nguyên's ward
people.appearance: Rat-bite scars up one forearm; a stare that never leaves a trap.

people.name: Phí Đông Canh
people.role: Old servant ploughman of the garden
people.appearance: One milky eye; a plough-handle callus the size of an egg.

people.name: Ông Lục Tiết
people.role: Founder of Trúc Thực Viên (760); a palace outer disciple who never passed the Feather Kindling
people.cause: died in the garden at 215, of the meridian scars of his forty-one Feather Kindlings

people.name: Tất Mạn Thu
people.role: Second head of Trúc Thực Viên (905-1050); wrote the Sixty-Year Flower
people.cause: died in the flowering of 1050, at 230, when the old grove bloomed and died

people.name: Cảnh Dạ Tuần
people.role: Stablemaster of the wardens' hall and its mule-doctor; a Pivot-born caravan driver
people.appearance: Whip scar round one wrist, a bell-clapper charm at his neck.

people.name: Từ Tiễn Sương
people.role: Tracker of the Bạch Lang road; reads wolf sign
people.appearance: One ear missing its lobe; she crouches to smell the ground.

people.name: Đoàn Bất Miên
people.role: Outer warden from Phạt Mộc; walks the night watch
people.appearance: Sunburnt nose, blister-hard right hand, and he talks to the dark.

people.name: Hứa Tịch Vân
people.role: Inner warden; the timber magistrate's daughter, who ran from Tùng Gian to her uncle's hall
people.appearance: Her magistrate's good green silk is patched twice at the knee with hall cloth.

people.name: Lâm Tiểu Tiễn
people.role: Outer warden from Bạch Lang; a tracker in training
people.appearance: Keeps licking her chapped lips; the wolf's-tooth necklace is too big for her.

people.name: Khâu Toán Lộ
people.role: Inner warden of the counting-house; counts caravan fees and walks the roads he counts
people.appearance: A bone abacus in his sleeve, and chalk dust on his boots.

people.name: Hoàng Thiết Huyền
people.role: Outer warden in the shooting yard
people.appearance: Bowstring grooves across two fingers, four wolf-tail tassels at his belt, and he cannot sit through a meal.

people.name: Trang Thiết Cước
people.role: Elder and treasurer; the Pivot caravan master who lost his wagons to the wolves and paid for the hall
people.appearance: A stout, bow-legged trader in a Pivot coat, with a camel bell on his belt that he rings when he laughs.
