people.wants: The wagon of 1190 left unnamed, and the hall paying its own way before his silver runs out.
people.secret: He pays the hall's shortfall each winter from his own silver. This autumn he paid a Pivot caravan for a driver's leg and wrote it down as a wolf bite, without asking how the wolves got near the wagons.

people.name: Diêm Lạc Nhạn
people.role: Master of the bow; a hunter of the northern woods who shot beside the head on the third night
people.appearance: A small, weathered woman in wolfskin, with an eagle on her shoulder and three wolf ears on a cord at her belt.
people.wants: Every wolf of the new pack dead, the wolf-king's pelt on the hall's wall, and the head's rule gone.
people.secret: She pays the outer wardens a pelt from her own share for every wolf they bring in shot from behind, against the head's rule. This autumn, three days out of Tùng Hạ on the Bạch Lang road, it cost a mule-driver his leg.

people.name: Lạc Tùng Lang
people.role: Warden of the Bạch Lang road; wears his village's wolf-tooth charm
people.appearance: Holds a healed arm a little stiff; a wolf-tooth charm hangs on a cord.
people.wants: For Diêm Lạc Nhạn to stop paying for running wolves before he has to choose between her and the head.
people.secret: He knows from the arrow he cut out of the wolf that Diêm pays the outer wardens for running wolves, and what it cost the driver; he has shown it to no one.

people.name: Lý Hành Lộ
people.role: The head's disciple; a market boy of Tùng Hạ Thị
people.appearance: Big ears, a water-carrier's stoop, and he answers a question a breath after you have asked another.

people.name: Vương Tiều Nhi
people.role: Outer warden from the woodcutters' village
people.appearance: Sawdust forever in her hair; she stands flat and easy, like a woodcutter at a log.

people.name: Trang Tiểu Đà
people.role: Outer warden; the caravan master's nephew
people.appearance: A camel bell on his belt as unmarked as new silver, and a Pivot coat a size too fine.

people.name: Liễu Khê Nhi
people.role: Inner warden born across the Ngư Ca border in Lạc Hà's land
people.appearance: A Lạc Hà river-knot tucked in her sleeve, which she hides when anyone looks.

people.name: Sầm Thanh Tùng
people.role: Inner warden from the village of the green pines
people.appearance: Pine resin on his sleeves, and a green needle sewn to his collar.

people.name: Doanh Thủ Lộ
people.role: Caravan guard and Hứa Vãn Cung's sworn brother; the hall counts him as its first warden
people.cause: killed by the wolves on the second night of the Tùng Hạ road, at 50 (A064)
people.appearance: Remembered on the road as a big lantern-jawed man with a bow-stiffened hand, buried under a pine.

people.name: Nhiếp Vãn Đào
people.role: True disciple of the Coiled Root Hall and Nhiếp Cô Tân's granddaughter; the inner gate's best duellist
people.appearance: A tall, sharp-faced young woman in a patrolman's short coat, with a black flying blade across her back that was her father's.
people.wants: Her father's name sung in the war roll with the bridges he cut, and any war the sect fights fought in the open.
people.secret: She found her grandfather's patrol order of 1172 among his things: the only written order the Coiled Root Hall has sent out in a century, because it had to cross the river. It carries his seal and not the head's. She has not told him, and she has not burned it.

people.name: Sử Trường Ngâm
people.role: Keeper of the spoken chronicle in the Hall of Voices
people.appearance: A thin, bald man with a voice much deeper than his body, who moves his lips while he listens.
people.wants: To sing the whole chronicle once and find a successor who will not leave a night out.
people.secret: He is adding a private verse about the sleepers of Tùng Phong to the chronicle's nine days, and no one has noticed it yet.

people.name: Tuyên Bích Hà
people.role: Steward of the outer gate at Tùng Hạ Thị; keeper of the inner gate's Wood test
people.appearance: A brisk woman with a pine-cone hairpin and a voice that carries across a whole yard without being raised.
people.wants: To have Trình Văn Thanh heard by someone who can use him before the Root Hall hears of him first.
people.secret: She teaches the outer gate's children a second primer in rhymes of her own because the first bores them, which the first elder would call writing.

people.name: Xa Trọng Sơn
people.role: Patrolman of the Coiled Root Hall; the seventh man of 1172
people.appearance: A heavy, quiet man with a drinker's red nose, a patrolman's token he never takes off, and a new bruise every week from things that fall on him.
people.wants: To get through one dusk listening sober and say what he heard.
people.secret: Once a month he sends Thôi Khinh Hồng a drunken letter by Yến Thu Hồng's tea-boy, telling what the order in the reed camp said.

people.name: Hách Mộc Sinh
people.role: Coiled Root Hall patrolman
people.appearance: Talks at cattle-pen pitch even indoors, so the whole mess knows when he is coming.

people.name: Trần Bách Xuyên
people.role: Patrol captain of the pine-sea roads
people.appearance: Tests every bowstring against his puckered left ear before he trusts it.

people.name: Đàm Lưu Ba
people.role: Ferry captain of the River Hall at Cổ Độ
people.appearance: Her laugh carries across the river; passengers grip the rail when she brings the ferry round.

people.name: Hoàng Đê Sinh
people.role: Flood warden of the River Hall
people.appearance: Carries a flood-mark rod and leans on it only when he thinks no one is watching.

people.name: Đặng Hoành Giang
people.role: The River Hall's man at Lãng Đào Môn
people.appearance: Stoops as if still bent over a gold-washer's pan; people say he walks like a man looking for something dropped.

people.name: Phương Ngọc Sa
people.role: The Lake Hall's pearl tallier at Hàm Nguyệt Trang
people.appearance: A tally-cord wound round her wrist; she counts the people in a room before she speaks.

people.name: Lăng Ngư Đăng
people.role: Lake Hall inner disciple
people.appearance: One bright ribbon in an otherwise plain braid; she smells of lamp-oil and lake fish.

people.name: Khuông Hàn Ly
people.role: First hand of the Array Hall, Cận Tùng Hàn's chosen successor
people.appearance: A narrow-faced woman who draws array lines in the air with one finger while she talks.
people.wants: To be asked to lay a road that holds one person, not a patrol, and to be left the hall without having to use it.
people.secret: She lays the river-mouth crossing flag by flag exactly as Cận Tùng Hàn retunes it, marking each flag in a private sign to learn which breaks first; Tạ Chuẩn Thằng (ta_chuan_thang) has seen the signs and means to tell Nhiếp.

people.name: Hồng Mặc Kỳ
people.role: Array Hall inner disciple
people.appearance: One shoe always untied, and go-stone chalk follows him about like weather.

people.name: Thi Mộc Hương
people.role: Incense maker at Lãnh Hương Viện
people.appearance: Agarwood smoke clings to her so thickly that the palace cats trail after.

people.name: Nhâm Thu Lãng
people.role: The Tide Rite's only disciple
people.appearance: Repeats every instruction under his breath, twice, and still asks again; his stammer eases only near water.

people.name: Cát Linh Thảo
people.role: Pill Room inner disciple
people.appearance: Fringe singed short; she hums the same three notes at the first furnace.

people.name: Hầu Thiện Kế
people.role: Resin clerk in Tùng Gian Thành
people.appearance: Tilts his ledger away from anyone passing, thumb gilded with resin.

people.name: Đồng Kiên Thạch
people.role: Fence-walker of the grey pine vein
people.appearance: Chalks a mark on his wrist at every fence post, as he has seen the surveyors do.

people.name: Cổ Lục Sơn
people.role: Warden of the malachite mine of Thạch Lục Khoáng
people.appearance: Malachite dust has turned his beard green at the roots.

people.name: Trịnh Ức Vân
people.role: The envoy's disciple; a survivor of Đoạn Vân Viện
people.appearance: A composed woman with a white streak in her hair from the night the cliff fell.
people.wants: To hear her mother's voice answer a name that is not hers, and to know what the rubble says.
people.secret: She writes the names the cliff answers to on flat pebbles and buries three each spring under the green pines with Hứa Niệm Tùng (hua_niem_tung), so the dead of Đoạn Vân Viện have a roll of their own.

people.name: Vu Hành Lâm
people.role: The Coiled Root Hall's man at Tuần Tùng Đường
people.appearance: His smile arrives a moment after everyone else's has gone.

people.name: Yến Thu Hồng
people.role: Thôi Khinh Hồng's last disciple and only attendant at the retreat
people.appearance: A grey-haired woman in an apron, who sweeps pine needles off the retreat's steps three times a day and sits on the top one between sweeps.
people.wants: To see her master take one step of the Startled Goose without a cough.
people.secret: She waters the retreat's youngest pine with her own tea each night, and it has begun to answer her; she has told no one, least of all Thôi Khinh Hồng, who has listened five hundred years for it.

people.name: Tống Ngôn Hòa
people.role: Letter-carrier to the vassals
people.appearance: Sleeps with the satchel in his arms like a child with a doll.

people.name: Lâm Điêu Bách
people.role: Woodcarver who mends the palace halls
people.appearance: Hums to the grain while he carves, and stops when watched.

people.name: Phù Liên Châu
people.role: The first elder's go-between in the market
people.appearance: Counts you with her eyes, the way a market woman counts coin.

people.name: Ngô Tố Âm
people.role: Vi Thanh Âm's disciple
people.appearance: Walks as if carrying a full bowl, even when her hands are empty.

people.name: Lư Chỉ Mặc
people.role: Tùng Đào's man at Sương Tùng Các
people.appearance: Birch-bark curls cling to his clothes wherever he goes.

people.name: Khang Tẩy Kim
people.role: The River Hall's steward at Đào Sa Thị; owes her life to a ma đạo fugitive
people.appearance: A sun-darkened woman with gold dust in the creases of her knuckles and a red thread tied round one wrist.
people.wants: To repay the red-robed woman's debt in a coin Triệu Huyết Y cannot refuse.
people.secret: She hides a hurt ma-đạo man in the Đào Sa reed beds, as the woman once hid her, and feeds him on the gold-washers' rice; Ông Khổ Sâm (ong_kho_sam) has noticed missing sacks and thinks they went to the dikes.

people.name: Lương Tạc Băng
people.role: Lake Hall inner disciple; the loudest voice for a Water gate
people.appearance: A big-shouldered woman in an ice-cutter's leather apron who speaks to elders as if they were across a frozen lake, and never sits out a whole council.
people.wants: A Water inner gate at Noãn Ốc, taught the Rain on the Pine Sea canon.
people.secret: She teaches the canon's first verse to the lake children at the ice-cutting, which is forbidden; Úc Hàm Ba (uc_ham_ba) holds the lamp.

people.name: Mạc Thằng Kiều
people.role: Rope-hand of the Coiled Root Hall; held the windlass line on the last Ngư Ca bridge in 1174
people.appearance: Rope-burn lines run across both palms; he coils any cord he picks up without noticing.

people.name: Trình Văn Thanh
people.role: Outer disciple who hears more in the pines than the primer says
people.appearance: A skinny woodcutter's boy with sap on his sleeves who turns his head toward the trees in the middle of a sentence.
people.wants: To hear the pines say the whole of what they say, and to find someone who will write it down.
people.secret: He hums the pines' longer phrase to himself on the hill each night and has begun to hear it answered from further up; Kha Lâm Đông (kha_lam_dong) follows him and swears he hears nothing.

people.name: Lăng Tiểu Lãng
people.role: Outer disciple from the lake
people.appearance: Wears a fish scale on one cheek like a beauty mark and has given up washing it off.

people.name: Cổ Hôi Thiết
people.role: Outer disciple at the malachite mine
people.appearance: Keeps the low, slow miner's stoop even across open yards.

people.name: Địch Tiểu Hổ
people.role: Young inner disciple of the Coiled Root Hall
people.appearance: A tiger-claw charm hangs at his neck, and he taps it whenever he says the word tiger.

people.name: Đàm Tiểu Độ
people.role: Ferry girl of the Đàm family
people.appearance: Freckled to the hairline, and calls out the fare before anyone has asked.

people.name: Hoàng Thủy Hộ
people.role: Outer disciple of the River Hall
people.appearance: Long-jawed, blotchy, ears set too low; even his father's friends pat his shoulder and look elsewhere. He sniffs the air before rain, and is right.

people.name: Thi Uyển Yên
people.role: Incense Hall inner disciple
people.appearance: Smells faintly of agarwood since birth; a pale censer-spark mark on one cheek.

people.name: Phan Ba Sinh
people.role: Inner disciple at the Tide Rite
people.appearance: Does not shiver at midwinter; salt crusts his eyebrows.

people.name: Khâu Hạnh Nhi
people.role: Pill Room sweeper
people.appearance: A broom taller than she is; she wipes her hands on her hair.

people.name: Lỗ Phủ Sinh
people.role: Outer disciple from the woodcutters' village
people.appearance: Answers every question a beat late, as though the words had to walk to him.

people.name: Lâm Thanh Mộc
people.role: Woodcarver's apprentice
people.appearance: Wood shavings in her hair at supper, and in bed.

people.name: Tôn Mạch Sinh
people.role: Granary guard at Lâm Hạ Trấn
people.appearance: A nibbled crust always rides in his pocket; grain dust in his hair.

people.name: Mã Lang Nha
people.role: Outer disciple riding with the road wardens
people.appearance: Rides with the whip uncoiled across his saddle; a wolf-tooth charm at his throat.

people.name: Ninh Hàn Chi
people.role: Outer disciple who was refused by Ngạo Tuyết Phái
people.appearance: Touches the plum-blossom scar on her forearm whenever she is angry.

people.name: Hứa Niệm Tùng
people.role: Young inner disciple who tends the pines of the dead
people.appearance: A sapling cutting wrapped in damp cloth rides in his pack.

people.name: Giáp Tân Hồi
people.role: Inner disciple of the Coiled Root Hall; the governor's descendant
people.appearance: Wears the clan-seal ring turned inward; stands as if a roll were being read over him.

people.name: Lục Tiểu Tuyền
people.role: Outer disciple at the Lake Hall
people.appearance: Towels over both shoulders, and a little steam always rising off her.

people.name: Bạch Lộc Sinh
people.role: Outer disciple from the reindeer herders
people.appearance: Wears the antler-button coat everywhere, in the lowlands too.

people.name: Tiền Thế Lâm
people.role: Inner disciple in the resin trade
people.appearance: A pocket abacus on a cord, clicking as he walks.

people.name: Sài Tiểu Đông
people.role: New outer disciple from the river towns
people.appearance: Cannot stand still through a speech; a coin-sized hole is burned through his sleeve.

people.name: Đoàn Tiểu Cầm
people.role: Young inner disciple of the Hall of Voices
people.appearance: Chews the end of her braid between sentences.

people.name: Thạch Định Nhi
people.role: Young inner disciple of the Array Hall
people.appearance: A measuring rope round her waist like a belt.

people.name: Bành Táo Nhi
people.role: Stove boy of the palace kitchen (servant)
people.appearance: Something breaks within arm's reach of him most days: today a bowl, yesterday the ladle.

people.name: Kiều Hàn Nguyệt
people.role: Hàm Nguyệt Trang's pledge at the Lake Hall
people.appearance: Gloved in midsummer; her fingertips frost the cup she holds.

people.name: Liễu Đình Sương
people.role: Steward of the listening terrace; lights the Pine-Heart Censer at dawn and dusk
people.appearance: Envoys stop mid-sentence under her stare.

people.name: Mạnh Kiên Căn
people.role: Coiled Root Hall patrolman; rode the relief to the river-mouth ice in 1172
people.appearance: Always sits facing the door; a mule-kick has flattened his chin.

people.name: Lộ Thanh Ngạn
people.role: Dike warden of the River Hall at Đào Thanh Thành; sister of a patrolman listed as a deserter
people.appearance: Dike mud on her hem even at the feast.

people.name: Úc Hàm Ba
people.role: Lake Hall inner disciple who passed the Wood test by one point
people.appearance: Blows a bone whistle at the ice-edge each dawn.

people.name: Tạ Chuẩn Thằng
people.role: Array Hall inner disciple; lays the sluice wards at Đào Thanh
people.appearance: Checks his own sleeves for lint before he checks anyone's work.

people.name: Viên Khổ Sâm
people.role: Pill Room inner disciple; keeps the only chimney under the canopy
people.appearance: Wears a chimney brush in her belt like a sword.

people.name: Mẫn Lục Yên
people.role: Incense Hall inner disciple; rolls the sticks that time the listening
people.appearance: Holds each incense stick to the light and sniffs it before she rolls the next.

people.name: Phí Hàn Châm
people.role: Fence-walker of the grey pine vein; counts Thiên Xu's surveyors
people.appearance: A cord of knots round his neck, one for every boot print he has found.

people.name: Đới Thạch Tâm
people.role: Root-listener at the malachite mine; says where a gallery may be dug
people.appearance: One ear pressed flat from lying on mine floors.

people.name: Tề Thương Mãn
people.role: Granary clerk of the steward's office at Lâm Hạ Trấn
people.appearance: Jingles his key ring when he lies; rice powder on his sleeves.

people.name: Hà Vọng Tân
people.role: Envoy's rider to Lãng Đào Môn and Tuần Tùng Đường
people.appearance: Scribbles in a notebook at every inn, in boots that never match.

people.name: Lã Truyền Thanh
people.role: Chants the primer to the outer gate at Tùng Hạ Thị, line by line
people.appearance: Voice hoarse from ninety years of chanting the primer.

people.name: Giáp Lệ Hàn
people.role: Keeps the Coiled Root Hall's roll of the Cold Ford families
people.appearance: A ledger-clip hangs at her belt where a knife would; the clan's thin straight nose.

people.name: Dư Phong Ngạn
people.role: Sluice keeper of the River Hall's lower gates at Đào Thanh Thành
people.appearance: Counts villages off on his fingers while others talk of other things.

people.name: Phó Tĩnh Ngôn
people.role: The second voice of the spoken chronicle, learning it from Sử Trường Ngâm
people.appearance: Hair cropped like a grave-keeper's; a stylus rests behind her ear.

people.name: Liễu Thanh Nhi
people.role: Outer disciple; carries the censer ash down from the terrace
people.appearance: Stops on each stair with the ash-bowl held to her chest, breath short.

people.name: Mạnh Thiếu Bách
people.role: Young inner disciple of the Coiled Root Hall; wants to see the Cold Ford
people.appearance: Sits on a bench as if about to draw a sword.

people.name: Úc Vãn Thủy
people.role: Outer disciple of the Lake Hall with thin Wood
people.appearance: Startles at the dusk gong and has to sit down, white to the lips.

people.name: Bạch Lộc Linh
people.role: Outer disciple from the reindeer herders of Tuyết Lộc
people.appearance: A reindeer calf follows her to class.

people.name: Đàm Tiểu Chu
people.role: Ferry boy of the Đàm family at Cổ Độ
people.appearance: Asleep in the bow before the ferry casts off, awake only when it touches the far bank.

people.name: Tống Tiểu Củ
people.role: Young inner disciple of the Array Hall
people.appearance: A ruler tucked in his belt; he measures twice, then a third time.

people.name: Mai Tiểu Phục
people.role: Outer disciple; gathers fallen-pine fungus for the Pill Room
people.appearance: Always chewing something from the baskets she is supposed to deliver.

people.name: Tiết Vân Huân
people.role: Young inner disciple of the Incense Hall
people.appearance: Sniffs her sleeves before she speaks.

people.name: Phí Tòng Thạch
people.role: Outer disciple at the grey pine vein watch
people.appearance: Spoiling for a fight and visibly disappointed when there is none.

people.name: Khương Bích Thạch
people.role: Outer disciple at the malachite mine
people.appearance: Dice rattle in his pocket at every step.

people.name: Tề Tiểu Mạch
people.role: Outer disciple; counts sacks at the granaries of Lâm Hạ Trấn
people.appearance: A pencil stub behind each ear; he counts under his breath.

people.name: Lam Dịch Phong
people.role: Young inner disciple riding the envoy's roads
people.appearance: A plum tassel on his satchel; a rider's windburn.

people.name: Kha Lâm Đông
people.role: Outer disciple from the woodcutters' village
people.appearance: Cocks his head toward the hill when others are speaking.

people.name: Giáp Tân Mai
people.role: Outer disciple; the governor's descendant
people.appearance: Murmurs the roll under her breath as she walks.

people.name: Tiêu Khê Nhi
people.role: Outer disciple of the River Hall; runs the sluice signals
people.appearance: Blows a two-note whistle when she wants a whole field to look up.

people.name: Ân Thính Tuyết
people.role: Young inner disciple of the Hall of Voices
people.appearance: One eyebrow lifts by itself when she listens.

people.name: Phùng Quế Chi
people.role: Head cook of the palace kitchen (servant)
people.appearance: Points her ladle like a sword at anyone who asks twice.

people.name: Sầm Chức Nương
people.role: Weaves the undyed pine-bark linen for the outer gate (servant)
people.appearance: Knotted warp-strings round both wrists.

people.name: Mạc Đốn Mộc
people.role: Carter of fallen timber for the palace woodcarver (servant)
people.appearance: Bark flakes fall from his beard when he nods.

people.name: Trác Thủy Bối
people.role: Outer disciple at the Lake Hall; dives for the pearl count
people.appearance: Her fingertips stay wrinkled long after she is dry.

people.name: Thân Phá Băng
people.role: Outer disciple of the Lake Hall who failed the Wood test twice
people.appearance: Rolls along like a man always crossing ice.

people.name: Lạc Trường Cung
people.role: Young inner disciple of the Coiled Root Hall; a bowyer's son
people.appearance: Fletching feathers stuck in his belt like a bird's tail.

people.name: Lộ Niệm Xuyên
people.role: River Hall inner disciple; the son of a patrolman whose name is not sung
people.appearance: Has his dead father's cleft chin and uses it when he is about to say nothing.

people.name: Mục Thu Đường
people.role: Outer disciple; carries letters at the Tùng Hạ Thị market
people.appearance: A market copper hung at her neck on a string.

people.name: Ứng Kỳ Sơn
people.role: The newest outer disciple, from Thanh Tùng Thôn
people.appearance: A fresh bruise on one cheek every week, worn like a medal.

people.name: Ngải Lục Hao
people.role: Young inner disciple of the Pill Room; stokes the chimney furnace
people.appearance: One eye reddened by smoke; eyebrows burnt short.

people.name: Tất Tiểu Phủ
people.role: Outer disciple; the woodcarver's second apprentice
people.appearance: Props each plank against his hip and sits to carve it, since he cannot lift it.

people.name: Thang Viễn Hành
people.role: Outer disciple; carries the palace's letters to the vassals
people.appearance: A satchel-bruise on his hip, mud to the knee.

people.name: Cung Cầu Chi
people.role: Old outer disciple; weighs resin at Tùng Gian Thành
people.appearance: Arrives in time for nothing: he has missed three ferries this season and a wedding.

people.name: Chiêm Hàn Sa
people.role: Outer disciple of the Lake Hall; spots Băng Tâm's skiffs
people.appearance: A rolled-bark spyglass on a cord; his eyes stay on the far shore.

people.name: Nhiếp Cô Tân
people.role: Master of the Coiled Root Hall (war, patrols, discipline); Cold Ford-born, the voice of the sect's old reach
people.appearance: A broad, weathered man who still walks like a fisher on a wet quay, with a governor's seal of green stone at his belt where a sword would hang.
people.wants: The Cold Ford back, by writ or without one, and the named heir's zither opened before the council while Đàm still sits.
people.secret: In 1172 he sent a patrol of six onto the river-mouth ice to map Thúy Vi's crossings for a winter war, without the head's leave. They never came back (N-thuy_vi-11). He let the sect list them as deserters rather than own the order, and one of them was Lộ Thu Hà's son. He also holds the letter Đàm wrote to Ngu Lam Sơn in 906 and never sent.

people.name: Dụ Tĩnh Lưu
people.role: Mistress of the River Hall at Đào Thanh Thành: the dikes, the tolls and the river vassals; the swing vote of the palace
people.appearance: A thin woman in a dark blue robe with river mud always drying on the hem, who carries a green glass lamp even at noon.
people.wants: A dike from Đào Thanh Thành to the river's last bend that no flood can top, and no head who would ever have to choose which bank drowns.
people.secret: Hề Tùng Ba told her on his deathbed in 840 that in 700 he opened the River Hall's sluice array to save Đào Thanh Thành's quays and sent the flood onto the abbey's bank. She has run his hall for 360 years so that no one else will make that choice, and she has never told the abbey's children.

people.name: Vi Thanh Âm
people.role: The head's true disciple, named heir in 1199; holds the canon to its twelfth layer
people.appearance: A slight young woman with ink on the side of her right hand, which she keeps in her sleeve, and a seven-string zither on her back.
people.wants: To be worthy of the headship, and to keep any more of the canon from dying in one person's head.
people.secret: She is writing the canon down. Four hundred pages of it, in a cipher of zither tablature, are hidden inside the body of her zither. It is the gravest taboo the sect has.

people.name: Cận Tùng Hàn
people.role: Master of the Array Hall: the palace wards and the River Hall's sluices; the man who broke the ice in 904
people.appearance: A long-boned old man with frost-white eyebrows and blue-stained fingers, who sits very still and counts under his breath.
people.wants: To keep his flags rolled, and to see Khuông Hàn Ly hold the Array Hall after him without ever laying a road on that ice.
people.secret: He heard them under the ice that night for most of an hour, and he did not open the array to let any of them up. Now Khuông Hàn Ly brings him every flag she makes for Nhiếp's crossing to check, and he retunes each one so that the road will hold a patrol and break under a company.

people.name: Thiều Lăng Ba
people.gloss: Walking on the waves (Lạc Thần Phú: lăng ba vi bộ)
people.role: Lake Warden: keeps the Lake Hall at Noãn Ốc and watches Băng Tâm's boats on the north shore of Hạo Nguyệt Hồ
people.appearance: A short, wind-burned woman in a sealskin cloak with a bronze mirror at her hip.
people.wants: An inner gate at Noãn Ốc for the lake's Water-rooted children, and Băng Tâm's skiffs fishing only the north shore.
people.secret: Every dusk she flashes three signals across the lake with the bronze mirror, and Mẫn Băng Hà (man_bang_ha), skiff captain of the frost coast, answers from the far shore; she is arranging a quiet truce for the ice-fishing season and has told neither the palace nor Kiều Nguyệt Châu.

people.name: Từ Tích Cốc
people.role: Steward of the palace: the granaries at Lâm Hạ Trấn, the resin trade and the treasury
people.appearance: A neat, round-faced man with an abacus of pine-nut beads that he works without looking.
people.wants: To die with the treasury solvent and the Root's winter war never funded.
people.secret: He is skimming one measure in a hundred from the Lâm Hạ granaries into a hidden famine store, so the sect can eat through a winter war it must not fight; Tôn Mạch Sinh (ton_mach_sinh) guards the door and thinks it is mouse-bait.

people.name: Địch Kinh Lâm
people.role: Captain of the Coiled Root Hall's patrols and tiger hunter of the deep pines
people.appearance: A lean, scarred man in a tiger-skin half-cape with the claw marks still in it.
people.wants: To put the six men's names on a post at the reed camp, and to learn whose order he really read.
people.secret: Each night he carves six names on pine stakes and buries them under the green pines of Thanh Tùng Thôn, so that Hứa Niệm Tùng (hua_niem_tung) tends graves the roll says do not exist.

people.name: Bạc Hải Âm
people.role: Keeper of the Tide Rite at the empty pavilion of Vọng Triều Các; the last who holds its method whole
people.appearance: A gaunt man with salt in his beard, barefoot in all weathers.
people.wants: To hold the Tide Rite until Nhâm Thu Lãng can carry it, and then to walk out into the sea.
people.secret: Each midwinter he teaches Phan Ba Sinh (phan_ba_sinh) the Rite's last tide in secret, because Nhâm Thu Lãng is too slow, and means to leave the method to the faster boy.

people.name: Lịch Hương Trầm
people.role: Keeper of the Incense Hall in the gardens of Lãnh Hương Viện; makes the sticks that time the listening
people.appearance: A tall woman whose sleeves smell of agarwood and cold plum, with soot under her nails.
people.wants: To make one stick that burns an extra breath, and to learn why the new resin burns short.
people.secret: She has traced the thin resin to Hầu Thiện Kế's (hau_thien_ke) side trade and is quietly buying back the good lots with her own stipend.

people.name: Chử Lan Giang
people.role: Envoy of Tùng Đào Cung to its seven vassals and to the Pivot
people.appearance: A handsome woman in river-blue silk who pours tea for everyone before she lets them speak.
people.wants: To make Doãn Ngọc Hành's smile cost the Pivot something, and to leave an envoy better than herself.
people.secret: She keeps one meeting in ten for herself, a private tithe of tea-money from the vassals' gifts, which she calls the envoy's costs; Trịnh Ức Vân (trinh_uc_van) keeps the true accounts and has not yet asked.

people.name: Lộ Thu Hà
people.role: Second of the River Hall: the flood marks and the dikes; mother of a patrolman listed as a deserter
people.appearance: A grey-haired woman with river silt on her boots and a patrolman's wooden token on a cord around her neck.
people.wants: To hear her son's name sung in the roll with the others, and to learn who wrote the order.
people.secret: She marks in the River Hall's dike-book every hour the Root Hall's patrols pass at night, to name the hour the six left; Lộ Thanh Ngạn (lo_thanh_ngan) walks the marks with her.

people.name: Tân Mặc Bách
people.role: Warden of Thương Tùng Mạch, the grey pine vein on Thiên Xu's border
people.appearance: A dark, square man in a cloak the grey of the pines he guards.
people.wants: To keep the grey pine vein fenced and Thiên Xu's boots outside it.
people.secret: He trades lumps of the vein's malachite to Ân Lăng Thạch (an_lang_thach), the Thiên Cơ Hall's stone-cutter, for their survey tokens; Đồng Kiên Thạch (dong_kien_thach) carries the lumps and thinks it is a friendship.

people.name: Bồ Hạnh Lâm
people.role: Master of the Pill Room, who holds two hundred recipes in his head
people.appearance: A stooped man with orange-stained fingertips and one eyebrow singed away.
people.wants: To pass all two hundred recipes to Đàm Thanh Giang before his lingering poison takes his memory.
people.secret: He has begun writing recipes inside his own sleeves in a cipher of herb names, the first written thing in the Pill Room in a thousand years; Khâu Hạnh Nhi (khau_hanh_nhi) has read three.

people.name: Giáp Tùng Chi
people.role: Governor of the Cold Ford coast 672-905, whose pine name the resin tax carried
people.cause: fell on the governor's quay at Hàn Tân when the Cold Ford was lost (C166), age 345

people.name: Vưu Liên Hoàn
people.role: The smith who forged the thousand-fathom chain of Thiết Tỏa Quan
people.cause: went down with the chain when Thiên Xu broke Thiết Tỏa Quan (C105), age 128

people.name: Hề Tùng Ba
people.role: Master of the River Hall for two centuries; laid the sluice arrays of Đào Thanh Thành
people.cause: old age at 500

people.name: Lộ Thanh Xuyên
people.role: Patrolman of the Coiled Root Hall, one of the six of 1172
people.cause: killed on the river-mouth ice of the Cold Ford by Hướng Dạ Đăng (N-thuy_vi-11); listed by the sect as a deserter

people.name: Nhiếp Thừa Phong
people.role: Nhiếp Cô Tân's son, who cut the Ngư Ca bridges
people.cause: killed by Lạc Hà on the last rope bridge of the Ngư Ca border in the Ferry War (A202), age 64

people.name: Chiêm Hậu Đức
people.role: First steward of the north
people.cause: old age at 500

people.name: Phương Tùng Bản
people.role: Board-drier of the instrument rooms: storm-felled pine at Bích Hác Sâm for the soundboards
people.appearance: Counts his boards aloud in sixes, and the whole workshop has learned to count with him.

people.name: Thẩm Dư Vận
people.role: Player of the seventh movement; teaches pilgrims on the rim to listen
people.appearance: Rattles a pine cone on a cord when she wants quiet, and the echo walls rattle back.

people.name: Thôi Lục Linh
people.role: Outer student from the malachite mine; winds strings for the instrument rooms
people.appearance: A grey streak in her braid that came in at twelve.

people.name: Mạnh Tiều Ca
people.role: Outer student from the woodcutters' village of Tiều Phu
people.appearance: Shifts in his seat through every movement; his belt is notched with a tally of lessons he left early.

people.name: Tôn Thính Hà
people.gloss: Listening to the clouds at dawn
people.role: Inner student of the third movement; wants to be the first after the heir
people.appearance: Bites the inside of her cheek whenever another player errs.

people.name: Cát Minh Huyền
people.role: Inner student of the heir; tunes her zither before dawn
people.appearance: Tilts his head a beat late when addressed, as if the words had to be tuned first.

people.name: Khúc Hành Ca
people.role: Outer student who drums for the marching movement
people.appearance: Drums on tables, rails and his own knees; a dead soldier's green cord is knotted round his wrist.

people.name: Cù Đồng Mộc
people.role: Master of the instrument rooms on the ravine rim; the last zither-maker of Cầm Tượng Trấn
people.appearance: A heavy man with sawdust in his eyebrows and two fingers of his left hand crushed flat.
people.wants: To carve one zither that sounds as the pines' own did in 1011, and to leave a maker's son on the rim who can weigh a board by hand.
people.secret: He is carving a second zither at night from storm-pine in the instrument rooms, a copy of the 1011 zither, so that the copy goes up the ravine at the next restringing and the original is buried with him; Phương Tùng Bản (phuong_tung_ban) dries the boards for it and has been told they are for a spare.

people.name: Quan Tịch Âm
people.role: The head's true disciple and heir; the academy's best player of the Monk's Rest
people.appearance: A small woman who has not raised her voice in a hundred years and whose rests make other players stop.
people.wants: To reach midwinter without anyone learning that she dreads the twelfth movement, and to be the heir the pines remember for her silences.
people.secret: She is teaching Cát Minh Huyền (cat_minh_huyen) the last page of the twelfth movement in the dark before dawn, so someone can finish it if she falls silent; he thinks it is a tuning exercise and has not asked why the page has no title.

people.name: Khương Lạc Huyền
people.role: Elder of the outer gate; the student whose playing made Thiên Xu's envoy forget his message in 1080
people.appearance: A handsome old student in a scarlet sash, who still tells the envoy story at every banquet.
people.wants: To be remembered in the academy's scores as the player who made an envoy forget, and to hold the village families' trust before the Root Hall's patrol does.
people.secret: He is writing the envoy story into the tablature as a thirteenth movement under his own name, in Hà Thính Tùng's (ha_thinh_tung) ink style, so that after Hà dies it reads as part of the canon.

people.name: Mẫn Ti Trúc
people.role: String-maker of the instrument rooms
people.appearance: Hums a half-tone flat while she counts; silk dust has turned her fingertips the colour of old ivory.

people.name: Hàn Thanh Hưởng
people.role: Inner disciple who plays the marching songs for Tùng Đào's patrols
people.appearance: Tucks the soldier's green cord into his sleeve when Hà Thính Tùng is near.

people.name: Âu Tiểu Miên
people.role: Outer disciple from Tùng Phong Thôn who falls asleep to his own playing
people.appearance: A pillow-crease on his cheek at every hour of the day.

people.name: Yên Tố Huyền
people.role: Inner disciple of the heir
people.appearance: A different coloured thread knotted into her hair each day.

people.name: Cổ Minh Thạch
people.role: Outer disciple from the malachite mine, all Metal
people.appearance: Knocks on every table before he sits at it, listening for the ring.

people.name: Tề Tiêu Vân
people.role: Inner disciple; a flute-player in a zither school
people.appearance: A bamboo flute thrust through her sash; a gap where a front tooth was knocked out.

people.name: Bàng Thạch Khánh
people.role: Outer disciple from the quarrymen's village of Lạc Thạch
people.appearance: Taps the quarry-hammer beat on his thigh without knowing it.

people.name: Không Hác
people.role: Abbot of Khô Mộc Tự; the monk whose zither the academy was founded round (620)
people.cause: withered with his tree when his own art turned on him, at 121 (V039)

people.name: Cù Cổ Đồng
people.role: Master zither-maker of Cầm Tượng Trấn and the academy's guest craftsman; made Vi Thanh Âm's zither
people.cause: buried when the ravine wall fell on Cầm Tượng Trấn, at 112 (V041)

people.name: Hàn Thanh Đài
people.gloss: Green moss, her Dao name, from Vương Duy's 'and shines again upon the green moss'
people.role: Keeper of the lamp oil and the guests' millet
people.appearance: Oil-dark fingertips; she sniffs every jar before she signs for it.

people.name: Hạ Không Thúy
people.gloss: Empty green, his Dao name, from Vương Duy's 'the empty green wets one's clothes'
people.role: Teaches letters at the Bách Diệp school
people.appearance: Grey stubble shaved on feast days only; ears reddened by the cold.

people.name: Ân Thổ Hoa
people.role: Lime-burner's daughter turned away by Thúy Vi's outer gate
people.appearance: Lime-white knuckles; a habit of apologising to the floor.

people.name: Phó Tiểu Diêm
people.role: Ridge servant's child; carries salt and letters to the abbey kitchen
people.appearance: Bright red scarf too long for her; satchel smelling of salt.

people.name: Trình Vân Phiến
people.role: Cuts and counts the mica at Vân Mẫu Khoáng
people.appearance: Mica glitter dusted in his eyebrows; a slow, flat-footed walk.

people.name: Hà Quế Hoa
people.gloss: Cassia flowers, her Dao name, from Vương Duy's 'idle, the cassia flowers fall'
people.role: Young monk who carries the Reader's bell
people.appearance: Shaved head, a pale half-moon on the left palm where the bell rope sits.

people.name: Mai Ngữ Yến
people.role: Yên Ba merchant's daughter at the school who cannot sit still
people.appearance: Good boots, mud to the knee; her fingers drum on everything within reach.

people.name: Văn Nhân Hưởng
people.gloss: But voices are heard (Vương Duy, Lộc Trại)
people.role: The Reader: reads the Empty Mountain Sutra aloud in Không Sơn Viện once a year
people.appearance: A small, sharp-eyed woman with a mica-miner's cracked hands and a reader's voice, low and very clear, that carries through stone.
people.wants: To understand what she has been reading for twenty years, and to read it once in daylight, with Thúy Vi's leave, so that it is no longer a secret.
people.secret: She has tried to cultivate the sutra's first three layers anyway, against her root. It has scarred a meridian, and the abbot does not know. She has also written the nine layers down, which nobody outside Thúy Vi has done since Thôi.

people.name: Kha Thủy Cùng
people.role: Prior (giám viện); runs the school and the novices
people.appearance: A square grey man with a jade-cutter's forearms who teaches letters with a stick and never uses it.
people.wants: To end the yearly reading before it puts the abbey wholly at Thúy Vi's mercy.
people.secret: For a year he has covered the abbey's missing jars of lamp oil out of his own allowance, not knowing where they go, to spare Hàn Thanh Đài (han_thanh_dai) the blame.

people.name: Lãnh Xuân Giản
people.gloss: The spring brook (Vương Duy: thời minh xuân giản trung)
people.role: Keeper of the mica and the Cloud Mother Seal
people.appearance: A pale woman who holds every stone up to the light before she speaks to the person who brought it.
people.wants: To keep the last clear mica hidden until the abbot dies.
people.secret: She is selling the small clear panes to Tuân Vân Mẫu (tuan_van_mau) for Thúy Vi silver and writing them into the ledger as spoiled.

people.name: Nông Bạch Thạch
people.gloss: White stone (Vương Duy: kinh khê bạch thạch xuất)
people.role: Teaches the novices the walk; turned away by Thúy Vi's inner gate
people.appearance: A broad, quiet man who smells of lime and always has a white pebble in his hand.
people.wants: To see one of his turned-away novices sit as long as the abbot's master did.
people.secret: For every novice he walks to the water's end he sets a white pebble on a cairn off the path, and the cairn now stands taller than he does.

people.name: Trang Thanh Tuyền
people.gloss: Clear spring (Vương Duy: thanh tuyền thạch thượng lưu)
people.role: Schoolmistress of the abbey's school in Bách Diệp Trấn
people.appearance: Chalk-white cuffs; she taps the desk twice before she speaks.

people.name: Thọ U Hoàng
people.gloss: The dark bamboo (Vương Duy: độc tọa u hoàng lý)
people.role: Hermit of the Peak of Sitting Alone
people.appearance: Long yellow nail on the plucking thumb; eyes that look through whoever stands in front of him.

people.name: Hỗ Kinh Điểu
people.gloss: The startled bird (Vương Duy: nguyệt xuất kinh sơn điểu)
people.role: A Yên Ba merchant's son sent up for schooling
people.appearance: Round cheeks sticky with sweets; a tailor-made robe let out at the waist.

people.name: Lao Hồng Diệp
people.role: Novice; sells red-leaf bookmarks at Lam Yên Thị
people.appearance: Pocket of red leaves that rustles when she runs; toe-bandage under one sandal.

people.name: Thông Vân Thạch
people.role: Digs the thin mica vein for the abbey
people.appearance: Mica glitter in his lashes; every lamp he lights gutters, every rope he trusts frays.

people.name: Cừ Tùng Gian
people.gloss: Among the pines (Vương Duy: minh nguyệt tùng gian chiếu)
people.role: The abbey's cook; a ridge child
people.appearance: Wide cook's forearm burn-scarred in a ladder of pale marks.

people.name: Ba Xuân Sơn
people.gloss: The spring mountain (Vương Duy: dạ tĩnh xuân sơn không)
people.role: Youngest novice; wants to be the next Reader
people.appearance: Knees permanently scabbed; a braid cut short with a kitchen knife.

people.name: Mâu Hành Đáo
people.role: The abbey's first prior; wrote down the novices' walk; died in the avalanche of 1019
people.cause: the second slide of the Vân Gian Trấn avalanche, digging for the buried (age 319)
people.appearance: Remembered as a tall woman, nose forever sunburnt, braid the grey of cloud.

people.name: Cống Thủ Nhất
people.role: Last abbot of Bão Nhất Quán; gave the young Tống Tọa Vân the abbey Rule
people.cause: his core withered after his spring dried in 488 (his method drew on it); died a guest at Không Sơn Viện, age 294
people.appearance: Remembered as a bent old man who carried a dry gourd everywhere.

people.name: Bàng Trấn Lãng
people.role: Draws breakwater arrays for the storm wards
people.appearance: Draws on every flat thing, including the table and his own cuff.

people.name: Dịch Tàn Chiếu
people.role: Keeper of the tide lamp at Nhật Xuất Thôn
people.appearance: Her left hand is black to the wrist with lamp soot.

people.name: Ngư Dạ Phàm
people.role: Carries oil up to the northern lamp
people.appearance: Laughs loud enough to be heard across the cove, through a nose an oar broke flat.

people.name: Đặng Hàm Sa
people.role: Salt boiler and oil clerk
people.appearance: Counts on four fingers of her left hand and has never needed a fifth.

people.name: Trạm Thâm Châu
people.role: Learns to dive at the burned piers
people.appearance: Coughs up a little seawater every dawn, though she has not dived in a week.

people.name: Biện Vĩ Đăng
people.role: Wick-cutter at the southern lamp
people.appearance: Reed-cuts on every finger, healed white.

people.name: Thạch Hải Thệ
people.role: Newly sworn keeper at the tide lamp
people.appearance: Stares a breath too long and has stopped apologising for it.

people.name: Chân Định Lan
people.role: Elder of the storm wards; wants the hall to stop watching for pirates and wall the coast against the sea
people.appearance: A square-shouldered woman in a salt-stiff coat, who measures every wall she passes with her eyes.
people.wants: A breakwater array along the gulf, paid for with the lamps' oil, before the next storm tide.
people.secret: She has written to the palace admiral Phàn Vọng Hải (phan_vong_hai), asking him to persuade the palace to order the hall to the sea-walls over Ôn's head.

people.name: Kiển Mục Hải
people.role: Keeper of the northern lamp in the crumbling fort of Liệu Phàm Bảo
people.appearance: A gaunt man in a seal-skin coat whose eyes have gone pale from staring at the dark sea.
people.wants: A relief posted before another winter, and an answer to his letters.
people.secret: He is trimming the fort lamp's wick short so it burns dim and the unlit sails think the fort empty. He is also drawing their hulls on the tower stair, to send to the palace admiral Phàn Vọng Hải (phan_vong_hai) himself when he is sure.

people.name: Lê Bạch Diêm
people.role: Steward of the hall: lamp oil, salt and laver, and the accounts
people.appearance: A brisk woman with salt-cracked hands and an abacus at her belt.
people.wants: A furlong of breakwater built from one year's oil.
people.secret: She buys lamp oil at a quiet price from Biện Ám Phàm's (bien_am_pham) boats 'because oil is oil', and writes it down as burned, to put a year's oil aside for walls. She is paying the people who run the poisons past the fort.

people.name: Trạm Châu Nhi
people.role: Keeper of the lamp at the burned piers of Châu Lệ Cảng; dives for pearls against her family's vow
people.appearance: Ear-lobes pierced through for pearls she has already sold.

people.name: Vệ Lư Sinh
people.role: Keeper of the southern lamp at Lô Châu Thôn; the hall's best ward-layer
people.appearance: Forearms thin as reeds; he keeps one eye shut against a sun that is not there.

people.name: Cao Tiểu Phàm
people.role: Outer watchman
people.appearance: A pirate's mark inked on his own forearm in lamp soot, smudged.

people.name: Mãn Hải Muội
people.role: Outer watchwoman at the burned piers
people.appearance: Her hair dries salt-white within an hour of any wetting.

people.name: Đinh Vọng Tinh
people.role: Lamp-lighter at Liệu Phàm Bảo
people.appearance: A harelip scar he hides behind a wisp of beard.

people.name: Kỳ Lam Sa
people.role: Inner disciple of the storm wards
people.appearance: Laver-green stains in the seams of her nails.

people.name: Vạn Lão Du
people.role: Servant who boils the lamp oil
people.appearance: Smells of fish oil in any season, and the gulls follow him.

people.name: Cơ Châu Lệ
people.role: Founder of Vọng Triều Đường (790); a pearl diver who watched Châu Lệ Cảng burn
people.cause: died at 320 on the tower above the burned piers

people.name: Dịch Thủy Thanh
people.role: Ôn Thủ Đăng's sworn brother; drowned keeping the Kim Sa lamp
people.cause: drowned at the Kim Sa lamp in the storm tide (V171)

people.name: Chúc Minh Lộ
people.role: Lantern keeper of the Trà Viên crossroads
people.appearance: A twitch whenever a door shuts.

people.name: Bao Thủy Hành
people.role: Carter captain of the Yên Ba salt-fish carts; outer for life
people.appearance: Rice crumbs for strays in every pocket.

people.name: Đào Thạch Ấn
people.role: Stonecutter's son who holds the chisel for the milestones
people.appearance: Chisel nicks healed pink across the heel of his hand.

people.name: Biện Hà Hương
people.role: Survivor of the 1190 caravan; lantern girl of the Phù Kiều road
people.appearance: Lantern blisters in rings round her fingers.

people.name: Nhậm Tùng Ảnh
people.role: Mist-layer who trains against Khuyết Lạc Vụ in Mê Vụ Lâm
people.appearance: A neat parting he re-combs whenever he loses.

people.name: Quan Dã Tử
people.role: A robber's son from the Bobtail ridge, hidden by the road captain
people.appearance: A boar-tusk charm he rubs when someone lies to him.

people.name: Tập Mính Nhi
people.role: Tập Xuân Trà's cousin; brews the road tea
people.appearance: A tea-stained corner of the lip.

people.name: Triều Ngũ Lang
people.role: Road captain; a robber of Đoản Vĩ Cương once
people.appearance: A heavy, scarred man with a lynx-bone axe and a laugh that carries further than the mist he lays.
people.wants: To die with his axe on a road he has made safe, and to see the boy he carried out of the caravan grow past his vengeance.
people.secret: At night he is learning his letters from a child's primer borrowed from Tập Mính Nhi, and tells the camp he is checking the tally.

people.name: Hàm Thanh Đăng
people.role: The founder's daughter; keeper of the crossroads lanterns
people.appearance: A tall woman with ink-stained fingers who carries a green-paned lantern and looks at every stranger twice.
people.wants: The founder's lantern out of Bàng Yên Tỏa's hands, and her father's name cleared of the theft.
people.secret: She is teaching Hàm Tiểu Vụ the first steps of the Haze Walk in the lantern cellar, which the founder's oath reserved to the head, and Tất Hành Vụ lets it pass.

people.name: Thai Vãn Xa
people.role: Captain of the Yên Ba road
people.appearance: Shows a silver tooth whenever he lies.

people.name: Luyện Tố Y
people.role: Mist-layer of the Phù Kiều road; on Tùng Đào's money
people.appearance: A neat woman in an undyed robe who smiles at everyone and remembers what they say.
people.wants: To pay off her brother's debts and be a mist-layer who answers to no one.
people.secret: She has two of the lantern's three turnings and is copying the third off Bàng Yên Tỏa's hands each spring while she holds the lantern; Hồ Tùng Nguyệt's agent comes for it at the autumn fair.

people.name: Hàm Tiểu Vụ
people.role: Lantern boy; the founder's grandson
people.appearance: Lamp soot ringed round his eyes like a badger's.

people.name: Tập Xuân Trà
people.role: Outer disciple; the head's niece from Trà Viên
people.appearance: Yawns into the steam of her own pot.

people.name: Mao Đạo Bi
people.role: Carves the mist-seal milestones
people.appearance: Stone dust frosting his lashes and a permanent squint.

people.name: Ký Thất Lộ
people.role: Newest outer disciple; orphan of the 1190 caravan
people.appearance: A mace scar over one eyebrow and a boy's thin wrists.

people.name: Khuyết Lạc Vụ
people.role: The best young mist-layer; trains in Mê Vụ Lâm
people.appearance: Eyes the colour of fog.

people.name: Hàm Thủ Lộ
people.role: Founder of Vụ Ẩn Môn (1050); the road guard who learned the Haze Walk
people.cause: old age (198), on the Đồng Sơn road; the cape believes the mist took him (N-vu_an-03)

people.name: Bối Trường Đình
people.role: Road guard; died holding the mist in 1190
people.cause: killed by the robbers of Đoản Vĩ Cương holding the mist over a caravan on the Đồng Sơn road (N-vu_an-04)

people.name: Chung Đồng Âm
people.role: Pours the second crucible at the furnace
people.appearance: Laughs with his whole mouth open, showing the front tooth a crucible lid cracked.

people.name: La Đằng Huyền
people.role: Hangs and tunes the warning lines in Mãng Đằng Lâm
people.appearance: A red bean rolled against her lip while she thinks.

people.name: Giang Phong Lô
people.role: Bellows boy at the furnace
people.appearance: Rags on both wrists, and the smell of singed hair follows him.

people.name: Âu Tường Thủ
people.role: Keeps the warding bells on the walls of Thu Trì
people.appearance: Sunburnt on one side of the face only, from the cart seat.

people.name: Đoàn Thính Mộc
people.role: Holds the bells while the true disciple tries the listening seal
people.appearance: Ears pierced seven times for bell-studs, six of them empty.

people.name: Cố Thang Nhi
people.role: Bath-keepers' girl at Quế Hương Thang
people.appearance: Her laugh goes through walls; the bath-keepers use it to find her.

people.name: Phan Linh Sách
people.role: Climber on the forest lines
people.appearance: Reties his bootlace three times before he trusts it.

people.name: Chung Tàn Hưởng
people.role: Grand elder; the founder's son, head 1060-1128, who gave the hall to Ân Thanh Linh
people.appearance: A huge, slow old caster with one ear gone to a cracked pour, who keeps an unlit blue lamp on his tea table.
people.wants: To light his father's lamp once, in front of someone who can see its colour.
people.secret: He is buying a measure of blue lamp oil from Lục Nhĩ Thính (luc_nhi_thinh) with his tea-table silver, and means to light the lamp the night the hidden line comes down.

people.name: Trịnh Thủ Linh
people.role: Keeper of the warding bells on the walls of Thu Trì Thành
people.appearance: A tidy man in a grey coat with a ring of small keys at his belt, one for each bell tower on the wall.
people.wants: Every deaf stretch walked until the bells come back, and no one asking what he told the ear.
people.secret: He tells Lục Nhĩ Thính (luc_nhi_thinh) one old bell a month, the ones due for the furnace, so the Tower's ear can buy them first and hang them at the ferry inn.

people.name: Chung Hồng Lô
people.role: Mistress of the furnace: the hall's master caster at the pour
people.appearance: Broad and red-armed, with her hair burned short and a leather apron black with bronze.
people.wants: The lightning bell poured, and her own mark stamped on a casting.
people.secret: She has cast a plain bell in her own mark and buried it under the furnace floor with Chung Tàn Hưởng's (chung_tan_huong) cracked bell beside it, to be found when the hall's castings are finally counted.

people.name: Đằng Quải Linh
people.role: Bell-hanger: climbs the canopy to hang and tend the bell lines
people.appearance: Elbows scarred white from a hundred branch falls.

people.name: Thiệu Văn Linh
people.role: The mistress's true disciple, who has tried nine times to cast a listening bell
people.appearance: A quick young woman with nine small cracked bells on a cord round her neck.
people.wants: A bell that listens, poured before the mistress does it for her.
people.secret: She copies one line a night from the mistress's letter chest, where the last words of the listening seal are kept, and means to pour the tenth bell without leave before the next wall bell reaches the furnace. Ân Thanh Linh (an_thanh_linh) counts the chest's seals each dusk.

people.name: Thang Tiểu Hỏa
people.role: Bellows boy at the furnace
people.appearance: Eyebrows still whole, which the others tease.

people.name: Hách Chỉ Diên
people.role: Flies paper kites to carry the bell lines across gorges
people.appearance: A kite string always on her wrist, tied to nothing.

people.name: Bạch Miên Thanh
people.role: Stuffs and tunes the clappers of the bell lines
people.appearance: Kapok fluff in his hair that no comb removes.

people.name: Ngụy Tiểu Đạc
people.role: Runner on the walls of Thu Trì
people.appearance: His purse clinks only when he wants it heard.

people.name: Cảnh Tĩnh Âm
people.role: Deafened at a pour; feels the bell lines through her feet
people.appearance: She walks with her toes spread and her head tilted, watching nothing.

people.name: Chung Thiết Liên
people.role: Founder of Vũ Linh Đường (930): a lamp-and-chain caster of Thanh Đăng Trấn who turned to bells
people.cause: a bell cracked in the pour

people.name: Giản Đăng Bộ
people.role: Lamp-bearer of the night crossings: carries the lead lamp through the Tower's dark forest
people.appearance: Lamp-burn on his chin, earned reading the road by night.

people.name: Lại Tiết Trượng
people.role: Master of the staff grove at Phạt Trúc Thôn; cuts and judges every disciple's first staff
people.appearance: Left thumb pared flat by the bamboo knife.

people.name: Giản Tiểu Đăng
people.role: Carries the second lamp on the night crossings, behind her father
people.appearance: Smudges soot on her chin to match her father's lamp-burn.

people.name: Mông Thiết Lang
people.role: Mine runner at Tử Tinh Khoáng; carries the warden's tallies up to the pass
people.appearance: Flinches at any loud noise, and has lost three hats to the wind this season.

people.name: Đinh Tiểu Chu
people.role: Pole-boy on the Hà Châu ferry
people.appearance: Shows the gold tooth to everyone, though it is brass.

people.name: Khương Lãng Thư
people.role: Coast guide at Vọng Hải Trấn; carries the Road Mother's letters to the boats
people.appearance: Her pouch is rubbed pale where she touches it when she is listening.

people.name: Mạnh Hồi Lộ
people.role: A Tower deserter who walked home to the Gate in 1190
people.appearance: The Tower's bell mark scratched out of his shoulder with a hot nail.

people.name: Phí Thoa Y
people.role: The Road Mother (Lộ Mẫu): master of the guides and keeper of the road books; holds the founder's straw cape
people.appearance: A small, bent woman under a cape so old its straw has gone silver, with a road book under one arm and a lamp in the other hand.
people.wants: To keep the road open and the Gate whole, to train a Road Mother after her, and to see the staff and the cape in one pair of hands before she dies. She no longer much minds whose hands they are.
people.secret: Hứa Thanh Diêm has written to her on the Rain Tower's behalf: if the Gate set Úc aside, the Tower would confirm her as head and send Úc Đả Diệp home. She has kept the letter for three years and not answered it.

people.name: Nghiêm Quy Khứ
people.role: The Tower's deserter of 1177, now a staff of the Gate; his life lamp still burns in the Tower's soul vaults
people.appearance: A quiet man with a bronze cup still hung at his throat, which he has never taken off.
people.wants: To die when his own lamp goes out, not when the Tower's shears close.
people.secret: He is teaching the outer boys a counting rhyme that is really the order of the Tower's lamp-shear cuts, so the Gate will know how to keep a lamp from the shears after him. Thôi Vọng Phàm (thoi_vong_pham) has learned the first verse and sells it to nobody yet.

people.name: Đinh Vãn Độ
people.role: Warden of the Gate's ferry post at Hà Châu, who planted its claim on the risen isle
people.appearance: A thick-armed ferryman with a staff that doubles as a pole and a gourd of rice wine that never seems to empty.
people.wants: The isle held in the Gate's name until the river changes again.
people.secret: He is poling Tower stone-cutters out to the isle by night for a skin of rice wine a trip, while swearing at its envoy Hứa Thanh Diêm (hua_thanh_diem) by day.

people.name: Lỗ Kim Tuyền
people.role: Warden of the Gate's mines around Thần Cổ Phong (Sa Kim, Tử Tinh, Thủ Lôi)
people.appearance: A tally-cord knotted round one wrist, never taken off.

people.name: Kỳ Khinh Mã
people.role: The head's last disciple and the fastest guide on the forest road; the Gate's courier to its hostage
people.appearance: Long-legged and sunburnt, with her sandals tied on with red thread and her staff across her shoulders like a yoke.
people.wants: The hostage home, and one letter she may sign herself.
people.secret: She is cutting a path to the ridge for Úc Yên Vũ (uc_yen_vu) in case her holding the girl back fails, one bend a season, each marked with a bit of red thread.

people.name: Khúc Phụ Thạch
people.role: Ore hauler at Sa Kim Khoáng and the Gate's informer below the Tower's seat
people.appearance: Bowed forward, with the tump-line groove across his forehead.

people.name: Cù Tiểu Thoa
people.role: Lamp-carrier on the night crossings
people.appearance: Lamp-wax spattered through her hair like a grey streak.

people.name: Mẫn Thanh Trượng
people.role: Bamboo-feller who cuts the Gate's staffs
people.appearance: Bamboo splinters in his forearms like a pelt.

people.name: Thôi Vọng Phàm
people.role: Coast guide at Vọng Hải Trấn
people.appearance: A telescope of rolled paper he holds to his eye at nothing.

people.name: Úc Yên Vũ
people.gloss: Misty rain (Tô Thức: nhất thoa yên vũ)
people.role: The hostage's daughter, raised at the gate
people.appearance: Her father's staff, cut down to her height, never leaves her hand.

people.name: Mạc Nhất Thoa
people.role: Founder of Xuyên Lâm Môn (690); author of its primer and its staff canon
people.cause: a centipede's venom in Xích Túc Cốc, guiding a caravan through

people.name: Nhậm Bình Sinh
people.gloss: Let it be, all my life (Tô Thức: nhậm bình sinh)
people.role: Second head of Xuyên Lâm Môn (878-1169); refused the Night Rain arts
people.cause: the winter after nine days in the rain at the Tower's new gate

people.name: Úc Từ Hành
people.role: The head's younger brother; guide to the Tower's column in the Cinnabar Vein War
people.cause: lost with Kỷ Vãn Tình's rear guard at the pass of Đan Sơn Mạch

people.name: Nhạc Viễn Chí
people.role: Dusk Field picker; stayed with the grand elder in 1187
people.appearance: A singed thumb from lighting the grand elder's lamp every dusk.

people.name: Âu Hoàng Kỳ
people.role: Furnace House alchemist; tastes the quarter dose
people.appearance: Speaks in a flat, unhurried voice, her gums stained grey-green.

people.name: Ma Thu Diệp
people.role: Placed from Lạc Hà this spring; picks on the Dusk Field
people.appearance: Goes barefoot wherever she can, her heels cracked like dry paddy.

people.name: Thái Tri Mẫu
people.role: Inner disciple; grinds miasma-root for the head's antidote
people.appearance: Stoops over every table as if reading its grain; mortar dust whitens his eyebrows.

people.name: Cố Tằm Nhi
people.role: Mistletoe cutter of the mulberry wood
people.appearance: Scalded, shiny fingertips from her father's reeling vats.

people.name: Trang Vãn Lô
people.role: Dusk Field picker; Trang Vãn Thảo's elder brother
people.appearance: A heavy-browed, plain face; he stands half a step ahead of his sister.

people.name: Mộ Ngưu Tất
people.role: Inner disciple of the Furnace House; banks the founder's coals
people.appearance: A ladder of burn scars up one forearm, lime-white in her hair.

people.name: Diêm Tử Tô
people.role: Grand elder and co-founder (1065); keeps the Dusk Field at the old seat and has not lit a furnace since 1150
people.appearance: A tall old man with a perilla leaf pinned to his collar, who sits beside a cold bronze furnace on the steppe every evening and polishes it until the light goes.
people.wants: To light a furnace once more before he dies, for Văn Đương Quy's Kết Đan, and to know why Vi changed the recipe.
people.secret: Sorting her notes for the move in 1187, he found that Vi changed the recipe of her breakthrough pill the night before. She added a dusk herb she had bought at Lạc Đan Thanh's stall in Vật Hoa Thị (A186), because the drought had thinned the bed grown from Hàn Thanh Cao's seed. He does not know whether Lạc sold her a bad herb or whether she asked him for one. He has never asked, because either answer would end something. This spring Lạc sent word that he will tell, for one pill brewed in the Cold Furnace, and Chử Hồng Diệp's (chu_hong_diep) letter came the same month with a recipe very like Vi's.

people.name: Văn Đương Quy
people.role: The pavilion's best picker; keeps the Dusk Field with the grand elder
people.appearance: A brown, wiry woman in a straw cape, always kneeling, with a gourd at her hip and grass seeds in her hair.
people.wants: To pick one sunset on the steppe without being asked a question, and to see the dusk-wormwood seed itself.
people.secret: Each dusk she wraps a pinch of the Dusk Field's best evening herb for a Tang Ma Thành mother whose son is wasting, and Tiền Tiểu Đồng (tien_tieu_dong) carries it into the city for her for nothing.

people.name: Sầm Bạch Chỉ
people.role: Keeper of the furnaces at the mulberry wood
people.appearance: Pats his round belly while he thinks; charcoal blackens every knuckle.

people.name: Lý Tang Ký
people.role: Keeper of the mulberry wood; sells the pavilion's pills
people.appearance: A sharp-faced woman in a silk robe dyed the green of mulberry leaves, with a price list sewn inside her sleeve.
people.wants: A bench among the Thúy Vi guild's elders, as one of them and not as a supplier.
people.secret: She is grafting wild mistletoe in a locked shed to sell the pavilion's rarest herb as her own stock; Cố Tằm Nhi (co_tam_nhi) is paid to water it and told it is for the head.

people.name: Phùng Cam Thảo
people.role: Inner disciple at the bellows
people.appearance: Chews a licorice twig; his log-driver's shoulders have gone soft.

people.name: Khổng Ích Mẫu
people.role: Carries the tincture to Lạc Hà's Miasma Watch
people.appearance: A grass-woven bracelet at each wrist, one for every journey north.

people.name: Trang Vãn Thảo
people.role: Outer disciple on the Dusk Field
people.appearance: Keeps a reed flute in her braid and hums when she thinks she is alone.

people.name: Tiền Tiểu Đồng
people.role: Outer disciple from Tang Ma Thành's rope walks
people.appearance: A grin with one eyetooth missing; he walks a cart rail like a rope.

people.name: Mai Tiểu Ngải
people.role: Outer disciple placed from Lạc Hà
people.appearance: A habit of tilting her head at every kind word, as though checking it for a flaw.

people.name: Vi Ngưng Yên
people.role: Founder of Yên Quang Các (1065); picked only in the hour of the glow
people.cause: died in her breakthrough to Nguyên Anh, on a pill her Dao partner made, at 210

people.name: Hàn Thanh Cao
people.role: Picker who died saving the last bed of dusk-wormwood
people.cause: a grass fire on the dry steppe, at 71

events.text_vi: Mạc Quy Khư, khi ấy là tu sĩ Kết Đan hai trăm bốn mươi tuổi, bước vào cổng Phù Tang Cảnh trên Dục Nhật Đảo vào lần khai mở đầu tiên được ghi lại; Thiên Nguyên lịch tính năm từ ngày ấy.
events.text_en: Mạc Quy Khư, a Kết Đan cultivator of 240, enters the gate of Phù Tang Cảnh on Dục Nhật Đảo at its first recorded opening; the Thiên Nguyên calendar counts its years from that day.

events.text_vi: Mạc Quy Khư bước ra từ Phù Tang Cảnh, linh căn bị mười mặt trời của nơi ấy thiêu thủng, trong tay ôm một chiếc bình không men lạnh hơn biển.
events.text_en: Mạc Quy Khư comes out of Phù Tang Cảnh with his root burned through by its ten suns and an unglazed vase in his arms that is colder than the sea.

events.text_vi: Những ngư dân đầu tiên của vịnh thấy mặt trời mọc lên từ biển ở Dục Nhật Đảo, và tin rằng nó tắm ở đó mỗi đêm.
events.text_en: The first fishers of the gulf see the sun rise out of the sea at Dục Nhật Đảo, and believe it bathes there every night.

events.text_vi: Một kiếm khách vô danh chém giết giao long nơi nội hải; xương nó hóa thành dải đá ngầm, nơi về sau sẽ dựng lên một bến cảng.
events.text_en: A nameless swordsman kills the sea-serpent of the inland sea; its bones become the reef where a harbour will one day stand.

events.text_vi: Những người săn hải cẩu trên mũi đất lạnh thấy các đảo núi lửa đỏ rực dưới tuyết, và gọi vùng đất ấy là Mũi Tuyết Lửa.
events.text_en: Sealers on the cold cape see the volcanic isles glow red under the snow, and call the land the Cape of Snow and Fire.

events.text_vi: Một vị Hóa Thần tinh thông thủy pháp, nay không ai còn nhớ danh tính, rời bỏ nhân gian từ bên hồ dài phương bắc trong khi Mạc Quy Khư khi ấy còn trẻ đứng nhìn; động phủ cũ cùng linh khí thâm hàn của người ở lại thành một phúc địa.
events.text_en: A Hóa Thần master of water, whose name no one remembers, leaves the world from the long northern lake while a young Mạc Quy Khư watches; his old home and its cold, deep qi stay behind as a blessed land.

events.text_vi: Ngư dân bên hồ dài kể rằng năm năm trước họ thấy một người bước trên mặt nước đi vào vầng trăng; họ dựng một miếu thờ bên bờ.
events.text_en: Fishers on the long lake say that five years ago they saw a man walk over the water into the moon; they build a shrine on the shore.

events.text_vi: Thương nhân phàm tục bắt đầu tụ họp bên một cây cầu đá giữa lòng đại lục, nơi đường từ bốn bờ biển giao nhau.
events.text_en: Mortal traders begin to meet at a stone bridge in the heart of the continent, where the roads from four coasts cross.

events.text_vi: Cỏ trên đồng bằng phía tây mọc cao đến mức người cưỡi ngựa khuất trong đó; bầu trời như chạm đất ở mọi phía.
events.text_en: The grass of the western plain grows so tall that riders vanish in it; the sky seems to touch the ground on every side.

events.text_vi: Một vì sao rơi xuống dãy núi phương bắc; hố sao khép lại thành một tiểu bí cảnh của sắt và tinh quang, đóng mở theo tinh tú.
events.text_en: A star falls on the northern mountains; its crater seals over a small realm of iron and starlight that opens and closes with the stars.

events.text_vi: Những người chăn cừu đầu tiên trên đồng cỏ cao Dao Quang thấy đất ấm giữa mùa đông và cỏ xanh dưới tuyết.
events.text_en: The first shepherds of Dao Quang's high meadows find the ground warm in winter and the grass green under the snow.

events.text_vi: Cơ Phượng Nghi khai lập Cửu Thiều Cung trên các dãy đồi Thê Ngô Lĩnh, một cung điện nhã nhạc mà chín khúc Thiều được truyền rằng có thể gọi phượng hoàng.
events.text_en: Cơ Phượng Nghi founds Cửu Thiều Cung on the ridges of Thê Ngô Lĩnh, a palace of court music whose nine Shao tunes are said to call the phoenix.

events.text_vi: Những con vịt trời lẻ loi trú đông trên đảo nhiều đến mức thủy thủ đất liền gọi nó là Cô Vụ.
events.text_en: Lone wild ducks winter on the island in such numbers that mainland sailors call it Cô Vụ.

events.text_vi: Cơ Phượng Nghi tạc nên Tiêu Thiều Quản, chín ống cho chín khúc Thiều; người ta nói đệ tử nào nghe trọn khúc sẽ quên hết mọi người thầy khác.
events.text_en: Cơ Phượng Nghi carves the Tiêu Thiều Quản, nine pipes for the nine Shao; it is said a disciple who hears it played in full forgets every other teacher.

events.text_vi: Sấm sét đánh vào cùng một ngọn núi mỗi đêm suốt một năm; đá nơi ấy đến nay vẫn ngân vang tiếng lôi.
events.text_en: Lightning strikes the same peak every night for a year; the rock there still hums with thunder.

events.text_vi: Những người lái đò phàm tục dựng nên Đông Lưu Thành bên một khúc quanh lớn của dòng sông phương bắc.
events.text_en: Mortal boatmen build Đông Lưu Thành on a great bend of the northern river.

events.text_vi: Những người lái đò Đông Lưu dâng hà thần một con lợn mỗi mùa xuân để được qua sông bình an.
events.text_en: The boatmen of Đông Lưu give the river spirit a pig every spring for safe passage.

events.text_vi: Dân du mục lùa ngựa băng qua thảo nguyên sau dãy núi; bãi dựng trại của họ trở thành Mã Minh Thôn.
events.text_en: Nomad herders drive their horses across the steppe behind the range; their camping ground becomes Mã Minh Thôn.

events.text_vi: Nhạc Cửu Thiều vang xa qua các dãy đồi đến mức nông dân tính ngày gieo hạt theo khúc nhạc buổi sớm.
events.text_en: Cửu Thiều's music carries so far over the ridges that farmers time their sowing by its morning hymn.

events.text_vi: Người ta thấy một con chim năm sắc bay trên những hang đỏ; bờ biển được đặt tên theo nơi phượng hoàng sinh ra.
events.text_en: A five-coloured bird is seen over the vermilion caves; the coast is named for the phoenix's birthplace.

events.text_vi: Một nhà sư ngồi suốt trăm năm hướng về mặt trời mọc trên một đỉnh cao rồi viên tịch tại đó; ánh sáng người thu nạp chưa từng rời khỏi nơi ấy.
events.text_en: A monk sits a hundred years facing the sunrise on a high peak and dies there; the light he gathered never leaves the place.

events.text_vi: Đá từ trời rơi xuống Thiên Tuyền Nguyên suốt chín ngày; tinh thiết trong đó kéo những tu sĩ đầu tiên về miền trung tâm.
events.text_en: Stones fall from the sky on Thiên Tuyền Nguyên for nine days; the star iron in them draws the first cultivators to the heart.

events.text_vi: Một người chăn cừu tìm thấy một khối tinh thiết trên đồng bằng và đổi lấy một con bò; người mua trở thành thợ rèn đầu tiên của miền trung tâm.
events.text_en: A shepherd finds a lump of star iron on the plain and trades it for a cow; the buyer becomes the first smith of the heart.

events.text_vi: Thợ săn trên băng kể rằng Chúc Long ngủ dưới Chúc Long Sơn và thắp sáng ngọn núi mỗi khi nằm mộng.
events.text_en: Ice hunters say the Torch Dragon sleeps under Chúc Long Sơn and lights the mountain when it dreams.

events.text_vi: Chung Hoài Cực, năm tám mươi tuổi, khai lập Thiên Xu Tông dưới chòm Bắc Đẩu; đất quanh tông môn ngày một trù phú khi môn hạ tụ về, thành Bắc Thần Phúc Địa.
events.text_en: Chung Hoài Cực, at 80, founds Thiên Xu Tông under the stars of the Northern Dipper; the ground around his seat grows rich as the sect gathers, and becomes the Bắc Thần Phúc Địa.

events.text_vi: Cửu Thiều Cung đặt đồng lúa Triêu Dương Nguyên dưới sự che chở của mình.
events.text_en: Cửu Thiều Cung takes the rice plain of Triêu Dương Nguyên under its protection.

events.text_vi: Cửu Thiều dựng Vân Môn Thành trên đồng bằng, lấy tên nhạc Vân Môn, khúc song sinh của nhạc Thiều; chiếc khánh đá Vân Môn Khánh treo trong chính điện.
events.text_en: Cửu Thiều builds Vân Môn Thành on the plain, named for the Vân Môn music, the Thiều's twin; the stone chime Vân Môn Khánh hangs in its hall.

events.text_vi: Những người chăn tuần lộc định cư trên bờ bắc phủ tuyết của hồ; trại của họ trở thành Tuyết Lộc Thôn.
events.text_en: Reindeer herders settle on the lake's snowy north shore; their camp becomes Tuyết Lộc Thôn.

events.text_vi: Những người chăn thả tìm thấy những hòn đá trên sườn núi ngân lên trước mỗi cơn bão; họ để yên chúng nơi cũ.
events.text_en: Herders find stones on the ridges that hum before a storm; they leave them where they lie.

events.text_vi: Lúa được cấy lần đầu trên những cánh đồng ngập nước của đồng bằng; ruộng nước Thủy Điền còn lâu đời hơn mọi tông môn trừ hai.
events.text_en: Rice is first planted in the flooded fields of the plain; Thủy Điền's paddies are older than every sect but two.

events.text_vi: Những ngư dân một mình chèo thuyền vào sương giá trở về với những con cá không ai khác bắt được; người khác theo họ đến bờ biển lạnh.
events.text_en: Fishers who row out alone into the frost come back with fish no one else can catch; others follow them to the cold coast.

events.text_vi: Những chiếc thuyền chài hát lúc chiều tà trên đường về; lữ khách từ vùng đồi gọi đây là dòng sông của những bài ca ngư phủ.
events.text_en: Fishing boats sing at dusk on the way home; travellers from the hills call it the river of fishermen's songs.

events.text_vi: Một con hỏa long chết già trong hang ổ; hơi nóng của cả kiếp sống dài thấm vào lòng đất, khiến vùng đất quanh đó mãi ấm áp và dồi dào hỏa khí.
events.text_en: A fire dragon dies of age in its lair; the heat of its long life seeps into the earth and the land around it stays warm and rich with fire.

events.text_vi: Dưới sự che chở của Thiên Xu Tông, ngã tư của thương nhân lớn dần thành Thạch Kiều Thành, tòa thành đầu tiên của miền trung tâm.
events.text_en: Under Thiên Xu Tông's protection the traders' crossing grows into Thạch Kiều Thành, the first city of the heart.

events.text_vi: Các chiêm tinh sư của Củng Tinh Quán nhận ra hồ cao Tinh Lạc Hồ soi chòm Bắc Đẩu ban đêm rõ như trên trời.
events.text_en: Củng Tinh Quán's star-readers find that the high lake Tinh Lạc Hồ holds the Dipper at night as clearly as the sky.

events.text_vi: Người ta đào được sắt của một ngôi sao rơi ở Vẫn Tinh; Củng Tinh Quán giữ quyền khai thác mỏ.
events.text_en: Iron from a fallen star is dug at Vẫn Tinh; Củng Tinh Quán keeps the mine.

events.text_vi: Lý Thiên Cổ khai lập Khải Lôi Môn tại Kinh Trập Sơn, nơi sấm xuân đánh thức muôn loài ngủ đông; môn phái dạy rằng tu sĩ phải mời gọi thiên lôi.
events.text_en: Lý Thiên Cổ founds Khải Lôi Môn in Kinh Trập Sơn, where spring thunder wakes the sleeping creatures; the Gate teaches that a cultivator must invite the lightning.

events.text_vi: Sấm xuân đánh thức muôn loài đang ngủ trong Tàng Trập Động; thợ săn chờ ở miệng hang mỗi năm vào ngày Kinh Trập.
events.text_en: Spring thunder wakes the creatures sleeping in Tàng Trập Động; hunters wait at the cave mouth every year on the day of Kinh Trập.

events.text_vi: Khải Lôi Môn dựng Lôi Trạch Thành nơi cửa sông dưới chân núi.
events.text_en: Khải Lôi Môn builds Lôi Trạch Thành at the river mouth below its mountains.

events.text_vi: Bùi Lộc Trại khai lập Không Sơn Viện giữa đồi núi Thanh Loan Lĩnh, một thư viện tĩnh lặng đến mức, như lời thơ, núi vắng chẳng thấy người.
events.text_en: Bùi Lộc Trại founds Không Sơn Viện in the hills of Thanh Loan Lĩnh, an academy so quiet that, as the poem says, on the empty mountain no one is seen.

events.text_vi: Các chiêm tinh sư của Củng Tinh Quán hoàn thành Tuyền Cơ Nghi, một hồn thiên nghi theo dõi chòm Bắc Đẩu suốt năm.
events.text_en: The star-readers of Củng Tinh Quán finish the Tuyền Cơ Nghi, an armillary that follows the Northern Dipper through the year.

events.text_vi: Những người tiều phu hát trên sườn núi dưới Không Sơn Viện được nhờ hát khẽ lại; thị trấn họ lập nên đến nay vẫn gọi là Tiều Ca.
events.text_en: Woodcutters singing on the ridges below Không Sơn Viện are asked to sing more quietly; the town they found is still called Tiều Ca.

events.text_vi: Lúa mì mọc trên lớp tro ấm của mũi đất; những cánh đồng đầu tiên của Mạch Lãng Thôn gợn như sóng.
events.text_en: Wheat grows in the warm ash of the cape; the first fields of Mạch Lãng Thôn ripple like waves.

events.text_vi: Những ruộng muối đào ở Diêm Điền trên bờ biển phía tây làm ra muối biển đầu tiên của đại lục.
events.text_en: Salt pans dug at Diêm Điền on the west coast make the continent's first sea salt.

events.text_vi: Nước thu trong vịnh cùng một màu với bầu trời bất tận; những ngư dân đầu tiên nói họ không biết phải quăng lưới vào đâu.
events.text_en: The autumn water of the bay is one colour with the endless sky; the first fishers say they could not tell where to cast.

events.text_vi: Một phiên chợ của cân và thước mở ra bên Thiên Xu Tông; người ta gọi nó là Thiên Quyền Thị, và cân của chợ công bằng nhất đại lục.
events.text_en: A market of weight and measure opens beside Thiên Xu Tông; it is called Thiên Quyền Thị, and its scales are the fairest on the continent.

events.text_vi: Nhạc công Vân Môn tấu nhạc đón mặt trời buổi sớm trên mặt hồ, và mây bình minh nhuốm màu của khúc nhạc.
events.text_en: Vân Môn's musicians play to the morning sun over the lake, and the dawn clouds take the colour of the music.

events.text_vi: Những ruộng dâu trồng trên đất đỏ ở Tang Điền nuôi tằm cho cả phương nam.
events.text_en: Mulberry fields planted in the red soil at Tang Điền feed the silkworms of the south.

events.text_vi: Kỳ Tùng Ẩn khai lập Tùng Đào Cung giữa rừng thông bạt ngàn, cùng đệ tử đầu tiên Thôi Khinh Hồng, khi ấy một trăm hai mươi tuổi.
events.text_en: Kỳ Tùng Ẩn founds Tùng Đào Cung among the endless pines, with his first disciple Thôi Khinh Hồng, then 120.

events.text_vi: Khải Lôi Môn lập nên Không Mông Thành giữa mưa bụi mịt mờ của các thung lũng phía nam.
events.text_en: Khải Lôi Môn founds Không Mông Thành in the hazy rain of its southern valleys.

events.text_vi: Lý Thiên Cổ lần đầu gióng một chiếc trống làm từ gỗ bị sét đánh; Xuân Lôi Cổ trở thành trái tim truyền thừa của Khải Lôi.
