events.text_vi: Tầm Kiếm Đường hoàn thành bản đồ khối núi phía nam: mọi hang đều đã được tìm kiếm, trừ những hang sau cổng của Lê Hoa Am.
events.text_en: Tầm Kiếm Đường finishes its map of the southern massif: every cave searched but those behind Lê Hoa Am's gate.

events.text_vi: Khang Thiên Chùy đúc một chìa khóa thứ hai từ Cô Vụ Giới tại lò Xích Kim và nói với tình nhân rằng nó đã hỏng.
events.text_en: Khang Thiên Chùy cuts a second key from the Lone Duck Ring at the Xích Kim furnace and tells his mistress it has failed.

events.text_vi: Người chép sách Cơ Ký Âm hiểu ra rằng những ngôi mộ cổ nhất của Lôi Trạch đọc tụng công pháp của Khải Lôi như người đứng đầu đã đọc nó dưới thiên kiếp. Lý Hận Bích niêm các cuốn sách chép của ông trong cấm chế.
events.text_en: The copyist Cơ Ký Âm understands that the oldest graves of Lôi Trạch chant Khải Lôi's canon as their head chanted it under the tribulation. Lý Hận Bích seals his copybooks in the ward.

events.text_vi: Đêm thứ ba của mùa đông sói, một người hộ tống thương đội tên Hứa Vãn Cung bắn con sói xám dẫn đầu bầy trên đường Tùng Hạ, và bầy sói quay vào rừng thông.
events.text_en: On the third night of the wolf winter a caravan guard named Hứa Vãn Cung shoots the grey wolf that leads the pack on the Tùng Hạ road, and the wolves go back into the pines.

events.text_vi: Chân Định Lan của Vọng Triều một mình canh giữ bến tàu của Phượng Minh Cung ở Thạch Cơ Thành trong đêm; triều bão vẫn làm nó nứt.
events.text_en: Chân Định Lan of Vọng Triều wards the palace's jetty at Thạch Cơ Thành alone by night; the storm cracks it anyway.

events.text_vi: Bọn cướp từ Đoản Vĩ Cương ập vào một đoàn thương nhân trên đường Đồng Sơn. Người hộ đường Bối Trường Đình chết khi đang giữ màn sương che phủ nó, và một đứa trẻ sống sót.
events.text_en: Robbers from the Ridge of the Bobtails fall on a caravan on the Đồng Sơn road. The guard Bối Trường Đình dies holding the mist over it, and one child lives.

events.text_vi: Sau bầy sói mùa đông năm trước, những người canh đường thề trung thành với Tùng Đào lập Tuần Tùng Đường trên ngọn đồi trên Tùng Hạ Thị để hộ tống thương đội.
events.text_en: After last winter's wolves, road wardens sworn to Tùng Đào found Tuần Tùng Đường on the hill above Tùng Hạ Thị to guard the caravans.

events.text_vi: Một con nguyệt hồ trắng xuất hiện trên hồ ba đêm liền; dân làng nói rằng ở đâu đó phương bắc một phúc địa đang thức giấc.
events.text_en: A white moon-fox is seen on the lake three nights running; the villagers say a blessed land is waking somewhere in the north.

events.text_vi: Bàn tiệc của Thiên Xu nếm ra vị hồ trong rượu của Lễ Tuyền. Thiên Xu không nói gì trước người ngoài, mỗi năm lấy bốn mươi vò nước suối nguyên chất làm tiền phạt, và cử một quản hầm rượu đến sống ở Tuyền Phòng.
events.text_en: The Pivot's table tastes the lake in Lễ Tuyền's wine. Thiên Xu says nothing in public, takes forty jars of pure spring a year as a fine, and sends a cellar steward to live at the Spring House.

events.text_vi: Một mật sứ của trưởng lão đầu tiên của Tùng Đào mua hết các khoản nợ của một con bạc ở Phù Kiều tại Hàn Tân Thành.
events.text_en: An agent of Tùng Đào's first elder buys up a Phù Kiều gambler's debts in Hàn Tân Thành.

events.text_vi: Đám kiếm khách trẻ của Dạ Quang lại uống bằng chén dạ quang; các trưởng lão Băng Tâm làm như không thấy.
events.text_en: Dạ Quang's young blades drink from the night-glowing cups again; Băng Tâm's elders pretend not to see.

events.text_vi: Một trận bão cát từ Phong Sa Nhãn vùi một đoàn buôn muối trên con đường sa mạc. Một người bảo vệ đi ra khỏi đó, mang theo thanh đao của người kia.
events.text_en: A sandstorm out of Phong Sa Nhãn buries a salt caravan on the desert road. One guard walks out of it, carrying the other's sabre.

events.text_vi: Một lữ khách nghỉ đêm trong Không Sơn Viện bỏ hoang thề rằng đã nghe thấy ai đó đọc sách thành tiếng ở phòng bên.
events.text_en: A traveller who spends a night in the empty Không Sơn Viện swears he heard someone reading aloud in the next room.

events.text_vi: Một nhạc công ở Thiều Âm Thị tấu một khúc nhạc không ai dạy, và mọi con chim trên đồi đều im bặt; các trưởng lão Phượng Minh trả tiền cho y đi thật xa.
events.text_en: A musician in Thiều Âm Thị plays a tune no one taught him, and every bird on the ridge falls silent; Phượng Minh's elders pay his passage far away.

events.text_vi: Thích Minh Thư ở kho lưu trữ của Thiên Xu xin Hàn Thủy Mặc một đêm mực, để chép một bản danh sách lính canh Tinh Tủy Mạch.
events.text_en: Thích Minh Thư of the Pivot's archive asks Hàn Thủy Mặc for a night's ink, for a guard roll of Tinh Tủy Mạch.

events.text_vi: Những kẻ đào di tích mở các cánh cửa băng của Bắc Minh Quán trên bờ phía bắc, bỏ trống từ năm 332. Những thợ cắt băng họ thuê không đục nổi một cánh cửa; một cô gái ở Tạc Băng Thôn đã làm nó tan bằng đôi tay.
events.text_en: Diggers open the frozen doors of Bắc Minh Quán on the northern shore, empty since 332. The ice-cutters they hired could not chip one door; a girl of Tạc Băng Thôn melted it with her hands.

events.text_vi: Thợ săn Bành Liệp Hổ bị loài hổ ở Phục Hổ Cương giết chết; huynh đệ kết nghĩa của ông cõng ông xuống Ô Diêu.
events.text_en: The hunter Bành Liệp Hổ is killed by the tiger-kind of Phục Hổ Cương; his sworn brother carries him down to Ô Diêu.

events.text_vi: Con thuyền được trả tiền để đưa nhạc sĩ của Thiều Âm Thị đi rời bến mà không có ông; Lộ Văn Khánh giữ ông lại trong tàn tích của Kích Khánh Đường.
events.text_en: The boat paid to carry the musician of Thiều Âm Thị away sails without him; Lộ Văn Khánh keeps him in the ruins of Kích Khánh Đường.

events.text_vi: Ngu Lam Sơn gieo ba mảnh của Tự Viên và trao chúng cho Thiệu Thanh Đài, Hoàn Cô Bách và Hướng Vãn Chu; ông sẽ xét họ vào năm 1205.
events.text_en: Ngu Lam Sơn plants three plots of the Heir's Garden and gives them to Thiệu Thanh Đài, Hoàn Cô Bách and Hướng Vãn Chu; he will judge them in 1205.

events.text_vi: Giá lúa ở Mục Ca Thành tăng gấp đôi sau một mùa kém; những người chăn thả hát rong lấy tiền trên phố Yên Ba.
events.text_en: Grain prices in Mục Ca Thành double after a poor harvest; the herders sing their songs for coin in Yên Ba's streets.

events.text_vi: Lũ trẻ Tân Khẩu thách nhau chạm vào rìa chướng khí gần Vô Định Thành; một đứa không trở về.
events.text_en: Children of Tân Khẩu dare each other to touch the edge of the miasma by Vô Định Thành; one doesn't come back.

events.text_vi: Những con chim chiếu thư mào đỏ nở trong một gác xép kín của Bách Vũ Các, từ những quả trứng được mang ra khỏi chuồng chim của Ngô Đồng Đình.
events.text_en: Red-crested writ birds hatch in a hidden loft of Bách Vũ Các from eggs carried out of the Wutong Court's aviary.

events.text_vi: Hình Lạc Nhạn đi ba trăm bước vào chướng khí của Chiết Kích Nguyên để tìm cậu bé Tân Khẩu bị lạc và trở về với chiếc giày của cậu.
events.text_en: Hình Lạc Nhạn walks three hundred paces into the miasma of Chiết Kích Nguyên after the lost Tân Khẩu boy and comes back with his shoe.

events.text_vi: Một bản chép danh sách lính canh năm 803 của Tinh Tủy Mạch được trao cho sứ giả của Băng Tâm tại một nhà khách ở Thạch Kiều.
events.text_en: A copy of the 803 guard roll of Tinh Tủy Mạch is handed to Băng Tâm's envoy in a guest-house at Thạch Kiều.

events.text_vi: Ung Hạc Minh thuần phục một hạc vương không cho ai khác cưỡi.
events.text_en: Ung Hạc Minh tames a crane king that will let no one else ride it.

events.text_vi: Lữ khách trên đường rừng thấy đậu đỏ rải trên lối dẫn tới Hồng Đậu Trang, và bước vòng qua.
events.text_en: Travellers on the forest road find red beans scattered on the path to Hồng Đậu Trang, and step around them.

events.text_vi: Một trận lũ xuân làm lộ ra con phố cũ của Đông Lưu Thành trên lòng sông cạn; lũ trẻ nhặt được những đồng tiền của một tòa thành không ai còn nhớ.
events.text_en: A spring flood uncovers the old street of Đông Lưu Thành on the dry bed; children find coins of a city no one remembers.

events.text_vi: Vệ Văn Cơ, một trận pháp sư làm thuê, được trả tiền để bố trí lại các trận phong quanh Vạn Cốt Trủng; y bỏ việc sau một đêm.
events.text_en: Vệ Văn Cơ, a formation master for hire, is paid to re-lay the wards around the Vạn Cốt Trủng; he quits after one night.

events.text_vi: Vị ẩn sĩ Dục Nhật Đảo không tỉnh dậy cho câu hỏi mùa xuân. Người lái đò của ông trả lời thay bằng giọng của ông.
events.text_en: The hermit of Dục Nhật Đảo does not wake for the spring question. His ferryman answers it in his voice.

events.text_vi: Một ngoại môn đệ tử của Tùng Đào, con trai một tiều phu, nói rằng những cây thông phía trên Tùng Hạ Thị đang ngâm một điều gì đó dài hơn sách vỡ lòng.
events.text_en: An outer disciple of Tùng Đào, a woodcutter's son, says the pines above Tùng Hạ Thị are chanting something longer than the primer.

events.text_vi: Chúc Long Sơn rền vang dưới lớp băng lần đầu tiên sau bảy trăm bảy mươi bốn năm; các ni cô Lê Hoa Am cầu nguyện suốt mùa đông.
events.text_en: Chúc Long Sơn rumbles under the ice for the first time in 774 years; Lê Hoa Am's nuns pray all winter.

events.text_vi: Họ Vương ở Đạo Hương gửi thư cầu hôn đến họ Tạ ở Phong Lâm; thư hồi âm vẫn chưa tới.
events.text_en: The Vương clan of Đạo Hương sends a letter of betrothal to the Tạ of Phong Lâm; the reply has not yet come.

events.text_vi: Một cồn sông ở Hà Châu nổi lên khỏi mặt nước sau một trận động đất; cả Thính Vũ lẫn Xuyên Lâm đều đòi quyền sở hữu.
events.text_en: A river isle at Hà Châu rises out of the water after an earthquake; Thính Vũ and Xuyên Lâm both claim it.

events.text_vi: Tang Tục Lạc mang một sợi tơ lửa, ươm ở miệng phun của Chúc Dung Khẩu, đến Chức Hà Các.
events.text_en: Tang Tục Lạc carries a strand of fire-silk reeled at the vent of Chúc Dung Khẩu to Chức Hà Các.

events.text_vi: Một người giữ dây ở Bàn Căn Đường của Tùng Đào, người đã giữ dây tời trong đêm cây cầu Ngư Ca cuối cùng, sang bờ Lạc Hà theo một lời nhắn không ký tên vào mùa xuân và không trở lại.
events.text_en: A rope-hand of Tùng Đào's Coiled Root Hall, who held the windlass line on the night of the last Ngư Ca bridge, crosses to the Lạc Hà bank on an unsigned word in spring and does not come back.

events.text_vi: Vào buổi sáng hòn đảo trồi lên ở Hà Châu, người coi bến đò của Xuyên Lâm Môn là Đinh Vãn Độ chống thuyền ra đó và cắm cây trượng của Xuyên Lâm Môn xuống bùn của nó.
events.text_en: On the morning the isle rises at Hà Châu, the Gate's ferry warden Đinh Vãn Độ poles out to it and drives the Gate's staff into its mud.

events.text_vi: Trận động đất nâng hòn đảo ở Hà Châu lên cũng chẻ Sơn Khẩu Trại làm đôi từ đầu đến cuối, và Thính Vũ Lâu không phái lính canh trở lại.
events.text_en: The earthquake that raises the isle at Hà Châu splits Sơn Khẩu Trại from end to end, and the Tower does not send its guard back.

events.text_vi: Trúc Thực Viên ghi dòng truyền thừa của mình là Mộc và Thủy.
events.text_en: Trúc Thực Viên writes its lineage as Wood and Water.

legendary_items.story: Stamped the North Star Compact in 510; every writ of war since bears its mark.
legendary_items.name: Bắc Thần Ấn

legendary_items.story: The rebel vassal's spear, taken when Phá Quân Môn was destroyed in 874.
legendary_items.name: Phá Quân Thương

legendary_items.story: Reads the Dipper. It foretold the War of the Pivot, and no one listened.
legendary_items.name: Tuyền Cơ Nghi

legendary_items.story: Lạc Thần Phú: phiên nhược kinh hồng, uyển nhược du long, the line her name comes from. Worn through 1,100 years.
legendary_items.name: Du Long Thao

legendary_items.story: Lý Bạch's monk's zither: như thính vạn hác tùng, like pines in ten thousand ravines.
legendary_items.name: Tùng Phong Cầm

legendary_items.story: One of Vương Bột's twin swords of General Vương's armoury, after which Tử Điện Thành is named. Its twin was lost in 803.
legendary_items.name: Tử Điện

legendary_items.story: The founder Phó Tiêu Tương's, of bamboo from Tương Phi Đảo. Under it Mạnh Dạ Vũ proclaimed the Night Rain Edict.
legendary_items.name: Tương Phi Tán

legendary_items.story: The sect's founding treasure, from Vương Xương Linh's line; its head bears its name.
legendary_items.name: Băng Tâm Ngọc Hồ
legendary_items.gloss: Jade Vessel of the Ice Heart

legendary_items.story: Given with the hills in the Gift of the Empty Mountain (500).
legendary_items.name: Bạch Vân Phất Trần

legendary_items.story: Cửu Thiều's mind-bending instrument, the cause of the Nine Shao judgement. Phượng Minh found it on the empty land; Thiên Xu does not know.
legendary_items.name: Tiêu Thiều Quản
legendary_items.secret: Thiên Xu destroyed a sect over it

legendary_items.story: Xích Thành's war banner, taken in 590, now carried by the sect that revived its fire arts.
legendary_items.name: Xích Hà Kỳ

legendary_items.story: Half of Lạc Anh's twin swords; the school split over them in 610.
legendary_items.name: Phi Hồng

legendary_items.story: Said to hold a sea. Older than the calendar.
legendary_items.name: Quy Khư Bình

legendary_items.story: Tô Thức, Hậu Xích Bích Phú: a lone crane crossing the river from the east.
legendary_items.name: Cô Hạc

legendary_items.story: His master's. It survived the tribulation that killed the master; he has not seen since.
legendary_items.name: Thương Tang Kính

legendary_items.story: The only map of the way into Đào Nguyên Cảnh.
legendary_items.name: Đào Nguyên Đồ

legendary_items.story: Đỗ Mục: chiết kích trầm sa thiết vị tiêu. The marshal Quý Trường Kích's own halberd, under ten thousand bones.
legendary_items.name: Trầm Sa Kích

legendary_items.story: Tử Điện's twin, dropped on the plain in 803.
legendary_items.name: Thanh Sương

legendary_items.story: Whoever holds it commands the army that waits in the realm.
legendary_items.name: Thiết Mã Phù

legendary_items.story: A branch of the tree where the ten suns bathe.
legendary_items.name: Phù Tang Chi

legendary_items.story: Mộc Lan Thi: sóc khí truyền kim thác, hàn quang chiếu thiết y. Hoắc Hàn Quang's sword, sealed with him.
legendary_items.name: Sóc Khí

legendary_items.story: Lý Bạch: the sun on Incense Burner Peak makes purple smoke. Cao Đan Hà's furnace, with the pill that killed her.
legendary_items.name: Tử Yên Lô

legendary_items.story: The marshal's banner, carried off by Lôi Vô Danh. With its tally it raises the army.
legendary_items.name: Thiết Mã Kỳ

legendary_items.story: Cung Hỏa Vân's fan, in the abode where he hid among the vents.
legendary_items.name: Diễm Dương Phiến

legendary_items.story: Lý Bạch: giang thành ngũ nguyệt lạc mai hoa. Lương Lạc Mai's jade flute that is also a blade; her death is still unexplained, and the flute is the clue.
legendary_items.name: Ngũ Nguyệt Mai

legendary_items.story: Mặc Huyết Sinh's brush. His last disciple Triệu Huyết Y is searching for it.
legendary_items.name: Huyết Mặc Bút

legendary_items.story: Khải Lôi's thunder inheritance, sealed by Hầu Xuân Lôi in 470.
legendary_items.name: Xuân Lôi Cổ

legendary_items.story: The other half of Lạc Anh's twin swords, lost with its last head.
legendary_items.name: Tàn Hồng

legendary_items.story: Cô Phàm's compass, left in the harbour the fleet never returned to.
legendary_items.name: Viễn Ảnh Châm

legendary_items.story: Liễu Tông Nguyên: fishing alone in the snow of the cold river.
legendary_items.name: Độc Điếu Can

legendary_items.story: Sầm Tham: snow flies in the eighth month. Under the lava with the school.
legendary_items.name: Phi Tuyết

legendary_items.story: The pirate lord's sabre.
legendary_items.name: Kình Nha

legendary_items.story: After the Kim Cốc garden story and Đỗ Mục's poem; lost in the ashes of 1003.
legendary_items.name: Lục Châu

legendary_items.story: Vân Môn's music, the Thiều's twin.
legendary_items.name: Vân Môn Khánh

eras.name: The Wild Age
eras.gist: Hermits and beasts. Cửu Thiều Cung (70) is the only sect.

eras.name: The Age of First Gates
eras.gist: Thiên Xu and the first great sects open their gates; Thiên Xu claims the heart of the continent. Ends with the War of the Nine Shao, Thiên Xu's first judgement.

eras.name: The Age of Seven Seats
eras.gist: The other great sects are founded and grab land; three old sects end. Ends when Tùng Đào and Lạc Hà try to take the heart and lose the War of the Pivot.

eras.name: The Age of the North Star Compact
eras.gist: Land changes hands only by a fall, a gift, an oath or a war licensed by Thiên Xu's writ. Thiên Xu enforces the Compact.

eras.name: The War of Broken Halberds
eras.gist: Lạc Hà and Thính Vũ break the Compact together; Thiên Xu wins at the cost of its marshal, and the 805 truce renews the Compact.

eras.name: The Age of Vein Wars
eras.gist: No sect dares an open war of conquest; neighbours fight short wars over the wild veins near their borders, and Thiên Xu ends or decides them.

land_changes.how: conquest (no writ; the Pivot let it stand)

wars.name: War of the Nine Shao
wars.outcome: Cửu Thiều Cung destroyed for arts that bent the minds of others' disciples; Thiên Xu takes none of its land. Thiên Xu's first judgement.

wars.name: War of the Frost Coast
wars.outcome: Hàn Giang Môn falls; Hàn Sương Châu goes to Băng Tâm. One of the last land-grabs before the Compact.

wars.name: War of the Pivot
wars.outcome: Tùng Đào and Lạc Hà try to take the heart of the continent, the crossroads of every route. Thiên Xu beats both, takes no land, and imposes the North Star Compact in 510.

wars.name: War of the Vermilion Caves
wars.outcome: Xích Thành Môn had turned to burning villages; Phượng Minh fights it under Thiên Xu's writ and takes Đan Huyệt Châu.

wars.name: War of the Petal Shore
wars.outcome: The two fight over the land of the vanished Lạc Anh Phái; the Pivot's judgement of 620 splits it, the bay to Lạc Hà and the forest to Thính Vũ.

wars.name: Haze-and-Pine War
wars.outcome: Tùng Đào takes the Cold Ford coast with Hàn Tân Thành without a writ; the Pivot lets it stand.

wars.name: Desert Road War
wars.outcome: Over the caravan road between Cô Yên Mạc and Triêu Dương Nguyên. Thiên Xu imposes a truce; no land changes.

wars.name: The Pirate Purge
wars.outcome: Called and led by Thiên Xu with Phượng Minh's and Lạc Hà's fleets; the ma đạo pirates of Thôn Hải Môn are destroyed.

wars.name: War of Broken Halberds
wars.outcome: Lạc Hà and Thính Vũ break the Compact together. The war ends in one day at Chiết Kích Nguyên in 803; Thiên Xu holds but loses its marshal and ten thousand dead; the 805 truce renews the Compact and leaves the poisoned plain empty.

wars.name: Phá Quân Rebellion
wars.outcome: A Thiên Xu vassal that wanted conquest rises against its lord and is destroyed; Cửu Cao Phái receives its holdings.

wars.name: Cold Ford War
wars.outcome: Thúy Vi retakes the Cold Ford coast under Thiên Xu's writ.

wars.name: Long Lake War
wars.outcome: Over Hạo Nguyệt Hồ and its pearls on the Lãnh Nguyệt Lâm border; settled by Thiên Xu's arbitration with no land change.

wars.name: Thunder Vein War
wars.outcome: Phượng Minh tries to take Kinh Lôi Mạch; the Pivot ends the war and Thính Vũ keeps the vein.

wars.name: Taming of Dạ Quang
wars.outcome: The independent desert raiders of Dạ Quang Môn are beaten and made a vassal of Băng Tâm; hence their low loyalty.

wars.name: Cinnabar Vein War
wars.outcome: Thính Vũ attacks Phượng Minh's Đan Sơn Mạch; Thiên Xu steps in on Phượng Minh's side and Thính Vũ is beaten.

wars.name: Ferry War
wars.outcome: Over river tolls on the Ngư Ca border; no land changes.

vassal_lord_changes.how: beaten in the Taming of Dạ Quang

vassal_lord_changes.note: receives the holdings of the destroyed Phá Quân Môn

other_events.text: Chúc Long Sơn erupts under the ice and buries Hồ Thiên Phái; Ngọc Hồ Sơn lies empty until Băng Tâm claims it in 470.
Không Sơn Viện's last master, with no heir, gives Thanh Loan Lĩnh to Phùng Yên Hà, who founds Thúy Vi Tông there (C010). Vân Khởi Quán (540) is founded by the academy's last student.
Cô Phàm Các swears to Lạc Hà Tông; Cô Vụ Đảo becomes Lạc Hà's and the sea sect its vassal until it is lost at sea in 705 (C015).
After the War of the Pivot, Thiên Xu imposes the Bắc Thần Ước (北辰約): land changes hands only by a fall, a gift, an oath or a war licensed by its writ, and it enforces the Compact.
Phó Tiêu Tương, founder of Thính Vũ Lâu, dies; Mạnh Dạ Vũ, then 180, becomes head.
Mạnh Dạ Vũ's Night Rain Edict (Dạ Vũ Lệnh) opens the Tower to ma đạo arts; Thính Vũ Lâu turns to the ma đạo, and its chính vassal Xuyên Lâm Môn cools toward it (user decision 2026-11-15).
Kim Cốc Viên, Lạc Hà's merchant vassal, collapses in a market crash and a great fire; its city in Thu Thủy Loan is left a ruin and Thiên Bảo Trai takes its trade.
Băng Tâm Các claims Tinh Tủy Mạch, Thiên Xu's wild vein near its border, before the Pivot; the claim is rejected and Sở Ngọc Hồ withdraws.

famous_sites.name: Thiết Mã Cảnh
famous_sites.note: Lục Du: thiết mã băng hà nhập mộng lai, armoured horses and frozen rivers come into my dreams. Its gate opens inside Chiết Kích Nguyên, near the barrow; whose war it holds is for the history (#27).

famous_sites.name: Phù Tang Cảnh
famous_sites.note: Sơn Hải Kinh: in the hot valley stands the Phù Tang tree, where the ten suns bathe. Its gate is on the island Dục Nhật Đảo, where the sun bathes.

famous_sites.name: Đào Nguyên Cảnh
famous_sites.gloss: Realm of the Peach Blossom Spring
famous_sites.note: Đào Uyên Minh: a fisherman follows a stream of peach petals through a cave into a hidden valley, and can never find it again. Its gate is a cave by a forest stream.

famous_sites.name: Cố Lũy
famous_sites.note: Tô Thức: cố lũy tây biên, nhân đạo thị Tam Quốc Chu lang Xích Bích, west of the old ramparts, they say, is where the Three Kingdoms fought. Fallen walls on the edge of Chiết Kích Nguyên; whose they were is for the history (#27).

famous_sites.name: Bắc Thần Phúc Địa
famous_sites.gloss: Blessed Land of the North Star
famous_sites.note: Luận Ngữ: like the North Star, which keeps its place while all the stars turn toward it. Around Thiên Xu Tông's seat.

famous_sites.name: Thiên Xích Phúc Địa
famous_sites.gloss: Blessed Land of the Thousand-Foot Pines
famous_sites.note: Đỗ Phủ: thanh tùng hận bất cao thiên xích, I only regret the green pine is not a thousand feet tall. Around Tùng Đào Cung's seat.

famous_sites.name: Địa Linh Phúc Địa
famous_sites.gloss: Blessed Land Where the Earth Is Alive
famous_sites.note: Vương Bột, Đằng Vương Các Tự (the text Lạc Hà is named from): nhân kiệt địa linh, great men where the earth is alive with spirit. Around Lạc Hà Tông's seat.

famous_sites.name: Tuyền Cơ Đài
famous_sites.note: Tuyền cơ, the bowl of the Dipper and the armillary that tracks it. The sect head's retreat.

famous_sites.name: Thạch Thượng Tuyền
famous_sites.note: Vương Duy: minh nguyệt tùng gian chiếu, thanh tuyền thạch thượng lưu; the city Tùng Gian took the first half. The sect head's retreat.

famous_sites.name: Châu Liêm Đình
famous_sites.note: Vương Bột: châu liêm mộ quyển Tây Sơn vũ, at dusk the pearl blinds roll up on the rain over the western hills. The sect head's retreat.

famous_sites.name: Văn Lôi Đài
famous_sites.note: Where the rain the tower listens to turns to thunder. The sect head's retreat.

famous_sites.name: Tố Tâm Động
famous_sites.note: The ice heart in its jade pot, kept plain. The sect head's retreat.

famous_sites.name: Hoành Thúy Đình
famous_sites.note: Lý Bạch: thương thương hoành thúy vi, grey-green, the emerald haze lies across the hills. The sect head's retreat.

famous_sites.name: Bích Ngô Đình
famous_sites.note: Đỗ Phủ: bích ngô thê lão phượng hoàng chi, on the green wutong the old phoenix perches. The sect head's retreat.

doan_ngoc_hanh.note: The Pivot's cautious keeper: stands in the Seven-Star Array behind stone wardens and weighs the foe.

do_tinh_ha.note: Four centuries of the Pivot's wars: stands, weighs, waits, and kills with one called thrust of the rebel's spear.

doan_hi_hoa.note: The named heir: her master's canon at its first layers and an edge she has not learned to sheathe.

thoi_khinh_hong.note: The pine that outlived its founder: endless slow regrowth, roots, and a goose's leap out of every killing blow.

dam_tung_lai.note: A calm teacher who answers force with patience: wave heals, his master's canon, a palm that only answers.

ho_tung_nguyet.note: The sect's first elder and favourite teacher: gentle rain, deep linh lực, and dreams that cultivate on the road.

dam_thanh_giang.note: The head's humble disciple who would rather tend herbs and pills than fight: a healer's canon, a furnace gourd.

to_van_chieu.note: A long-fight caster: the cloud stacks Earth, the glow deepens, and a rain of bought blades finishes what the cloud has weighed.

tram_tich_duong.note: A wall that keeps a tally: he lets the foe spend, then calls the debt with the Ruin Ledger and the Vô Định Tally.

to_mo_van.note: Three good roots and a talisman hand; fights with paper and a seal.

manh_da_vu.note: Hears the blow, drains the foe and cuts once; the canon's first half only, the Regalia's bolt in place of his own Thunder.

quan_vu_thanh.note: A patient, gracious swordswoman of the rain who would rather talk than win; the canon's first half only.

manh_luu_ly.note: Glass-meridian Thunder: all speed and no defence, burning years to break through.

co_da_lan.note: Never lost a duel: a pure Metal root, swords only, one cut drawn out until it lands.

le_tieu_hon.note: Binds, seals and brands from behind a bell, and lets the chained bolts finish what the curses start.

so_ngoc_ho.note: The still Keeper: stands in the Heart in the Jade Vessel stance until her ward is thick, freezes the hour, and seals the foe in frost.

tiet_han_mai.note: The keeper of the lid: frost-lotus seal, glacier bastion, and a mirror for the soul arts.

so_han_y.note: Her master's calm, stubborn disciple: an ice sword and the frost seal, nothing else yet.

ngu_lam_son.note: Never strikes first: haze field, returning light and a slow green heal that outlasts the foe.

quyen_thanh_lam.note: Thúy Vi's diligent, loyal first elder: the sect's fields carried wherever he goes, a steady Earth body under him.

hoa_trieu_duong.note: The singing head: lays five colours of plumage, sings them off as fire and healing, and holds the Shao in reserve.

vu_ngo_dong.note: The wutong where the phoenixes roost: his birds fight first, and the fan finishes.

tham_bac_than.note: The star-reader of Củng Tinh: the finest formation master alive, who reads heaven's secrets before every choice.

tong_toa_van.note: The last student of the empty mountain: an unshakable Dao heart. He sits, banks Clouds, and answers with the hundred-echo palm only if he must.

phan_vat_hoa.note: The treasure-market mistress: a hammer-seal, a bought fate and a pearl grown inside her.

cat_luu_quang.note: The star-iron smith: a stubborn forger who fights with the blades he tempers.

thang_vo_ta.note: The silent sword of Phất Y: a pure blade who held Tư Không Hạc Niên for three days with the same afterimage art.

ung_hac_minh.note: The crane rider: fast on the wind, kind to every beast, and the one crane king that lets no one else ride it fights beside her.

kieu_nguyet_chau.note: The pearl mistress of the moon lake: a reflection that takes the blow, nacre that wraps it, and a fist pearl to finish.

ha_thinh_tung.note: The zither master of ten thousand ravines: songs that march and lull, and a silence that ends them.

nghiem_linh_chi.note: The valley-mistress of the herb fields: a patient grower and brewer who keeps her herbs alive in the gourd.

giang_cuu_khuc.note: The river-fleet master: an anchor, a toll seal and the nine bends.

bui_phieu_binh.note: The strait-crossing master: the tide under him and the wind in the fan.

khau_muc_van.note: The horse lord of the plain: a sturdy body, a lance, and a herd that runs on the wind, his spirit horse first among them.

chau_phi_van.note: The hall-mistress of scribes: a devout talisman maker who lays her paper at dawn and waits.

uc_diep_thanh.note: The rain-forest guide: a bamboo staff and a pressing stance that never stops, honest and stubborn; the Thunder in his root is his own and untaught.

nghe_hong_dau.note: The red-bean mistress: charming at the door and pure poison behind it; the sword at her side is half asleep.

thai_le_tuyet.note: The abbess of the pear-blossom hermitage: a bell, a seal and a moonlit sword.

doan_thanh_lang.note: The frost-coast sea hunter: a harpoon that binds the foe (it cannot flee) and makes its soonest art wait 0.3 s, and a body hardened by cold water.

hang_da_boi.note: The desert raider who knelt and did not forget: blood sabres that cut the horse first.

dong_hong_lo.note: The furnace that never cools: two recipes in one season over volcanic fire. In a fight he piles Burn and lets it wait.

mai_le_tuyen.note: The healer of the sweet spring: a brimming cup of spirit wine, gentle rain and endless regeneration.

ninh_truc_thuc.note: The bamboo breeder: the continent's best spirit farmer. He has stored the Sixty-Year Flower for 160 years and never flowered.

hung_phan_vu.note: The vent-tempered body: a brave, impatient brawler who stands in the lava, burns, and gets back up.

ly_han_bich.note: The grave-ward mistress: a vengeful soul caster who wards the graves, tolls her bell and curses from the dark; her Darkness is her own and untaught.

mac_quy_khu.note: The oldest man alive: a Primordial Chaos root from before the sects, fire and snow, Yin and Yang, time held still, and a clay vase that takes the blow he cannot.

tu_khong_hac_nien.note: The lone crane: a pure Metal sword sage with nothing but the sword, every point spent on the edge, carrying a Wind blade he cannot wake.

trieu_huyet_y.note: The last disciple of Mặc Huyết Sinh: hidden, drained and draining. Beside the Hollow Tide she carries the first six layers of the Blood-Ink Canon (proposal blood-ink-canon, demonic.techniques.json), which she cannot finish without the abode's walls.

lac_dan_thanh.note: The market alchemist who charges what he likes: pills no one else can make, and even his failures come out as pills.

gia_hoi_xuan.note: The apricot-blossom healer: a second spring for whoever others gave up on. Her own needle art is proposed in market-folk.techniques.json (second-spring-needle-art).

kim_van_ly.note: The richest merchant of the west: coins, caches and buried vaults, a gold root who bets badly on purpose.

doan_thuong_hai.note: The blind survivor of a Hóa Thần tribulation: a still lake that hears every move and answers it, scarred against lightning, with a mirror that takes the bolt.

ve_van_co.note: The formation master for hire: his arrays travel with him and stand wherever he is paid to stand them.

lam_da_hac.note: The woodcutter's son with iron bones: an axe, a body that will not break, and no sect to teach him

ta_thanh_loan.note: The bird mother: three bonded birds, a whistle, and a fan of moulted feathers.

hoan_truc_lung.note: Servant; woven-cage-breath (the pavilion's Metal-Earth servant method).

ton_han_thach.note: A shield on the desert road.

quach_lam.note: A ledger with a sword hidden in it.

luc_han_chu.note: A boathook spear and a short temper.

van_tuyet_khanh.note: The Array's next keeper, if there is time.

pham_lanh_van.note: A brush and a frost talisman.

truong_lanh_ha.note: A Water sword in an Ice house.

la_bang_tuyen.note: A strong root with one foot out of the door.

bui_han.note: A young plum with a grudge.

sam_bich_lan.note: A poet in the wrong sect.

trinh_lang.note: A hothead in a cold hall.

co_lang_suong.note: The array on the peak: a frost-lotus seal, a glacier bastion, and a patience no one has outlasted.

tham_han_giang.note: The coast's sword: outlasts, then plum-cuts.

pho_am_huong.note: Five petals of cold and a falling plum: the inner gate's sword in its first form.

khuong_luu_ly.note: The pure Ice duelist: every cut a stack, every fifth a freeze.

on_sa_ngoc.note: The desert's ice: wards and patience on the caravan road.

kha_tinh_ba.note: The vein's warden: shield, armour, bell, and a long stubborn fight.

lam_tuyet_dieu.note: The beast keeper: a frost-wolf pack leader and an ice sable.

nguy_thanh_han.note: The envoy: a frost fan and a quick road home.

vien_chuoc.note: A furnace in the snow: pills first, flame if cornered.

cung_mac_suong.note: An Ice caster with a black edge she does not use in public.

hang_minh_sa.note: A sabre with nowhere to be drawn.

do_suong_nhi.note: The outer gate's keeper: a banner and a warm hand.

ho_tieu_dam.note: The outer gate's hope, one night from the road.

luong_bach_tan.note: The keeper of the tide: a shell, a mirror, and a canon she teaches two ways.

ong_te_do.note: A boat-hook and the stern lamp.

hau_bach_chu.note: A shipwright who refines hulls and keels.

sa_kinh_nhi.note: The fifth heir, at the turn.

tuong_bach_luyen.note: The assayer: he burns off whatever a foe has borrowed.

than_van_cam.note: The weaver: binding threads that burn.

nhiem_thanh_lam.note: Guest; a stand-in Profound Water method from Lam Điện.

nguu_thai_diep.note: Servant; a stand-in Yellow Earth method.

ha_tinh_can.note: The rite without the abbey: she holds it at its full cost, and lately twice.

trieu_ngu_lang.note: Out of the mist, then the axe.

ham_thanh_dang.note: Her lanterns are on every crossroads.

luyen_to_y.note: Holds the lantern, and watches the turnings.

khuyet_lac_vu.note: Loses even the head in her mist.

an_thanh_linh.note: The bell-caster: wards that ring before the blow, and a bronze pour for whoever comes too close.

chung_tan_huong.note: Slow and heavy; a bell and a hammer.

thieu_van_linh.note: Bells in the air, and not yet the one she wants.

phi_thoa_y.note: The Road Mother: a cape that the weather cannot touch, a lamp that will not go out, and a staff that never hurries.

nghiem_quy_khu.note: Fights like a man who knows someone, somewhere, can feel it when he is hurt.

dinh_van_do.note: Heavy and slow; plants himself and stays.

ky_khinh_ma.note: All pressing stance; strikes on the run.

tao_mo_tu.note: A pill-taster who heals slowly and does not fall.

diem_tu_to.note: The cold furnace: great healing he will not spend.

beasts.appearance: A small blue-crested bird with a tail twice its length, the colour of the whistle at her owner's throat.

combat.note: First of the three bonded birds that All Birds Bow (bvc-bird-mother) counts; Call of the Luan (bvc-blue-luan-whistle) answers through it.

bond.rule: Bonded by hand-rearing; it answers the bone whistle and no other note.

beasts.backstory: The chick of the blue-crested bird that died of age on Tạ Thanh Loan's arm in 1105, whose wing bone became her whistle. She reared it in her sleeve that winter and took her name from its mother.

beasts.appearance: A plump brown sparrow that smells of cinnamon bark and sleeps on her left shoulder.

combat.note: Second of the three bonded birds (bvc-bird-mother).

bond.rule: Bonded by hand-rearing.

beasts.backstory: Netted as a fledgling in the cinnamon woods of Nhục Quế Thôn, where the sisters learned to catch birds. It is the one that finds the others when they stray.

beasts.appearance: A fork-tailed black bird with a red eye, the only one of the three that is ever awake.

combat.note: Third of the three bonded birds (bvc-bird-mother); the one that dives first.

bond.rule: Bonded by hand-rearing.

beasts.backstory: She took it out of Huyền Viên Lâm in 1168, the winter the dark apes killed her sister's husband: it was mobbing them alone above the place he fell. It still dives at anything with fur.

beasts.appearance: A long-tailed blue magpie with one white primary, which perches on the lofts' sill and watches the road.

combat.note: Her Beast Pen bird (her route's Lineage birds).

bond.rule: It was Ổ Tùng Lâm's; it chose her after he died.

beasts.backstory: Ổ Tùng Lâm's magpie. It flew home alone from Huyền Viên Lâm in 1168, three days before the news did, and has not left the moulting lofts since.

beasts.appearance: A white sable draped across her shoulders, so still it is taken for a fur.

combat.note: Her Ice companion; her build's Ice stacks and companion nodes serve it and the wolf.

bond.rule: Raised from a kit inside her coat.

beasts.backstory: The sable kit Lam Tuyết Điêu carried inside her coat when she came to the Pavilion. It has grown with her into a Kết Đan beast, which no other sable of the Beast Hall has done.

beasts.species: frost wolf, leader of the Beast Hall pack
beasts.appearance: A big grey-white wolf with a black stripe down its spine and frost in its ruff.

combat.note: The frost-wolf pack leader her build's companion health and power nodes are for.

bond.rule: Raised at the Beast Hall from a pup.

beasts.backstory: Grandson of the tundra wolf that came with her from Tuyết Lang Nguyên. It leads the Beast Hall's frost-wolf pack, and it was the first to grow restless when the vein began to warm.

beasts.species: grey crane of the winter terrace
beasts.appearance: A grey crane with frost-white wingtips that stands on one leg in any gale.

combat.note: The crane A Crane for the Rider (crane-bond-rite) reads through the `crane` tag; his build's Wind Edge strike.

bond.rule: Bonded by shared breath; it takes no other rider after its rider dies (cuu_cao.md section 4).

beasts.backstory: The winter terrace's lead crane. Cừ Vân Lý breathed with it on his first winter flight in 1160 and has flown it every winter since; it has never flown the vein circuit (A096), and he means it never to.

beasts.species: crane chick of the nine marshes
beasts.appearance: A lame, half-fledged crane chick, all knees and down, usually under her arm.

combat.note: Her Beast Den companion; weak, and it will stay weak until it can fly.

bond.rule: Kept, not bonded: she has no Wind to breathe with it, so it is hers by feeding only.

beasts.backstory: Hatched lame in the breeding reeds in 1199. The crane doctor wanted to cull it; Mai Lô Tuyết, who has never been off the ground, carried it home instead.

beasts.gloss: Green Field, after the marsh ground where it was first seen
beasts.appearance: A grey-crowned crane half again the height of the flock, wings broad as a boat's sail, with the founder's Green Field Bell tied to its leg.

combat.note: A companion share under Formulas J: Wind strikes on the rider's basic_cooldown; it takes the rider's attack_pct [companion]; 'beside you' (duel-readings R1) counts it. A Crane for the Rider (crane-bond-rite) reads its hits through the `crane` tag, and Rider and King (cc-green-field-riders set) answers each evade with one of its Wind strikes.

bond.rule: It carries no other rider. A crane bonds once by shared breath and takes no other rider after its rider dies (cuu_cao.md section 4).

beasts.backstory: The crane king of the nine marshes, which had thrown every rider who tried it for three centuries. In 1197 Ung Hạc Minh breathed with it on its first flight and it let her stay on (A097). It still throws anyone else, and has thrown the envoy Vi Thừa Phong twice.

beasts.appearance: A grey lynx with black ear tufts, always at his heel.

combat.note: The lynx in front (his Beast Den node).

bond.rule: Raised from a kit he did not sell.

beasts.backstory: The one kit of a litter Quản Tuyết Tung kept instead of selling at Quy Điểu Trấn's ice market. It hunts with him in Lãnh Nguyệt Lâm and will not go near Quần Lang Lâm.

beasts.appearance: A grey ridge hound with a scarred muzzle that never barks.

combat.note: The hound his build's Beast Den node and Metal pins work with.

bond.rule: Raised from a pup on the beast trails.

beasts.backstory: A pup of the cave hunters' hounds of Thủ Động Trại. It hunted the tiger-kind of Phục Hổ Cương beside Ân Thủ Sơn and Bành Liệp Hổ, and it helped him carry Bành's body down in 1195.

beasts.appearance: A grey stallion a hand taller than any horse on the plain, dappled like cloud, its muzzle gone white.

combat.note: The companion of mv-horse-lord, Horse and Rider Bear It Together (mv-dap-van-bridle-ring) and Turn the Herd (mv-cloud-herding-lance); it wears the Packmate Collar (wood-packmate-collar). The Long Ride counts its hits.

bond.rule: Born the same night as its rider; it has let no one else ride it.

beasts.backstory: Foaled in the manor's stable in Thanh Điền the night Khấu Mục Vân was born (A169), and named Cloud-Treader by him. It has carried him in thirty-one festival races and lost none. The grooms say it has grown slow this decade.

beasts.appearance: A short-coupled chestnut mare with a mane like a grass fire and a temper to match.

combat.note: The horse The Long Ride (cloud-herd-body-canon) counts for him.

bond.rule: Broken to the saddle by him in 1116, at the cost of his lip.

beasts.backstory: The mare whose hoof split Tần Thiên Lý's lip when he broke her in 1116. In the snow of 1121 (A171) she was the one horse of his string that lived, and he built the herds back from her foals.

beasts.appearance: A red-crested messenger bird with a green back, riding his right shoulder.

combat.note: One of the bird companions The Birds Fight First (pm-wutong-court) and Birds Pay Court to the Phoenix (five-virtue-phoenix-canon) count.

bond.rule: Hatched in the Wutong aviary and raised by his hand.

beasts.backstory: The eldest writ bird of the Wutong Court. It carries only the head's own letters and goes to no other shoulder.

beasts.species: fighting bird of the great wutong
beasts.appearance: A hawk-sized red bird on his left shoulder whose tail feathers end in black char.

combat.note: His fighting bird: the other bird companion of The Birds Fight First (pm-wutong-court).

bond.rule: Hatched in the great wutong and raised by his hand.

beasts.backstory: One of the fighting birds that roost in the great wutong. Its tail was scorched in the Cinnabar Vein War in 1154 and grew back black, and the ridge children call it the coal bird.

beasts.gloss: Fish-Dog (an old name for the kingfisher)
beasts.appearance: A blue-backed kingfisher that never leaves her collar.

combat.note: The bird half that The Birds Bring the Fire (pm-wutong-twig-ring) reads.

bond.rule: Hatched in the aviary; it chose her collar and has not left it.

beasts.backstory: An Thúy Vũ calls it by the old name for its kind. Vu Ngô Đồng calls it the fish-dog, loudly, and it bites him.

beasts.appearance: A silver marten asleep around her neck, which passes for a fur collar until it opens an eye.

combat.note: The marten her Beast Pen route and the Beast Soul Union serve.

bond.rule: Bred in the Marten Yard and raised on her shoulder.

beasts.backstory: The eleventh marten to sleep on Lô Dã Hương's collar, and the best nose the Yard has bred. Hồng Lô Cốc has offered for it twice.

beasts.species: spirit cow, lead of the cape herd
beasts.appearance: A dun spirit cow with one horn broken short, who walks at the head of the herd and stops when the flute stops.

combat.note: The herd's lead, the companion his Beast Pen route plays into the foe.

bond.rule: Raised to the flute.

beasts.backstory: The lead cow of Thúy Vi's spirit herd on the cape. Uông Mục Địch has played to her for ninety years, and she has stood listening at each of his three failed breakthroughs.

beasts.appearance: A sleek grey fur seal with a torn flipper, who brings her the first fish of every dive.

combat.note: Her companion in the surf; her build takes no companion node.

bond.rule: Raised from a pup on the terrace.

beasts.backstory: The first of the two fur seals Đoàn Tố Ba tamed. It fishes for her and follows her deeper than any diver goes.

beasts.appearance: A small dark fur seal that barks at the Old Ivory and at no one else.

combat.note: Her second seal.

bond.rule: Raised from a pup on the terrace.

beasts.backstory: The younger seal. It will not go near the boats of Ngạc Hải Tiêu's crew.

beasts.appearance: A grey-backed eagle on her shoulder, hooded indoors.

combat.note: The eagle that spots for her bow (her Beast Pen node).

bond.rule: Taken from the nest in the northern forest and raised by her.

beasts.backstory: Taken as an eyas above Liệp Hộ Thôn. It followed her south after the wolf pack in the winter of 1190 and spotted for her on the third night (A064).
